Pet Dagannoth Supreme.title: Pet Dagannoth Supreme
Pet Dagannoth Supreme.intro: The Pet Dagannoth Supreme is a pet dropped by the Dagannoth Supreme . It is a much smaller version of Dagannoth Supreme.

Pet Dagannoth Prime.title: Pet Dagannoth Prime
Pet Dagannoth Prime.intro: The Pet Dagannoth Prime is a pet dropped by the Dagannoth Prime . It is a much smaller version of Dagannoth Prime.

Pet chaos elemental.title: Pet chaos elemental
Pet chaos elemental.intro: The pet chaos elemental is a pet that resembles the miniature chaotic clouds that inhabit the area where the Chaos Fanatic resides, and can be obtained by killing the Chaos Elemental or the Chaos Fanatic .

Pet Dagannoth Rex.title: Pet Dagannoth Rex
Pet Dagannoth Rex.intro: The Pet Dagannoth Rex is a pet dropped by the Dagannoth Rex . It is a miniature version of Dagannoth Rex.

Pet Penance Queen.title: Pet Penance Queen
Pet Penance Queen.intro: The Pet Penance Queen is a pet obtained from high level gambles in Barbarian Assault . It is a much smaller version of the Penance Queen . Players have a 1 in 1,000 chance of obtaining it from a high level gamble .

Pet Kree'arra.title: Pet Kree'arra
Pet Kree'arra.intro: Pet Kree'arra is a pet dropped by Kree'arra . It is a much smaller version of Kree'arra . Upon completing the dialogue with this pet, it will trigger the death animation of Kree'arra and disappear for approximately 5 seconds before reappearing in the same place.

Pet K'ril Tsutsaroth.title: Pet K'ril Tsutsaroth
Pet K'ril Tsutsaroth.intro: Pet K'ril Tsutsaroth is a pet dropped by K'ril Tsutsaroth . It is a much smaller version of K'ril Tsutsaroth . If any surrounding players have their area sounds on, they will be able to hear the pet stomping.

Pet General Graardor.title: Pet General Graardor
Pet General Graardor.intro: Pet General Graardor is a pet dropped by General Graardor . It is a much smaller version of General Graardor . If any surrounding players have their area sounds on, they would be able to hear the pet stomping.

Pet Zilyana.title: Pet Zilyana
Pet Zilyana.intro: The Pet Zilyana is a pet dropped by Commander Zilyana . It is a much smaller version of Commander Zilyana .

Baby Mole.title: Baby Mole
Baby Mole.intro: Baby Mole is a miniature version of the giant mole and is dropped by the aforementioned boss at a rate of 1/3,000. Players can change the skin of their baby mole pet to a baby mole-rat skin, which looks similar to the baby mole NPCs , by using a mole claw on their pet. Using a mole skin on the pet will turn it back into a regular baby mole.

Kalphite Princess.title: Kalphite Princess
Kalphite Princess.intro: The Kalphite Princess is a pet dropped by the Kalphite Queen . It is a much smaller version of the Kalphite Queen. Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change its form.

Prince Black Dragon.title: Prince Black Dragon
Prince Black Dragon.intro: The Prince Black Dragon is a pet dropped by the King Black Dragon . It is a much smaller version of the King Black Dragon.

Pet Smoke Devil.title: Pet Smoke Devil
Pet Smoke Devil.intro: The pet smoke devil is a pet dropped by the Thermonuclear smoke devil . It is a much smaller version of the ( Thermonuclear ) smoke devil . Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change between the regular smoke devil and the thermonuclear smoke devil.

Pet Kraken.title: Pet Kraken
Pet Kraken.intro: The pet kraken is a pet dropped by the Kraken . It is a much smaller version of the Cave kraken .

Pet dark core.title: Pet dark core
Pet dark core.intro: The pet dark core is a pet dropped by the Corporeal Beast . It is the dark energy core that is summoned during the fight with the Corporeal Beast. Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change between the dark core and the Corporeal Critter, which is a smaller version of the Corporeal Beast.

Chompy chick.title: Chompy chick
Chompy chick.intro: The Chompy chick is a pet that can be received as a rare drop from chompy birds ( not jubbly birds ), and can only be obtained by players who have completed the elite Western Provinces diary and received its rewards. There is a chance to receive the pet when the chompy bird is killed and when it is plucked.

Venenatis spiderling.title: Venenatis spiderling
Venenatis spiderling.intro: The Venenatis spiderling is a pet dropped by Venenatis and Spindel , and is a much smaller version of it. Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change between its regular and legacy forms, the latter which uses the former appearance of the pet prior to 25 January 2023.

Pet Snakeling.title: Pet Snakeling
Pet Snakeling.intro: The Pet Snakeling is a pet dropped by Zulrah . It resembles the appearance of the snakelings that Zulrah summons during the fight. Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change it between its normal, magma, or tanzanite form.

Callisto cub.title: Callisto cub
Callisto cub.intro: The Callisto cub is a pet dropped by Callisto and Artio , and is a much smaller version of them. Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change between its regular and legacy forms, the latter of which uses the former appearance of the pet prior to 25 January 2023.

Vet'ion jr..title: Vet'ion Jr.
Vet'ion jr..intro: Vet'ion Jr. is a pet dropped by Vet'ion and Calvar'ion . It is a much smaller version of Vet'ion . Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change between its normal and reborn form, as well as legacy forms of both, which uses the former appearance of the pet prior to 25 January 2023.

Scorpia's offspring.title: Scorpia's offspring
Scorpia's offspring.intro: Scorpia's offspring is a pet dropped by Scorpia . It is similar in appearance to the offspring encountered during the fight with Scorpia, but is slightly larger and has a unique colour scheme.

Hellpuppy.title: Hellpuppy
Hellpuppy.intro: When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat ), it will be placed into their inventory . When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your

TzRek-Jad.title: TzRek-Jad
TzRek-Jad.intro: The TzRek-Jad (translated as Baby Fire Elemental ) is a pet that can be obtained via defeating TzTok-Jad in the TzHaar Fight Cave . It is a much smaller version of TzTok-Jad . Players are twice as likely to receive the pet upon defeating TzTok-Jad if they are assigned to defeat it on a Slayer task. In addition, players may exchange their fire capes by speaking to TzHaar-Mej-Jal for a 1/200 chance of obtaining TzRek-Jad. Provid

Abyssal orphan.title: Abyssal orphan
Abyssal orphan.intro: The Abyssal orphan is a boss pet that resembles the scions that are encountered during the Abyssal Sire boss fight.

Phoenix.title: Phoenix
Phoenix.intro: The Phoenix is a pet that can be received from looting the Reward Cart , from which rewards are obtained by subduing the Wintertodt with at least 500 points.

Olmlet.title: Olmlet
Olmlet.intro: The Olmlet is a pet obtained from the Chambers of Xeric . It is a much smaller version of the Great Olm , with its body fully visible. Players have a 1/53 chance of receiving the pet when they receive an item from the unique drop table after killing the Great Olm.

Skotos.title: Skotos
Skotos.intro: Skotos is a pet dropped by Skotizo . It is a much smaller version of Skotizo. The pet has one of the highest drop rates for a one-off pet at 1/65; this is due to the time it takes to assemble a dark totem being taken into account.

Jal-Nib-Rek.title: Jal-Nib-Rek
Jal-Nib-Rek.intro: The Jal-Nib-Rek (roughly translated as Foreign Nibbler Baby/Young ) is a Jal-Nib dropped by TzKal-Zuk upon completion of the Inferno . The standard drop rate is 1/100, but this is increased to 1/75 if TzKal-Zuk is defeated while on a Slayer task. Players may also exchange their infernal capes by speaking to TzHaar-Ket-Keh for a 1/100 chance of obtaining the pet. Providing a player defeats TzKal-Zuk while on a slayer task for a

Noon.title: Noon
Noon.intro: Noon is a pet dropped by the Grotesque Guardians . It is a much smaller version of Dawn . Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change between Noon and Midnight, a smaller version of Dusk . When following a player, Noon makes a flapping sound which can only be turned off by muting Area Sounds.

Vorki.title: Vorki
Vorki.intro: Vorki is a pet dropped by Vorkath . It is a much smaller version of Vorkath .

Lil' Zik.title: Lil' Zik
Lil' Zik.intro: Lil' Zik is a pet that can be obtained from completing the Theatre of Blood . It is a much smaller version of Verzik Vitur 's final form. Players have a chance of receiving the pet when looting the monumental chests in Verzik's treasure vault. The drop rate is dependent on the player's performance in the raid, unaffected by that of teammates, ranging from 1/650 to 1/6,500 in regular raids and ranging from 1/500 to 1/5,000 in H

Ikkle Hydra.title: Ikkle Hydra
Ikkle Hydra.intro: The Ikkle Hydra is a pet dropped by the Alchemical Hydra , and is a much smaller version of the Hydra. Players may change the pet's appearance via the " Metamorphosis " option to its green, blue, red, or black appearance (with the respective amount of heads like in the boss encounter).

Sraracha.title: Sraracha
Sraracha.intro: Sraracha is a pet dropped by Sarachnis , and is a much smaller version of the boss. Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change its form, providing they have used an orange or blue egg sac to unlock its other coloured forms.

Youngllef.title: Youngllef
Youngllef.intro: The Youngllef is a pet received from the reward chest in the Gauntlet . It is a smaller version of the Crystalline Hunllef . Upon completion of the Corrupted Gauntlet , players unlock the right click " Metamorphosis " option to change between the regular Youngllef and the corrupted Youngllef variant. The pet will always be received in the regular form, even if it is obtained from the Corrupted Gauntlet.

Smolcano.title: Smolcano
Smolcano.intro: Smolcano is a pet dropped by Zalcano . It is a much smaller version of Zalcano.

Lil' Creator.title: Lil' Creator
Lil' Creator.intro: The Lil' Creator is a pet obtained from spoils of war in Soul Wars . It is a much smaller version of the Avatar of Creation . Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change between Lil' Creator and Lil' Destructor, which is a smaller version of the Avatar of Destruction .

Tiny tempor.title: Tiny tempor
Tiny tempor.intro: Tiny Tempor is a pet obtained from the reward pool in the Ruins of Unkah . It is a much smaller version of the Tempoross .

Nexling.title: Nexling
Nexling.intro: When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat ), it will be placed into their inventory . When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your

Abyssal protector.title: Abyssal protector
Abyssal protector.intro: Abyssal protector is a pet that can be obtained from the Rewards Guardian . It is a much smaller version of the Abyssal guardians found within the Guardians of the Rift minigame .

Muphin.title: Muphin
Muphin.intro: Muphin is a pet dropped by the Phantom Muspah , and is a much smaller version of it. Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change between its ranged, melee, and shielded forms, providing they have used a charged ice on it to unlock the latter two forms.

Wisp.title: Wisp
Wisp.intro: Wisp is a pet dropped by The Whisperer . It is a much smaller version of her.

Butch.title: Butch
Butch.intro: Butch is a pet dropped by Vardorvis . It is a much smaller version of him.

Baron.title: Baron
Baron.intro: Baron is a pet dropped by Duke Sucellus . It is a much much smaller version of him.

Lil'viathan.title: Lil'viathan
Lil'viathan.intro: Lil'viathan is a pet dropped by The Leviathan . It is a much smaller version of it.

Scurry.title: Scurry
Scurry.intro: Scurry is a pet dropped by Scurrius . It is a much smaller version of Scurrius. When spoken to, it has three distinct personalities: Scurry , the main (melee) rat, Chewy , the ranged rat, and Nibbles , the mage rat.

Smol Heredit.title: Smol Heredit
Smol Heredit.intro: Smol Heredit is a pet that can be obtained from completing the Fortis Colosseum after defeating Sol Heredit . Players have a 1/200 chance of obtaining him. Alternatively, players can exchange Dizana's quiver to Minimus for another 1/200 chance to obtain him. Unlike other boss pets, Smol Heredit is considered a main drop and will be shown accordingly on the colosseum interface upon reaching the final wave.

Nid.title: Nid
Nid.intro: Nid is an araxyte pet dropped by Araxxor . It is a much smaller version of Araxxor . Players can right click " Metamorph " to change between Nid and Rax by using the coagulated venom , which unlocks the ability to do so.

Huberte.title: Huberte
Huberte.intro: Huberte is a pet dropped by the Hueycoatl . It is a much smaller version of her.

Moxi.title: Moxi
Moxi.intro: When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat ), it will be placed into their inventory . When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your

Bran.title: Bran
Bran.intro: Bran is a pet dropped by the Royal Titans . It is a much smaller version of Branda the Fire Queen . Players can right click " Metamorphosis " to change between Bran and Ric, a smaller version of Eldric the Ice King .

Yami.title: Yami
Yami.intro: When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower; Unlike other pets, Yami will initially spawn in front of Yama's throne with a cloud of smoke similar to those of imps , saying Oh no. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat ), it will be plac

Gull.title: Gull
Gull.intro: Gulls are birds found flying around Gielinor . They can mostly be found near the sea. They have no use besides making the game more immersive, and can only be examined.

Beef.title: Beef
Beef.intro: When a player receives the pet, it will automatically try to appear as their follower. At the same time, a message in the chatbox will state You have a funny feeling like you're being followed. However, if a player receives a pet while having a follower out (for example, a cat ), it will be placed into their inventory . When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your

Aggy.title: Aggy
Aggy.intro: Aggy is a pet that can be obtained from defeating the Mad Angel , being a much smaller version of it.

Giant Squirrel.title: Giant Squirrel
Giant Squirrel.intro: The giant squirrel is a skilling pet that can be obtained after completion of an Agility course , as well as from tagging marked ticket dispensers within the Brimhaven Agility Arena .

Heron.title: Heron
Heron.intro: The heron is a members-only skilling pet that can be obtained while training Fishing . The chances of getting it are dependent on the player's Fishing level, and the time it takes to gather a resource.

Baby chinchompa.title: Baby chinchompa
Baby chinchompa.intro: The baby chinchompa is a skilling pet that can be obtained while catching any kind of chinchompa . The chances of getting it are dependent on the player's Hunter level.

Herbi.title: Herbi
Herbi.intro: Herbi is a pet obtained from hunting herbiboars found in Fossil Island 's Mushroom Forest . There is a 1/6,500 chance to receive the pet as the player harvests the herbs from the herbiboar.

Quetzin.title: Quetzin
Quetzin.intro: Quetzin (pronounced ket-zin) is a pet that can be obtained from completing Hunters' Rumours in the Hunter Guild by opening hunters' loot sacks .

Rock golem.title: Rock golem
Rock golem.intro: The rock golem is a members-only skilling pet that can be obtained while training Mining . The chances of getting it are dependent on the player's Mining level, and the time it takes to gather a resource.

Rift guardian.title: Rift guardian
Rift guardian.intro: The rift guardian is a members-only skilling pet that can be obtained while training Runecraft . The chances of getting it are dependent on the player's Runecraft level, the rune the player is crafting, and the number of essence used. Upon using the Guardian's eye on it, which is purchased from the Guardians of the Rift reward shop for 3,000 abyssal pearls , players unlock a permanent metamorphosis option to turn it into the G

Rocky.title: Rocky
Rocky.intro: Rocky is a skilling pet that can be obtained when training the Thieving skill. This includes stealing from stalls, pickpocketing from NPCs, picking fruit in the Sorceress's Garden , and looting grand gold chests within Pyramid Plunder . The chances of getting it are dependent on the player's Thieving level, and the person/object the player is stealing from.

Beaver.title: Beaver
Beaver.intro: The beaver is a members-only skilling pet that can be obtained while training Woodcutting . A strange sound is heard when you obtain the beaver while Woodcutting. The chances of getting it are dependent on the player's Woodcutting level, the base drop chance for a given tree, and the rate of successfully chopping logs.

Tangleroot.title: Tangleroot
Tangleroot.intro: The tangleroot is a skilling pet that can be obtained when checking the health (for patches that have this option, like fruit trees ) or when harvesting the final crop (for patches without a "Check-health" option) of a farming patch . It may also be obtained while playing the Tithe Farm minigame or from killing the Hespori . The chances of getting it are dependent on the player's Farming level and the crop the player is harves

Soup.title: Soup
Soup.intro: Soup is a skilling pet that can be obtained while training the Sailing skill.

Little Nightmare.title: Little Nightmare
Little Nightmare.intro: The Little Nightmare is a pet that can be obtained by defeating The Nightmare or Phosani's Nightmare . It is a much smaller version of her. The pet has a 1/800 drop rate in the original encounter, decreasing for every additional player in the room when the fight started: 1/1600 in a duo, 1/2400 in a trio, 1/3200 in a 4-man and 1/4000 in a 5-or-higher-man encounter. At Phosani's Nightmare, the pet has a flat 1/1400 drop rate.

Dom.title: Dom
Dom.intro: Dom is a pet dropped by the Doom of Mokhaiotl , and is a much smaller version of it. Dom can only be dropped upon completion of delve level of 6 or higher.

Tumeken's guardian.title: Tumeken's guardian
Tumeken's guardian.intro: Tumeken's Guardian is a pet that can be obtained from completing the Tombs of Amascut . It is a much smaller version of Tumeken's Warden . Players have a chance of receiving the pet when looting the reward chest in the burial chamber. It is possible for it to be obtained in Entry mode, although at a much lower rate.

Bloodhound.title: Bloodhound
Bloodhound.intro: The Bloodhound is a pet that can be received as a rare reward from master Treasure Trails at a rate of 1/1,000. Like dogs , the Bloodhound can be used to dig for Treasure Trail steps.

Maggot marquess.title: Maggot marquess
Maggot marquess.intro: Maggot marquess is a pet that can be obtained from defeating the Maggot King , being a much smaller version of it.

Mr McGroot.title: Mr McGroot
Mr McGroot.intro: Mr McGroot is a pet obtained from hunting goats on Wyrmscraig , a Hunter training method.

Abyssal Sire.title: Abyssal Sire
Abyssal Sire.intro: The Abyssal Sire is an abyssal demon Slayer boss that requires level 85 Slayer to kill. To access the boss, the player must have visited the Abyss at least once, either through the Mage of Zamorak or the Fairy Ring network . As with all other Slayer bosses, the Sire can only be fought when assigned abyssal demons (outside of Krystilia ) or itself as a Slayer task . Although it resides in a multi-combat area, it is a solo-only

Unsired.title: Unsired
Unsired.intro: An unsired is an untradeable item dropped by the Abyssal Sire . They are to be placed at the Font of Consumption , which consumes the unsired, but gives the player a reward in the process.

Abyssal head.title: Abyssal head
Abyssal head.intro: An abyssal head is a rare drop from abyssal demons , requiring 85 Slayer to kill. Players may also obtain an abyssal head by placing an unsired at the Font of Consumption; this has a 5/64 chance, and as an unsired is a 1/100 drop, this effectively makes it a 1/1,280 drop per Abyssal Sire kill.

Bludgeon spine.title: Bludgeon spine
Bludgeon spine.intro: The bludgeon spine is one of three pieces that can be combined with the bludgeon axon and bludgeon claw to make an abyssal bludgeon by speaking to The Overseer , who combines the three parts for the player. If a player has already had the Overseer construct one, they will be required to use the parts on the Overseer's book instead.

Bludgeon claw.title: Bludgeon claw
Bludgeon claw.intro: The bludgeon claw is one of three pieces that can be combined with the bludgeon axon and bludgeon spine to make an abyssal bludgeon by speaking to The Overseer , who combines the three parts for the player. If a player has already had the Overseer construct one, they will be required to use the parts on the Overseer's book instead.

Bludgeon axon.title: Bludgeon axon
Bludgeon axon.intro: The bludgeon axon is one of three pieces that can be combined with the bludgeon spine and bludgeon claw to make an abyssal bludgeon by speaking to The Overseer , who combines the three parts for the player. If a player has already had the Overseer construct one, they will be required to use the parts on the Overseer's book instead.

Jar of Miasma.title: Jar of Miasma
Jar of Miasma.intro: The jar of miasma is an item that can be obtained from using the unsired , dropped by the Abyssal Sire , on the Font of Consumption . Players have a 13/128 chance of receiving one when doing so. As an unsired is a 1/100 drop, this effectively makes the chances of obtaining a jar 1/984.

Abyssal dagger.title: Abyssal dagger
Abyssal dagger.intro: The abyssal dagger is the most powerful dagger in the game and requires 70 Attack to wield. Players have a 13/64 (~20.3%) chance of receiving an abyssal dagger when using an unsired on the Font of Consumption at the centre of the Abyssal Nexus , giving it effectively a chance of 1/492 (~0.20%) per Abyssal Sire kill. Players also have a 1/32,000 (~0.003%) chance of receiving an abyssal dagger as a drop from abyssal demons .

Abyssal whip.title: Abyssal whip
Abyssal whip.intro: The abyssal whip is a one-handed melee weapon which requires an Attack level of 70 to wield. It can be obtained as a drop from abyssal demons or from sacrificing an unsired .

Alchemical Hydra.title: Alchemical Hydra
Alchemical Hydra.intro: The Alchemical Hydra is a boss version of hydra , found in the lower level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm , requiring level 95 Slayer to kill. The Alchemical Hydra was the creation of a Dragonkin named Karuulm . While Karuulm saw promise in his creation, he nevertheless saw it as a failure because he could not replicate its traits, and abandoned it along with his other creations: the Wyrms , Drakes , and Hydras

Hydra's claw.title: Hydra's claw
Hydra's claw.intro: The hydra's claw is an item dropped by the Alchemical Hydra . It can be combined with the Zamorakian hasta to create the dragon hunter lance .

Hydra tail.title: Hydra tail
Hydra tail.intro: The hydra tail is an item dropped by hydras and the Alchemical Hydra . It can be combined with the dragonbone necklace and bonecrusher to create the bonecrusher necklace , which combines the effects of both. There will be a confirmation message before combining them; this can be reversed.

Hydra leather.title: Hydra leather
Hydra leather.intro: Hydra leather is dropped by the Alchemical Hydra . It is used to make ferocious gloves , by placing it on the piece of machinery just south-west of the large pool in Lithkren Vault , requiring Dragon Slayer II and a hammer . The gloves can be reverted to leather using the same machinery.

Hydra's fang.title: Hydra's fang
Hydra's fang.intro: The Hydra's fang is an item dropped by hydras and the Alchemical Hydra . It can be combined with the Hydra's eye and heart to create the brimstone ring .

Hydra's eye.title: Hydra's eye
Hydra's eye.intro: The Hydra's eye is an item dropped by hydras and the Alchemical Hydra . It can be combined with the Hydra's fang and heart to create the brimstone ring .

Hydra's heart.title: Hydra's heart
Hydra's heart.intro: The Hydra's heart is an item dropped by hydras and the Alchemical Hydra . It can be combined with the Hydra's eye and fang to create the brimstone ring .

Dragon knife.title: Dragon knife
Dragon knife.intro: The dragon knife is a throwing knife that requires a Ranged level of 60 to wield. It is the most powerful type of throwing knife available. They can be obtained as a drop from wyrms , drakes , and hydras . They can be poisoned and can be wielded with a shield or god book for protection.

Dragon thrownaxe.title: Dragon thrownaxe
Dragon thrownaxe.intro: The dragon thrownaxe , like all thrownaxes , is a members -only Ranged throwing weapon and is the most powerful type of throwing axe. It is obtained as a drop from wyrms , drakes , hydras , and the Alchemical Hydra .

Jar of Chemicals.title: Jar of Chemicals
Jar of Chemicals.intro: The jar of chemicals is a rare drop from the Alchemical Hydra that can be found in the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon .

Alchemical hydra heads.title: Alchemical hydra heads
Alchemical hydra heads.intro: Alchemical hydra heads are a rare drop from the Alchemical Hydra . They can be stuffed at the taxidermist in Canifis by using the item on her and paying 50,000 coins, returning stuffed hydra heads . When shown the heads, she will say, "This hydra looks like it might fall to pieces soon. I'll have to be careful to preserve it properly."

The Gauntlet.title: The Gauntlet
The Gauntlet.intro: The Gauntlet is a solo minigame in Prifddinas in which the player is given a limited amount of time to explore a randomly generated dungeon layout, gather various resources and supplies by skilling and defeating crystalline monsters, all in preparation to defeat the Crystalline Hunllef , which is based upon a deadly wolf-like predator from the elven homeworld of Tarddiad . The Gauntlet was created as a training ground by the A

Crystal armour seed.title: Crystal armour seed
Crystal armour seed.intro: The crystal armour seed is an elven crystal that can be turned into crystal armour at a singing bowl . Completing the Gauntlet will yield a chance of gaining these seeds and combining them with crystal shards can be used to create the armour pieces.

Crystal weapon seed.title: Crystal weapon seed
Crystal weapon seed.intro: A crystal weapon seed is an elven crystal that can be turned into crystal weapons . Completing the Gauntlet will yield a chance of gaining these seeds. The crystal weapon seed can be bought from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 12 Last Man Standing points.

Enhanced crystal weapon seed.title: Enhanced crystal weapon seed
Enhanced crystal weapon seed.intro: The enhanced crystal weapon seed is an enhanced version of the crystal weapon seed that can be obtained as a rare drop from the Gauntlet . With level 82 Smithing and Crafting (the levels can be boosted ), it can be sung into either the Blade of Saeldor or Bow of Faerdhinen at a singing bowl . If the player does not meet the Smithing and Crafting requirements, they can have Conwenna or Reese sing the crystal for them for an ext

Gauntlet cape.title: Gauntlet cape
Gauntlet cape.intro: The gauntlet cape is a cosmetic cape that is obtained after completing the Corrupted Gauntlet , after which it will automatically appear inside the players' inventory. If a player has one in their bank or cape rack , they will not receive another. The cape is lost upon death if not protected.

Zulrah.title: Zulrah
Zulrah.intro: Zulrah is a level 725 solo-only snake boss . Before the player can fight Zulrah, players must have completed Regicide to the point of reaching Port Tyras , as well as having spoken with High Priestess Zul-Harcinqa to offer themselves as the sacrifice in place of the gnome child , as Zul-Gwenwynig will prevent the player from boarding the boat until Zul-Harcinqa allows them to be the sacrifice.

Tanzanite mutagen.title: Tanzanite mutagen
Tanzanite mutagen.intro: A tanzanite mutagen is an untradeable item dropped by Zulrah . It allows a player to cosmetically recolour their serpentine helm to a turquoise coloured tanzanite helm . The mutagen is consumed upon use.

Magma mutagen.title: Magma mutagen
Magma mutagen.intro: A magma mutagen is an untradeable item dropped by Zulrah . It allows a player to cosmetically recolour their serpentine helm to a magma helm . The mutagen is consumed upon use.

Jar of Swamp.title: Jar of Swamp
Jar of Swamp.intro: The jar can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of Zulrah. Doing so requires having defeated Zulrah at least once.

Magic fang.title: Magic fang
Magic fang.intro: The magic fang is obtained from killing Zulrah . With level 59 Crafting , it can be used with a chisel and either a staff of the dead or an uncharged trident of the seas to create the toxic staff of the dead or trident of the swamp , respectively.

Serpentine visage.title: Serpentine visage
Serpentine visage.intro: The serpentine visage is obtained from killing Zulrah . With level 52 Crafting , it can be used with a chisel to create the serpentine helm , granting 120 Crafting experience.

Tanzanite fang.title: Tanzanite fang
Tanzanite fang.intro: The tanzanite fang is obtained from killing Zulrah . It can be used with a chisel to create the toxic blowpipe (empty) , requiring level 78 Fletching and granting 120 experience.

Zul-andra teleport.title: Zul-andra teleport
Zul-andra teleport.intro: Zul-andra teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to Zul-Andra . They can be obtained from defeating Zulrah .

Uncut onyx.title: Uncut onyx
Uncut onyx.intro: An uncut onyx is the second rarest gem in Old School RuneScape , behind zenyte . It can be cut with a chisel at level 67 Crafting , granting 167.5 experience . This makes a cut onyx , which can be used to make very powerful jewellery . The cut onyx can also be used with a zenyte shard to create an uncut zenyte .

Zulrah's scales.title: Zulrah's scales
Zulrah's scales.intro: Zulrah's scales are items used to charge serpentine helms , toxic blowpipes , toxic staves of the dead , and tridents of the swamp . It can also be used to create anti-venom at 87 Herblore by using them on an Antidote++ , with 5 scales used per dose.

rows.text: Medium port reward bag Port Tyras
Large port reward bag Port Tyras
Huge port reward bag Port Tyras

Chambers of Xeric.title: Chambers of Xeric
Chambers of Xeric.intro: The Chambers of Xeric is a raid located within a sprawling cave system beneath Mount Quidamortem in the Kebos Lowlands . It was the first raid introduced to Old School RuneScape .

Twisted bow.title: Twisted bow
Twisted bow.intro: The twisted bow is a rare reward from the Chambers of Xeric that requires a Ranged level of 85 to wield. It can fire any type of arrow, including dragon arrows . The twisted bow is extremely valuable due to its unmatched power against monsters with a high Magic level or accuracy bonus, such as Commander Zilyana and TzKal-Zuk .

Metamorphic dust.title: Metamorphic dust
Metamorphic dust.intro: Metamorphic dust is a tertiary drop obtained upon completing a Chambers of Xeric raid in Challenge Mode . It is used on an Olmlet to allow it to metamorphose into Tektiny, Enraged Tektiny, Vespina, Flying Vespina, a vanguard, a puppadile, or Vasa Minirio.

Elder maul.title: Elder maul
Elder maul.intro: The elder maul is a two-handed crush weapon that requires Attack and Strength levels of 75 to wield. It can be obtained as a possible reward from the Chambers of Xeric .

Kodai insignia.title: Kodai insignia
Kodai insignia.intro: The Kodai insignia is obtained as a possible reward from the Chambers of Xeric . It has an Inspect option which will result in the chatbox stating, " You sense a dark magic emanating from the insignia. It looks like this could be attached to a wand. " It is used on a master wand to create the kodai wand , which requires 80 Magic to wield. This process cannot be reverted.

Dragon claws.title: Dragon claws
Dragon claws.intro: Dragon claws are a two-handed melee weapon obtained as a rare reward from the Chambers of Xeric , and require level 60 Attack to equip. They are notable for their special attack, which can quickly deal a high amount of damage, making them a popular weapon for PKing .

Ancestral hat.title: Ancestral hat
Ancestral hat.intro: The ancestral hat is obtained as a rare drop from the Chambers of Xeric . It is part of the ancestral robes set, and requires level 75 in Magic and 65 Defence to wear. It can be stored in the magic wardrobe of a player-owned house .

Ancestral robe top.title: Ancestral robe top
Ancestral robe top.intro: The ancestral robe top is obtained as a rare drop from the Chambers of Xeric . It is part of the ancestral robes set, and requires level 75 in Magic and 65 Defence to wear. It can be stored in the magic wardrobe of a player-owned house .

Ancestral robe bottom.title: Ancestral robe bottom
Ancestral robe bottom.intro: The ancestral robe bottom is obtained as a rare drop from the Chambers of Xeric . It is part of the ancestral robes set, and requires level 75 in Magic and 65 Defence to wear. It can be stored in the magic wardrobe of a player-owned house .

Dinh's bulwark.title: Dinh's bulwark
Dinh's bulwark.intro: Dinh's bulwark is a two-handed shield created by Dinh , a Lovakengj smith of unparalleled skill. It requires 75 Attack and Defence to wield and is obtained as a rare reward from the Chambers of Xeric .

Dexterous prayer scroll.title: Dexterous prayer scroll
Dexterous prayer scroll.intro: Dexterous prayer scrolls are a possible reward from the Chambers of Xeric . Reading it allows the player to unlock Rigour , which requires 70 Defence and 74 Prayer . There are no skill requirements to read the scroll, but reading it will consume it.

Arcane prayer scroll.title: Arcane prayer scroll
Arcane prayer scroll.intro: Arcane prayer scrolls are a possible reward from the Chambers of Xeric . Reading it allows the player to unlock Augury , which requires 70 Defence and 77 Prayer . There are no skill requirements to read the scroll, but reading it will consume it.

Dragon hunter crossbow.title: Dragon hunter crossbow
Dragon hunter crossbow.intro: The dragon hunter crossbow is a one-handed crossbow and dragonbane weapon obtained as a possible reward from the Chambers of Xeric , requiring 70 Ranged to wield. It can fire up to and including dragon bolts . The crossbow has an attack range of 7, and the longrange combat style will increase it by 2.

Twisted buckler.title: Twisted buckler
Twisted buckler.intro: The twisted buckler is a ranged-class shield that is obtained as a possible reward from the Chambers of Xeric , requiring level 75 Ranged and Defence to equip.

Torn prayer scroll.title: Torn prayer scroll
Torn prayer scroll.intro: A torn prayer scroll is a possible reward from the Chambers of Xeric . Reading it allows the player to unlock Preserve , which requires 55 Prayer . There are no skill requirements to read the scroll, but reading it will consume it.

Dark relic.title: Dark relic
Dark relic.intro: The dark relic is a possible reward from the Chambers of Xeric . It has a Commune option which will result in the chat box stating A dark power emanates from the relic. You sense that this power can be directed.

Onyx.title: Onyx
Onyx.intro: An onyx is the second rarest gem in Old School RuneScape , behind zenyte (which is created from an onyx and a zenyte shard ). Cutting an uncut onyx with a chisel requires level 67 Crafting and yields 167.5 experience . It can then be made into onyx jewellery by using a furnace along with a gold bar and a mould . Onyx can also be cut into 24 onyx bolt tips , though this is not recommended due to the bolt tips being worth signif

rows.text: Onyx Gold bar Cosmic rune Ball of wool

Twisted ancestral colour kit.title: Twisted ancestral colour kit
Twisted ancestral colour kit.intro: The twisted ancestral colour kit is a tertiary drop that can be obtained upon completing a Chambers of Xeric raid in Challenge Mode within the required time frame. It can be combined with any piece of the ancestral robes set to turn it into the corresponding piece of twisted ancestral robes .

Xeric's guard.title: Xeric's guard
Xeric's guard.intro: Xeric's guard is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from Captain Rimor by the entrance to the Chambers of Xeric after completing 100 Chambers of Xeric in Challenge Mode .

Xeric's warrior.title: Xeric's warrior
Xeric's warrior.intro: Xeric's warrior is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from Captain Rimor by the entrance to the Chambers of Xeric after completing 500 Chambers of Xeric in Challenge Mode .

Xeric's sentinel.title: Xeric's sentinel
Xeric's sentinel.intro: Xeric's sentinel is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from Captain Rimor by the entrance to the Chambers of Xeric after completing 1,000 Chambers of Xeric in Challenge Mode .

Xeric's general.title: Xeric's general
Xeric's general.intro: Xeric's general is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from Captain Rimor by the entrance to the Chambers of Xeric after completing 1,500 Chambers of Xeric in Challenge Mode .

Xeric's champion.title: Xeric's champion
Xeric's champion.intro: Xeric's champion is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from Captain Rimor by the entrance to the Chambers of Xeric after completing 2,000 Chambers of Xeric in Challenge Mode .

Soul Wars.title: Soul Wars
Soul Wars.intro: Soul Wars is a members -only team minigame , a remake of the original Soul Wars released in RuneScape 2 on 10 February 2009. In Soul Wars, two opposing teams compete against each other to gather soul fragments and offer them to the Soul Obelisk in order to weaken, and ultimately defeat, each other's Avatars through combat. Each game lasts up to 15 minutes.

Soul cape.title: Soul cape
Soul cape.intro: A soul cape is a cape obtained from the Soul Wars minigame , costing 2,500 Zeal Tokens to purchase from the reward shop. It requires level 70 Prayer to purchase and equip, and offers the highest Prayer bonus in the cape slot . It is visually identical to the capes that are given to players upon entering a round in the Soul Wars minigame, however, the capes inside the minigame do not have any bonuses.

Ectoplasmator.title: Ectoplasmator
Ectoplasmator.intro: The Ectoplasmator is a reward from the Soul Wars minigame . Requiring 40 Prayer , it can be purchased from Nomad on the Isle of Souls for 250 Zeal Tokens .

Knight of Ardougne.title: Knight of Ardougne
Knight of Ardougne.intro: The Knights of Ardougne are found in the East Ardougne market place. One is also found in the courtyard of the East Ardougne Castle . Most are found attempting to chase away thieves. They will protect all stalls from the silk stall and up by attacking players that they observe stealing from them. After completion of the Song of the Elves , knights of Ardougne can be found patrolling the streets of West Ardougne as well.

TzHaar Fight Cave.title: TzHaar Fight Cave
TzHaar Fight Cave.intro: The TzHaar Fight Cave , commonly referred to as the Fight Caves , is a combat minigame in the outer area of Mor Ul Rek , located within the Karamja volcano. Fully completing it is considered an early major challenge players will take on in Old School RuneScape .

Spoils of war.title: Spoils of War
Spoils of war.intro: The spoils of war is a reward from the Soul Wars Minigame . It can be purchased from Nomad on the Isle of Souls for 30 Zeal Tokens .

Glacial temotli.title: Glacial temotli
Glacial temotli.intro: Glacial temotli are a two-handed blunt weapon that requires level 55 Attack to wield, obtained as a rare drop from frost nagua and Amoxliatl in the Ruins of Tapoyauik . Like their slash and stab equivalents, the sulphur blades and earthbound tecpatl , it performs two independently rolled hits per attack . The maximum damage of each hit is determined by calculating the combined max hit as normal and dividing it by two. If the c

Amoxliatl.title: Amoxliatl
Amoxliatl.intro: Amoxliatl is a powerful Frost Nagua found within the Ruins of Tapoyauik , who serves as its guardian and is fought during The Heart of Darkness as the final fight of the quest.

Pendant of Ates (inert).title: Pendant of Ates
Pendant of Ates (inert).intro: The Pendant of Ates is an amulet that can be charged to provide teleports to six locations around Varlamore . The pendant is an untradeable rare drop from killing frost naguas or Amoxliatl .

Frozen tear.title: Frozen tear
Frozen tear.intro: Frozen tears are a drop from creatures within the Ruins of Tapoyauik . They are used to charge the Pendant of Ates , in which each tear provides one teleport charge.

Araxxor.title: Araxxor
Araxxor.intro: Araxxor is the boss version of araxytes found within the Morytania Spider Cave , requiring level 92 Slayer and access to Morytania to kill. As a Slayer boss , he may only be killed while on a spider or araxyte Slayer task . Konar quo Maten can also assign Araxxor specifically when she assigns a boss task .

Araxyte venom sac.title: Araxyte venom sac
Araxyte venom sac.intro: Araxyte venom sacs are items dropped by araxytes that serve as both a consumable and as a secondary ingredient used to create extended anti-venom+ potions. Each sac can upgrade one dose of anti-venom+ into a dose of extended anti-venom+ , with this process requiring level 94 Herblore .

Spider cave teleport.title: Spider cave teleport
Spider cave teleport.intro: Spider cave teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the entrance of the Morytania Spider Cave . They can be obtained from defeating Araxxor .

Araxyte fang.title: Araxyte fang
Araxyte fang.intro: The araxyte fang is an item dropped by Araxxor . With a Crafting level of 86, it can be etched using a chisel to produce the tradeable etched araxyte fang , which is used to upgrade the amulet of torture into the amulet of rancour , giving 500 Crafting experience.

Noxious point.title: Noxious point
Noxious point.intro: The noxious point is a rare drop from Araxxor . It can be combined with the noxious blade and noxious pommel to create the noxious halberd .

Noxious blade.title: Noxious blade
Noxious blade.intro: The noxious blade is a rare drop from Araxxor . It can be combined with the noxious point and noxious pommel to create the noxious halberd .

Noxious pommel.title: Noxious pommel
Noxious pommel.intro: The noxious pommel is a rare drop from Araxxor . It can be combined with the noxious point and noxious blade to create the noxious halberd .

Araxyte head.title: Araxyte head
Araxyte head.intro: The araxyte head is a rare drop from araxytes , as well as Araxxor . It can be combined with a slayer helmet or slayer helmet (i) to create an araxyte slayer helmet or araxyte slayer helmet (i) , respectively. Doing so requires purchasing the ability Eye see you for 1,000 Slayer reward points .

Jar of Venom.title: Jar of Venom
Jar of Venom.intro: The jar of venom is a rare untradeable drop from Araxxor that can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of Araxxor.

Coagulated venom.title: Coagulated venom
Coagulated venom.intro: Coagulated venom is a tertiary drop from Araxxor that can be used on Nid to allow it to metamorphose into Rax . The drop is guaranteed if Araxxor is killed under 1:15. Once used on Nid, it cannot be obtained again. Nid must be following the player, you cannot use this while Nid is in your inventory, or in the player's pet menagerie in their player-owned house.

Karil's coif.title: Karil's coif
Karil's coif.intro: Karil's coif is ranged armour worn in the headwear slot that is part of Karil the Tainted's set of barrows equipment . To wear Karil's coif, a player must have 70 Defence and 70 Ranged .

Ahrim's hood.title: Ahrim's hood
Ahrim's hood.intro: Ahrim's hood is magic armour worn in the headwear slot that is part of Ahrim the Blighted's set of barrows equipment . To wear Ahrim's hood, a player must have 70 Defence and 70 Magic .

Dharok's helm.title: Dharok's helm
Dharok's helm.intro: Dharok's helm is melee armour worn in the headwear slot that is part of Dharok the Wretched's set of barrows equipment . To wear Dharok's helm, a player must have 70 Defence .

Guthan's helm.title: Guthan's helm
Guthan's helm.intro: Guthan's helm is melee armour worn in the headwear slot that is part of Guthan the Infested's set of barrows equipment . To wear Guthan's helm, a player must have 70 Defence .

Torag's helm.title: Torag's helm
Torag's helm.intro: Torag's helm is melee armour worn in the headwear slot that is part of Torag the Corrupted's set of Barrows equipment . To wear Torag's helmet, a player must have 70 Defence .

Verac's helm.title: Verac's helm
Verac's helm.intro: Verac's helm is melee armour worn in the headwear slot that is part of Verac the Defiled's set of Barrows equipment . To wear Verac's helmet, a player must have 70 Defence .

Karil's leathertop.title: Karil's leathertop
Karil's leathertop.intro: Karil's leathertop is a degradable piece of ranged armour worn in the body slot that is part of Karil the Tainted's set of barrows equipment . To wear Karil's top, a player must have 70 Defence and 70 Ranged .

Ahrim's robetop.title: Ahrim's robetop
Ahrim's robetop.intro: Ahrim's robetop is magic armour worn in the body slot that is part of Ahrim the Blighted's set of barrows equipment. To wear Ahrim's robe top, a player must have 70 Defence and 70 Magic .

Dharok's platebody.title: Dharok's platebody
Dharok's platebody.intro: Dharok's platebody is melee armour worn in the body slot that is part of Dharok the Wretched's set of Barrows equipment . To wear Dharok's platebody, a player must have 70 Defence .

Guthan's platebody.title: Guthan's platebody
Guthan's platebody.intro: Guthan's platebody is melee armour worn in the body slot that is part of Guthan the Infested's set of barrows equipment . To wear Guthan's platebody, a player must have 70 Defence .

Torag's platebody.title: Torag's platebody
Torag's platebody.intro: Torag's platebody is melee armour worn in the body slot that is part of Torag the Corrupted's set of barrows equipment. To wear Torag's platebody, a player must have 70 Defence .

Verac's brassard.title: Verac's brassard
Verac's brassard.intro: Verac's brassard is melee armour worn in the body slot that is part of Verac's equipment . To wear Verac's brassard, a player must have 70 Defence .

Karil's leatherskirt.title: Karil's leatherskirt
Karil's leatherskirt.intro: Karil's leatherskirt is Ranged armour worn in the legwear slot that is part of Karil the Tainted's set of Barrows equipment . To wear Karil's leatherskirt, a player must have 70 Defence and 70 Ranged .

Ahrim's robeskirt.title: Ahrim's robeskirt
Ahrim's robeskirt.intro: Ahrim's robe skirt is a piece of magic armour worn in the legwear slot which is part of Ahrim the Blighted's set of barrows equipment . To wear Ahrim's robe skirt, a player must have 70 Defence and 70 Magic .

Dharok's platelegs.title: Dharok's platelegs
Dharok's platelegs.intro: Dharok's platelegs is melee armour worn in the legs slot that is part of the Dharok the Wretched's set of Barrows equipment . To wear Dharok's platelegs, a player must have 70 Defence .

Guthan's chainskirt.title: Guthan's chainskirt
Guthan's chainskirt.intro: Guthan's chainskirt is a piece of melee armour that is part of Guthan the Infested's set of Barrows equipment and is worn in the legwear slot . To equip Guthan's chainskirt, a player must have 70 Defence .

Torag's platelegs.title: Torag's platelegs
Torag's platelegs.intro: Torag's platelegs are melee armour worn in the legwear slot that is part of Torag the Corrupted's set of barrows equipment. To wear Torag's platelegs, a player must have 70 Defence .

Verac's plateskirt.title: Verac's plateskirt
Verac's plateskirt.intro: Verac's plateskirt is melee armour worn in the legwear slot that is part of Verac the Defiled's set of Barrows equipment . To wear Verac's plateskirt, a player must have 70 Defence .

Karil's crossbow.title: Karil's crossbow
Karil's crossbow.intro: Karil's crossbow is a two-handed ranged weapon that is part of Karil the Tainted's set . It requires 70 Ranged to wield. It fires bolt racks , which break upon firing. When equipped with the other three pieces of Karil the Tainted 's set the wearer will receive the set effect, which has a chance to temporarily lower their target's Agility level. Additionally, if an amulet of the damned is worn alongside the set, there is also

Ahrim's staff.title: Ahrim's staff
Ahrim's staff.intro: Ahrim's staff is a one-handed magic weapon that is part of Ahrim the Blighted's set . To wield Ahrim's staff, the player must have 70 Magic and 70 Attack . It increases Magic damage by 5%.

Dharok's greataxe.title: Dharok's greataxe
Dharok's greataxe.intro: Dharok's greataxe is a two-handed axe that is part of the Dharok the Wretched's set of barrows equipment . To wield the Dharok's greataxe, a player requires 70 Attack and 70 Strength . It cannot be used for Woodcutting , unlike other axes.

Guthan's warspear.title: Guthan's warspear
Guthan's warspear.intro: Guthan's warspear is a two-handed melee weapon that is part of Guthan the Infested's set of barrows equipment and requires 70 Attack to wield. It is the second most accurate spear in game, surpassed only by the Zamorakian spear / hasta , which has +85 Stab. However, it is slower than most spears, having an attack rate of 5 ticks, rather than 4 ticks, and it cannot be poisoned.

Torag's hammers.title: Torag's hammers
Torag's hammers.intro: Torag's hammers are a two-handed blunt weapon that is part of Torag the Corrupted's set of barrows equipment . To wield Torag's hammers, a player must have 70 Attack and Strength .

Verac's flail.title: Verac's flail
Verac's flail.intro: Verac's flail is a two-handed spiked weapon that is part of Verac the Defiled's set of barrows equipment . To wield Verac's flail, a player must have 70 Attack . The flail shares many similarities to a mace , notably its attack styles and stat distribution, though it attacks one tick slower.

Bolt rack.title: Bolt rack
Bolt rack.intro: Bolt racks are ammunition exclusively used by the Karil's crossbow . They are a reward from Barrows with at least 881 reward potential, purchased from Ak-Haranu's Exotic Shop on the Port Phasmatys docks, or purchased from the Last Man Standing shop .

Brutus.title: Brutus
Brutus.intro: Brutus is a low-level free-to-play boss located in the Lumbridge cow field , whom players defeat as part of the quest The Ides of Milk , and can be fought after completion of the quest as a boss encounter. During the quest, he cannot kill the player with standard attacks (though his charge and stomp attacks can still kill) and does not drop anything.

Mooleta.title: Mooleta
Mooleta.intro: The mooleta is a melee off-hand dropped by the post-quest version of Brutus . It has no requirements to wield and offers similar bonuses to a steel defender .

Bottomless milk bucket (empty).title: Bottomless milk bucket
Bottomless milk bucket (empty).intro: The bottomless milk bucket is dropped by Brutus , the repeatable post-quest boss of The Ides of Milk quest. It can be used to hold up to 10,000 uses of a variety of milks and milk-related products, albeit one at a time:

Cow slippers.title: Cow slippers
Cow slippers.intro: The cow slippers are a cosmetic pair of footwear dropped by the post-quest version of Brutus . They have no requirements to wear, and can function as warm clothing when subduing the Wintertodt .

Bryophyta.title: Bryophyta
Bryophyta.intro: Bryophyta ( / ˌ b r aɪ oʊ ˈ f aɪ t ə / , BRY -oh- FY -tə ), the Moss Giantess, is a moss giant boss who can be found in her lair in the Varrock Sewers . The entrance to the lair is located just east of the moss giants in the sewers, and can be accessed by navigating the sewers, using the level 51 Agility shortcut from Edgeville Dungeon , or by teleporting with a giantsoul amulet .

Bryophyta's essence.title: Bryophyta's essence
Bryophyta's essence.intro: Bryophyta's essence is an item obtained from Bryophyta's chest , and can be used with a battlestaff with 62 Crafting to create an uncharged Bryophyta's staff .

Tyrannical ring.title: Tyrannical ring
Tyrannical ring.intro: The tyrannical ring is a ring dropped by Callisto and Artio . Callisto can be found in Callisto's Den and Artio can be found in the Hunter's End .

Dragon pickaxe.title: Dragon pickaxe
Dragon pickaxe.intro: The dragon pickaxe is the second strongest and second fastest pickaxe in-game, tied with the 3rd Age pickaxe and behind the crystal pickaxe . It requires 61 Mining to mine with the pickaxe and 60 Attack to wield it. However, as its special attack temporarily boosts the player's Mining level by 3, players with at least 60 Attack can start mining with the pickaxe at 58 Mining.

Dragon 2h sword.title: Dragon 2h sword
Dragon 2h sword.intro: The dragon 2h sword is one of the strongest two-handed swords in Old School RuneScape , requiring level 60 Attack to wield. Due to its slow attacking speed and the fact that it cannot be used with a shield or defender , many players prefer using other dragon weaponry instead, such as the dragon scimitar .

Claws of Callisto.title: Claws of Callisto
Claws of Callisto.intro: The claws of Callisto are an item dropped by Callisto and Artio . They are used to upgrade Viggora's chainmace into an Ursine chainmace . This process requires level 85 Smithing ; players without the required level to combine the items may ask Andros Mai in Ferox Enclave to do so instead, for a fee of 500,000 coins . The uncharged weapon may be dismantled to separate the chainmace and claws.

Voidwaker hilt.title: Voidwaker hilt
Voidwaker hilt.intro: The Voidwaker hilt is one of three pieces of the Voidwaker dropped by Callisto and Artio . The hilt, alongside the Voidwaker blade and Voidwaker gem , must be brought to Madam Sikaro in the Ferox Enclave Dungeon , who combines the three parts for a fee of 500,000 coins .

Cerberus.title: Cerberus
Cerberus.intro: Cerberus is a level 318 hellhound boss who resides in Cerberus' Lair , deep beneath the Taverley Dungeon in the cave entrance in the north-east part of the hellhound area, which is found beyond the poisonous spiders . Defeating Cerberus requires a Slayer level of 91, along with a task of hellhounds or Cerberus herself. In the event of a hellhound or elite clue scroll task, wild pies may be used to boost the player's Slayer lev

Eternal crystal.title: Eternal crystal
Eternal crystal.intro: The eternal crystal is an add-on dropped by Cerberus . When used with a pair of infinity boots , eternal boots will be created. This process cannot be reversed, and requires level 60 in Runecraft and Magic (boosts cannot be used), granting 200 experience in both skills.

Pegasian crystal.title: Pegasian crystal
Pegasian crystal.intro: The pegasian crystal is an add-on dropped by Cerberus . When used with a pair of ranger boots , Pegasian boots will be created. This process cannot be reversed, and requires level 60 in Runecraft and Magic (boosts cannot be used), granting 200 experience in both skills.

Primordial crystal.title: Primordial crystal
Primordial crystal.intro: The primordial crystal is an add-on dropped by Cerberus . When used with a pair of dragon boots , primordial boots will be created. This process cannot be reversed, and requires level 60 in Runecraft and Magic (boosts cannot be used), granting 200 experience in both skills.

Jar of Souls.title: Jar of Souls
Jar of Souls.intro: The jar of souls is a rare drop from Cerberus , found in Cerberus' Lair within Taverley Dungeon .

Smouldering stone.title: Smouldering stone
Smouldering stone.intro: A smouldering stone is a stone dropped by Cerberus and, much more rarely, hellhounds . It can be used to upgrade the dragon axe , dragon harpoon , and dragon pickaxe into the infernal axe , infernal harpoon , and infernal pickaxe , respectively. These infernal tools have a 1/3 chance to instantly process and destroy a resource (using a charge and granting half of the normal processing experience gained in Firemaking , Cooking

Key master teleport.title: Key master teleport
Key master teleport.intro: Key master teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player directly next to the Key Master in Cerberus' Lair . They are dropped exclusively by Cerberus , and have no requirements to use.

Chaos Elemental.title: Chaos Elemental
Chaos Elemental.intro: The Chaos Elemental is a dark cloud with six tentacles that dwells in the members-only section of the Wilderness , just west of the Rogues' Castle . This area is moderately easy to access from the deep Wilderness teleport lever in Ardougne or Edgeville . The nearby Wilderness Obelisk can randomly teleport players south-east of the Rogues' Castle; after the hard Wilderness Diary is completed, the location can be chosen from any
