Chaos Fanatic.title: Chaos Fanatic
Chaos Fanatic.intro: The Chaos Fanatic is a relatively simple boss that resides west of the Lava Maze in level 42 Wilderness , surrounded by miniature chaotic clouds that serve as unattackable scenery. His special attack mechanic is similar to that of the crazy and deranged archaeologists.

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and gem drop table

Odium shard 1.title: Odium shard 1
Odium shard 1.intro: The odium shard 1 is an item dropped by the Chaos Fanatic . When the two other shards, the odium shard 2 and 3 are obtained, they can be forged into an Odium ward on the Blighted Volcano on the most north-east part of the Wilderness .

Malediction shard 1.title: Malediction shard 1
Malediction shard 1.intro: The malediction shard 1 is an item dropped by the Chaos Fanatic . When the two other shards, the malediction shard 2 and 3 are obtained, they can be forged into a malediction ward on the Blighted Volcano on the most north-east part of the Wilderness .

Commander Zilyana.title: Commander Zilyana
Commander Zilyana.intro: Commander Zilyana is the appointed leader of Saradomin 's forces in the God Wars Dungeon and one of only three known still living representatives of the Icyene race, one being the half-human half-Icyene Safalaan and the other being a full-blooded Icyene encountered during the quest The Blood Moon Rises .

Armadyl crossbow.title: Armadyl crossbow
Armadyl crossbow.intro: The Armadyl crossbow is a ranging weapon that requires a Ranged level of 70 to wield, and can fire up to and including dragon bolts . It is dropped only by Commander Zilyana . This item counts as an Armadyl item in the God Wars Dungeon .

Saradomin hilt.title: Saradomin hilt
Saradomin hilt.intro: The Saradomin hilt is a rare drop from Commander Zilyana , in the God Wars Dungeon . When attached to a completed Godsword blade , which can be created by combining the three Godsword shards , it creates the Saradomin Godsword .

Saradomin sword.title: Saradomin sword
Saradomin sword.intro: The Saradomin sword is the personal weapon of Commander Zilyana , the Saradominist general within the God Wars Dungeon . It can be obtained as a rare drop from Commander Zilyana, or as a very rare drop from her bodyguards. It is a two-handed sword which requires 70 Attack to wield.

Saradomin's light.title: Saradomin's light
Saradomin's light.intro: Saradomin's light is an item obtained by killing Commander Zilyana in the God Wars Dungeon . It can be used to permanently remove the darkness in Zamorak's Fortress in the God Wars Dungeon , which in turn allows the player to see better and more clearly. However, doing so will not prevent the prayer drain from occurring when players enter Zamorak's Fortress .

Godsword shard 1.title: Godsword shard 1
Godsword shard 1.intro: The godsword shard 1 is a drop from the bosses and sub-bosses in the God Wars Dungeon . It is used to make a godsword , by using it on an anvil with godsword shard 2 and 3 , creating the godsword blade . Doing this requires level 80 Smithing and gives 100 Smithing experience .

Godsword shard 2.title: Godsword shard 2
Godsword shard 2.intro: The godsword shard 2 is a drop from the bosses and sub-bosses in the God Wars Dungeon . It is used to make a Godsword by using it on an anvil with Godsword shard 1 and 3 , creating the Godsword blade . Doing this gives 100 Smithing experience and requires level 80 Smithing.

Godsword shard 3.title: Godsword shard 3
Godsword shard 3.intro: The godsword shard 3 is a drop from the bosses and sub-bosses in the God Wars Dungeon . It is used to make a Godsword , by using it on an anvil with Godsword shard 1 and 2 , creating the Godsword blade . Doing this gives 100 Smithing experience and requires level 80 Smithing .

Corporeal Beast.title: Corporeal Beast
Corporeal Beast.intro: The Corporeal Beast , often referred to simply as Corp , is a large monster residing in its lair , accessed via the games necklace or an entrance in level 21 Wilderness . Due to its very high combat stats, it is often fought by groups of players. Unlike its RuneScape 3 counterpart, it has no quest requirements to access.

Elysian sigil.title: Elysian sigil
Elysian sigil.intro: The elysian sigil can be attached to a blessed spirit shield to make an elysian spirit shield . To attach the sigil to the blessed spirit shield, players need 90 Prayer and 85 Smithing . It is a very rare drop from the Corporeal Beast . Players without the required skill levels to create the shield may ask Abbot Langley in the Edgeville Monastery to combine the sigil and the blessed spirit shield, for a fee of 1,500,000 coins.

Spectral sigil.title: Spectral sigil
Spectral sigil.intro: The spectral sigil can be attached to a blessed spirit shield to make a spectral spirit shield . To attach the sigil to the blessed spirit shield, players need 90 Prayer and 85 Smithing . It is made by using the sigil on an anvil, while having a hammer and a blessed spirit shield in the inventory. Alternatively, players can ask Abbot Langley to attach it for 1,500,000 coins. It is a rare drop from the Corporeal Beast .

Arcane sigil.title: Arcane sigil
Arcane sigil.intro: The arcane sigil is an item obtained as a rare drop from the Corporeal Beast . It can be attached to a blessed spirit shield to create an arcane spirit shield , as well as an Elidinis' ward to create Elidinis' ward (f) .

Holy elixir.title: Holy elixir
Holy elixir.intro: The holy elixir is an item that players can use to bless a spirit shield , making it a blessed spirit shield , requiring level 85 Prayer . It is a rare drop from the Corporeal Beast .

Spirit shield.title: Spirit shield
Spirit shield.intro: The spirit shield is obtained as a drop from the Corporeal Beast . It requires 45 Defence and 55 Prayer to wield.

Jar of Spirits.title: Jar of Spirits
Jar of Spirits.intro: The jar can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of the boss. Doing so requires killing it at least once.

Crazy Archaeologist.title: Crazy archaeologist
Crazy Archaeologist.intro: Bellock , the crazy archaeologist , is a relatively simple boss that resides in the ruins south of The Forgotten Cemetery within level 23 Wilderness . His special attack mechanic is similar to that of the Deranged archaeologist and the Chaos Fanatic .

Odium shard 2.title: Odium shard 2
Odium shard 2.intro: The odium shard 2 is an item dropped by the Crazy archaeologist . When the two other shards, the odium shard 1 and 3 are obtained, they can be forged into an Odium ward on the Blighted Volcano on the most north-east part of the Wilderness .

Fedora.title: Fedora
Fedora.intro: A fedora is a rare drop from the crazy archaeologist , it being the hat he wears. It is purely cosmetic and has no bonuses.

Malediction shard 2.title: Malediction shard 2
Malediction shard 2.intro: The malediction shard 2 is an item dropped by the Crazy archaeologist . When the two other shards, the malediction shard 1 and 3 are obtained, they can be forged into a malediction ward on the Blighted Volcano on the most north-east part of the Wilderness .

Dagannoth Kings.title: Dagannoth Kings
Dagannoth Kings.intro: The Dagannoth Kings (commonly abbreviated DKs ) are a group of three dagannoth that live deep in the cave on Waterbirth Island which is a multiway combat area. They are all level 303, and also represent the combat triangle . Each of the kings uses a different combat style , is weak against the type that defeats them on the combat triangle, and has a high defence against all others. They all have their own, unique ring drops, w

Berserker ring.title: Berserker ring
Berserker ring.intro: The berserker ring is the strength bonus variant of the Fremennik rings and is dropped by Dagannoth Rex in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon . The Fremennik rings are some of the very few rings to give stat bonuses. Group Ironmen who do not have individual prestige require at least 1 Dagannoth Rex kill before they are able to wear this item.

Archers ring.title: Archers ring
Archers ring.intro: The archers ring is one of the Fremennik rings and is dropped by the Dagannoth Supreme in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon . It increases the player's ranged accuracy and ranged defence when worn.

Seers ring.title: Seers ring
Seers ring.intro: The Seers ring is one of the four Fremennik rings , and is dropped by the Dagannoth Prime in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon .

Dragon axe.title: Dragon axe
Dragon axe.intro: The dragon axe is the second best axe in the game after its direct upgrade, the crystal axe , and is tied with the 3rd Age axe . It is 10% more efficient at chopping logs than the rune axe .

Seercull.title: Seercull
Seercull.intro: The seercull is a Fremennik bow that requires a Ranged level of 50 to wield, and fires arrows up to Amethyst . Compared to a magic shortbow , it has a slower rate of fire and a different special attack which is more effective against mages. In addition, its normal and rapid fire attacks have one more range than that of a shortbow , and its long range attack is equivalent to that of a composite bow . It is a comparable weapon t

Warrior ring.title: Warrior ring
Warrior ring.intro: The warrior ring is one of the four Fremennik rings and is dropped by Dagannoth Rex . The Fremennik rings are among the few rings that provide combat stat bonuses.

Mud battlestaff.title: Mud battlestaff
Mud battlestaff.intro: A mud battlestaff is a mud elemental staff which provides unlimited amounts of water and earth runes as well as the autocast option when equipped. It requires 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield.

Deranged Archaeologist.title: Deranged archaeologist
Deranged Archaeologist.intro: The Deranged archaeologist is a relatively simple boss that resides at the southern end of the Tar Swamp on Fossil Island . His special attack mechanic is similar to that of the Crazy archaeologist and the Chaos Fanatic .

Steel ring.title: Steel ring
Steel ring.intro: The steel ring is an item dropped by the deranged archaeologist . It has no requirements to equip and is the best-in-slot melee defensive ring, surpassing the ring of suffering (i) . However, it has no Magic defence, Ranged defence, or Prayer bonuses.

Doom of Mokhaiotl.title: Doom of Mokhaiotl
Doom of Mokhaiotl.intro: The Doom of Mokhaiotl , also referred to as Osto-Ayak , is a giant insect-like, demonic boss found in the Ruins of Mokhaiotl , which is accessed during The Final Dawn quest, deep beneath the Tlati Rainforest .

Avernic treads.title: Avernic treads
Avernic treads.intro: Avernic treads are boots that require level 80 in Defence , Strength , Ranged , and Magic to wear. They are dropped in their base form by the Doom of Mokhaiotl , and can be upgraded into stronger variants.

Eye of Ayak (uncharged).title: Eye of Ayak
Eye of Ayak (uncharged).intro: The Eye of Ayak is a one-handed powered staff that requires level 83 Magic to wield. It is a drop from the Doom of Mokhaiotl upon completion of delve level 3 and higher. Like most powered staves, it is only tradeable when it is fully uncharged.

Mokhaiotl cloth.title: Mokhaiotl cloth
Mokhaiotl cloth.intro: Mokhaiotl cloth is an item dropped by the Doom of Mokhaiotl . It is used alongside 10,000 demon tears to upgrade the tormented bracelet into the confliction gauntlets .

Mokhaiotl waystone.title: Mokhaiotl waystone
Mokhaiotl waystone.intro: Mokhaiotl waystones are consumable items used to teleport to the Ruins of Mokhaiotl . They can only be used after completion of The Final Dawn , and can be obtained as a drop from the Doom of Mokhaiotl .

Demon tear.title: Demon tear
Demon tear.intro: Demon tears are items used to charge the Eye of Ayak as an alternative to runes, or as part of the materials required to create the avernic treads and confliction gauntlets .

Duke Sucellus.title: Duke Sucellus
Duke Sucellus.intro: Duke Sucellus (pronounced / s uː ˈ k ɛ l ə s / soo-KELL-əs ) is a chthonian demon sealed in Ghorrock Prison , who is encountered during Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire . A high-ranking commander of the Zarosian Empire , Sucellus took informal command of the remaining forces of the Empire after the Betrayal of Zaros . A stronger variant of him can be fought again after the completion of the quest.

Eye of the Duke.title: Eye of the Duke
Eye of the Duke.intro: The Eye of the Duke is an item dropped by Duke Sucellus . It is one of four components used to create the soulreaper axe , alongside the executioner's axe head , siren's staff , and Leviathan's lure .

Virtus mask.title: Virtus mask
Virtus mask.intro: The Virtus mask is a part of the Virtus robes set that is worn in the head slot , requiring level 78 in Magic and 75 Defence to equip. It can be obtained as a rare drop from The Leviathan , The Whisperer , Vardorvis , and Duke Sucellus .

Virtus robe bottom.title: Virtus robe bottom
Virtus robe bottom.intro: The Virtus robe bottoms are a part of the Virtus robes set that are worn in the legs slot , requiring level 78 in Magic and 75 Defence to equip. They can be obtained as a rare drop from The Leviathan , The Whisperer , Vardorvis , and Duke Sucellus .

Virtus robe top.title: Virtus robe top
Virtus robe top.intro: The Virtus robe top is a part of the Virtus robes set that is worn in the body slot , requiring level 78 in Magic and 75 Defence to equip. It can be obtained as a rare drop from The Leviathan , The Whisperer , Vardorvis , and Duke Sucellus .

Magus vestige.title: Magus vestige
Magus vestige.intro: After learning how to combine ring icons from Peer the Seer , the vestige can be used on a seers icon to create the magus icon , which is then brought to a furnace alongside three chromium ingots and a ring mould to craft the magus ring . The entire process requires level 90 Magic and 80 Crafting , which can be boosted.

Ice quartz.title: Ice quartz
Ice quartz.intro: The ice quartz is a gem dropped by Duke Sucellus . It is used on an ancient sceptre to create the ice ancient sceptre ; this process can be reversed. It can also be used to open a chest in the Ancient Vault .

Frozen tablet.title: Frozen tablet
Frozen tablet.intro: The frozen tablet is an item dropped by Duke Sucellus . It is used on the ring of shadows to unlock a teleport to Ghorrock Dungeon .

Chromium ingot.title: Chromium ingot
Chromium ingot.intro: Chromium ingots are metal bars dropped by the Leviathan , the Whisperer , Vardorvis , and Duke Sucellus . They can also be smelted via a mixture of runite and adamantite ores at the Blast Furnace , or fished up from the fishing spot at the Stranglewood , though incredibly rare. They are used in the process of creating the four ancient rings , each requiring three ingots.

Awakener's orb.title: Awakener's orb
Awakener's orb.intro: Awakener's orbs are items dropped by the Forgotten Four bosses fought during Desert Treasure II . The orbs can be used to fight stronger variants of those bosses.

Fire cape.title: Fire cape
Fire cape.intro: The fire cape is a melee cape obtained as a reward for completing the TzHaar Fight Cave . It is the second best melee cape in the game, outclassed only by the infernal cape . In order to obtain the fire cape, players must survive all waves of TzHaar Fight Caves and defeat TzTok-Jad . Note that the cape will not be awarded should both the player and TzTok-Jad die simultaneously, even though the boss log will count the kill. The

Fortis Colosseum.title: Fortis Colosseum
Fortis Colosseum.intro: The Fortis Colosseum is a large stadium found on the cliffs east of Civitas illa Fortis . Here, players can take on up to twelve waves of opponents, culminating with the final wave against Sol Heredit . Enemies will spawn in similarly to the TzHaar Fight Caves and Inferno , though additional enemies will also spawn in during the wave.

Dizana's quiver (uncharged).title: Dizana's quiver
Dizana's quiver (uncharged).intro: Dizana's quiver is an item that requires level 75 Ranged to equip. It provides the best in slot ranged attack bonus for the cape slot, and is awarded for defeating Sol Heredit in the Fortis Colosseum .

Sunfire fanatic cuirass.title: Sunfire fanatic cuirass
Sunfire fanatic cuirass.intro: The sunfire fanatic cuirass is an item that requires level 60 Prayer and 40 Defence to equip, obtained as a possible reward from participating in the Fortis Colosseum .

Sunfire fanatic chausses.title: Sunfire fanatic chausses
Sunfire fanatic chausses.intro: The sunfire fanatic chausses are an item that requires level 60 Prayer and 40 Defence to equip, obtained as a possible reward from participating in the Fortis Colosseum . Part of the sunfire fanatic armour set, they provide the best in slot prayer bonus for the legs slot (+2 over Proselyte), and also have identical defence bonuses to the rune platelegs .

Sunfire fanatic helm.title: Sunfire fanatic helm
Sunfire fanatic helm.intro: The sunfire fanatic helm is an item that requires level 60 Prayer and 40 Defence to equip, obtained as a possible reward from participating in the Fortis Colosseum .

Echo crystal.title: Echo crystal
Echo crystal.intro: Echo crystals are a drop received from participating in the Fortis Colosseum . It is used on a pair of guardian boots to create echo boots , which gives it an additional +2 prayer bonus and a passive recoil effect.

Tonalztics of Ralos (uncharged).title: Tonalztics of Ralos
Tonalztics of Ralos (uncharged).intro: The Tonalztics of Ralos is a one-handed thrown weapon that requires level 75 Ranged to equip, obtained by participating in the Fortis Colosseum . Unlike most thrown weapons , it is not stackable and effectively provides unlimited "ammo," though it has an additional effect when charged with Sunfire splinters . The weapon rolls against a monster's light ranged defence.

Sunfire splinters.title: Sunfire splinters
Sunfire splinters.intro: Sunfire splinters can be obtained from participating in the Fortis Colosseum , hunting sunlight antelope , defeating the Hueycoatl and opening Chest (moon key) . They are used for various items:

General Graardor.title: General Graardor
General Graardor.intro: General Graardor is the leader of Bandos ' forces within the God Wars Dungeon . He is the only known living member of the Ourg race.

Bandos chestplate.title: Bandos chestplate
Bandos chestplate.intro: The Bandos chestplate is a part of the Bandos armour set, which requires 65 Defence to wear. It is dropped by General Graardor and his bodyguards in the God Wars Dungeon . The Bandos chestplate provides a +4 Strength bonus , and more defensive bonuses than comparable body armours such as the fighter torso and Inquisitor's hauberk . Despite seemingly being made of metal, the Bandos chestplate does not interfere with Ava's devic

Bandos tassets.title: Bandos tassets
Bandos tassets.intro: Bandos tassets are a part of the Bandos armour set, requiring 65 Defence to wear. They are dropped by General Graardor and his bodyguards in the God Wars Dungeon . Bandos tassets are widely used by experienced players as they offer high stats compared to other leg slot items, including the second highest strength bonus, tied with the Inquisitor's plateskirt , Blood Moon tassets , and oathplate legs . It's beaten only by Torva

Bandos boots.title: Bandos boots
Bandos boots.intro: Bandos boots are part of the Bandos armour set, which requires 65 Defence to wear. They have the second highest ranged defence bonus for boots (beaten only by its upgraded variants, the guardian boots and the echo boots ).

Bandos hilt.title: Bandos hilt
Bandos hilt.intro: The Bandos hilt is dropped by General Graardor , in the God Wars Dungeon . When attached to a completed Godsword blade , it creates the Bandos godsword .

Giant Mole.title: Giant Mole
Giant Mole.intro: The Giant Mole ( Talpidae wysonian ) is a relatively simple boss found in the Mole Hole under Falador Park .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Mole skin.title: Mole skin
Mole skin.intro: Mole skins are dropped by the Giant Mole that lurks below Falador park . Players who have completed the Falador hard achievement diary will receive mole skins and mole claws in noted form. Like the mole claw, mole skins can be traded to Wyson the gardener for bird nests . Unlike nests received through Woodcutting , Bird house trapping , or Managing Miscellania , these nests never contain bird's eggs but often contain allotment

Mole claw.title: Mole claw
Mole claw.intro: Mole claws are dropped by the Giant Mole that lurks below Falador Park . It is also dropped by molanisks and experiment No.2s . Players who have completed the Falador hard achievement diary will receive mole claws and mole skins from the Giant Mole in noted form. Like the mole skins, mole claws can be traded to Wyson the gardener for bird nests .

Immaculate mole skin.title: Immaculate mole skin
Immaculate mole skin.intro: Immaculate mole skins are a tertiary drop from the Giant Mole , which are used to combine the gem bag and gem tote to create the gem sack . Doing so requires a needle and level 81 Crafting , granting 300 experience.

Grotesque Guardians.title: Grotesque Guardians
Grotesque Guardians.intro: The Grotesque Guardians are a pair of gargoyles , Dusk and Dawn , found on the Slayer Tower 's rooftop, whose entrance is found on the 2 floor 3 floor . In order to access the roof for the first time, players must unlock the gate using a brittle key obtained from killing gargoyles during a Slayer task (requiring 75 ). This is a permanent unlock; once the brittle key has been used, the gate will remain accessible in future, and

Black tourmaline core.title: Black tourmaline core
Black tourmaline core.intro: The black tourmaline core is an item dropped by the Grotesque Guardians that can be found on the Slayer Tower 's rooftop. It can be used to upgrade the Bandos boots to create guardian boots , after which the core is used up. This process is irreversible.

Granite gloves.title: Granite gloves
Granite gloves.intro: Granite gloves are a pair of melee -oriented gloves dropped by the Grotesque Guardians , requiring level 50 Defence and Strength to equip.

Granite ring.title: Granite ring
Granite ring.intro: The granite ring is a defensive ring dropped by the Grotesque Guardians that can be found on the Slayer Tower 's rooftop. Level 50 Defence and Strength are required to wear it.

Granite hammer.title: Granite hammer
Granite hammer.intro: The granite hammer is a warhammer dropped by the Grotesque Guardians . Level 50 Attack and 50 Strength is required to wield it.

Jar of Stone.title: Jar of Stone
Jar of Stone.intro: The jar of stone is a rare drop from the Grotesque Guardians that can be found on the Slayer Tower 's rooftop.

Granite dust.title: Granite dust
Granite dust.intro: Granite dust is dropped by the Grotesque Guardians on the Slayer Tower roof, and the Mad Angel on Wyrmscraig .

Hespori.title: Hespori
Hespori.intro: The Hespori is a sporadic Farming boss fought in the cave within the west wing of the Farming Guild which requires 65 Farming to access. To fight the Hespori, you must first plant a hespori seed in the hespori patch within the cave, and then wait 22-32 hours for it to grow (depending on planting time). You will need a rake to clear the patch of any weeds , and a seed dibber to plant the seed unless the Farming portion of Barba

tables.heading: Drops › Main table › Fruit tree seeds

Bottomless compost bucket.title: Bottomless compost bucket
Bottomless compost bucket.intro: A bottomless compost bucket is a drop from the Hespori , which can be filled with compost , supercompost , or ultracompost . Tool Leprechauns will store one of them in its own slot.

Iasor seed.title: Iasor seed
Iasor seed.intro: Iasor seeds are a type of anima seed requiring level 76 Farming to plant. They are obtained exclusively from the Hespori , and can only be planted in the anima patch within the intermediate tier of the Farming Guild . Planting an iasor seed gives 100 Farming experience .

Kronos seed.title: Kronos seed
Kronos seed.intro: Kronos seeds are a type of anima seed requiring level 76 Farming to plant. They are obtained exclusively from the Hespori , and can only be planted in the anima patch within the intermediate tier of the Farming Guild . Planting a kronos seed gives 100 Farming experience .

Attas seed.title: Attas seed
Attas seed.intro: Attas seeds are a type of anima seed requiring level 76 Farming (boostable) to plant. They are obtained exclusively from the Hespori , and can only be planted in the anima patch within the intermediate tier of the Farming Guild . Planting an attas seed gives 100 Farming experience .

The Hueycoatl.title: The Hueycoatl
The Hueycoatl.intro: The Hueycoatl ( / ˈ hw eɪ k oʊ ˈ æ t ə l / HWAY -koh-at-el ) is a draconic boss whose large body is coiled around the Darkfrost . Said to have scales as strong as rock and sleep atop a pile of gold, the Hueycoatl has awakened and wreaked havoc around the mountain and the dwarves of Cam Torum require assistance in subduing her.

Dragon hunter wand.title: Dragon hunter wand
Dragon hunter wand.intro: The dragon hunter wand is a one-handed staff and wand , and dragonbane weapon requiring level 65 Magic to wield. It is obtained as a rare drop from the Hueycoatl .

Tome of Earth (empty).title: Tome of Earth
Tome of Earth (empty).intro: The tome of earth is a book held in place of a shield that is a possible reward from the Hueycoatl . The tome of earth requires level 50 in Magic to wield.

Soiled page.title: Soiled page
Soiled page.intro: Soiled pages are a possible drop from the Hueycoatl , or created at the Book of Earthen Might with desiccated pages and level 50 Runecraft . They are used to charge the tome of earth , which gives it additional effects.

Hueycoatl hide.title: Hueycoatl hide
Hueycoatl hide.intro: Hueycoatl hide is a reward dropped by the Hueycoatl . Unlike other hides, it does not need to be tanned and can be directly crafted into Hueycoatl hide armour .

Huasca seed.title: Huasca seed
Huasca seed.intro: Huasca seeds can be planted in a herb patch at level 65 Farming to yield grimy huasca , which is used to create prayer regeneration potions .

The Inferno.title: Inferno
The Inferno.intro: The Inferno is a solo minigame that was added to Old School RuneScape on the 1 June 2017 , along with an update to the city of Mor Ul Rek . The player must survive 69 increasingly challenging waves, ultimately killing the level 1400 TzKal-Zuk , to obtain the infernal cape . If defeated, the player must restart from the first wave. A successor to the TzHaar Fight Caves , the Inferno was dubbed the greatest solo PVM challenge to

Infernal cape.title: Infernal cape
Infernal cape.intro: The infernal cape is the most powerful melee cape in terms of overall bonuses, awarded for defeating TzKal-Zuk in the Inferno . It surpasses its predecessor, the fire cape , boasting greater melee attack and strength bonuses, along with slightly higher defensive bonuses. In spite of this, it is still surpassed by the Ardougne cloaks 3 and 4 in stab attack and prayer bonuses, and by the mythical cape in crush attack.

Kalphite Queen.title: Kalphite Queen
Kalphite Queen.intro: The Kalphite Queen ( Kalphiscarabeinae pasha ), also called the KQ , is the strongest of the Kalphites .

Kq head.title: Kq head
Kq head.intro: The Kq head is a rare drop from the Kalphite Queen . It can be stuffed at the Taxidermist in Canifis by using the item on her and paying 50,000 coins, returning a stuffed kq head . When players take it to her, she will tell players "That must be the biggest kalphite I've ever seen! Preserving insects is always tricky. I'll have to be careful..."

Jar of Sand.title: Jar of Sand
Jar of Sand.intro: The jar can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of the Kalphite Queen. Doing so requires killing her at least once.

Dragon chainbody.title: Dragon chainbody
Dragon chainbody.intro: The dragon chainbody is the highest tier of chainbody in the game, requiring a Defence level of 60 to equip. As with most dragon armour , players cannot make this item using the Smithing skill.

King Black Dragon.title: King Black Dragon
King Black Dragon.intro: The King Black Dragon , commonly referred to as KBD , is a three-headed dragon located in his lair , accessible only through the deep Wilderness . With a combat level of 276, he is one of the strongest dragons in Old School RuneScape .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Kbd heads.title: Kbd heads
Kbd heads.intro: Kbd heads are a rare drop from the King Black Dragon . It can be stuffed at the Taxidermist in Canifis by using the item on her and paying 50,000 coins, returning a stuffed kbd heads . When players take it to the her, she will tell players "Three?! This must be a King Black Dragon! I'll have to get out my heavy duty tools -- this skin's as tough as iron!"

Draconic visage.title: Draconic visage
Draconic visage.intro: The draconic visage is a very rare item obtained from many high-levelled dragons , as well as Skeletal Wyverns . It was supposedly created by the Dragonkin as a way to channel dragonfire .

Kraken.title: Kraken
Kraken.intro: The Kraken is a stronger and larger version of the cave kraken . It requires level 87 Slayer to kill and cannot be boosted. Located at the Kraken Cove , it can only be attacked if the player has it, or cave krakens as a Slayer task , which also requires level 50 Magic . Alongside its non-boss variants , it is the only monster that drops the trident of the seas and Kraken tentacle .

Kraken tentacle.title: Kraken tentacle
Kraken tentacle.intro: A kraken tentacle is obtained from killing cave krakens (and their boss version ) in the Kraken Cove , located just south-west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony . The tentacle is used to make abyssal tentacles , enhanced tridents of the seas , and enhanced tridents of the swamps .

Trident of the Seas (full).title: Trident of the Seas
Trident of the Seas (full).intro: The trident of the seas is a one-handed powered staff requiring 75 Magic to wield. Once charged with runes and coins, it can be used to attack with a built-in magic spell regardless of the player’s current spellbook .

Jar of Dirt.title: Jar of Dirt
Jar of Dirt.intro: The jar can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of the Kraken. Doing so requires killing it at least once.

Kree'arra.title: Kree'arra
Kree'arra.intro: Kree'arra is one of Armadyl 's most trusted generals. He is the most powerful of the surviving aviansie , and leader to the forces of Armadyl's Eyrie in the God Wars Dungeon .

Armadyl helmet.title: Armadyl helmet
Armadyl helmet.intro: The Armadyl helmet is an item that can be obtained from Kree'arra and his bodyguards in the God Wars Dungeon , or as an extremely rare drop from an Armadylean / Bandosian guard from elite coordinate clues. Along with the Armadyl chestplate and chainskirt , it is part of the Armadyl armour set, and requires 70 Defence and Ranged to wear.

Armadyl chestplate.title: Armadyl chestplate
Armadyl chestplate.intro: The Armadyl chestplate is an item that can be obtained from Kree'arra and his bodyguards in the God Wars Dungeon . Along with the Armadyl helmet and chainskirt , it is part of the Armadyl armour set, and requires 70 Defence and Ranged to wear.

Armadyl chainskirt.title: Armadyl chainskirt
Armadyl chainskirt.intro: The Armadyl chainskirt is an item that can be obtained from Kree'arra and his bodyguards in the God Wars Dungeon . Along with the Armadyl helmet and chestplate , it is part of the Armadyl armour set, and requires 70 Defence and Ranged to wear.

Armadyl hilt.title: Armadyl hilt
Armadyl hilt.intro: The Armadyl hilt is a rare drop from Kree'arra , in the God Wars Dungeon . Its design resembles a bird or winged being. When attached to a completed Godsword blade , which can be created by combining the three Godsword shards, it creates the Armadyl godsword .

K'ril Tsutsaroth.title: K'ril Tsutsaroth
K'ril Tsutsaroth.intro: K'ril Tsutsaroth (pronounced / ˌ k r ɪ l ˈ t ʌ d z iː r ɒ θ / KRILL TUTT -zee-roth ) is the leader of Zamorak 's forces in the God Wars Dungeon .

Staff of the Dead.title: Staff of the Dead
Staff of the Dead.intro: The staff of the dead is a one-handed bladed staff that requires 75 Magic and 75 Attack to wield. It is dropped by K'ril Tsutsaroth , and counts as a Zamorakian item while in the God Wars Dungeon and in the desert Bandit Camp . It is one of several one-handed staves which boost magic damage by 15%.

Zamorakian spear.title: Zamorakian spear
Zamorakian spear.intro: The Zamorakian spear is a two-handed spear obtained from the God Wars Dungeon as a drop from K'ril Tsutsaroth and his bodyguards, requiring an Attack level of 70 to wield. Unlike other spears , it cannot be poisoned , and has its highest bonus in stab , while other spears have the same bonus on all melee attack styles. The Zamorakian spear offers the fourth highest stab bonus of all weapons at +85, shared with the Zamorakian h

Steam battlestaff.title: Steam battlestaff
Steam battlestaff.intro: A steam battlestaff is a steam elemental staff which provides unlimited amounts of water and fire runes as well as the autocast option when equipped. It requires 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield.

Zamorak hilt.title: Zamorak hilt
Zamorak hilt.intro: The Zamorak hilt is dropped by K'ril Tsutsaroth , in the God Wars Dungeon as a rare drop. When attached to a completed godsword blade , which can be created by combining the three godsword blade shards, it creates the Zamorak godsword .

The Leviathan.title: The Leviathan
The Leviathan.intro: The Leviathan is a large sea creature found within the Scar , who is encountered during Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire . Once dwelling in the Eastern Ocean , the Leviathan was inadvertently dragged into the Scar during the Battle for the Eye when Perseriya of the Forgotten Four accidentally opened an abyssal rift in an attempt to teleport reinforcements in.

Leviathan's lure.title: Leviathan's lure
Leviathan's lure.intro: The Leviathan's lure is an item dropped by The Leviathan . It is one of four components used to create the soulreaper axe , alongside the executioner's axe head , eye of the Duke , and siren's staff .

Venator vestige.title: Venator vestige
Venator vestige.intro: After learning how to combine ring icons from Peer the Seer , the vestige can be used on an archer icon to create the venator icon , which is then brought to a furnace alongside three chromium ingots and a ring mould to craft the venator ring . The entire process requires level 90 Magic and 80 Crafting , which can be boosted.

Smoke quartz.title: Smoke quartz
Smoke quartz.intro: The smoke quartz is a gem dropped by the Leviathan . It is used on an ancient sceptre to create the smoke ancient sceptre ; this process can be reversed. It can also be used to open a chest in the Ancient Vault .

Scarred tablet.title: Scarred tablet
Scarred tablet.intro: The scarred tablet is an item dropped by the Leviathan . It is used on the ring of shadows to unlock a teleport to the Scar .

The Mad Angel.title: Mad Angel
The Mad Angel.intro: The Mad Angel is a golem boss found in Ardeaglais , a cathedral on the island of Wyrmscraig . A weak version of it is fought during the quest Fallen From Grace , and a stronger, repeatable version becomes available after quest completion.

Hallowfell.title: Hallowfell
Hallowfell.intro: Hallowfell is a two-handed sword that requires level 75 Attack to wield. It is a reward from fighting the Mad Angel , a boss found on Wyrmscraig , and it has a unique effect where it can hit multiple enemies in an area around the player at once.

Ardeaglais teleport.title: Ardeaglais teleport
Ardeaglais teleport.intro: Ardeaglais teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the entrance of Ardeaglais on Wyrmscraig . It is dropped by the Mad Angel , and can be stored in the master scroll book .

Maggot King.title: Maggot King
Maggot King.intro: The Maggot King is a boss in Vampyrium that requires completion of The Blood Moon Rises to kill. The entrance to its lair can be found in the forest east of Sangvesti , near the Ruined Village .

Crimson kisten.title: Crimson kisten
Crimson kisten.intro: The crimson kisten is a two-handed spiked weapon requiring level 60 Attack and 85 Strength to wield. Obtained as a rare drop from the Maggot King , the weapon is mainly used for its special attack , dealing high damage against opponents weak to crush attacks.

Jar of Light.title: Jar of Light
Jar of Light.intro: The jar of light is a rare drop from the Mad Angel found on Wyrmscraig .

Elder venator fang.title: Elder venator fang
Elder venator fang.intro: The elder venator fang is an item dropped by the Maggot King . With a Crafting level of 84, it can be etched using a chisel to produce the tradeable etched elder venator fang , which is used to upgrade the necklace of anguish into the necklace of rupture , giving 500 Crafting experience. The etched elder venator fang , despite being tradeable, cannot be sacrificed in Death's Coffer .

Moons of Peril.title: Moons of Peril
Moons of Peril.intro: The Moons of Peril are three nagua bosses imprisoned in Neypotzli , a prison located beneath Cam Torum . Aimed at mid-level players of at least level 75 combat, players may fight each boss one-by-one, using the powerful resources within Neypotzli to restock inbetween fights. Completing the Perilous Moons quest acts as an introduction to Neypotzli and the bosses, and is required to fight them.

Eclipse Moon chestplate.title: Eclipse Moon chestplate
Eclipse Moon chestplate.intro: Eclipse Moon chestplate is an item that requires level 75 Ranged and 50 Defence to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli .

Eclipse Moon tassets.title: Eclipse Moon tassets
Eclipse Moon tassets.intro: Eclipse Moon tassets are an item that requires level 75 Ranged and 50 Defence to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli .

Eclipse atlatl.title: Eclipse atlatl
Eclipse atlatl.intro: The eclipse atlatl is a non-degradable two-handed ranged weapon that requires level 75 Ranged , 50 Attack , and 50 Strength to equip. It can be obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli . It uses atlatl darts as ammunition, which can be collected by Ava's devices .

Blue Moon chestplate.title: Blue Moon chestplate
Blue Moon chestplate.intro: The Blue Moon chestplate is an item that requires level 75 Magic and 50 Defence to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli .

Eclipse Moon helm.title: Eclipse Moon helm
Eclipse Moon helm.intro: Eclipse Moon helm is an item that requires level 75 Ranged and 50 Defence to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli .

Blue Moon tassets.title: Blue Moon tassets
Blue Moon tassets.intro: The Blue Moon tassets are an item that requires level 75 Magic and 50 Defence to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli .

Blue Moon helm.title: Blue Moon helm
Blue Moon helm.intro: The Blue Moon helm is an item that requires level 75 Magic and 50 Defence to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli .

Blue Moon spear.title: Blue Moon spear
Blue Moon spear.intro: The Blue Moon spear is a non-degradable two-handed bladed staff that requires level 70 Attack and 75 Magic to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli . It can autocast elemental spells from the standard spellbook , as well as combat spells from the Arceuus spellbook and Ancient Magicks . Despite the name, the Blue Moon spear is not a spear and not considered a corpbane weapon .

Blood Moon chestplate.title: Blood Moon chestplate
Blood Moon chestplate.intro: The Blood Moon chestplate is an item that requires level 75 Strength and 50 Defence to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli . With similar stats to a fighter torso , it is tradeable and has identical strength bonus, while having +50 more magic defence bonus.

Blood Moon tassets.title: Blood Moon tassets
Blood Moon tassets.intro: Blood Moon tassets are an item that requires level 75 Strength and 50 Defence to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli . With an identical strength bonus to the Bandos tassets and having +36 more magic defence bonus, it can be considered as a cheaper, easier to acquire alternative.

Blood Moon helm.title: Blood Moon helm
Blood Moon helm.intro: Blood Moon helm is an item that requires level 75 Strength and 50 Defence to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli .

Dual macuahuitl.title: Dual macuahuitl
Dual macuahuitl.intro: The dual macuahuitl (in English pronounced roughly mah- KWAH -weetl ) is a non-degradable two-handed spiked weapon that requires level 70 Attack and 75 Strength to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli .

Atlatl dart.title: Atlatl dart
Atlatl dart.intro: Atlatl darts are ammunition used exclusively by the eclipse atlatl , which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli . Alternatively the darts can be crafted, requiring level 74 Fletching , Headless atlatl dart and Atlatl dart tips . Ironmen additionally require 54 Slayer in order to obtain broken antlers , which are required to make the dart tips.

Nex.title: Nex
Nex.intro: Nex is one of Zaros ' most powerful followers. She is imprisoned in the Ancient Prison , sealed away beneath the God Wars Dungeon . An immensely powerful entity and one of Zaros's most powerful weapons of war, Nex is a nihil from Freneskae and possesses physical traits of the icyene , demons , aviansie and vampyres .

Ancient hilt.title: Ancient hilt
Ancient hilt.intro: The ancient hilt is a rare drop from Nex , in the God Wars Dungeon . Its design bears the Zarosian symbol, and was created under Nex's orders after her escape from the Ancient Prison . Though the hilt was created, it never saw usage as the four armies of the gods joined forces to imprison Nex once more before the weapon could be completed.

Nihil horn.title: Nihil horn
Nihil horn.intro: The nihil horn is an item dropped by Nex . It is used to upgrade an Armadyl crossbow to a Zaryte crossbow , alongside 250 nihil shards .

Zaryte vambraces.title: Zaryte vambraces
Zaryte vambraces.intro: Zaryte vambraces are a pair of vambraces requiring 80 Ranged and 45 Defence to wear. Obtained as a drop from Nex , the vambraces are the best-in-slot offensive gloves for rangers, surpassing Barrows gloves . It is also the only hands slot item to offer a Ranged Strength bonus.

Torva full helm (damaged).title: Torva full helm
Torva full helm (damaged).intro: The Torva full helm is part of the Torva armour set, requiring 80 Defence to wear. The helmet boasts the highest strength bonus of any helmet, being 2 higher than the Neitiznot faceguard and 3 higher than the serpentine helm . As a Zarosian -aligned item, Torva armour will give Zarosian protection within the God Wars Dungeon .

Torva platebody (damaged).title: Torva platebody
Torva platebody (damaged).intro: The Torva platebody is part of the Torva armour set, requiring 80 Defence to wear. The platebody boasts the highest strength bonus of any body slot equipment, being 2 higher than the oathplate chest , Bandos chestplate , Inquisitor's hauberk , fighter torso , and Blood Moon chestplate . As a Zarosian -aligned item, Torva armour will give Zarosian protection within the God Wars Dungeon .

Torva platelegs (damaged).title: Torva platelegs
Torva platelegs (damaged).intro: The Torva platelegs are part of the Torva armour set, requiring 80 Defence to wear. The platelegs boast the highest strength bonus of any legs slot equipment, being 2 higher than the Bandos tassets . As a Zarosian -aligned item, Torva armour will give Zarosian protection within the God Wars Dungeon .

Nihil shard.title: Nihil shard
Nihil shard.intro: Nihil shards are an item dropped by all monsters in the Ancient Prison .

The Nightmare.title: The Nightmare
The Nightmare.intro: The Nightmare of Ashihama , often referred to as The Nightmare , is a boss monster located in Morytania . The Nightmare can be found in the Sisterhood Sanctuary under the town of Slepe . Access to Morytania is the only requirement for fighting The Nightmare.

tables.heading: Drops › Uniques › Inquisitor's and Nightmare staff table

Inquisitor's mace.title: Inquisitor's mace
Inquisitor's mace.intro: The Inquisitor's mace is a one-handed crush weapon requiring 80 Attack to wield. Received as a drop from The Nightmare , it has bonuses nearly identical to the Ghrazi rapier and blade of Saeldor , acting as the crush variant of these weapons, with an additional +3 Strength bonus and +2 Prayer bonus.

Inquisitor's great helm.title: Inquisitor's great helm
Inquisitor's great helm.intro: The Inquisitor's great helm is a drop from The Nightmare , requiring 70 Strength and 30 Defence to equip, and is part of the Inquisitor's armour set.

Inquisitor's hauberk.title: Inquisitor's hauberk
Inquisitor's hauberk.intro: The Inquisitor's hauberk is a drop from The Nightmare , requiring 70 Strength and 30 Defence to equip, and is part of the Inquisitor's armour set.

Inquisitor's plateskirt.title: Inquisitor's plateskirt
Inquisitor's plateskirt.intro: The Inquisitor's plateskirt is a drop from The Nightmare , requiring 70 Strength and 30 Defence to equip, and is part of the Inquisitor's armour set.

Nightmare staff.title: Nightmare staff
Nightmare staff.intro: The Nightmare staff is a one-handed staff that can be received as a drop from The Nightmare . Requiring level 72 Magic and 50 Hitpoints to wield, it can autocast offensive standard spells as well as Ancient Magicks .

Harmonised orb.title: Harmonised orb
Harmonised orb.intro: The harmonised orb is an item obtained as a rare drop from The Nightmare . It can be used on a Nightmare staff to upgrade it to the harmonised Nightmare staff .

Eldritch orb.title: Eldritch orb
Eldritch orb.intro: The eldritch orb is an item obtained as a rare drop from The Nightmare . It can be used on a Nightmare staff to upgrade it to the eldritch Nightmare staff .

Volatile orb.title: Volatile orb
Volatile orb.intro: The volatile orb is an item obtained as a rare drop from The Nightmare . It can be used on a Nightmare staff to upgrade it to the volatile Nightmare staff .

Jar of Dreams.title: Jar of Dreams
Jar of Dreams.intro: The jar of dreams is a rare drop from The Nightmare found in the Sisterhood Sanctuary .

Slepey tablet.title: Slepey tablet
Slepey tablet.intro: The Slepey tablet is a reward from defeating Phosani's Nightmare . Players may use the tablet on Drakan's medallion to be given the ability to teleport to Slepe , which takes players to the entrance of the Sisterhood Sanctuary .

Parasitic egg.title: Parasitic egg
Parasitic egg.intro: The parasitic egg is a reward from defeating Phosani's Nightmare . Players may use the egg on the Little Nightmare to allow it to metamorphose into a parasite version of the pet.

Obor.title: Obor
Obor.intro: Obor , the Hill Titan, is the hill giant boss residing in his lair, located behind the locked gates found at the western wall of the hill giant area in the Edgeville Dungeon .

Hill giant club.title: Hill giant club
Hill giant club.intro: The hill giant club is a two-handed melee weapon requiring 40 Attack to equip. It is currently the best-in-slot weapon for crush bonuses in free-to-play , possessing very similar stats to a rune 2h sword but with the slash and crush bonuses swapped, though the rune 2h sword has a slightly higher slash bonus than the crush bonus of the club.

Phantom Muspah.title: Phantom Muspah
Phantom Muspah.intro: The Phantom Muspah is a solo boss that can be fought after completion of the quest Secrets of the North . It is the leftover energy of the Strange Creature that manifested after the events of the quest.

Venator shard.title: Venator shard
Venator shard.intro: The Venator shard is a drop received from defeating the Phantom Muspah . Five shards are combined to create the venator bow .

Ancient icon.title: Ancient icon
Ancient icon.intro: The ancient icon is an untradeable drop received from defeating the Phantom Muspah , who can be fought upon completion of Secrets of the North . It can be brought to Eblis alongside the ancient staff to upgrade it to the ancient sceptre . This process is irreversible and the sceptre is untradeable.

Charged ice.title: Charged ice
Charged ice.intro: Charged ice is a tertiary drop from the Phantom Muspah , guaranteed as a drop if it is killed in under three minutes. It is used on a Muphin to allow it to metamorphose into its melee and shielded forms. Once used on Muphin, it cannot be obtained again, even if the player gets another kill under three minutes.

Frozen cache.title: Frozen cache
Frozen cache.intro: The frozen cache is a drop received from defeating the Phantom Muspah . When opened, it gives a reward from the Muspah's drop table.

Ancient essence.title: Ancient essence
Ancient essence.intro: Ancient essence is a drop received from defeating the Phantom Muspah . An average Phantom Muspah kill will drop 765.4 essence (counting frozen cache loot, not counting breaking down items.) It can also be obtained by mining ancient essence crystals in the Ghorrock Dungeon with 75 Mining , granting 13.5 Mining experience. It is used to create the saturated heart and forgotten brews . It is also used to charge the Venator bow to

Royal Titans.title: Royal Titans
Royal Titans.intro: The Royal Titans are a boss encounter consisting of the two giants Eldric the Ice King and Branda the Fire Queen . Rulers over their domains in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon and beneath the Karamja Volcano respectively, Branda is set on expanding her territory and has begun clashing with Eldric.

Deadeye prayer scroll.title: Deadeye prayer scroll
Deadeye prayer scroll.intro: The deadeye prayer scroll is a possible reward from looting Eldric the Ice King of the Royal Titans . Reading it requires level 62 Prayer , which in turn consumes the scroll and unlocks the Deadeye prayer, which replaces Eagle Eye within the prayer book.

Mystic vigour prayer scroll.title: Mystic vigour prayer scroll
Mystic vigour prayer scroll.intro: The mystic vigour prayer scroll is a possible reward from looting Branda the Fire Queen of the Royal Titans . Reading it requires level 63 Prayer , which in turn consumes the scroll and unlocks the Mystic Vigour prayer, which replaces Mystic Might within the prayer book. Since the scroll is consumed upon reading, it cannot be obtained again from looting Branda the Fire Queen .

Giantsoul amulet (uncharged).title: Giantsoul amulet
Giantsoul amulet (uncharged).intro: The giantsoul amulet is an amulet that can be obtained as an untradeable drop from looting either Branda the Fire Queen or Eldric the Ice King . When charged, it provides teleports to the entrances of the lairs of Bryophyta , Obor , and the Royal Titans .

Ice element staff crown.title: Ice element staff crown
Ice element staff crown.intro: The ice element staff crown is a possible reward from looting Eldric the Ice King of the Royal Titans . It is used alongside a battlestaff and the fire element staff crown , which can be obtained from looting Branda the Fire Queen , to create the twinflame staff .

Fire element staff crown.title: Fire element staff crown
Fire element staff crown.intro: The fire element staff crown is a possible reward from looting Branda the Fire Queen of the Royal Titans . It is used alongside a battlestaff and the ice element staff crown , which can be obtained from looting Eldric the Ice King , to create the twinflame staff .

Desiccated page.title: Desiccated page
Desiccated page.intro: Desiccated pages are an untradeable item obtained as loot from the Royal Titans . Players can obtain them commonly as regular loot, but can also guarantee obtaining them via their right-click "Take pages" option; tertiary loot (such as Bran and clue scrolls ) are still rolled as normal.

rows.text: Eldric the Ice King Take pages
Branda the Fire Queen Take pages

Sarachnis.title: Sarachnis
Sarachnis.intro: Sarachnis , the mother of the temple spiders , is a mid-level boss found in the Forthos Dungeon , in a former burial tomb south of the Spider Den.

Jar of Eyes.title: Jar of Eyes
Jar of Eyes.intro: The jar of eyes is a rare drop from Sarachnis found in the Forthos Dungeon .

Giant egg sac(full).title: Giant egg sac
Giant egg sac(full).intro: A giant egg sac is an item obtained as a drop from Sarachnis , which can be opened with a knife while standing inside a bank (right click egg sac in bank interface, then click empty) to obtain 100 red spiders' eggs , which is worth 17,800 . This means opening a full giant egg sac results in a profit of 1,695 .

Sarachnis cudgel.title: Sarachnis cudgel
Sarachnis cudgel.intro: Sarachnis cudgel is a one-handed crush weapon dropped by Sarachnis , requiring level 65 Attack to equip. The weapon appears to be made from several of Sarachnis' legs bound together by her webs.

Pristine spider silk.title: Pristine spider silk
Pristine spider silk.intro: Pristine spider silk is an item dropped by Sarachnis , which can be combined with the herb sack to create a silklined herb sack , which gives an increased storage capacity.

Scorpia.title: Scorpia
Scorpia.intro: Scorpia is a large female scorpion boss that resides in a cave beneath the Scorpion Pit located in Wilderness level 53-55.

Odium shard 3.title: Odium shard 3
Odium shard 3.intro: The odium shard 3 is an item dropped by Scorpia . When the two other shards, the odium shard 1 and 2 are obtained, they can be forged into an odium ward on the Blighted Volcano on the most north-east part of the Wilderness .

Malediction shard 3.title: Malediction shard 3
Malediction shard 3.intro: The malediction shard 3 is an item dropped by Scorpia . When the two other shards, the malediction shard 1 and 2 are obtained, they can be forged into a malediction ward on the Blighted Volcano on the most north-east part of the Wilderness .

Scurrius.title: Scurrius
Scurrius.intro: Scurrius, the Rat King is a boss residing in the Varrock Sewers . As a mid-level boss meant for players with a combat level of 60-90, Scurrius is meant to introduce various mechanics that are present in higher-level play, such as switching protection prayers quickly during combat as well as dodging attacks and managing multiple monsters mid-fight.

Scurrius' spine.title: Scurrius' spine
Scurrius' spine.intro: Scurrius' spine is an uncommon drop from Scurrius . It can be combined with various weapons to create rat bone weapons .

Shellbane Gryphon.title: Shellbane gryphon
Shellbane Gryphon.intro: The shellbane gryphon is the boss version of gryphons found in a cave in the centre of the Great Conch , requiring level 51 Slayer and completion of Troubled Tortugans to kill. As a Slayer boss , it may only be killed while on a gryphons Slayer task . Gryphon Slayer tasks must be unlocked by purchasing the 'Wings Spread' reward from a Slayer master for 80 Slayer Points in order to be assigned them by Nieve / Steve or Duradel /

Jar of Feathers.title: Jar of Feathers
Jar of Feathers.intro: The jar of feathers is a rare untradeable drop from the Shellbane Gryphon that can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of the boss.

Belle's folly (tarnished).title: Belle's folly (tarnished)
Belle's folly (tarnished).intro: The tarnished Belle's folly is the broken version of Belle's folly , dropped exclusively by the Shellbane Gryphon . Players with 70 Smithing and completion of the quest Sleeping Giants can repair the blade at the polishing wheel in the Giants' Foundry ; boosts can be used. Repairing the blade grants the player 500 Smithing experience.

Gryphon feather.title: Gryphon feather
Gryphon feather.intro: Gryphon feathers are dropped by all types of gryphons . They are used to charge the horn of plenty , giving various buffs whilst training Hunter . They can be stored in a huntsman's kit .

Skotizo.title: Skotizo
Skotizo.intro: Skotizo is a demonic boss located beneath the Catacombs of Kourend . Accessing his lair requires the use of a dark totem on the altar found in the centre of the Catacombs; one dark totem permits only one attempt, which makes him a sporadic boss .

Jar of Darkness.title: Jar of Darkness
Jar of Darkness.intro: The jar can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of Skotizo. Doing so requires killing it at least once.

Dark claw.title: Dark claw
Dark claw.intro: The dark claw is an uncommon drop from Skotizo . It can be combined with a slayer helmet or slayer helmet (i) to create a purple slayer helmet or purple slayer helmet (i) , respectively. Doing so requires purchasing the ability Dark Mantle for 1,000 Slayer reward points .

Dark totem.title: Dark totem
Dark totem.intro: The dark totem is an item that can be created by combining the dark totem base , dark totem middle , and dark totem top . The totem pieces are dropped in that order and duplicates drop after all three are obtained. It is used on the altar in the centre of the Catacombs of Kourend to access the lower level of the catacombs to fight Skotizo . The totem is consumed when using it on the altar regardless of the outcome of the fight

Ancient shard.title: Ancient shard
Ancient shard.intro: Ancient shards are obtained from monsters found within the Catacombs of Kourend (excluding ghosts ). Three shards can be used with a Darklight at the altar in the centre of the catacombs to create an Arclight , a degradeable variant of the darklight that is the second most powerful melee weapon when used against demons. Ancient shards are also used to charge Arclight. One shard provides 333 charges, three shards provide 1,000

Tempoross.title: Tempoross
Tempoross.intro: Tempoross is a cooperative minigame -style boss that is fought using skills rather than combat. 35 Fishing is required to fight it, with players assisting the Spirit Anglers in depleting its energy by fishing for and cooking harpoonfish to be loaded as cannon ammunition, then reducing its essence by fishing for energised fish.

rows.text: 20 per raw fish 20 per crystallised fish 65 per cooked fish

Big harpoonfish.title: Big harpoonfish
Big harpoonfish.intro: A big harpoonfish is an abnormally large harpoonfish that can be received from the reward pool in the Ruins of Unkah . It can be traded for 25 soaked pages by talking to the retired sailor inside the fishing store in the Ruins of Unkah.

Spirit angler headband.title: Spirit angler headband
Spirit angler headband.intro: The Spirit angler headband is an upgraded version of the angler hat . It can be purchased from Gita Prymes by exchanging an angler hat along with 1,200 spirit flakes . The headband grants 0.4% bonus Fishing experience . Tempoross has a skill requirement of 35 Fishing; therefore, the headband requires level 35 Fishing to wear.

Spirit angler top.title: Spirit angler top
Spirit angler top.intro: The Spirit angler top is an upgraded version of the angler top . It can be purchased from Gita Prymes by exchanging an angler top along with 1,200 spirit flakes . The top grants 0.8% bonus Fishing experience . Tempoross has a skill requirement of 35 Fishing; therefore, the top requires level 35 Fishing to wear.

Spirit angler waders.title: Spirit angler waders
Spirit angler waders.intro: The Spirit angler waders are an upgraded version of the angler waders . They can be purchased from Gita Prymes by exchanging angler waders along with 1,200 spirit flakes . The waders grant 0.6% bonus Fishing experience . Tempoross has a skill requirement of 35 Fishing; therefore, the waders require level 35 Fishing to wear.

Spirit angler boots.title: Spirit angler boots
Spirit angler boots.intro: The Spirit angler boots are an upgraded version of the angler boots . They can be purchased from Gita Prymes by exchanging a pair of angler boots along with 1,200 spirit flakes . The boots grant 0.2% bonus Fishing experience . Tempoross has a skill requirement of 35 Fishing; therefore, the boots require level 35 Fishing to wear.

Tome of Water (empty).title: Tome of Water
Tome of Water (empty).intro: The tome of water is a book held in place of a shield that is a possible reward from Tempoross . The tome of water requires level 50 in Magic to wield.

Soaked page.title: Soaked page
Soaked page.intro: Soaked pages are a possible catch from fishing at the reward pool with the reward permits from subduing Tempoross , or created at the Book of Storms with desiccated pages and level 50 Runecraft . They are used to charge the tome of water , which gives it additional effects.

Tackle box.title: Tackle box
Tackle box.intro: The tackle box can be obtained from fishing at the reward pool with the reward permits gained from subduing Tempoross , or purchased from Flakes 'n' Flotsam for 6,000 spirit flakes . The tackle box can be used to store various fishing equipment. It is not possible to use the items whilst they are in the tackle box; for example, players must still have a fishing rod and Sandworms in their inventory to fish Anglerfish even if th

Fish barrel.title: Fish barrel
Fish barrel.intro: The fish barrel is an item that can be obtained from the reward pool in the Ruins of Unkah after defeating Tempoross , or purchased from Flakes 'n' Flotsam for 6,000 spirit flakes . The barrel is able to store a combined total of 28 raw fish of any type except for harpoonfish (from Tempoross ), stackable fish, trophy fish , Leechfin , and fish caught in the Chambers of Xeric , Ruins of Camdozaal , or Neypotzli . Players can ri

Dragon harpoon.title: Dragon harpoon
Dragon harpoon.intro: The dragon harpoon is a wieldable harpoon that requires 61 Fishing to use and 60 Attack to wield. The harpoon gives the player a 20% increased catch rate compared to the regular harpoon , reduced to 5% at Tempoross . Its combat stats are comparable to the dragon dagger , but it is 1 tick slower. It can be stored in a tackle box .

Spirit flakes.title: Spirit flakes
Spirit flakes.intro: Spirit flakes are a fishing enhancer item received from looting the reward pool after defeating Tempoross . On average, 12 are received per reward permit. They can be stored in a tackle box .

rows.text: Tiny port reward bag Ruins of Unkah
Small port reward bag Ruins of Unkah
Medium port reward bag Ruins of Unkah

Thermonuclear Smoke Devil.title: Thermonuclear smoke devil
Thermonuclear Smoke Devil.intro: The thermonuclear smoke devil , often referred to as thermy , is the boss version of the smoke devil . It requires a minimum of 93 Slayer to damage. Located at the Smoke Devil Dungeon south of Castle Wars , the Thermonuclear smoke devil can only be attacked on a smoke devil task, with the exception of one kill for the Western Provinces Diary (provided that the player has 93 Slayer without boosting).

Occult necklace.title: Occult necklace
Occult necklace.intro: The occult necklace is a magical amulet that requires 70 Magic to wear. It is dropped by the smoke devil and its boss variant . Wearing it increases the player's Magic damage by 5%, and is the only amulet to give such a bonus. This 5% bonus will also stack with existing boosts, such as the staff of the dead and the imbued slayer helmet . The salve amulet(ei) does not apply its damage bonus to other hit targets when barraging .

Smoke battlestaff.title: Smoke battlestaff
Smoke battlestaff.intro: The smoke battlestaff is an elemental staff requiring 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield. The staff provides unlimited amounts of air and fire runes as well as the autocast option when equipped.

Jar of Smoke.title: Jar of Smoke
Jar of Smoke.intro: It can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of the boss. Doing so requires killing it at least once.

Vardorvis.title: Vardorvis
Vardorvis.intro: Carnifex Maximus Vardorvis was a Ghrazi vampyre whose corpse is found in the Stranglewood Ritual Site , animated by the Strangler parasite. A high-ranking member of the Zarosian Empire , Vardorvis succumbed to the Strangler and has remained under its control ever since, where the player encounters it during Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire . A stronger variant of him can be fought again after the completion of the quest.

Executioner's axe head.title: Executioner's axe head
Executioner's axe head.intro: The executioner's axe head is an item dropped by Vardorvis . It is one of four components used to create the soulreaper axe , alongside the eye of the Duke , siren's staff , and Leviathan's lure .

Ultor vestige.title: Ultor vestige
Ultor vestige.intro: After learning how to combine ring icons from Peer the Seer , the vestige can be used on a berserker icon along with 500 blood runes , to create the ultor icon , which is then brought to a furnace alongside three chromium ingots and a ring mould , to craft the ultor ring . The entire process requires level 90 Magic and 80 Crafting , both of which can be boosted.

Blood quartz.title: Blood quartz
Blood quartz.intro: The blood quartz is a gem dropped by Vardorvis . It is used on an ancient sceptre to create the blood ancient sceptre ; this process can be reversed. It can also be used to open a chest in the Ancient Vault (this will consume the Blood quartz).

Strangled tablet.title: Strangled tablet
Strangled tablet.intro: The strangled tablet is an item dropped by Vardorvis . It is used on the ring of shadows to unlock a teleport to the temple entrance in the Stranglewood .

Treasonous ring.title: Treasonous ring
Treasonous ring.intro: It can be imbued into a treasonous ring (i) using 650,000 Nightmare Zone reward points or 325,000 with the hard tier of Combat Achievements , 260 Soul Wars zeal tokens , or a scroll of imbuing , purchased for 200 Emir's Arena reward points, doubling the stab attack and stab defence bonuses to +8.

Fangs of Venenatis.title: Fangs of Venenatis
Fangs of Venenatis.intro: The fangs of Venenatis are an item dropped by Venenatis and Spindel . They are used to upgrade Craw's bow into a webweaver bow . This process requires level 85 Fletching ; players without the required level to combine the items may ask Derse Venator in Ferox Enclave to do so instead, for a fee of 500,000 coins . The uncharged weapon may be dismantled to separate the bow and fangs.

Voidwaker gem.title: Voidwaker gem
Voidwaker gem.intro: The Voidwaker gem is one of three pieces of the Voidwaker dropped by Venenatis and Spindel . The gem, alongside the Voidwaker hilt and Voidwaker blade , must be brought to Madam Sikaro in the Ferox Enclave Dungeon , who combines the three parts for a fee of 500,000 coins .

Ring of the gods.title: Ring of the gods
Ring of the gods.intro: It can be imbued , with the holy wrench in inventory, for 650,000 Nightmare Zone reward points or 325,000 with the hard tier of Combat Achievements , 260 Soul Wars zeal tokens , or a scroll of imbuing , purchased for 200 Emir's Arena reward points, giving it an additional +4 prayer bonus as well as the effect of the holy wrench when equipped. A Prayer cape cannot be used as a substitute for the holy wrench when imbuing.

Skull of Vet'ion.title: Skull of Vet'ion
Skull of Vet'ion.intro: The skull of Vet'ion is an item dropped by Vet'ion and Calvar'ion . It is used to upgrade Thammaron's sceptre into an accursed sceptre . This process requires level 85 Crafting ; players without the required level to combine the items may ask Phabelle Bile in Ferox Enclave to do so instead, for a fee of 500,000 coins . The uncharged weapon may be dismantled to separate the sceptre and skull.

Voidwaker blade.title: Voidwaker blade
Voidwaker blade.intro: The Voidwaker blade is one of three pieces of the Voidwaker , dropped by Vet'ion and Calvar'ion . The blade, alongside the Voidwaker hilt and Voidwaker gem , must be brought to Madam Sikaro in the Ferox Enclave Dungeon , who combines the three parts for a fee of 500,000 coins .

Vorkath.title: Vorkath
Vorkath.intro: Vorkath (roughly translated as pathetic failure/weakling/runt in the dragonkin's language ) is a draconic boss-monster first encountered during the Dragon Slayer II quest as the penultimate boss. Created by Zorgoth during the Fourth Age 's Dragonkin Conflicts , the blue dragon is one of his subjects that has survived his experiments in the laboratory beneath the dragonkin fortress on Ungael . Despite its phenomenal strength, Z

Vorkath's head.title: Vorkath's head
Vorkath's head.intro: Vorkath's head is an item dropped by Vorkath . The head has various uses, such as being used to upgrade Ava's accumulator , as a cosmetic upgrade to the Slayer helmet , or sacrificed for Prayer experience. For any given kill, the drop rate of the head is 1/50, with the exception of the 50th kill, when the drop is guaranteed.

Skeletal visage.title: Skeletal visage
Skeletal visage.intro: A skeletal visage is an item obtained as a very rare drop from Vorkath .

Jar of Decay.title: Jar of Decay
Jar of Decay.intro: The jar of decay is a rare drop from Vorkath who can be found on the island of Ungael .

Dragonbone necklace.title: Dragonbone necklace
Dragonbone necklace.intro: The dragonbone necklace is a necklace that is dropped exclusively by Vorkath . Wearing the necklace requires level 70 in Prayer , and currently offers the highest Prayer bonus of any piece of equipment available in Old School RuneScape .

The Whisperer.title: The Whisperer
The Whisperer.intro: The Whisperer is a siren found in the sunken cathedral of the Lassar Undercity , who is encountered during Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire . A high-ranking assassin in the Zarosian Empire whose real name was classified, the Whisperer succumbed to the darkness of the blackstone and was transformed into her current state. A stronger variant of her can be fought again after the completion of the quest.

Siren's staff.title: Siren's staff
Siren's staff.intro: The siren's staff is an item dropped by The Whisperer . It is one of four components used to create the soulreaper axe , alongside the executioner's axe head , eye of the Duke , and Leviathan's lure .

Bellator vestige.title: Bellator vestige
Bellator vestige.intro: After learning how to combine ring icons from Peer the Seer , the vestige can be used on a warrior icon , along with 500 blood runes to create the bellator icon , which is then brought to a furnace alongside three chromium ingots and a ring mould to craft the bellator ring . The entire process requires level 90 Magic and 80 Crafting , which can be boosted.

Shadow quartz.title: Shadow quartz
Shadow quartz.intro: The shadow quartz is a gem dropped by the Whisperer . It is used on an ancient sceptre to create the shadow ancient sceptre ; this process can be reversed. It can also be used to open a chest in the Ancient Vault .

Sirenic tablet.title: Sirenic tablet
Sirenic tablet.intro: The sirenic tablet is an item dropped by the Whisperer . It is used on the ring of shadows to unlock a teleport to the palace of the Lassar Undercity .

Wintertodt.title: Wintertodt
Wintertodt.intro: The Wintertodt ( / ˈ w ɪ n t ər t ɒ d / win-ter-tod ) is a cooperative minigame-style boss that is fought using skills rather than combat. It is imprisoned behind the Doors of Dinh within the Northern Tundras of Great Kourend . 50 Firemaking is required to fight the Wintertodt, with players assisting the Order of the Sacred Flame by keeping braziers lit and pyromancers alive to defeat it.

rows.text: Adding Bruma roots to a brazier
Adding Bruma kindling to a brazier

Tome of Fire (empty).title: Tome of Fire
Tome of Fire (empty).intro: The tome of fire is a book held in place of a shield that is a possible reward from the reward cart upon subduing the Wintertodt . The tome of fire requires level 50 in Magic to wield.

Burnt page.title: Burnt page
Burnt page.intro: Burnt pages are a possible reward from the Reward Cart upon subduing the Wintertodt , or created at the Book of Eternal Flame with desiccated pages and level 50 Runecraft . They are used to charge the tome of fire , which gives it additional effects.

Pyromancer garb.title: Pyromancer garb
Pyromancer garb.intro: The pyromancer garb is a possible reward from the Reward Cart upon subduing the Wintertodt . The garb provides a 0.8% Firemaking experience boost. This is increased to 2.5% when wearing the full pyromancer outfit . Players can also trade in extra pieces for an extra supply crate or 50 burnt pages via Ignisia .

Pyromancer hood.title: Pyromancer hood
Pyromancer hood.intro: The pyromancer hood is a possible reward from the Reward Cart upon subduing the Wintertodt . The hood provides a 0.4% Firemaking experience boost. This is increased to 2.5% when wearing the full pyromancer outfit . Players can also trade in extra pieces for an extra supply crate or 50 burnt pages via Ignisia .

Pyromancer robe.title: Pyromancer robe
Pyromancer robe.intro: The pyromancer robe is a possible reward from the Reward Cart upon subduing the Wintertodt . The robe provides a 0.6% Firemaking experience boost. This is increased to 2.5% when wearing the full pyromancer outfit . Players can also trade in extra pieces for an extra supply crate or 50 burnt pages via Ignisia .

Pyromancer boots.title: Pyromancer boots
Pyromancer boots.intro: The pyromancer boots are a possible reward from the Reward Cart upon subduing the Wintertodt . The boots provide a 0.2% Firemaking experience boost. When wearing the full pyromancer outfit , the set bonus is 2.5%. Players can also trade in extra pieces for an extra supply crate or 50 burnt pages via Ignisia .

Warm gloves.title: Warm gloves
Warm gloves.intro: Warm gloves are obtained as a reward from the Reward Cart by contributing in the subduing of the Wintertodt .

Bruma torch.title: Bruma torch
Bruma torch.intro: The bruma torch is a possible reward from the Reward Cart after subduing the Wintertodt . When worn during the Wintertodt boss fight, it acts as a warm clothing item, and it can also be used as a replacement for a tinderbox for the purpose of lighting braziers , regardless of whether the torch is equipped or in the player's inventory.

Yama.title: Yama
Yama.intro: Yama, the Master of Pacts is a powerful demonic duo-focused boss who dwells in Yama's Domain found in the depths of the Chasm of Fire .
