Chasm teleport scroll.title: Chasm teleport scroll
Chasm teleport scroll.intro: Chasm teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the bottom of the Chasm of Fire next to the Voice of Yama . They can be obtained from defeating Yama and by opening dossiers . On average, Yama drops one teleport scroll approximately every 2.91 kills, including via dossiers.

Oathplate shards.title: Oathplate shards
Oathplate shards.intro: Oathplate shards are an uncommon drop from Yama used to create infernal nuggets , which can then be turned into oathplate armour . Nuggets can be created with level 83 Smithing by combining 5 oathplate shards with 28 crushed infernal shale .

Oathplate helm.title: Oathplate helm
Oathplate helm.intro: The oathplate helm is part of the oathplate armour set, requiring 78 Defence to wear. The helmet boasts the highest slash bonus of any helmet, being 5 higher than the warrior helm / fighter hat . As a Zamorakian -aligned item, oathplate armour will give Zamorakian protection within the God Wars Dungeon .

Oathplate chest.title: Oathplate chest
Oathplate chest.intro: The oathplate chest is part of the oathplate armour set, requiring 78 Defence to wear. The chest is the only piece of body slot item to have a positive slash bonus , excluding the Vesta's chainbody which is only usable in Bounty Hunter . As a Zamorakian -aligned item, oathplate armour will give Zamorakian protection within the God Wars Dungeon .

Oathplate legs.title: Oathplate legs
Oathplate legs.intro: Oathplate legs are part of the oathplate armour set, requiring 78 Defence to wear. The legs are the only piece of legs slot item to have a positive slash bonus , excluding the Vesta's plateskirt which is only usable in Bounty Hunter . As a Zamorakian -aligned item, oathplate armour will give Zamorakian protection within the God Wars Dungeon .

Rite of vile transference.title: Rite of vile transference
Rite of vile transference.intro: The rite of vile transference is a scroll which when read will permanently upgrade the Death Charge spell to restore special attack energy from two targets per cast instead of one.

Forgotten lockbox.title: Forgotten lockbox
Forgotten lockbox.intro: The forgotten lockbox is a drop received from defeating Yama that can be opened to obtain a reward.

Soulflame horn.title: Soulflame horn
Soulflame horn.intro: The soulflame horn is a weapon obtained as a rare drop from Yama that requires level 80 Magic to equip. It is a guaranteed drop when defeating him in a Contract of Harmony Acquisition fight. The horn's main appeal is its special attack, which empowers nearby players' next melee attack, allowing its user to fill a support role in group content.

Dossier.title: Dossier
Dossier.intro: Dossiers are a drop from Yama . They can be opened to obtain a contract , chasm teleport scrolls , or a rite of vile transference . The Rite of Vile Transference is guaranteed from the first Dossier opened with at least 100 Yama kill count.

Barrel of demonic tallow (full).title: Barrel of demonic tallow
Barrel of demonic tallow (full).intro: A barrel of demonic tallow is an uncommon drop from Yama that can be emptied to receive 100 demonic tallow , an ingredient for surge potions . Partially emptying it converts it into a partially empty barrel that cannot be traded.

Zalcano.title: Zalcano
Zalcano.intro: Zalcano is a demon imprisoned beneath Prifddinas that is fought using skilling rather than conventional combat. Being immune to traditional combat damage, players must use their Mining , Smithing , and Runecraft skills to create imbued tephra capable of destroying her stone armour. Once her armour has been destroyed, they must damage her by mining her with a pickaxe .

Crystal tool seed.title: Crystal tool seed
Crystal tool seed.intro: The crystal tool seed is an elven crystal that can be turned into the crystal axe , crystal harpoon , or crystal pickaxe , using 120 crystal shards and the dragon counterpart on a singing bowl . It can be obtained as a drop from Zalcano .

Zalcano shard.title: Zalcano shard
Zalcano shard.intro: The Zalcano shard is an item dropped by Zalcano . It can be used on the dragon pickaxe to create the dragon pickaxe (or) , which alters its appearance. It is solely a cosmetic upgrade and does not change the stats.

Theatre of Blood.title: Theatre of Blood
Theatre of Blood.intro: The Theatre of Blood is a raid located beneath the castle of Ver Sinhaza . It is a large arena used by the ruling vampyres to host blood sports. The only hard requirement to participate in the raid is the completion of the Priest in Peril quest to be able to access Morytania . The raid is featured prominently in the quest A Night at the Theatre and also plays a part in The Blood Moon Rises .

Scythe of Vitur (uncharged).title: Scythe of Vitur
Scythe of Vitur (uncharged).intro: The Scythe of Vitur is a two-handed slash weapon requiring levels 80 Attack and 90 Strength to wield, available as a rare drop from the Theatre of Blood . The scythe is extremely valuable due to its immense power against most large monsters. It is only tradeable when completely uncharged.

Ghrazi rapier.title: Ghrazi rapier
Ghrazi rapier.intro: The Ghrazi rapier is a one-handed stab weapon obtainable as a rare drop from the Theatre of Blood . It requires level 80 Attack to wield. It provides the highest strength and stab bonus out of any weapon for its attack speed . This makes the rapier tied with the blade of Saeldor and the Inquisitor's mace for the melee weapon with the highest damage output for general use, although it is outperformed by the Osmumten's fang agai

Sanguinesti staff (uncharged).title: Sanguinesti staff
Sanguinesti staff (uncharged).intro: The Sanguinesti staff is a one-handed powered staff requiring 82 Magic to wield, available as a rare drop from the Theatre of Blood . Like most powered staves, it is only tradeable when it is fully uncharged. Named after the Sanguinesti region , the staff was crafted by Lord Lowerniel Drakan himself, and was given to Lady Verzik Vitur as a gift for her assistance in the Misthalin–Morytania War .

Justiciar faceguard.title: Justiciar faceguard
Justiciar faceguard.intro: The Justiciar faceguard is obtained as a rare drop from the Theatre of Blood . It is part of the justiciar armour set, and requires level 75 Defence to equip.

Justiciar chestguard.title: Justiciar chestguard
Justiciar chestguard.intro: The Justiciar chestguard is part of the justiciar armour set requiring 75 Defence to equip. It is a rare drop from the Theatre of Blood .

Justiciar legguards.title: Justiciar legguards
Justiciar legguards.intro: The Justiciar legguards is obtained as a rare drop from the Theatre of Blood . It is part of the justiciar armour set, and requires level 75 Defence to equip.

Avernic defender hilt.title: Avernic defender hilt
Avernic defender hilt.intro: The Avernic defender hilt is an add-on that can be received as a reward from the Theatre of Blood . When used with a dragon defender , the Avernic defender will be created after a confirmation message. This process can be reversed, but the hilt will not be returned.

Vial of blood.title: Vial of blood
Vial of blood.intro: Vials of blood are obtained as drops from the Theatre of Blood or made by squeezing 50 blood sacs into a vial. It is used as the base instead of a vial of water when creating bastion and battlemage potions .

Sinhaza shroud tier 1.title: Sinhaza shroud tier 1
Sinhaza shroud tier 1.intro: Sinhaza shroud tier 1 is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from the Mysterious Stranger by the entrance to the Theatre of Blood after completing 100 Theatre of Blood raids.

Sinhaza shroud tier 2.title: Sinhaza shroud tier 2
Sinhaza shroud tier 2.intro: Sinhaza shroud tier 2 is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from the Mysterious Stranger by the entrance to the Theatre of Blood after completing 500 Theatre of Blood raids.

Sinhaza shroud tier 3.title: Sinhaza shroud tier 3
Sinhaza shroud tier 3.intro: Sinhaza shroud tier 3 is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from the Mysterious Stranger by the entrance to the Theatre of Blood after completing 1,000 Theatre of Blood raids.

Sinhaza shroud tier 4.title: Sinhaza shroud tier 4
Sinhaza shroud tier 4.intro: Sinhaza shroud tier 4 is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from the Mysterious Stranger by the entrance to the Theatre of Blood after completing 1,500 Theatre of Blood raids.

Sinhaza shroud tier 5.title: Sinhaza shroud tier 5
Sinhaza shroud tier 5.intro: Sinhaza shroud tier 5 is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from the Mysterious Stranger by the entrance to the Theatre of Blood after completing 2,000 Theatre of Blood raids.

Sanguine dust.title: Sanguine dust
Sanguine dust.intro: Sanguine dust is a tertiary drop obtained upon completing a Theatre of Blood raid in Hard Mode . It is used on Lil' Zik to allow it to metamorphose into Lil' Maiden, Lil' Bloat, Lil' Nylo, Lil' Sot, and Lil' Xarp.

Tombs of Amascut.title: Tombs of Amascut
Tombs of Amascut.intro: The Tombs of Amascut is a raid set in the Kharidian Desert , within the Jaltevas Pyramid at the necropolis . To participate in the raid, players will have to complete the Beneath Cursed Sands quest .

Holy ornament kit.title: Holy ornament kit
Holy ornament kit.intro: The holy ornament kit is an ornament kit that can be obtained as a tertiary drop from completing a Theatre of Blood raid in Hard Mode. It can be used on the scythe of Vitur , converting it into a Holy Scythe of Vitur ; the Ghrazi rapier , converting it into the holy Ghrazi rapier ; or the Sanguinesti staff , converting it into the holy Sanguinesti staff . Aside from changing the weapons appearances, it also makes them count as

Tumeken's shadow (uncharged).title: Tumeken's shadow
Tumeken's shadow (uncharged).intro: Tumeken's shadow is a two-handed powered staff requiring 85 Magic to wield, and is only available as a rare drop from the Tombs of Amascut . The staff is extremely valuable as, when matched with other high-end magic gear, it excels with its damage and immense accuracy even against magic-resistant monsters. Like most powered staves, it is only tradeable when it is fully uncharged.

Elidinis' ward.title: Elidinis' ward
Elidinis' ward.intro: Elidinis' ward is a magical shield requiring 80 Magic , Defence , and Prayer to equip. Obtained as a rare drop from the Tombs of Amascut , the ward once belonged to the goddess Elidinis herself, who gave it to Pharaoh Osmumten before disappearing to mourn the loss of her husband Tumeken at the end of the Kharidian–Zarosian War .

Sanguine ornament kit.title: Sanguine ornament kit
Sanguine ornament kit.intro: The Sanguine ornament kit is an ornament kit that can be obtained as a tertiary drop from completing a Theatre of Blood raid in Hard Mode. It can only be used on the scythe of Vitur , converting it into a sanguine scythe of Vitur .

Masori mask.title: Masori mask
Masori mask.intro: The Masori mask is obtained as a rare drop from the Tombs of Amascut . It is part of the Masori armour set, and requires level 80 Ranged and 30 Defence to equip. As with the rest of the armour set, the mask boasts the highest ranged attack bonus of any item in the head slot .

Masori body.title: Masori body
Masori body.intro: The Masori body is obtained as a rare drop from the Tombs of Amascut . It is part of the Masori armour set, and requires level 80 Ranged and 30 Defence to equip. As with the rest of the armour set, the body boasts the highest ranged attack bonus of any item in the body slot .

Masori chaps.title: Masori chaps
Masori chaps.intro: The Masori chaps are obtained as a rare drop from the Tombs of Amascut . They are part of the Masori armour set, and require level 80 Ranged and 30 Defence to equip. As with the rest of the armour set, the chaps boast the highest ranged attack bonus of any item in the legs slot .

Lightbearer.title: Lightbearer
Lightbearer.intro: The Lightbearer is a ring obtained as a rare reward from the Tombs of Amascut . The ring was crafted by the warrior Ahmek from the unstable energy left behind from Tumeken 's sacrifice that ended the Kharidian–Zarosian War .

Osmumten's fang.title: Osmumten's fang
Osmumten's fang.intro: Osmumten's fang is a one-handed stab weapon obtained as a rare reward from the Tombs of Amascut . It was the weapon of Pharaoh Osmumten , who was a skilled hunter. It requires level 82 Attack to wield. A cursed phalanx can be attached to the fang to create Osmumten's fang (or) , a cosmetic variant of the weapon.

Thread of Elidinis.title: Thread of Elidinis
Thread of Elidinis.intro: The thread of Elidinis is an uncommon reward from the rewards chest within the Tombs of Amascut . Players with 75 Crafting can use the thread on a rune pouch with a needle in their inventory to create a divine rune pouch , which can store four types of runes instead of three. This process can be reversed to return both items.

Breach of the Scarab.title: Breach of the Scarab
Breach of the Scarab.intro: The Breach of the Scarab is an untradeable jewel that can be obtained as a reward from the Tombs of Amascut .

Eye of the Corruptor.title: Eye of the Corruptor
Eye of the Corruptor.intro: The Eye of the Corruptor is an untradeable jewel that can be obtained as a reward from the Tombs of Amascut .

Jewel of the Sun.title: Jewel of the Sun
Jewel of the Sun.intro: The Jewel of the Sun is an untradeable jewel that can be obtained as a reward from the Tombs of Amascut .

Jewel of Amascut.title: Jewel of Amascut
Jewel of Amascut.intro: The jewel of Amascut is an untradeable jewel that can be obtained as a reward from the Tombs of Amascut .

Menaphite ornament kit.title: Menaphite ornament kit
Menaphite ornament kit.intro: The Menaphite ornament kit is an ornament kit that can be used on Elidinis' ward (f) to create Elidinis' ward (or) , which alters its appearance. It is solely a cosmetic upgrade and does not change its stats.

Cursed phalanx.title: Cursed phalanx

Masori crafting kit.title: Masori crafting kit

This alters its appearance to match the appearance of Masori armour . It is solely a cosmetic upgrade and does not change the stats.

Cache of runes.title: Cache of runes

Dual sai.title: Dual sai
Dual sai.intro: The dual sai is a rare reward obtained from hard Treasure Trails . It has no requirements to be equipped and has equivalent stab attack bonus to a steel sword but offering slightly higher strength bonus.

Rune cane.title: Rune cane
Rune cane.intro: The rune cane is obtained as a reward from hard Treasure Trails . As with standard rune equipment , level 40 Attack is needed to equip this item. It is not used often as a weapon as it has the same stats as a rune mace with a 1- tick slower attack speed .

Amulet of glory (t4).title: Amulet of glory (t)
Amulet of glory (t4).intro: The amulet of glory (t) (or trimmed amulet of glory ) is a cosmetic variant of the regular amulet of glory . Players can receive this item as a reward from hard Treasure Trails at a chance of 1/1,625 per slot. Aside from appearance, it has the same functions and stat bonuses as a regular amulet of glory (including gem mining as long as it is charged).

Magic comp bow.title: Magic comp bow
Magic comp bow.intro: The magic comp bow requires level 50 Ranged to wield, and can fire arrows up to amethyst . It is slightly quicker and more accurate than a magic longbow , and features the same special attack . Magic comp bows can be obtained as a reward for completing a hard Treasure Trail .

Ring of 3rd Age.title: Ring of 3rd Age
Ring of 3rd Age.intro: The ring of 3rd Age can be obtained as a drop from The Mimic . It can change the model of the player to look like various 3rd age equipment .

Fury ornament kit.title: Fury ornament kit
Fury ornament kit.intro: The fury ornament kit is an ornament kit that can be obtained as a reward from elite Treasure Trails . It can be attached to Amulet of fury , making it an Amulet of fury (or) . Once it is attached, the amulet becomes untradeable. The ornamental kit can be detached any time the player wishes.

Dragon chainbody ornament kit.title: Dragon chainbody ornament kit
Dragon chainbody ornament kit.intro: The dragon chainbody ornament kit is an ornament kit that can be obtained as a reward from elite Treasure Trails . It can be attached to the Dragon chainbody , making it a Dragon chainbody (g) . Once attached, the ornamented chainbody cannot be sold, but the kit can be detached from the chainbody and sold.

Dragon legs/skirt ornament kit.title: Dragon legs/skirt ornament kit
Dragon legs/skirt ornament kit.intro: The dragon legs/skirt ornament kit is an ornament kit that can be obtained as a reward from elite Treasure Trails . It can be attached to a pair of Dragon platelegs or dragon plateskirt , creating Dragon platelegs (g) / skirt (g) . Once attached, the ornamented platelegs/plateskirts cannot be sold, but the kit can be detached from the platelegs/plateskirts and sold.

Dragon sq shield ornament kit.title: Dragon sq shield ornament kit
Dragon sq shield ornament kit.intro: The dragon sq shield ornament kit is an ornament kit that can be obtained as a reward from elite Treasure Trails . It can be attached to the Dragon sq shield , making it a Dragon sq shield (g) . Once attached, the ornamented square shield cannot be sold, but the kit can be detached from the square shield and sold.

Dragon full helm ornament kit.title: Dragon full helm ornament kit
Dragon full helm ornament kit.intro: The dragon full helm ornament kit is an ornament kit that can be obtained as a reward from elite Treasure Trails . It can be attached to the Dragon full helm , making it a Dragon full helm (g) . Once attached, the ornamented helm cannot be sold, but the kit can be detached from the helm and sold.

Dragon scimitar ornament kit.title: Dragon scimitar ornament kit
Dragon scimitar ornament kit.intro: The dragon scimitar ornament kit is an ornament kit that can be obtained as a reward from elite Treasure Trails . It can be attached to the dragon scimitar , making it a dragon scimitar (or) .

Light infinity colour kit.title: Light infinity colour kit
Light infinity colour kit.intro: The light infinity colour kit is an ornament kit that can be obtained as a reward from elite Treasure Trails . It can be attached to hat , top and bottoms of the infinity robes set. It can't be attached to the boots or gloves . Once attached, the robes cannot be sold, but the kit can be detached safely, receiving both items.

Dark infinity colour kit.title: Dark infinity colour kit
Dark infinity colour kit.intro: The dark infinity colour kit is an ornament kit that can be obtained as a reward from elite Treasure Trails . It can be attached to hat , top and bottoms of the infinity robes set. It can't be attached to the boots or gloves . Once attached, the robes cannot be sold, but the kit can be detached safely, receiving both items.

Holy wraps.title: Holy wraps
Holy wraps.intro: Holy wraps are handwear that can be obtained by completing elite Treasure Trails . They require 31 Prayer to wear. It gives the best prayer bonus in the hands slot. Katana.title: Katana
Katana.intro: The katana is a sword that can be obtained as a very rare reward from elite Treasure Trails . It requires 40 Attack to wield. The sword is technically a two-handed weapon despite visually being used to attack with one hand.

Dragon cane.title: Dragon cane
Dragon cane.intro: The dragon cane is a reward from elite Treasure Trails that requires level 60 Attack to wield. This weapon has similar stats to the dragon mace (including the +5 Prayer bonus ), although no quest completion is required to wield the dragon cane (while completion of Heroes' Quest is needed to wield the dragon mace). Unlike the mace however, the Dragon Cane has an attack speed of 5 ticks (3.0s).

Briefcase.title: Briefcase
Briefcase.intro: The briefcase is a rare reward from elite Treasure Trails . It provides no stat bonuses and is purely cosmetic. The item is seen being held by Estate agents , Uri , Hatius Cosaintus , Charles , and the random event Certer brothers ( Niles , Giles , and Miles ).

Bucket helm.title: Bucket helm
Bucket helm.intro: The bucket helm is obtained as a possible reward from elite Treasure Trails . It has no bonuses and is purely cosmetic.

Blacksmith's helm.title: Blacksmith's helm
Blacksmith's helm.intro: The Blacksmith's helm is a reward from elite Treasure Trails . It is usually worn as a cosmetic item since its defensive bonuses are the same as those of an iron full helm . Although the helm matches the appearance of the Smiths' Uniform , it does not count towards the set bonus.

Deerstalker.title: Deerstalker
Deerstalker.intro: The deerstalker is a rare reward from elite Treasure Trails . It provides no stats and is purely cosmetic. Sherlock wears this hat.

Afro.title: Afro
Afro.intro: This item can be stored in the treasure chest of a costume room , provided that the elite clue interface is opened before attempting to store the item. This requires a mahogany treasure chest . Alternatively, the item can be used on the opened treasure chest to insert it without viewing the interface.

Top hat.title: Top hat

Big pirate hat.title: Big pirate hat
Big pirate hat.intro: The big pirate hat is a rare reward from elite Treasure Trails . It provides no stats and is purely cosmetic. It is a bigger version of the pirate's hat . For 500 coins , it can be taken to Patchy and attached to a right eye patch to create a pirate hat & patch .

Monocle.title: Monocle
Monocle.intro: The monocle is a rare reward from elite Treasure Trails . It provides no stats and is purely cosmetic.

Fremennik kilt.title: Fremennik kilt
Fremennik kilt.intro: A Fremennik kilt is a rare reward from elite Treasure Trails . It has the same bonuses as iron platelegs , except for an additional +1 strength bonus . Unlike most strength bonus providing equipment, it has no requirements to equip.

Sagacious spectacles.title: Sagacious spectacles

Uri's hat.title: Uri's hat

Obsidian cape (r).intro: The obsidian cape (r) is obtained as a possible reward from master Treasure Trails . According to the treasure chest interface, the (r) stands for "red".

Fancy tiara.intro: The fancy tiara is obtained as a possible reward from master Treasure Trails .

3rd Age range coif.title: 3rd Age range coif
3rd Age range coif.intro: The 3rd Age range coif is a part of the 3rd Age ranger kit . Requiring level 65 Ranged and 45 Defence to wear, it has the third highest ranged attack bonus of all head-slot items, surpassed by the Masori mask and Armadyl helmet .

3rd Age range top.title: 3rd Age range top
3rd Age range top.intro: The 3rd Age range top is a part of the 3rd age range set . Requiring level 65 Ranged and 45 Defence to wear, it offers identical bonuses to a blessed d'hide body except for having higher Magic defence and no prayer bonus .

3rd Age range legs.title: 3rd Age range legs
3rd Age range legs.intro: The 3rd Age range legs are a part of the 3rd Age range set . Requiring level 65 Ranged and 45 Defence to wear, they offer similar bonuses to blessed d'hide chaps , giving an additional +2 to magic defence while lacking any prayer bonus .

3rd Age vambraces.title: 3rd Age vambraces
3rd Age vambraces.intro: The 3rd Age vambraces are a part of the 3rd age range set . Requiring level 65 Ranged and 45 Defence to wear, they offer similar bonuses to blessed vambraces with an additional +1 to magic defence instead of a +1 prayer bonus like blessed.

3rd Age robe top.title: 3rd Age robe top
3rd Age robe top.intro: The 3rd Age robe top is a part of the 3rd Age mage set . Requiring level 65 Magic and 30 Defence to wear, it has the sixth highest magic attack bonus of any body-slot item, surpassed only by Dagon'hai robe top , Blue Moon chestplate , Ahrim's robetop , Virtus robe top , and the ancestral robe top . It has a Magic damage bonus of 1%.

3rd Age robe.title: 3rd Age robe
3rd Age robe.intro: The 3rd Age robe is a part of the 3rd Age mage set . Requiring level 65 Magic and 30 Defence to wear, it has the fifth highest magic attack bonus of any leg-slot item, only surpassed by Blue Moon tassets , Ahrim's robeskirt , Virtus robe bottom and ancestral robe bottom . It has a Magic damage bonus of 1%.

3rd Age amulet.title: 3rd Age amulet
3rd Age amulet.intro: The 3rd Age amulet is a part of the 3rd age mage set . Requiring level 65 Magic and 30 Defence to wear, it has the highest magic attack bonus of any neck-slot item.

3rd Age plateskirt.title: 3rd Age plateskirt
3rd Age plateskirt.intro: The 3rd Age plateskirt is a part of the 3rd Age melee set . It has the same stats as the 3rd Age platelegs , and also requires level 65 Defence to wear. It is tied with the aforementioned 3rd Age platelegs for the third-highest defence bonuses of all non-degradable melee leg slot items, only surpassed by the justiciar legguards and torva platelegs . 3rd Age mage hat.title: 3rd Age mage hat
3rd Age mage hat.intro: The 3rd Age mage hat is a piece of the 3rd Age mage set worn in the head slot . Requiring level 65 Magic and 30 Defence to wear, it has the highest Magic attack bonus of all mage hats, tied with Virtus mask and ancestral hat . It has a Magic damage bonus of 1%.

3rd Age platelegs.title: 3rd Age platelegs
3rd Age platelegs.intro: 3rd Age platelegs are 3rd Age armour , requiring 65 Defence to equip. 3rd Age kiteshield.title: 3rd Age kiteshield
3rd Age kiteshield.intro: The 3rd Age kiteshield is a part of the 3rd Age melee set . Level 65 Defence is required to wield the kiteshield. The 3rd Age kiteshield is a possible reward from hard , elite and master tier Treasure Trails and cannot be made through any skills. It can also be obtained when opening mimic caskets, after defeating the Mimic boss .

Gilded platebody.title: Gilded platebody
Gilded platebody.intro: The gilded platebody is a part of gilded equipment and can be obtained from completing hard , elite and master tier Treasure Trails . A gilded platebody has the same defence bonuses and requirements to equip (40 Defence and the completion of Dragon Slayer I ) as a rune platebody , and is usually worn by players who wish to display their wealth.

Gilded platelegs.title: Gilded platelegs
Gilded platelegs.intro: Gilded platelegs are a part of gilded equipment and can be obtained from hard , elite and master tier Treasure Trails . They are a gold-plated version of rune platelegs and share the same bonuses and requirements to equip, however, this version cannot be made through the Smithing skill.

Gilded plateskirt.title: Gilded plateskirt
Gilded plateskirt.intro: The Gilded plateskirt is a part of gilded equipment . A gilded plateskirt has the same stats as a rune plateskirt , except it weighs 1 kg more. A gilded plateskirt can be received from hard , elite and master tier Treasure Trails .

Gilded full helm.title: Gilded full helm
Gilded full helm.intro: The Gilded full helm is a gold-plated version of the rune full helm and a part of gilded equipment . It has the same stats as the rune full helmet, and only differs in appearance. It requires 40 Defence to wear.

Gilded kiteshield.title: Gilded kiteshield

Gilded med helm.title: Gilded med helm

Gilded chainbody.title: Gilded chainbody

Gilded 2h sword.title: Gilded 2h sword

Gilded spear.title: Gilded spear

Gilded hasta.title: Gilded hasta

It can also be obtained when opening mimic caskets, after defeating the Mimic boss . The wand requires 65 Magic to wield.

3rd Age bow.title: 3rd Age bow
3rd Age bow.intro: The 3rd Age bow is a part of the 3rd age range set . It is a possible reward from elite and master Treasure Trails and cannot be made through any skills. It can also be obtained when opening mimic caskets, after defeating the Mimic boss . Requiring 65 Ranged to wield, the 3rd age bow can fire arrows up to dragon arrows at the same speed as that of a shortbow whilst having a longer attack range.

Gilded scimitar.title: Gilded scimitar
Gilded scimitar.intro: The Gilded scimitar is a possible reward from elite and master Treasure Trails .

Gilded boots.title: Gilded boots
Gilded boots.intro: The gilded boots are a part of gilded equipment and a possible reward from elite and master Treasure Trails . They have the same stats as rune boots and the same requirement of 40 Defence to equip.

Gilded coif.title: Gilded coif
Gilded coif.intro: A gilded coif is part of the gilded dragonhide armour set that can be obtained as a rare reward from elite Treasure Trails . It requires 40 ranged to equip. It has worse offensive stats than Robin Hood hat , but better defensive stats.

Gilded d'hide vambraces.title: Gilded d'hide vambraces
Gilded d'hide vambraces.intro: The Gilded d'hide vambraces is a part of the gilded dragonhide armour that can be obtained as a rare reward from elite Treasure Trails , and require 40 Ranged to wear. They are currently the best free-to-play gloves for both ranged and melee combat.

Gilded d'hide body.title: Gilded d'hide body
Gilded d'hide body.intro: The Gilded d'hide body is a part of the gilded dragonhide armour that can be obtained as a rare reward from elite Treasure Trails . It offers considerably higher defensive bonuses than the Green d'hide body , and similarly requires the completion of Dragon Slayer I as well as 40 Defence and Ranged to wear. It is currently the best free-to-play body item for ranged combat.

Gilded d'hide chaps.title: Gilded d'hide chaps
Gilded d'hide chaps.intro: Gilded d'hide chaps is a part of the gilded dragonhide armour that can be obtained as a rare reward from elite Treasure Trails . It offers considerably higher defensive bonuses than the green d'hide chaps and similarly requires 40 Ranged . They are currently the best free-to-play legging item for ranged combat.

Gilded pickaxe.title: Gilded pickaxe
Gilded pickaxe.intro: The Gilded pickaxe is a cosmetic variant of the rune pickaxe that can be obtained as a rare reward from elite and master Treasure Trails .

Gilded axe.title: Gilded axe
Gilded axe.intro: The gilded axe is a cosmetic variant of the rune axe that can be obtained as a rare reward from elite and master Treasure Trails .

Gilded spade.title: Gilded spade
Gilded spade.intro: The gilded spade is a two-handed fun weapon that can be obtained as a rare reward from elite and master Treasure Trails .

Ring of nature.title: Ring of nature
Ring of nature.intro: The ring of nature can be obtained as a reward from elite Treasure Trails . It can change the model of the player to look like a bush.

Lava dragon mask.title: Lava dragon mask
Lava dragon mask.intro: The lava dragon mask is a cosmetic mask obtained as a possible reward from elite Treasure Trails .

3rd Age pickaxe.title: 3rd Age pickaxe
3rd Age pickaxe.intro: The 3rd Age pickaxe is a piece of 3rd Age equipment . It requires 65 Attack to wield and 61 Mining to use and shares the same mining speed and special attack as a dragon pickaxe . It is widely understood as one of, if not the most valuable item in the game entirely due to rarity.

3rd Age axe.title: 3rd Age axe
3rd Age axe.intro: The 3rd Age axe is a piece of 3rd Age equipment . It requires 65 Attack to wield and 61 Woodcutting to use and shares the same cutting speed, special attack , and stats as a dragon axe .

3rd Age druidic robe bottoms.title: 3rd Age druidic robe bottoms
3rd Age druidic robe bottoms.intro: The 3rd Age druidic robe bottoms are a rare reward obtained from master Treasure Trails and cannot be made through any skills. It can also be obtained when opening mimic caskets, after defeating the Mimic boss . It is part of the 3rd age druidic robes set, and requires 65 Prayer to wear.

3rd Age druidic robe top.title: 3rd Age druidic robe top
3rd Age druidic robe top.intro: The 3rd Age druidic robe top is a rare reward obtained from master Treasure Trails and cannot be made through any skills. It can also be obtained when opening mimic caskets, after defeating the Mimic boss . It is part of the 3rd age druidic robes set, and requires 65 Prayer to wear.

3rd Age druidic staff.title: 3rd Age druidic staff
3rd Age druidic staff.intro: The 3rd Age druidic staff is a rare reward obtained from master Treasure Trails and cannot be made through any skills. It can also be obtained when opening mimic caskets, after defeating the Mimic boss . It is part of the 3rd age druidic robes set, and requires 65 Prayer and Attack to wear. It has the same stats as any Crozier .

3rd Age druidic cloak.title: 3rd Age druidic cloak
3rd Age druidic cloak.intro: The 3rd Age druidic cloak is a rare reward obtained from master Treasure Trails and cannot be made through any skills. It can also be obtained when opening mimic caskets, after defeating the Mimic boss . It is part of the 3rd Age druidic robes set, and requires 65 Prayer to wear. It has the same stats as Vestment cloaks .

Bucket helm (g).title: Bucket helm (g)
Bucket helm (g).intro: The bucket helm (g) is obtained as a possible reward from master Treasure Trails .

Ring of coins.title: Ring of coins
Ring of coins.intro: The ring of coins is obtained as a possible reward from master Treasure Trails . It can change the model of the player to look like a pile of coins .
