Unholy blessing.title: Unholy blessing
Unholy blessing.intro: The unholy blessing can be found as a reward from all levels of Treasure Trails , except beginner .

Holy blessing.title: Holy blessing
Holy blessing.intro: The holy blessing can be found as a reward from all levels of Treasure Trails , except beginner . The scroll's examine text reflects the philosophy of Saradomin .

Peaceful blessing.title: Peaceful blessing
Peaceful blessing.intro: The peaceful blessing can be found as a reward from all levels of Treasure Trails , except beginner . The scroll's examine text reflects the philosophy of Guthix . The scroll can be equipped in the ammunition slot, and provides a +1 prayer bonus .

War blessing.title: War blessing
War blessing.intro: The war blessing can be found as a reward from all levels of Treasure Trails , except beginner . The scroll's examine text reflects the philosophy of Bandos .

Honourable blessing.title: Honourable blessing
Honourable blessing.intro: The honourable blessing can be found as a reward from all levels of Treasure Trails , except beginner . The scroll's examine text reflects the philosophy of Armadyl .

Ancient blessing.title: Ancient blessing
Ancient blessing.intro: The ancient blessing can be found as a reward from all levels of Treasure Trails , except beginner .

Nardah teleport.title: Nardah teleport
Nardah teleport.intro: Nardah teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to Nardah . They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

Mos le'harmless teleport.title: Mos le'harmless teleport
Mos le'harmless teleport.intro: Mos le'harmless teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to Mos Le'Harmless . They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

Mort'ton teleport.title: Mort'ton teleport
Mort'ton teleport.intro: Mort'ton teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the centre of Mort'ton . They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

Feldip hills teleport.title: Feldip hills teleport
Feldip hills teleport.intro: Feldip hills teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the Feldip Hills , near the Hunting expert . They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

Lunar isle teleport.title: Lunar isle teleport
Lunar isle teleport.intro: Lunar isle teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to Lunar Isle . They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

Digsite teleport.title: Digsite teleport
Digsite teleport.intro: Digsite teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the Digsite , just south of the crashed gnome glider. They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

Piscatoris teleport.title: Piscatoris teleport
Piscatoris teleport.intro: Piscatoris teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to Piscatoris , just outside the Piscatoris Fishing Colony , near the tunnel entrance. They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

Pest control teleport.title: Pest control teleport
Pest control teleport.intro: Pest control teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the Void Knights' Outpost. They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

Tai bwo wannai teleport.title: Tai bwo wannai teleport
Tai bwo wannai teleport.intro: Tai bwo wannai teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to Tai Bwo Wannai . They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

Lumberyard teleport.title: Lumberyard teleport
Lumberyard teleport.intro: Lumberyard teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the Lumber Yard . They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

Iorwerth camp teleport.title: Iorwerth camp teleport
Iorwerth camp teleport.intro: Iorwerth camp teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the Iorwerth Camp . They can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails except beginner.

Master scroll book (empty).title: Master scroll book
Master scroll book (empty).intro: A master scroll book is an item obtainable from any level Treasure Trail except beginner. If a reward casket would reward any type of teleport scroll , there is a 1/23 chance for it to reward a master scroll book instead.

Red firelighter.title: Red firelighter
Red firelighter.intro: Red firelighters are a possible reward from Treasure Trails . They create red logs when used with regular logs .

Green firelighter.title: Green firelighter
Green firelighter.intro: Green firelighters are a possible reward from Treasure Trails . They create green logs when used with regular logs .

Blue firelighter.title: Blue firelighter
Blue firelighter.intro: Blue firelighters are a possible reward from Treasure Trails . They create blue logs when used with regular logs .

Purple firelighter.title: Purple firelighter
Purple firelighter.intro: Purple firelighters are a possible reward from Treasure Trails . They create purple logs when used with regular logs .

White firelighter.title: White firelighter
White firelighter.intro: White firelighters are a possible reward from Treasure Trails . They create white logs when used with regular logs .

Charge dragonstone jewellery scroll.title: Charge dragonstone jewellery scroll
Charge dragonstone jewellery scroll.intro: The charge dragonstone jewellery scroll is a consumable scroll obtained as a reward from all levels of Treasure Trails , excluding beginner clue scrolls . In order to use the scroll, players must first have completed the Heroes' Quest .

Purple sweets.title: Purple sweets
Purple sweets.intro: Purple sweets are a stackable food item that are earned from all levels of Treasure Trails , except beginner . They are the only stackable food item in the game, restoring 1–3 Hitpoints and 10% run energy per sweets eaten.

Scroll Cases.title: Scroll case
Scroll Cases.intro: Scroll cases increase the total combined number clue scrolls / scroll boxes that a player can hold in their inventory/bank upon opening. Cases are earned once the required number of scrolls for that tier have been completed and will be included with that clue's reward and every subsequent clue reward until consumed.

Minor beginner scroll case.title: Minor beginner scroll case
Minor beginner scroll case.intro: Minor beginner scroll cases are a type of scroll case awarded upon completing 50 beginner clue scrolls .

Minor easy scroll case.title: Minor easy scroll case
Minor easy scroll case.intro: Minor easy scroll cases are a type of scroll case awarded upon completing 100 easy clue scrolls .

Major beginner scroll case.title: Major beginner scroll case
Major beginner scroll case.intro: Major beginner scroll cases are a type of scroll case awarded upon completing 100 beginner clue scrolls .

Major easy scroll case.title: Major easy scroll case
Major easy scroll case.intro: Major easy scroll cases are a type of scroll case awarded upon completing 200 easy clue scrolls .

Minor medium scroll case.title: Minor medium scroll case
Minor medium scroll case.intro: Minor medium scroll cases are a type of scroll case awarded upon completing 100 medium clue scrolls .

Major medium scroll case.title: Major medium scroll case
Major medium scroll case.intro: Major medium scroll cases are a type of scroll case awarded upon completing 250 medium clue scrolls .

Minor hard scroll case.title: Minor hard scroll case
Minor hard scroll case.intro: Minor hard scroll cases are a type of scroll case awarded upon completing 50 hard clue scrolls .

Major hard scroll case.title: Major hard scroll case
Major hard scroll case.intro: Major hard scroll cases are a type of scroll case awarded upon completing 150 hard clue scrolls .

Minor elite scroll case.title: Minor elite scroll case
Minor elite scroll case.intro: Minor elite scroll cases are a type of scroll case awarded upon completing 50 elite clue scrolls .

Major elite scroll case.title: Major elite scroll case
Major elite scroll case.intro: Major elite scroll cases are a type of scroll case awarded upon completing 150 elite clue scrolls .

Minor master scroll case.title: Minor master scroll case
Minor master scroll case.intro: Minor master scroll cases are a type of scroll case awarded upon completing 25 master clue scrolls . Opening the 25th reward casket (master) will display the additional message For completing 25 master clue scrolls, you have earned a minor scroll case! , and opening the scroll case displays the message You have increased your master clue scroll cap! You can now carry [amount] master clue scrolls and scroll boxes. .

Major master scroll case.title: Major master scroll case
Major master scroll case.intro: Major master scroll cases are a type of scroll case awarded upon completing 75 master clue scrolls .

Mimic scroll case.title: Mimic scroll case
Mimic scroll case.intro: The Mimic scroll case is a type of scroll case awarded from defeating the Mimic boss (elite or master casket mimic) and then opening the elite / master reward casket it came from, which raises the cap on the number of scroll boxes for all tiers by 1. Opening the case results in the message You have increased the capacity for all of your clue scrolls by one! in the chatbox.

Barbarian Assault.title: Barbarian Assault
Barbarian Assault.intro: Barbarian Assault is a combat minigame played in the basement of the Barbarian Outpost . A team of five players must work together in different roles to battle ten waves of monsters before finally defeating the Penance Queen . There are no requirements to play, but players with a higher combat level will generally perform better due to the aggressive Penance creatures in the arena.

rows.text: For completing wave 10, each player gets 80 points for their role plus 5 points in each of the other 3 roles instead of the formulas above.

Fighter hat.title: Fighter hat
Fighter hat.intro: The fighter hat is a piece of members-only armour that requires 45 Defence to wear, and is obtained through the Barbarian Assault minigame . Players with 275 honour points in each role and who have killed the Penance Queen can purchase the hat from Commander Connad , located on the ground floor of the Barbarian Outpost .

Ranger hat.title: Ranger hat
Ranger hat.intro: A ranger hat is a piece of headgear available as a reward from Barbarian Assault . It resembles the head of a Penance Ranger .

Runner hat.title: Runner hat
Runner hat.intro: The runner hat is a piece of members-only armour that requires 45 Defence and is rewarded from the Barbarian Assault minigame . Players with 275 Honour points in all four roles and who have killed the Penance Queen can purchase the hat from Commander Connad , located on the ground floor 1 floor of the Barbarian Outpost .

Fighter torso.title: Fighter torso
Fighter torso.intro: The fighter torso (called the Penance torso in the Barbarian Assault Reward Shop ) is armour that requires 40 Defence to equip and is a reward from the Barbarian Assault minigame . It can be purchased from Commander Connad for 375 honour points in all four roles, and one Penance Queen kill. It can be sold back to Connad for 300 honour points in all four roles by using it on him.

Healer hat.title: Healer hat
Healer hat.intro: The healer hat is a possible reward item from Barbarian Assault and requires 45 Defence to wear. Players who have killed the Penance Queen and have 275 Honour points in each of the four roles can purchase the hat from Commander Connad , located on the main floor of the Barbarian Outpost . The hat is part of the penance set , all parts of which are available from Barbarian Assault.

Penance skirt.title: Penance skirt
Penance skirt.intro: A penance skirt is a piece of armour that requires level 60 Ranged and level 40 Defence to wear. Through participating in the Barbarian Assault mini-game, players who earn 375 honour points in each of the four roles, and who have killed the Penance Queen , can purchase the skirt from Commander Connad , located on the main floor of the Barbarian Outpost . It functions as an upgraded Red d'hide chaps , having 1 more Ranged attac

Runner boots.title: Runner boots
Runner boots.intro: Runner boots (called the Penance boots in the Barbarian Assault Reward Shop ) are boots obtained from Barbarian Assault , requiring 40 Defence to wear. The boots can be obtained by exchanging 100 Honour Points in each role from the Barbarian Assault minigame , and does not require the Penance Queen to be killed.

Penance gloves.title: Penance gloves
Penance gloves.intro: Penance gloves are gloves obtained from Barbarian Assault , requiring 40 Defence to wear. Players with 150 honour points in each of the four roles can purchase the gloves by speaking to Commander Connad , located on the main floor of the Barbarian Outpost . Players do not have to kill the Penance Queen to obtain the gloves.

Granite helm.title: Granite helm
Granite helm.intro: Granite helm is a helmet that can be obtained by killing terror dogs or from High Level Gambles at Barbarian Assault . 50 Strength and 50 Defence are required to equip the helm. It has slightly better stats than the rune full helm but slightly worse stats than the dragon med helm .

Barracuda Trials.title: Barracuda Trials
Barracuda Trials.intro: Barracuda Trials are a series of Sailing activities. There are three trials: The Tempor Tantrum unlocked at level 30, The Jubbly Jive unlocked at level 55, and The Gwenith Glide unlocked at level 72. Only skiffs may be used.

rows.text: Iron helm , oak masts and linen sails

Granite body.title: Granite body
Granite body.intro: The granite body is a piece of body armour that requires 50 Defence and 50 Strength to wear. Players who have killed the Penance Queen can purchase it from Commander Connad , located on the ground floor of the Barbarian Outpost , for 95,000 coins . It is the only reward from the Barbarian Assault minigame that is not obtained with honour points .

Stormy key.title: Stormy key
Stormy key.intro: A stormy key is an item rewarded upon clearing the swordfish rank of the Tempor Tantrum Barracuda Trial , requiring a completion time of 1:48.00.

Ralph's fabric roll.title: Ralph's fabric roll
Ralph's fabric roll.intro: Ralph's fabric roll is an item rewarded upon clearing the marlin rank of the Tempor Tantrum Barracuda Trial , requiring a completion time of 4:30.00.

Barrel stand.title: Barrel stand
Barrel stand.intro: The barrel stand is an item rewarded upon clearing the shark rank of the Tempor Tantrum Barracuda Trial , requiring a completion time of 2:51.00.

Fetid key.title: Fetid key
Fetid key.intro: A fetid key is an item rewarded upon clearing the swordfish rank of the Jubbly Jive Barracuda Trial , requiring a completion time of 2:03.00.

Captured wind mote.title: Captured wind mote
Captured wind mote.intro: The captured wind mote is an item rewarded upon clearing the shark rank of the Jubbly Jive Barracuda Trial , requiring a completion time of 3:00.00.

Gurtob's fabric roll.title: Gurtob's fabric roll
Gurtob's fabric roll.intro: Gurtob's fabric roll is an item rewarded upon clearing the marlin rank of the Jubbly Jive Barracuda Trial , requiring a completion time of 5:21.00.

Serrated key.title: Serrated key
Serrated key.intro: A serrated key is an item rewarded upon clearing the swordfish rank of the Gwenith Glide Barracuda Trial , requiring a completion time of 2:00.00.

Gwyna's fabric roll.title: Gwyna's fabric roll
Gwyna's fabric roll.intro: Gwyna's fabric roll is an item rewarded upon clearing the marlin rank of the Gwenith Glide Barracuda Trial , requiring a completion time of 6:09.00.

Heart of Ithell.title: Heart of Ithell
Heart of Ithell.intro: The Heart of Ithell is an item rewarded upon clearing the shark rank of the Gwenith Glide Barracuda Trial , requiring a completion time of 3:42.00.

Brimhaven Agility Arena.title: Brimhaven Agility Arena
Brimhaven Agility Arena.intro: The Brimhaven Agility Course is an Agility -training minigame located beneath Brimhaven . The course has no requirements to access other than a 200 coins fee paid to Cap'n Izzy No-Beard before each entry. Instead of running laps like other Agility courses , the player may navigate obstacles to reach ticket dispensers scattered across platforms, in order to tag them for additional Agility experience, as well as Agility arena ti

Agility arena ticket.title: Agility arena ticket
Agility arena ticket.intro: Agility Arena tickets are earned by taking part in the Brimhaven Agility Arena . One ticket and one Brimhaven voucher are earned for tagging a ticket dispenser . They are exchanged at the Agility Arena Store by talking to Pirate Jackie the Fruit for 345 Agility experience each, or 379.5 experience each with Karamja gloves 2 or higher equipped.

Brimhaven voucher.title: Brimhaven voucher
Brimhaven voucher.intro: A Brimhaven voucher is received while participating in the Brimhaven Agility Arena . One voucher and one Agility Arena ticket is earned for tagging a ticket dispenser . They are exchanged at the Agility Arena Store by talking to Pirate Jackie the Fruit for items.

Pirate's hook.title: Pirate's hook
Pirate's hook.intro: The pirate's hook is a reward from the Brimhaven Agility Arena that occupies the glove slot. It can be purchased from Pirate Jackie the Fruit for 800 Brimhaven vouchers .

Graceful hood.title: Graceful hood
Graceful hood.intro: The graceful hood is part of the graceful outfit , costing 35 marks of grace from Grace in the Rogues' Den . When worn, it reduces weight by 3 kg and increases the run energy restoration rate by 3%; this is increased to 30% when the full outfit is worn.

Graceful top.title: Graceful top
Graceful top.intro: The graceful top is part of the graceful outfit , costing 55 marks of grace from Grace in the Rogues' Den . When worn, it reduces weight by 5 kg and increases the run energy restoration rate by 4%; this is increased to 30% when the full outfit is worn.

Graceful legs.title: Graceful legs
Graceful legs.intro: The graceful legs are part of the graceful outfit , costing 60 marks of grace from Grace in the Rogues' Den . When worn, they reduce weight by 6 kg and increases the run energy restoration rate by 4%; this is increased to 30% when the full outfit is worn.

Graceful gloves.title: Graceful gloves
Graceful gloves.intro: The graceful gloves are part of the graceful outfit , costing 30 marks of grace from Grace in the Rogues' Den . When worn, they reduce weight by 3 kg and increase the run energy restoration rate by 3%; this is increased to 30% when the full outfit is worn.

Graceful boots.title: Graceful boots
Graceful boots.intro: Graceful boots are a part of the graceful outfit , costing 40 marks of grace from Grace in the Rogues' Den . When worn, they reduce weight by 4 kg and increase the run energy restoration rate by 3%; this is increased to 30% when the full outfit is worn.

Graceful cape.title: Graceful cape
Graceful cape.intro: The graceful cape is part of the graceful outfit , costing 40 marks of grace from Grace in the Rogues' Den . When worn, it reduces weight by 4 kg and increases the run energy restoration rate by 3%; this is increased to 30% when the full outfit is worn.

Castle Wars.title: Castle Wars
Castle Wars.intro: Castle Wars is a free-to-play combat minigame similar to Capture the Flag , but with a Old School RuneScape twist.

Decorative helm.title: Decorative helm
Decorative helm.intro: Decorative helms can be purchased at the Castle Wars arena through the exchange of Castle wars tickets . They may refer to:

Decorative full helm.title: Decorative full helm
Decorative full helm.intro: Decorative full helms can be purchased at the Castle Wars arena through the exchange of Castle wars tickets . They may refer to:

Decorative armour.title: Decorative armour
Decorative armour.intro: Decorative armour is one of the rewards available from Castle Wars . There are three colours available: red , white , and gold . All of these colours have some sort of blue trim in the design.

Decorative sword.title: Decorative sword
Decorative sword.intro: Decorative swords can be purchased at the Castle Wars arena through the exchange of Castle wars tickets . They may refer to:

Decorative shield.title: Decorative shield
Decorative shield.intro: Decorative shields can be purchased at the Castle Wars arena through the exchange of Castle wars tickets . They may refer to:

Decorative boots.title: Decorative boots
Decorative boots.intro: Decorative boots can be purchased at the Castle Wars arena through the exchange of Castle wars tickets . They may refer to:

Saradomin banner.title: Saradomin banner
Saradomin banner.intro: The Saradomin banner is the standard of Team Saradomin in the Castle Wars minigame , in which players on Team Saradomin must defend the Saradomin flag while players on Team Zamorak attempt to capture it and return it to their base to score points. The flag can be passed to another player if it is dropped. It can be bought from the Castle Wars Ticket Exchange shop, owned by Lanthus for 100 castle wars tickets .

Zamorak banner.title: Zamorak banner
Zamorak banner.intro: The Zamorak banner is the standard of Team Zamorak in the Castle Wars minigame , in which players on Team Zamorak must defend the Zamorak banner while players on Team Saradomin attempt to capture it and return it to their base to score points. The flag can be passed to another player if it is dropped. It can be bought from the Castle Wars Ticket Exchange shop, owned by Lanthus for 100 castle wars tickets .

Saradomin halo.title: Saradomin halo
Saradomin halo.intro: The Saradomin halo is an item worn in the head slot that can be bought from (or sold to) Lanthus for 75 Castle Wars tickets .

Zamorak halo.title: Zamorak halo
Zamorak halo.intro: The Zamorak halo is an item worn in the head slot that can be bought from (or sold to) Lanthus for 75 Castle Wars tickets .

Guthix halo.title: Guthix halo
Guthix halo.intro: The Guthix halo is an item worn in the head slot that can be bought from (or sold to) Lanthus for 75 Castle Wars tickets .

Fishing Trawler.title: Fishing Trawler
Fishing Trawler.intro: Fishing Trawler is a Fishing minigame in which players must prevent Murphy 's trawling boat from sinking for five minutes. The minigame can be played at any level, but 15 Fishing is required to receive any rewards.

rows.text: Filling a leak with swamp paste
Repairing the net with a rope
Fixing a broken rail caused by the kraken

Angler hat.title: Angler hat
Angler hat.intro: The angler hat is obtained from aerial fishing by purchasing it from Alry the Angler for a price of 50 Molch pearls or acquired randomly from completing a game of Fishing Trawler . The hat grants 0.4% bonus Fishing experience . A Fishing level of 34 is required to wear it. The angler hat is 1 of 4 pieces of the angler's outfit .

Angler top.title: Angler top
Angler top.intro: The angler top is obtained from aerial fishing by purchasing it from Alry the Angler for a price of 50 Molch pearls or acquired randomly from completing a game of Fishing Trawler . The top grants 0.8% bonus Fishing experience . A Fishing level of 34 is required to wear it. The angler top is 1 of 4 pieces of the angler's outfit .

Angler waders.title: Angler waders
Angler waders.intro: The angler waders are obtained from aerial fishing by purchasing it from Alry the Angler for a price of 50 Molch pearls or acquired randomly from completing a game of Fishing Trawler . The waders grant 0.6% bonus Fishing experience . A Fishing level of 34 is required to wear it. The angler waders are 1 of 4 pieces of the angler's outfit .

Angler boots.title: Angler boots
Angler boots.intro: The angler boots are obtained from aerial fishing by purchasing it from Alry the Angler for a price of 50 Molch pearls or acquired randomly from completing a game of Fishing Trawler . The boots grant 0.2% bonus Fishing experience . A Fishing level of 34 is required to wear it. The angler boots are 1 of 4 pieces of the angler's outfit .

Giants' Foundry.title: Giants' Foundry
Giants' Foundry.intro: Giants' Foundry is a Smithing minigame in which players are tasked with creating giant weapons for Kovac . To participate in the minigame, players must complete the Sleeping Giants quest.

Smiths tunic.title: Smiths tunic
Smiths tunic.intro: The smiths tunic is a piece of the Smiths' Uniform set that can be purchased from the Giants' Foundry reward shop for 4,000 Foundry Reputation .

Smiths trousers.title: Smiths trousers
Smiths trousers.intro: The smiths trousers are a piece of the Smiths' Uniform set that can be purchased from the Giants' Foundry reward shop for 4,000 Foundry Reputation .

Smiths boots.title: Smiths boots
Smiths boots.intro: Smiths boots are a piece of the Smiths' Uniform set that can be purchased from the Giants' Foundry reward shop for 3,500 Foundry Reputation .

Smiths gloves.title: Smiths gloves
Smiths gloves.intro: The smiths gloves is a piece of the Smiths' Uniform set that can be purchased from the Giants' Foundry reward shop for 3,500 Foundry Reputation .

Colossal blade.title: Colossal blade
Colossal blade.intro: The colossal blade is a two-handed sword purchased from the Giants' Foundry reward shop for 5,000 Foundry Reputation , requiring level 60 Attack to wield.

Double ammo mould.title: Double ammo mould
Double ammo mould.intro: The double ammo mould is an item that makes cannonballs twice as fast compared to a regular ammo mould , making 8 cannonballs rather than 4 (and using 2 metal bars rather than 1) per action.

Kovac's grog.title: Kovac's grog
Kovac's grog.intro: Kovac's grog is a type of ale that restores 1 Hitpoint and temporarily boosts Smithing by 4 while draining Attack , Ranged , and Magic by 2. This provides the second highest Smithing boost available, surpassing the mature dwarven stout's 2-level boost. Furthermore, this is a reliable boost, unlike orange spicy stew which may boost or drain the player by up to 5 levels when 3 dashes of orange spice are added.

Smithing catalyst.title: Smithing catalyst
Smithing catalyst.intro: Smithing catalyst is a consumable item purchased from the Giants' Foundry reward shop for 15 Foundry Reputation .

Gnome Restaurant.title: Gnome Restaurant
Gnome Restaurant.intro: Gnome Restaurant , known by the gnomes as Aluft Aloft Gnome Food Delivery Service , is a minigame that involves Gnome cooking , and delivering your creations to various customers as quickly as possible. To start the minigame, talk to Gianne jnr. on the west end of the 1 floor 2 floor of the Grand Tree .

Grand seed pod.title: Grand seed pod
Grand seed pod.intro: The grand seed pod is a single-use teleport item that can be obtained as a rare reward from Wingstone , Penwie , Brambickle , and Professor Manglethorp in the Gnome Restaurant minigame . Seed pods are stackable. They can take players to the Grand Tree , and have two right-click options: launch and squash.

Gnome scarf.title: Gnome scarf
Gnome scarf.intro: The gnome scarf is a possible reward from the Gnome Restaurant activity. Players have a 1/17 chance of receiving this from Captain Daerkin and Captain Ninto . The scarf has no stats, but it can function as warm clothing in Wintertodt reducing damage taken, and is the only tradeable neck slot item to do so. It is often used for fashion purposes.

Gnome goggles.title: Gnome goggles
Gnome goggles.intro: Gnome goggles are a possible reward from the Gnome Restaurant minigame. Players have a 1/17 chance to obtain them as a reward from Captain Daerkin or Captain Ninto , which are accessible with hard deliveries. The gnome goggles are part of the gnome pilot set which also includes the gnome scarf .

Mint cake.title: Mint cake
Mint cake.intro: Mint cake is a food item that, when eaten, will restore a player's run energy by 50%. Mint cakes restore more energy per consumption than any other item using only one click (outside of the Agility cape). When eaten, it gives the message Mmm ... minty. You feel energized! .

Guardians of the Rift.title: Guardians of the Rift
Guardians of the Rift.intro: Guardians of the Rift is a non-combat minigame that takes place within the Temple of the Eye . The main goal of the game is to assist The Great Guardian in closing an abyssal rift to the Scar , the most dangerous part of Abyssal Space , by supplying it with guardian stones while protecting it from the abyssal creatures that come through the rift.

Abyssal pearls.title: Abyssal pearls
Abyssal pearls.intro: Abyssal pearls are items obtained from the Rewards Guardian after completing a round of Guardians of the Rift . They are used to purchase items from Temple Supplies , the shop run by Apprentice Felix near the entrance to the minigame. The rewards are helpful items for training Runecraft , including the Raiments of the Eye outfit pieces costing 1,350 abyssal pearls. The average number of abyssal pearls per search is 2.14 (2.41

Abyssal needle.title: Abyssal needle
Abyssal needle.intro: The abyssal needle is an item that can be obtained from the Rewards Guardian after completing a round of Guardians of the Rift . It can also be purchased from the Temple Supplies shop for 750 abyssal pearls .

Catalytic talisman.title: Catalytic talisman
Catalytic talisman.intro: The catalytic talisman is a talisman that can be received as a drop from the Rewards Guardian , using points earned while playing Guardians of the Rift . It allows players to access any catalytic runic altar , providing the player has completed the quests to access some of them.

Abyssal green dye.title: Abyssal green dye
Abyssal green dye.intro: Abyssal green dye is an item that allows one piece of the raiments of the eye to be recoloured to a green variant. It is a one time use per item, therefore a total of three are needed to recolour a full set, with optionally two more for the Amulet of the Eye and the lost bag .

Abyssal blue dye.title: Abyssal blue dye
Abyssal blue dye.intro: Abyssal blue dye is an item that allows one piece of the raiments of the eye to be recoloured to a blue variant. It is a one time use per item, therefore a total of three are needed to recolour a full set, with optionally two more for the Amulet of the Eye and the lost bag .

Abyssal red dye.title: Abyssal red dye
Abyssal red dye.intro: Abyssal red dye is an item that allows one piece of the raiments of the eye to be recoloured to a red variant. It is a one time use per item, therefore a total of three are needed to recolour a full set, with optionally two more for the Amulet of the Eye and the lost bag .

Hat of the Eye.title: Hat of the Eye
Hat of the Eye.intro: The Hat of the Eye is a part of the Raiments of the Eye set, purchased from the Guardians of the Rift reward shop for 400 abyssal pearls . It grants 10% more runes when Runecrafting , and is increased to 60% when the full set is worn.

Robe top of the Eye.title: Robe top of the Eye
Robe top of the Eye.intro: The robe top of the Eye is a part of the Raiments of the Eye set, purchased from the Guardians of the Rift reward shop for 350 abyssal pearls . It grants 10% more runes when Runecrafting , and is increased to 60% when the full set is worn.

Robe bottoms of the Eye.title: Robe bottoms of the Eye
Robe bottoms of the Eye.intro: The robe bottoms of the Eye is a part of the Raiments of the Eye set, purchased from the Guardians of the Rift reward shop for 350 abyssal pearls . It grants 10% more runes when Runecrafting , and is increased to 60% when the full set is worn.

Boots of the Eye.title: Boots of the Eye
Boots of the Eye.intro: The boots of the Eye are a part of the Raiments of the Eye set, purchased from the Guardians of the Rift reward shop for 250 abyssal pearls . They grant 10% more runes when Runecrafting , which is increased to 60% when the full set is worn.

Ring of the elements.title: Ring of the elements
Ring of the elements.intro: The ring of the elements is an item purchased from the Guardians of the Rift reward shop for 400 abyssal pearls . It teleports players near the elemental runic altars . It also counts as a piece of warm clothing at Wintertodt , regardless of charge. When charged, the ring is untradeable.

Abyssal lantern.title: Abyssal lantern
Abyssal lantern.intro: The abyssal lantern is an item worn in the shield slot that can be obtained from the Rewards Guardian after completing a round of Guardians of the Rift . It can also be purchased from the Temple Supplies reward shop or Apprentice Felix via dialogue for 1,500 abyssal pearls .

Guardian's eye.title: Guardian's eye
Guardian's eye.intro: The Guardian's eye is an item that transforms the rift guardian pet into a greatish guardian , unlocking it as a permanent metamorphosis option and consuming the item in the process. It is purchased from the Guardians of the Rift reward shop for 3,000 abyssal pearls .

Intricate pouch.title: Intricate pouch
Intricate pouch.intro: The intricate pouch is an item that can be obtained from the Rewards Guardian after completing a game of Guardians of the Rift . It can be opened to obtain a reward.

Lost bag.title: Lost bag
Lost bag.intro: The lost bag is a cape slot item that can be obtained from an intricate pouch , which can be received from the Rewards Guardian after completing a round of Guardians of the Rift . It has no stat bonuses and is purely cosmetic.

Tarnished locket.title: Tarnished locket
Tarnished locket.intro: The tarnished locket is an item that can be obtained from an intricate pouch , which can be received from the Rewards Guardian after completing a round of Guardians of the Rift . After inspecting it, players can give the locket to Phileas the Lumbridge Guide in exchange for the Amulet of the Eye . If the locket is lost before turning it in, it can be reclaimed from Apprentice Felix .

Hallowed Sepulchre.title: Hallowed Sepulchre
Hallowed Sepulchre.intro: The Hallowed Sepulchre is an Agility activity set in an ancient Saradominist burial ground of the city Hallowvale , located beneath Darkmeyer available to players with level 52 Agility and completion of Sins of the Father . There are five floors available scaling with the player's Agility level. In order to receive hallowed marks , the coffins must be looted, with deeper floors providing more marks per looted coffin. Noticeboa

Hallowed mark.title: Hallowed mark
Hallowed mark.intro: Hallowed marks are the reward currency gained by looting coffins within the Hallowed Sepulchre in Darkmeyer . These can be used at the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop.

Hallowed token.title: Hallowed token
Hallowed token.intro: Hallowed token is an item used to add an extra minute of time during a Hallowed Sepulchre run, it is consumed upon use. If a player wants to add the extra minute to the run, the token needs to be activated before the timer runs out. It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 10 hallowed marks . You may use more than one token per attempt at the Sepulchre.

Hallowed focus.title: Hallowed focus
Hallowed focus.intro: The Hallowed focus is an item that will give a 100% chance to succeed at conjuring Portal Frames inside the Hallowed Sepulchre and will slightly speed up enchanting the portal when equipped. It also causes the player to use the lowest level enchantment spell available instead of the highest. It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 100 hallowed marks .

Hallowed grapple.title: Hallowed grapple
Hallowed grapple.intro: Hallowed grapple is an item that has a 100% chance of succeeding a grapple shortcut inside the Hallowed Sepulchre . It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 100 hallowed marks . The grapple only works inside the Hallowed Sepulchre and cannot be used elsewhere.

Hallowed symbol.title: Hallowed symbol
Hallowed symbol.intro: Hallowed symbol is an item that reduces the number of sacrificed vampyre dust and speeds up the rate at which the player can pass through the Prayer barrier when passing the Saradomin Brazier skilling challenge inside the Hallowed Sepulchre . It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 100 hallowed marks .

Hallowed hammer.title: Hallowed hammer
Hallowed hammer.intro: The hallowed hammer is an item that will never break nails inside the Hallowed Sepulchre (regardless of the plank and nail combination used). It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 100 hallowed marks . Unlike the other hallowed equipment, the hammer does not need to be equipped in order for its effect to work.

Hallowed ring.title: Hallowed ring
Hallowed ring.intro: Hallowed ring is a reward from the Hallowed Sepulchre . It can be purchased from the Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 250 hallowed marks . When equipped, it negates all damage taken from failing environmental obstacles like the knight statues ' swords and the crossbowman statues ' bolts, and reduces the recovery time by teleporting the player back to the start of the obstacle should they fail. It has no effect on the recover

Dark dye.title: Dark dye
Dark dye.intro: Dark dye allows one piece of the graceful outfit to be recoloured to a black and red variant. Six are needed to recolour the full graceful set, as the dye is consumed with one use.

Dark acorn.title: Dark acorn
Dark acorn.intro: A dark acorn is a Hallowed Sepulchre reward that recolours the giant squirrel pet into a black and red variant. It is purchased from the Mysterious Stranger's Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop for 3,000 hallowed marks .

Strange old lockpick (full).title: Strange old lockpick
Strange old lockpick (full).intro: The strange old lockpick is a potential reward from the Hallowed Sepulchre . It can be used to open any set of doors within the Barrows . It comes with 50 charges, which deplete when used to open a set of doors. The lockpick is only tradeable when fully charged. After all 50 charges have been used it disappears. When running low on charges, the High Level Alchemy spell can be used to recoup some of the costs, since its value s

Ring of endurance (uncharged).title: Ring of endurance
Ring of endurance (uncharged).intro: The ring of endurance is a potential reward from the Grand Hallowed Coffin on the final floor of the Hallowed Sepulchre and requires level 70 in the Agility skill to equip. The ring can be charged with stamina potions and stamina mixes , with each dose granting one charge, as well as extended stamina potions which grant two charges per dose. Storing a maximum of 1,000 charges, it costs 819,500 to fully charge using stamina pot

Mysterious page.title: Mysterious page
Mysterious page.intro: Mysterious pages are pages of the strange hallowed tome that can be obtained from looting coffins within the Hallowed Sepulchre . There are five pages in total. One page can be found in the coffins on each floor, with a 10% chance of being obtained provided that the player hasn't already obtained one. The collection log tracks which pages have been obtained.

Last Man Standing.title: Last Man Standing
Last Man Standing.intro: Last Man Standing , commonly referred to as LMS , is a player-versus-player battle royale style minigame in which the player, along with 3-23 others, are transported onto an island where they must fight for survival, killing each other and looting any items they can to become the titular last man standing.

Deadman's chest.title: Deadman's chest
Deadman's chest.intro: The Deadman's chest is a cosmetic platebody that can be bought from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 160 Last Man Standing points. It is part of the Deadman armour set.

Deadman's legs.title: Deadman's legs
Deadman's legs.intro: The Deadman's legs are cosmetic leggings that can be bought from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 160 Last Man Standing points. It is part of the Deadman armour set.

Deadman's cape.title: Deadman's cape
Deadman's cape.intro: The Deadman's cape is a cosmetic cape that can be bought from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 160 Last Man Standing points. It is part of the Deadman armour set.

Armadyl halo.title: Armadyl halo
Armadyl halo.intro: The Armadyl halo is an item worn in the head slot that can be bought from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 450 Last Man Standing points. It can also be sold back to the shop for 360 points. It acts as an Armadyl item, and thus prevents Armadylean followers from attacking its wearer in the God Wars Dungeon .

Bandos halo.title: Bandos halo
Bandos halo.intro: The Bandos halo is an item worn in the head slot that can be bought from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 450 Last Man Standing points. It can also be sold back to the shop for 360 points. It acts as a Bandos item, and thus prevents Bandosian followers from attacking its wearer in the God Wars Dungeon .

Seren halo.title: Seren halo
Seren halo.intro: The Seren halo is a halo affiliated with the god Seren . It can be bought from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 450 Last Man Standing points. It can also be sold back to the shop for 360 points.

Ancient halo.title: Ancient halo
Ancient halo.intro: The ancient halo is a halo affiliated with the god Zaros . It can be bought from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 450 Last Man Standing points. It can also be sold back to the shop for 360 points. As a Zaros item, it provides protection from Zaros' followers within the God Wars Dungeon 's Ancient Prison.

Brassica halo.title: Brassica halo
Brassica halo.intro: The Brassica halo is a halo affiliated with the god Brassica Prime . It can be bought from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 450 Last Man Standing points. It can also be sold back to the shop for 360 points.

Golden Armadyl special attack.title: Animation overrides
Golden Armadyl special attack.intro: Animation overrides are animations that can be unlocked to alter a default animation.

Golden Bandos special attack.title: Animation overrides
Golden Bandos special attack.intro: Animation overrides are animations that can be unlocked to alter a default animation.

Golden Saradomin special attack.title: Animation overrides
Golden Saradomin special attack.intro: Animation overrides are animations that can be unlocked to alter a default animation.

Golden Zamorak special attack.title: Animation overrides
Golden Zamorak special attack.intro: Animation overrides are animations that can be unlocked to alter a default animation.

Victor's cape (1).title: Victor's cape (1)
Victor's cape (1).intro: The victor's cape (1) is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained for free from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing after obtaining 1 non-casual win in the minigame.

Victor's cape (50).title: Victor's cape (50)
Victor's cape (50).intro: The victor's cape (50) is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing after obtaining 50 non-casual wins in the minigame.

Victor's cape (10).title: Victor's cape (10)
Victor's cape (10).intro: The victor's cape (10) is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing after obtaining 10 non-casual wins in the minigame.

Victor's cape (100).title: Victor's cape (100)
Victor's cape (100).intro: The victor's cape (100) is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing after obtaining 100 non-casual wins in the minigame.

Victor's cape (500).title: Victor's cape (500)
Victor's cape (500).intro: The victor's cape (500) is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing after obtaining 500 non-casual wins in the minigame.

Victor's cape (1000).title: Victor's cape (1000)
Victor's cape (1000).intro: The victor's cape (1000) is a cosmetic cape that can be obtained from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing after obtaining 1,000 non-casual wins in the minigame.

Granite clamp.title: Granite clamp
Granite clamp.intro: The granite clamp is an item that can be used on the granite maul or granite maul (ornate handle) to alter the maul's appearance. It is a purely cosmetic addition.

Ornate maul handle.title: Ornate maul handle
Ornate maul handle.intro: The ornate maul handle is an add-on that can be used to enhance the granite maul by reducing its special attack cost from 60% to 50%. This process can be reverted at any time, but the handle will be destroyed in doing so.

Steam staff upgrade kit.title: Steam staff upgrade kit
Steam staff upgrade kit.intro: The steam staff upgrade kit is an item which can be used on the steam battlestaff or its mystic counterpart to create the steam battlestaff (or) or the mystic steam staff (or) , which alters the staff's appearance, and is a purely cosmetic addition.

Lava staff upgrade kit.title: Lava staff upgrade kit
Lava staff upgrade kit.intro: The lava staff upgrade kit is an item which can be used on the lava battlestaff or its mystic counterpart to create the lava battlestaff (or) or the mystic lava staff (or) , which alters the staff's appearance, and is a purely cosmetic addition.

Dragon pickaxe upgrade kit.title: Dragon pickaxe upgrade kit
Dragon pickaxe upgrade kit.intro: The dragon pickaxe upgrade kit is an item that can be used on the dragon pickaxe to create the dragon pickaxe (upgraded) , which alters solely the pickaxe's appearance, and does not modify any stats.

Green dark bow paint.title: Green dark bow paint
Green dark bow paint.intro: Green dark bow paint is an item which can be used on the dark bow to recolour it green, and is a purely cosmetic addition.

Ward upgrade kit.title: Ward upgrade kit
Ward upgrade kit.intro: Ward upgrade kit is an item which can be used on either the odium ward or malediction ward to create the odium ward (or) and malediction ward (or) , respectively. The kit simply alters the ward's appearance, and is a purely cosmetic addition.

Yellow dark bow paint.title: Yellow dark bow paint
Yellow dark bow paint.intro: Yellow dark bow paint is an item which can be used on the dark bow to recolour it yellow, and is a purely cosmetic addition.

White dark bow paint.title: White dark bow paint
White dark bow paint.intro: White dark bow paint is an item which can be used on the dark bow to recolour it white, and is a purely cosmetic addition.

Blue dark bow paint.title: Blue dark bow paint
Blue dark bow paint.intro: Blue dark bow paint is an item which can be used on the dark bow to recolour it blue, and is a purely cosmetic addition.

Volcanic whip mix.title: Volcanic whip mix
Volcanic whip mix.intro: Volcanic whip mix is an item which can be used on the abyssal whip to create the volcanic abyssal whip , which makes the whip appear like lava, and is a purely cosmetic addition (although the volcanic abyssal whip does count as a piece of Warm Clothing when subduing the Wintertodt ).

Frozen whip mix.title: Frozen whip mix
Frozen whip mix.intro: Frozen whip mix is an item which can be used on the abyssal whip to create the frozen abyssal whip , which makes the whip appear like ice, and is a purely cosmetic addition.

Guthixian icon.title: Guthixian icon
Guthixian icon.intro: The Guthixian icon is an item purchased from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 500 Last Man Standing points. It can be brought to Juna in the Chasm of Tears along with a staff of the dead to create a staff of balance . This process is irreversible .

Swift blade.title: Swift blade
Swift blade.intro: The Swift blade is a one-handed weapon purchased from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 350 Last Man Standing points.

Magic Training Arena.title: Mage Training Arena
Magic Training Arena.intro: The Mage Training Arena is a Magic minigame located to the north of the Emir's Arena . Using various spells , players earn pizazz points in different minigames which they can use to buy items in a shop on the top floor of the arena.

Beginner wand.title: Beginner wand
Beginner wand.intro: The beginner wand is a one-handed staff , and the weakest of the wands , requiring 45 Magic to wield. It can be obtained by either exchanging pizazz points at the Mage Training Arena or buying one from another player.

Apprentice wand.title: Apprentice wand
Apprentice wand.intro: The apprentice wand is a one-handed staff and wand that can be wielded with 50 Magic . It can be obtained by either exchanging pizazz points at the Mage Training Arena or buying one from another player.

Teacher wand.title: Teacher wand
Teacher wand.intro: The teacher wand is a one-handed staff and wand that can be wielded with 55 Magic . It can be obtained by either exchanging pizazz points at the Mage Training Arena or buying one from another player.

Master wand.title: Master wand
Master wand.intro: The master wand is a one-handed staff and wand requiring 60 Magic to wield. It can be obtained by either exchanging pizazz points at the Mage Training Arena or buying one from another player. It is one of ten weapons able to autocast Ancient Magicks , and one of only four weapons able to autocast both Ancient Magicks and Arceuus combat spells . This means the wand is able to autocast the Ancient, Arceuus, and Standard spellboo

Infinity hat.title: Infinity hat
Infinity hat.intro: An infinity hat is magic armour from the infinity robes set worn in the headwear slot . 50 Magic and 25 Defence is required to wear the infinity hat. It can be obtained as a reward in the Mage Training Arena minigame for:

Infinity top.title: Infinity top
Infinity top.intro: The infinity top is magic armour from the infinity robes set worn in the body slot . 50 Magic and 25 Defence is required to wear the infinity top.

Infinity bottoms.title: Infinity bottoms
Infinity bottoms.intro: The infinity bottoms are a magic armour item obtained from the infinity robes set worn in the legwear slot. 50 Magic and 25 Defence is required to wear the infinity bottom.

Infinity boots.title: Infinity boots
Infinity boots.intro: Infinity boots are magical boots with the third highest Magic attack and Magic defence bonuses available, below the Avernic Treads and Eternal boots . They require 50 Magic and 25 Defence to equip.

Infinity gloves.title: Infinity gloves
Infinity gloves.intro: The infinity gloves are magic armour from the infinity robes set worn in the hand slot . 50 Magic and 25 Defence is required to wear the infinity gloves. The infinity gloves can be obtained as a reward in the Mage Training Arena minigame for:

Mage's book.title: Mage's book
Mage's book.intro: A mage's book is a book in the shield slot, requiring 60 Magic to wield. It is tied with the ancient wyvern shield for the third-best Magic attack bonus in the shield slot, behind the arcane spirit shield and the Elidinis' ward (f) , but it has no Melee or Ranged defensive bonuses. The mage's book is popular among combat pures because there is no required Defence level. It gives a Magic damage bonus of 2%.

Bones to peaches.title: Bones to Peaches
Bones to peaches.intro: Bones to Peaches is a spell that can be used to turn all unnoted normal bones , burnt bones , bat bones , bleached bones , jogre bones , wolf bones , monkey bones , Alan's bones , animals' bones , and big bones in the inventory into peaches , which can be eaten to heal 8 Hitpoints . Before it can be cast, it must be unlocked from the Mage Training Arena , which costs all of the following:

Mahogany Homes.title: Mahogany Homes
Mahogany Homes.intro: Mahogany Homes is a Construction minigame in which players complete contracts for various NPCs throughout Falador , Varrock , East Ardougne , and Hosidius . The player is assigned a contract by contractors working for the Mahogany Homes company, with the location of the contract chosen at random. Completing the contract involves travelling to the home of the NPC and repairing/replacing items within the home. This requires the

Carpenter's helmet.title: Carpenter's helmet
Carpenter's helmet.intro: The carpenter's helmet is acquired from Amy , the leader of Mahogany Homes , in exchange for 400 Carpenter points . The helmet grants 0.4% bonus Construction experience . This is increased to 2.5% when wearing the full carpenter's outfit . It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Carpenter's shirt.title: Carpenter's shirt
Carpenter's shirt.intro: The Carpenter's shirt is a shirt acquired from Amy , the owner of Mahogany Homes , in exchange for 800 Carpenter points . The shirt grants 0.8% bonus Construction experience . This is increased to 2.5% when wearing the full Carpenter's outfit . It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Carpenter's trousers.title: Carpenter's trousers
Carpenter's trousers.intro: The Carpenter's trousers are acquired from Amy , the leader of Mahogany Homes , in exchange for 600 Carpenter points . The trousers grant 0.6% bonus Construction experience when worn, and wearing the complete Carpenter's outfit provides a 2.5% bonus. The trousers can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Carpenter's boots.title: Carpenter's boots
Carpenter's boots.intro: The Carpenter's boots are acquired from Amy , leader of Mahogany Homes , in exchange for 200 Carpenter points . The boots grants 0.2% bonus Construction experience . This is increased to 2.5% when wearing the full Carpenter's outfit . It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Amy's saw.title: Amy's saw
Amy's saw.intro: Amy's saw is an equipable saw that can be bought from the Mahogany Homes Reward Shop for 500 Carpenter points . Unlike the crystal saw , it does not provide any Construction level boost.

Plank sack.title: Plank sack
Plank sack.intro: The plank sack is an item that can be bought from the Mahogany Homes Reward Shop for 350 carpenter points . Only one plank sack may be owned at a time.

Hosidius blueprints.title: Hosidius blueprints
Hosidius blueprints.intro: The Hosidius blueprints are an item purchased from Amy , leader of the Mahogany Homes , for 2,000 Carpenter points . It can be used to permanently unlock a Hosidius-themed house style .

Mastering Mixology.title: Mastering Mixology
Mastering Mixology.intro: Mastering Mixology is a Herblore minigame located in Aldarin . The main goal of the minigame is assisting the Alchemical Society in filling out orders of potions, which have skyrocketed after Varlamore opened its borders to the mainland.

Prescription goggles.title: Prescription goggles
Prescription goggles.intro: The prescription goggles are a piece of the alchemist's outfit purchased from the Mixology Rewards shop with 8,600 Mox resin , 7,000 Aga resin , and 9,350 Lye resin , which are earned from participating in the Mastering Mixology minigame. The goggles can be cosmetically changed between a focused and unfocused variant when in the inventory.

Alchemist labcoat.title: Alchemist labcoat
Alchemist labcoat.intro: The alchemist labcoat is a piece of the alchemist's outfit purchased from the Mixology Rewards shop with 2,250 Mox resin , 2,800 Aga resin , and 3,700 Lye resin , which are earned from participating in the Mastering Mixology minigame, and can be returned for 40% of the initial price.

Alchemist pants.title: Alchemist pants
Alchemist pants.intro: The alchemist pants are a piece of the alchemist's outfit purchased from the Mixology Rewards shop with 2,250 Mox resin , 2,800 Aga resin , and 3,700 Lye resin , which are earned from participating in the Mastering Mixology minigame, and can be returned for 40% of the initial price.

Alchemist gloves.title: Alchemist gloves
Alchemist gloves.intro: The alchemist gloves are a piece of the alchemist's outfit purchased from the Mixology Rewards shop with 2,250 Mox resin , 2,800 Aga resin , and 3,700 Lye resin , which are earned from participating in the Mastering Mixology minigame, and can be returned for 40% of the initial price.

Alchemist's amulet.title: Alchemist's amulet
Alchemist's amulet.intro: The alchemist's amulet is an item purchased from the Mixology Rewards shop with 6,900 Mox resin , 5,650 Aga resin , and 7,400 Lye resin , which are earned from participating in the Mastering Mixology minigame. While the amulet is equipped, there is a 15% chance the player will create a potion with an extra dose when brewing potions (but with no extra experience), which consumes one charge. This effect works when adding seconda

Reagent pouch.title: Reagent pouch
Reagent pouch.intro: The reagent pouch is a storage item purchased from the Mixology Rewards shop with 13,800 Mox resin , 11,200 Aga resin , and 15,100 Lye resin , which are earned from participating in the Mastering Mixology minigame.

Chugging barrel (disassembled).title: Chugging barrel
Chugging barrel (disassembled).intro: The chugging barrel is a tradeable item that allows players to consume up to five potions in a single click. It is purchased from the Mixology Rewards shop at a cost of 17,250 Mox resin , 14,000 Aga resin , and 18,600 Lye resin . It is sold in a disassembled state (where it cannot store potions); players must use the 'Assemble' option in order for the barrel to become useable. The player is not required to have done the Master

Pest Control.title: Pest Control
Pest Control.intro: Pest Control is a co-operative combat-based minigame , in which players defend the Void Knight from an onslaught of pests, while also destroying the portals from which the monsters spawn.

Void knight mace.title: Void knight mace
Void knight mace.intro: The Void Knight mace can be bought from a Void Knight for 250 commendation points , although a player must have 42 Attack , Strength , Defence , Hitpoints , Ranged , and Magic , along with 22 Prayer . The mace can be used to autocast Claws of Guthix , Crumble Undead , and the Wave and Surge spells . To cast Claws of Guthix, the player must have cast the spell 100 times in the Wilderness Mage Arena . Note that the Void knight m

Void knight top.title: Void knight top
Void knight top.intro: The Void Knight top is a piece of Void Knight equipment . It can be bought from a Void Knight for 250 Void Knight commendation points through the Pest Control mini game, although a player must have at least 42 Attack , Strength , Defence , Hitpoints , Ranged , and Magic , along with 22 Prayer to buy and wear one.

Void knight robe.title: Void knight robe
Void knight robe.intro: The Void Knight robe is a piece of Void Knight equipment . It can be bought from a Void Knight for 250 Void Knight commendation points through the Pest Control minigame, although a player must have at least 42 Attack , Strength , Defence , Hitpoints , Ranged , and Magic , along with 22 Prayer to buy and wear one.

Void knight gloves.title: Void knight gloves
Void knight gloves.intro: Void Knight gloves are a piece of Void Knight equipment . They can be bought from a Void Knight for 150 commendations , although a player must have at least 42 Attack , Strength , Defence , Hitpoints , Ranged , and Magic , along with 22 Prayer to buy and wear them. The gloves can also be given to the Dodgy Squire in exchange for 120 Void Knight commendation points.

Void mage helm.title: Void mage helm
Void mage helm.intro: The Void mage helm is a piece of Void Knight equipment . It can be bought from a Void Knight for 200 commendation points , if the player has at least 42 Attack , Strength , Defence , Hitpoints , Ranged , and Magic , and 22 Prayer to buy and wear one. It is worn in combination with the other pieces of Void Knight Armour ( Void knight top , Void knight robe , and Void knight gloves ) to achieve the designated set effect. The Voi

Void melee helm.title: Void melee helm
Void melee helm.intro: A Void melee helm is a piece of Void Knight equipment that is obtained as a reward in the Pest Control minigame. It can be bought from a Void Knight for 200 commendation points , although a player must have at least level 42 Attack , Strength , Defence , Hitpoints , Ranged , and Magic , along with level 22 Prayer to buy and wear one.

Void ranger helm.title: Void ranger helm
Void ranger helm.intro: The Void ranger helm is a piece of Void Knight equipment obtained as a reward from the Pest Control minigame. It can be bought from a Void Knight for 200 commendation points ; players also must have at least 42 Attack , Strength , Defence , Hitpoints , Ranged , Magic and 22 Prayer to buy and wear one.

Void seal(8).title: Void seal
Void seal(8).intro: The Void seal is a piece of Void Knight equipment reward in the Pest Control activity. It can be bought from a Void Knight for 10 commendation points. Unlike the rest of the Void Knight equipment, players do not require at least 42 Attack , Strength , Defence , Hitpoints , along with 22 Prayer to buy and wear one. Elite void top.title: Elite void top
Elite void top.intro: The elite Void top is a piece of Elite Void Knight equipment . It can be upgraded from a Void knight top for 200 Void Knight commendation points by speaking to the Elite Void Knight , although a player must have completed the Hard Western Provinces Diary to be able to upgrade it. It is worn in combination with the other pieces of Void Knight Armour to achieve the designated set effect, depending on which helm is worn. The stat

Elite void robe.title: Elite void robe
Elite void robe.intro: An elite void robe is a piece of Elite Void Knight equipment . It can be upgraded from a void knight robe for 200 Void Knight commendation points by speaking to the Elite Void Knight , although the hard Western Provinces Diary must be completed to upgrade it. When worn in combination with the other pieces of Void Knight armour, there is a set effect that depends on which void helm is worn. Compared to the void knight robe , it

Rogues' Den.title: Rogues' Den
Rogues' Den.intro: The Rogues' Den is a hideout located beneath a trapdoor in The Toad and Chicken inn in Burthorpe , containing a variety of Thieving and Agility related activities. While there are no entry requirements, its main attraction is the Maze exploration minigame, which requires 50 Agility and 50 Thieving (unboostable). Rogue mask.title: Rogue mask
Rogue mask.intro: The rogue mask is a piece of rogue equipment , which provides +5 bonuses to all Defence types. The mask is similar in design to a balaclava. The mask cannot be crafted, and are untradeable.

Rogue top.title: Rogue top
Rogue top.intro: The rogue top is part of the rogue equipment set, and provides +10 bonuses to all Defence types. The top cannot be crafted, and are untradeable.

Rogue trousers.title: Rogue trousers
Rogue trousers.intro: Rogue trousers are part of the rogue equipment set, and provide +7 bonuses to all Defence types. The trousers cannot be crafted, and are untradeable.

Rogue boots.title: Rogue boots
Rogue boots.intro: Rogue boots are part of the rogue equipment set, and provide +2 bonuses to all Defence types. The boots cannot be crafted, and are untradeable.

Rogue gloves.title: Rogue gloves
Rogue gloves.intro: Rogue gloves are part of the rogue equipment set, and provide +2 bonuses to all Defence types. The gloves cannot be crafted, and are untradeable.

Shades of Mort'ton.title: Shades of Mort'ton
Shades of Mort'ton.intro: Shades of Mort'ton is a quest that takes place in Morytania . The town of Mort'ton is overrun with Shades, and a strange affliction has taken over the townspeople. The player uncovers an old cure for the affliction and must help the village.

Amulet of the Damned (full).title: Amulet of the Damned
Amulet of the Damned (full).intro: The Amulet of the Damned is an amulet that provides extra buffs to Barrows equipment . It can be obtained from silver and gold shade chests found in the Shade Catacombs . The amulet has the same bonuses as an amulet of glory .

Flamtaer bag.title: Flamtaer bag
Flamtaer bag.intro: The Flamtaer bag is a bag that can store supplies used in the Shades of Mort'ton minigame . It is obtained from any chest (except bronze) in the Shade Catacombs . Players can only own one Flamtaer bag at any given time.

Fine cloth.title: Fine cloth
Fine cloth.intro: Fine cloth is a material used in the making of splitbark armour . The armour can be made by either providing payment and materials to Wizard Jalarast in the Wizards' Tower , or through the Crafting skill. Fine cloth can be obtained in the Shades of Mort'ton minigame from any level of chest other than bronze, but the higher level chests have a better chance of acquiring it.

Bronze locks.title: Bronze locks
Bronze locks.intro: Bronze locks are a potential reward from bronze chests in the Shades of Mort'ton minigame . They are used to create a bronze coffin by taking the locks and coffin to Dampe ; this process is reversible via the "Remove-lock" option on the coffin.

Steel locks.title: Steel locks
Steel locks.intro: Steel locks are a potential reward from steel chests in the Shades of Mort'ton minigame . They are used to create a steel coffin by taking the locks and coffin to Dampe ; this process is reversible via the "Remove-lock" option on the coffin.

Black locks.title: Black locks
Black locks.intro: Black locks are a potential reward from black chests in the Shades of Mort'ton minigame . They are used to create a black coffin by taking the locks and coffin to Dampe ; this process is reversible via the "Remove-lock" option on the coffin.

Silver locks.title: Silver locks
Silver locks.intro: Silver locks are a potential reward from silver chests in the Shades of Mort'ton minigame . They are used to create a silver coffin by taking the locks and coffin to Dampe ; this process is reversible via the "Remove-lock" option on the coffin.

Gold locks.title: Gold locks
Gold locks.intro: Gold locks are a potential reward from gold chests in the Shades of Mort'ton minigame . They are used to create a gold coffin by taking the locks and coffin to Dampe ; this process is reversible via the "Remove-lock" option on the coffin.

Zealot's helm.title: Zealot's helm
Zealot's helm.intro: The zealot's helm is a piece of the Zealot's robes set that can be obtained from looting gold chests within the Shade Catacombs .

Zealot's robe top.title: Zealot's robe top
Zealot's robe top.intro: The zealot's robe top is a piece of the Zealot's robes set that can be obtained from looting gold chests within the Shade Catacombs .

Zealot's robe bottom.title: Zealot's robe bottom
Zealot's robe bottom.intro: The zealot's robe bottom is a piece of the Zealot's robes set that can be obtained from looting gold chests within the Shade Catacombs .

Zealot's boots.title: Zealot's boots
Zealot's boots.intro: The zealot's boots is a piece of the Zealot's robes set that can be obtained from looting gold chests within the Shade Catacombs .

Tree wizards' journal.title: Tree wizards' journal
Tree wizards' journal.intro: The tree wizards' journal is a journal obtained from chests within the Shade Catacombs . Higher tier chests give a higher chance of obtaining the journal, as well as wearing a ring of wealth . Opening the journal for the first time gives players a runescroll of swampbark , which can be read to unlock the ability to create swampbark armour .

Bloody notes.title: Bloody notes
Bloody notes.intro: The bloody notes is a diary obtained from chests within the Shade Catacombs . Higher tier chests give a higher chance of obtaining the journal, as well as wearing a ring of wealth . Opening the notes for the first time gives players a runescroll of bloodbark , which can be read to unlock the ability to create bloodbark armour .

Temple Trekking.title: Temple Trekking
Temple Trekking.intro: Temple Trekking is a members -only minigame in which the player must escort victims of vampyre rule from Burgh de Rott through Morytania to the Paterdomus , the temple on River Salve , on the way guiding them through the swamp while defending them from dangerous packs of monsters, some unique to this minigame. Burgh de Rott Ramble is the reverse route in which the player escorts mercenaries from the Paterdomus to Burgh de Rott

Lumberjack hat.title: Lumberjack hat
Lumberjack hat.intro: The lumberjack hat is a part of the lumberjack clothing set that can be purchased from the Forestry Shop for 1,200 anima-infused bark , 200 noted yew logs , and 100 noted magic logs . These logs can be bought on the Grand Exchange for 93,200 . It is also dropped by undead lumberjacks in the Temple Trekking minigame . It increases experience by 0.4% when Woodcutting . This is increased to +2.5% when wearing the whole set. It is

Lumberjack top.title: Lumberjack top
Lumberjack top.intro: The lumberjack top is a part of the lumberjack clothing set that can be purchased from the Forestry Shop for 1,500 anima-infused bark , 60 noted yew logs , 120 noted magic logs , and 120 noted redwood logs . These logs can be bought on the Grand Exchange for 189,300 . It is also dropped by undead lumberjacks in the Temple Trekking minigame . It provides a +0.8% boost in Woodcutting experience, and is increased to +2.5% when th

Lumberjack legs.title: Lumberjack legs
Lumberjack legs.intro: The lumberjack legs are a part of the lumberjack clothing set that can be purchased from the Forestry Shop for 1,300 anima-infused bark , 160 noted yew logs , and 140 noted magic logs . These logs can be bought on the Grand Exchange for 118,120 . It is also dropped by undead lumberjacks in the Temple Trekking minigame . They increase experience by 0.6% when Woodcutting . This is increased to +2.5% when wearing the whole set.

Lumberjack boots.title: Lumberjack boots
Lumberjack boots.intro: The lumberjack boots are a part of the lumberjack clothing set that can be purchased from the Forestry Shop for 1,000 anima-infused bark , 100 noted maple logs , and 200 noted yew logs . These logs can be bought on the Grand Exchange for 21,700 . It is also dropped by undead lumberjacks in the Temple Trekking minigame . They increase experience by 0.2% when Woodcutting . This is increased to +2.5% when wearing the whole set.

Tithe Farm.title: Tithe Farm
Tithe Farm.intro: The Tithe Farm is a Farming based minigame that is located in Hosidius , requiring level 34 Farming to play. The minigame revolves around intensively planting special seeds into farming patches, tending them until harvest, and depositing the produce into sacks in order to earn points. Players can speak to Farmer Gricoller for information on how to play.

Farmer's strawhat.title: Farmer's strawhat
Farmer's strawhat.intro: The Farmer's strawhat is a strawhat acquired from the Tithe Farm minigame in exchange for 75 points. It is a part of the farmer's outfit . The strawhat grants 0.4% bonus Farming experience while equipped.

Farmer's jacket.title: Farmer's jacket
Farmer's jacket.intro: The Farmer's jacket is acquired from the Tithe Farm minigame in exchange for 150 points. It is a part of the Farmer's outfit . The jacket grants 0.8% bonus Farming experience when worn. This piece can only be equipped by players with body type A.

Farmer's boro trousers.title: Farmer's boro trousers
Farmer's boro trousers.intro: Farmer's boro trousers are acquired from the Tithe Farm minigame in exchange for 125 points. They are a part of the Farmer's outfit . The boro trousers grant 0.6% bonus Farming experience while equipped.

Farmer's boots.title: Farmer's boots
Farmer's boots.intro: Farmer's boots are acquired from the Tithe Farm minigame in exchange for 50 points. They are a part of the farmer's outfit . The boots grant 0.2% bonus Farming experience while equipped.

Seed box.title: Seed box
Seed box.intro: The seed box is an item that can store up to 2,147,483,647 seeds of six different types. It is purchased from Farmer Gricoller at the Tithe Farm for 250 points. This item can be used directly on a farming patch . Using the box on a patch will automatically plant the first applicable seed of that patch's type, which can be reordered. Players can right-click to open the box, which will have seeds that the player picks up be auto

Gricoller's can.title: Gricoller's can
Gricoller's can.intro: Gricoller's can is a reward from the Tithe Farm minigame , which is found in the south-east corner of Hosidius . Players may exchange points at Farmer Gricoller's Rewards for the can.

Herb sack.title: Herb sack
Herb sack.intro: A herb sack is an item that can be bought from Slayer masters for 750 Slayer reward points or from Farmer Gricoller's Rewards for 250 Tithe Farm points.

Trouble Brewing.title: Trouble Brewing
Trouble Brewing.intro: Trouble Brewing is a minigame that takes place on the east side of the pirate island of Mos Le'Harmless . The main goal of the game is to make as much rum as you can as fast as possible. To do this, there are a number of tasks that must be done, from gathering ingredients to taking care of the boilers.

Grey navy slacks.intro: Grey navy slacks can be purchased from Honest Jimmy for 1,000 Pieces of eight . It is for decoration only, and has no combat bonuses. It cannot be sold back to the shop.

Gilded smile flag.title: Gilded smile flag
Gilded smile flag.intro: The gilded smile flag can be purchased from Honest Jimmy , who oversees the Trouble Brewing minigame in Mos Le'Harmless , for 2,000 pieces of eight . Once purchased, it cannot be resold to the shop.

Cutthroat flag.title: Cutthroat flag
Cutthroat flag.intro: The cutthroat flag can be purchased from Honest Jimmy , who oversees the Trouble Brewing minigame in Mos Le'Harmless , for 2,000 pieces of eight . Once purchased, it cannot be resold to the shop.

Bronze fist flag.title: Bronze fist flag
Bronze fist flag.intro: The bronze fist flag can be purchased from Honest Jimmy , who oversees the Trouble Brewing minigame in Mos Le'Harmless , for 3,000 pieces of eight . Once purchased, it cannot be resold to the shop.

Lucky shot flag.title: Lucky shot flag
Lucky shot flag.intro: The lucky shot flag can be purchased from Honest Jimmy , who oversees the Trouble Brewing minigame in Mos Le'Harmless , for 4,000 pieces of eight . Once purchased, it cannot be resold to the shop.

Treasure flag.title: Treasure flag
Treasure flag.intro: The treasure flag can be purchased from Honest Jimmy , who oversees the Trouble Brewing minigame in Mos Le'Harmless , for 5,000 pieces of eight . Once purchased, it cannot be resold to the shop.

Phasmatys flag.title: Phasmatys flag
Phasmatys flag.intro: The phasmatys flag can be purchased from Honest Jimmy , who oversees the Trouble Brewing minigame in Mos Le'Harmless , for 6,000 pieces of eight . Once purchased, it cannot be resold to the shop.

The stuff.title: The stuff
The stuff.intro: The stuff is purchased from Honest Jimmy's House of Stuff with 50 pieces of eight from the Trouble Brewing minigame on Mos Le'Harmless . Access to the minigame and shop requires completion of the Cabin Fever quest . "The stuff" apparently contains some questionable and/or toxic content, as it has been banned by the Cooks' Guild of Varrock . However, it does not actually cause any negative side effects when used in brewing .

Vale Totems.title: Vale Totems
Vale Totems.intro: Vale Totems is a Fletching minigame found in Auburn Valley in the north western part of Varlamore . Players earn vale offerings and vale research points by building, carving, and decorating totems around the valley.

Rum.title: Rum
Rum.intro: Rum is a drink that can be purchased from Atlazora's Rest and The Flaming Arrow , which are both found in Civitas illa Fortis . It is also frequently found in mid-level salvage .

Fletching knife.title: Fletching knife
Fletching knife.intro: The fletching knife is an equippable version of a knife obtained as reward from the Vale Totems minigame . It can be found at a rate of 1/333.3 while rummaging through Vale offerings or purchased from Ranulph 's Vale Research Exchange for 350 research points . Spare fletching knives can be exchanged for 175 Vale research points.

Bow string spool.title: Bow string spool
Bow string spool.intro: The bow string spool is a reward from the Vale Totems minigame , which can be obtained from rummaging through Vale offerings at a rate of 1/200, or bought directly from Vale Research Exchange for 250 research points . Spare spools can be combined to increase the capacity of the spool, or they can be traded in to Ranulph for 125 Vale research points.

Ent branch.title: Ent branch
Ent branch.intro: An ent branch is an item received from the Vale Totems minigame , which can be obtained as common loot from rummaging through Vale offerings , or bought directly from Vale Research Exchange for 20 research points .

Greenman mask.title: Greenman mask
Greenman mask.intro: The greenman mask is a cosmetic reward from the Vale Totems minigame , which can be obtained from rummaging through Vale offerings at a rate of 1/500, or bought directly from Vale Research Exchange for 500 research points . Ironmen (including group ironmen , despite them being able to trade the mask with fellow group members) with spare masks can trade them in to Ranulph for 125 Vale research points.

Volcanic Mine.title: Volcanic Mine
Volcanic Mine.intro: The Volcanic Mine is a large volcanic chamber found underneath the Fossil Island Volcano . The mine entrance is located in the north-east corner of the volcano, with Petrified Pete guarding its entrance. Players can participate in the eponymous minigame inside the mine.

Large water container.title: Heat-proof vessel
Large water container.intro: A heat-proof vessel (also referred to as a large water container for the upgrade in the Collection Log and Petrified Pete's Ore Shop ) is a water container given to the player by Petrified Pete upon entering the Volcanic Mine . It can be equipped in the weapon slot. It has 36 uses per game, and can be used to throw water onto the lava, creating platforms which players can walk on.
