Volcanic mine teleport.title: Volcanic mine teleport
Volcanic mine teleport.intro: The Volcanic mine teleport is a magic tablet that can be broken by players to teleport to the Volcanic Mine entrance on the Fossil Island Volcano .

Dragon pickaxe (broken).title: Dragon pickaxe (broken)
Dragon pickaxe (broken).intro: A broken dragon pickaxe is a rare loot from opening ore packs from the Volcanic Mine reward shop .

Ash covered tome.title: Ash covered tome
Ash covered tome.intro: The ash covered tome is an item purchased from Petrified Pete's Ore Shop by the entrance to the Volcanic Mine on Fossil Island for 40,000 points. An enhanced Fertile Soil spell is unlocked by reading it. The enhancement gives the effect of ultracompost by casting the spell while having two volcanic ash in the player's inventory, which it consumes.

Prospector helmet.title: Prospector helmet
Prospector helmet.intro: The prospector helmet is a part of the Prospector kit that can be bought from the Motherlode Mine in exchange for 40 golden nuggets , or from the Volcanic Mine for 26,000 points. The helmet increases Mining experience by 0.4% when worn. Despite having two lights attached to it, the Prospector helmet does not act as a light source.

Prospector jacket.title: Prospector jacket
Prospector jacket.intro: The prospector jacket is one part of the prospector outfit and is a reward from the Motherlode Mine in exchange for 60 Golden nuggets or from Volcanic Mine for 39,000 points. The jacket gives a Mining experience boost of 0.8% when worn.

Prospector legs.title: Prospector legs
Prospector legs.intro: The prospector legs are a part of the Prospector kit that can be bought from the Motherlode Mine in exchange for 50 golden nuggets or Volcanic Mine for 34,000 points. These leggings increase Mining experience by 0.6% when worn.

Prospector boots.title: Prospector boots
Prospector boots.intro: Prospector boots are part of the Prospector kit set, worn in the foot slot. The Prospector boots increase Mining experience by 0.2% when worn.

Aerial Fishing.title: Aerial fishing
Aerial Fishing.intro: Aerial fishing is a hybrid Fishing and Hunter technique requiring levels 35 Hunter and 43 Fishing. The aerial fishing technique is used to catch several fish species at Lake Molch .

Golden tench.title: Golden tench
Golden tench.intro: The golden tench is a very rare equipable fish obtained from aerial fishing at Lake Molch at a rate of 1/20,000. When a player receives the tench, a message in the chatbox will state: The cormorant has brought you a very strange tench. , or The cormorant is about to eat a strange tench before you quickly yank it out of its mouth. if the player has the option to feed the cormorant whole fish enabled. Unlike other catches in Lak

Pearl fishing rod.title: Pearl fishing rod
Pearl fishing rod.intro: A pearl fishing rod is an item that can be purchased for 100 Molch pearls from Alry the Angler on Molch island . It is an equipable version of the fishing rod .

Pearl barbarian rod.title: Pearl barbarian rod
Pearl barbarian rod.intro: A pearl barbarian rod is an item that can be purchased for 150 Molch pearls from Alry the Angler on Molch island . It is an equipable version of the Barbarian rod , and can only be purchased if the relevant part of the Barbarian Training miniquest is completed with Otto Godblessed . It can only be used in the fishing spots at Otto's Grotto , and Mount Quidamortem in the Kebos Lowlands . Since barbarian fishing gives marginal S

Pearl fly fishing rod.title: Pearl fly fishing rod
Pearl fly fishing rod.intro: A pearl fly fishing rod is an equipable version of the fly fishing rod . It is purchased for 120 Molch pearls from Alry the Angler on Molch island . This rod can be used to fish for trout , salmon (both with feathers ), and rainbow fish (with stripy feathers ).

Fish sack.title: Fish sack
Fish sack.intro: The fish sack is an item that can be purchased for 500 Molch pearls from Alry the Angler on Molch Island . The Fish sack is worn in place of a cape and has minor defence bonuses.

Barracuda paint.title: Barracuda paint
Barracuda paint.intro: Barracuda paint is a type of boat paint used to recolour the trim of a player's skiff or sloop via the boat schematics board at the Shipyard . Trimming a boat requires level 25 Sailing and 20 Construction , granting 10 Construction experience. One paint is required for trimming skiffs, while sloops require two.

Camdozaal.title: Ruins of Camdozaal
Camdozaal.intro: The Ruins of Camdozaal is a ruined underground city which was once the home of the Imcando dwarves after the fall of Imcandoria . It is located beneath Ice Mountain , accessed through the entrance on the western side of the mountain after completion of the quest Below Ice Mountain . The ruins are home to the Sacred Forge , which runs on a material called barronite , and powers the entire city.

Barronite mace.title: Barronite mace
Barronite mace.intro: The Barronite mace is a crush melee weapon that can be obtained within the Ruins of Camdozaal , requiring 40 Attack to wield. Its bonuses are comparable to that of a rune mace , but it provides higher melee strength and crush accuracy bonuses at the cost of a lower prayer bonus. It also has a 15% damage and accuracy bonus against golems , including those within the dungeon. Unlike regular metal maces, the barronite mace offers

Barronite head.title: Barronite head
Barronite head.intro: The barronite head is one of the three parts of the barronite mace , obtained from smashing barronite deposits on the Barronite Crusher in the Ruins of Camdozaal 's next to Ramarno . When obtained, the message There's a Barronite Head inside! will be displayed.

Barronite handle.title: Barronite handle
Barronite handle.intro: The barronite handle is one of the three parts of the barronite mace , found while fishing at a fishing spot in the Ruins of Camdozaal . When obtained, the message You fished out a Barronite Handle! will be displayed. Note that the handle cannot be obtained from the frog spawn fishing spots in Camdozaal.

Barronite guard.title: Barronite guard
Barronite guard.intro: The barronite guard is one of the three parts of the barronite mace , obtained as a drop from golems in the Ruins of Camdozaal .

Ancient globe.title: Ancient globe
Ancient globe.intro: The ancient globe is a relic that may be received from breaking open barronite deposits . A relic from the Second Age , it belonged to the inhabitants of Lassar , who were destroyed by Saradominist armies after the events of the Betrayal of Zaros , which included the Imcando dwarves .

Ancient ledger.title: Ancient ledger
Ancient ledger.intro: The ancient ledger is a relic that may be received from breaking open barronite deposits . A relic from the Second Age , it belonged to the inhabitants of Lassar , who were destroyed by Saradominist armies after the events of the Betrayal of Zaros , which included the Imcando dwarves .

Ancient astroscope.title: Ancient astroscope
Ancient astroscope.intro: The ancient astroscope is a relic that may be received from breaking open barronite deposits . A relic from the Second Age , it belonged to the inhabitants of Lassar , who were destroyed by Saradominist armies after the events of the Betrayal of Zaros , which included the Imcando dwarves .

Ancient treatise.title: Ancient treatise
Ancient treatise.intro: The ancient treatise is a relic that may be received from breaking open barronite deposits . A relic from the Second Age , it belonged to the inhabitants of Lassar , who were destroyed by Saradominist armies after the events of the Betrayal of Zaros , which included the Imcando dwarves .

Ancient carcanet.intro: The ancient carcanet is a relic that may be received from breaking open barronite deposits . A relic from the Second Age , it belonged to the inhabitants of Lassar , who were destroyed by Saradominist armies after the events of the Betrayal of Zaros , which included the Imcando dwarves .

Imcando hammer.title: Imcando hammer
Imcando hammer.intro: The Imcando hammer is a wieldable variant of a hammer mostly used for Smithing , Crafting , or Construction . It can be obtained through smashing barronite deposits on the barronite crusher in the Ruins of Camdozaal after completing the Below Ice Mountain quest .

Champion's Challenge.title: Champions' Challenge
Champion's Challenge.intro: The Champions' Challenge is a Distraction and Diversion found in the basement of the Champions' Guild . While fighting various creatures of Gielinor , a player may be challenged to a duel by the champion of certain races, which are offered by means of a champion's scroll , which is received as an extremely rare drop (1/5,000 chance) . These duels take place with certain rules, from limiting the player's armour to disallowing s

Earth warrior champion scroll.title: Earth warrior champion scroll
Earth warrior champion scroll.intro: The earth warrior champion scroll is an extremely rare drop from earth warriors . It contains a challenge from the Earth Warrior Champion . In order to be eligible to receive the scroll, players must have at least 32 quest points and be on a members world.

Ghoul champion scroll.title: Ghoul champion scroll
Ghoul champion scroll.intro: The ghoul champion scroll is an extremely rare drop from ghouls . It contains a challenge from the Ghoul Champion . In order to be eligible to receive the scroll, players must have at least 32 quest points and be on a members world.

Giant champion scroll.title: Giant champion scroll
Giant champion scroll.intro: The giant champion scroll is an extremely rare drop from various giants. It contains a challenge from the Giant Champion . In order to be eligible to receive the scroll, players must have at least 32 quest points and be on a members world.

Goblin champion scroll.title: Goblin champion scroll
Goblin champion scroll.intro: The goblin champion scroll is an extremely rare drop from goblins . It contains a challenge from the Goblin Champion . In order to be eligible to receive the scroll, players must have at least 32 quest points and be on a members world.

Hobgoblin champion scroll.title: Hobgoblin champion scroll
Hobgoblin champion scroll.intro: The hobgoblin champion scroll is an extremely rare drop from hobgoblins . It contains a challenge from the Hobgoblin Champion . In order to be eligible to receive the scroll, players must have at least 32 quest points and be on a members world.

Imp champion scroll.title: Imp champion scroll
Imp champion scroll.intro: The imp champion scroll is an extremely rare drop from imps . It contains a challenge from the Imp Champion . In order to be eligible to receive the scroll, players must have at least 32 quest points and be on a members world.

Jogre champion scroll.title: Jogre champion scroll
Jogre champion scroll.intro: The jogre champion scroll is an extremely rare drop from jogres . It contains a challenge from the Jogre Champion . In order to be eligible to receive the scroll, players must have at least 32 quest points and be on a members world.

Lesser demon champion scroll.title: Lesser demon champion scroll
Lesser demon champion scroll.intro: The lesser demon champion scroll is an extremely rare drop from lesser demons . It contains a challenge from the Lesser Demon Champion . In order to be eligible to receive the scroll, players must have at least 32 quest points and be on a members world.

Zombie champion scroll.title: Zombie champion scroll
Zombie champion scroll.intro: The zombie champion scroll is an extremely rare drop from Zombies . It contains a challenge from the Zombies Champion . In order to be eligible to receive the scroll, players must have at least 32 quest points and be on a members world.

Champion's cape.title: Champion's cape
Champion's cape.intro: The champion's cape is a cosmetic cape that is rewarded after defeating all 11 champions available in the Champions' Challenge . It is worn by Leon d'Cour , the human champion, Dimintheis , a Varrockian noble, as well as Toby , the taskmaster of the Varrock Diary .

Skeleton champion scroll.title: Skeleton champion scroll
Skeleton champion scroll.intro: The skeleton champion scroll is an extremely rare drop from skeletons . It contains a challenge from the Skeleton Champion . In order to be eligible to receive the scroll, players must have at least 32 quest points and be on a members world.

Chompy Bird Hunting.title: Chompy bird hunting
Chompy Bird Hunting.intro: Chompy bird hunting is an unmarked Ranged activity that involves killing chompy and jubbly birds . It becomes available after completion of the quest Big Chompy Bird Hunting . Plucking a Chompy bird grants the player 30 Hunter experience.

Chompy bird hat.title: Chompy bird hunting
Chompy bird hat.intro: Chompy bird hunting is an unmarked Ranged activity that involves killing chompy and jubbly birds . It becomes available after completion of the quest Big Chompy Bird Hunting . Plucking a Chompy bird grants the player 30 Hunter experience.

Colossal Wyrm Agility.title: Colossal Wyrm Agility Course
Colossal Wyrm Agility.intro: The Colossal Wyrm Agility Course is an Agility course found in the Avium Savannah which involves running around the scaffolding that surrounds the Colossal Wyrm Remains . Before attempting the course, players must first speak to Worm Tongue , an anteater, about helping him gather termites around the scaffolding in order to preserve the wyrm's remains.

Colossal wyrm teleport scroll.title: Colossal wyrm teleport scroll
Colossal wyrm teleport scroll.intro: The Colossal Wyrm teleport scroll are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the Colossal Wyrm Remains . They can be purchased from Worm Tongue's Wares for 40 termites obtained from the Colossal Wyrm Agility Course .

Calcified acorn.title: Calcified acorn
Calcified acorn.intro: The calcified acorn is a reward from the Colossal Wyrm Agility Course that can be purchased from Worm Tongue for 900 termites . Using it on a giant squirrel will allow it to metamorphose into a bone squirrel .

Creature Creation.title: Creature Creation
Creature Creation.intro: Creature Creation is a solo activity that involves creating unique hybrid monsters and killing them for their drops. It can be found in the Tower of Life dungeon after completing the Tower of Life quest. A trapdoor on the ground floor of the tower leads to the dungeon.

Tea flask.title: Tea flask
Tea flask.intro: A tea flask is a container item that can store up to 5 cups of plain tea . Tea may be drunk directly from the flask restoring 3 Hitpoints and temporarily boosting Attack by 2 + 2% (rounded down). Upon consuming the tea, the player will exclaim Ahhh, tea is so refreshing. . The tea flask may also be used on an empty cup to fill it. Tea flasks cannot be filled with damiana tea , nettle tea , or tea from a player-owned house .

Plain satchel.title: Plain satchel
Plain satchel.intro: A plain satchel is a drop from frogeels , which can be created in the basement of the Tower of Life after completing the Tower of Life quest . When equipped, it will also enhance the beckon emote .

Green satchel.title: Green satchel
Green satchel.intro: A green satchel is a drop from unicows , which can be created in the basement of the Tower of Life after completing the Tower of Life quest . When equipped, it will also enhance the beckon emote .

Red satchel.title: Red satchel
Red satchel.intro: A red satchel is a drop from spidines , which can be created in the basement of the Tower of Life after completing the Tower of Life quest . When equipped, it will also enhance the beckon emote .

Black satchel.title: Black satchel
Black satchel.intro: A black satchel is a drop from swordchicks , which can be created in the basement of the Tower of Life after completing the Tower of Life quest . When equipped, it will also enhance the beckon emote .

Gold satchel.title: Gold satchel
Gold satchel.intro: A gold satchel is a drop from jubsters , which can be created in the basement of the Tower of Life after completing the Tower of Life quest . When equipped, it will also enhance the beckon emote .

Rune satchel.title: Rune satchel
Rune satchel.intro: Rune satchels are a drop from newtroosts , which can be created in the basement of the Tower of Life after completing the Tower of Life quest . When equipped, it will also enhance the beckon emote .

Cyclopes.title: Cyclops
Cyclopes.intro: A cyclops (plural cyclopes ) is a large one-eyed giant . They are known for dropping many alchable drops, so bringing nature and fire runes is helpful as it allows players to make longer trips and more money without banking or taking up inventory space. The cyclopes found in the Warriors' Guild were brought over by Harrallak Menarous from the Wushanko Isles when he went on an expedition there.

Bronze defender.title: Bronze defender
Bronze defender.intro: The bronze defender is the weakest defender . It is similar to a dagger, but held in the off-hand in place of a shield. The bronze defender is dropped by cyclopes on the top floor of the Warriors' Guild . Entry to the Cyclops room requires a minimum of 100 Warrior guild tokens .

Iron defender.title: Iron defender
Iron defender.intro: The iron defender is a defender made of iron . It is dropped by any of the cyclops on the top floor of the Warriors' Guild when showing a bronze defender to Kamfreena and entering the room with it in your inventory. It is one of the two defenders that does not provide a strength bonus , along with the bronze defender.

Steel defender.title: Steel defender
Steel defender.intro: The steel defender is the third weakest defender . It is similar to a dagger, but held in the off-hand in place of a shield. It requires 5 Attack and 5 Defence to wield. The steel defender is dropped by cyclopes on the top floor of the Warriors' Guild when showing an iron defender to Kamfreena and entering the room with it in your inventory.

Black defender.title: Black defender
Black defender.intro: The black defender is a defender made of black metal. It is similar to a dagger, but held in the off-hand in place of a shield. It requires 10 Attack and 10 Defence to wield. The black defender is dropped by cyclopes on the top floor of the Warriors' Guild when showing a steel defender to Kamfreena and entering the room with it in your inventory.

Mithril defender.title: Mithril defender
Mithril defender.intro: The mithril defender is a defender made of mithril . It is held in the shield slot and requires 20 Attack and Defence to wield. It can be obtained by killing cyclopes on the top floor of the Warriors' Guild when showing a black defender to Kamfreena and entering the room with it in your inventory.

Adamant defender.title: Adamant defender
Adamant defender.intro: The adamant defender is a defender made out of adamant . It is held in the shield slot and requires 30 Attack and Defence to wield. It can be obtained by killing cyclopes on the top floor of the Warriors' Guild when showing a mithril defender to Kamfreena and entering the room with it in your inventory.

Rune defender.title: Rune defender
Rune defender.intro: The rune defender is the 3rd strongest defender . It is used for its attack bonus and is held in the off-hand in place of a shield . It requires 40 Attack and 40 Defence to wield. The rune defender is dropped by cyclopes on the top floor of the Warriors' Guild after showing an adamant defender or better to Kamfreena as the player enters the room.

Dragon defender.title: Dragon defender
Dragon defender.intro: The dragon defender is the second strongest defender , behind the Avernic defender . It is used for its attack and strength bonus and is held in the shield slot. It requires level 60 Defence to equip.

Elder chaos top.title: Elder chaos top
Elder chaos top.intro: The elder chaos top is obtained as a rare drop from Elder Chaos druids . It is part of the elder chaos druid robes set, and requires level 40 in Magic to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Elder chaos robe.title: Elder chaos robe
Elder chaos robe.intro: The elder chaos robe is obtained as a rare drop from Elder Chaos druids . It is part of the elder chaos druid robes set, and requires level 40 in Magic to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Elder chaos hood.title: Elder chaos hood
Elder chaos hood.intro: The elder chaos hood is obtained as a rare drop from Elder Chaos druids . It is part of the elder chaos druid robes set, and requires level 40 in Magic to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Forestry.title: Forestry
Forestry.intro: Forestry: The Way of the Forester is a social-focused expansion to core Woodcutting . It aims to make Woodcutting a more social experience by "removing resource competition, introducing new events, and expanding the skill's economic offerings". All of these features can be found throughout Gielinor, wherever trees are, excluding the Woodcutting Guild .

Fox whistle.title: Fox whistle
Fox whistle.intro: The fox whistle is a rare reward from the Poachers Forestry event . It is used on the beaver pet to allow it to metamorphose into a fox . It is consumed in the process.

Golden pheasant egg.title: Golden pheasant egg
Golden pheasant egg.intro: The Golden pheasant egg is a rare reward from the Pheasant Control Forestry event . It is used on the beaver pet to allow it to metamorphose into a pheasant . It is consumed in the process.

Forestry hat.title: Forestry hat
Forestry hat.intro: The forestry hat is a cosmetic variant of the Lumberjack hat , purchased from the Forestry Shop for 1,250 anima-infused bark , the lumberjack hat, and 60 noted oak , willow , teak , maple , mahogany , arctic pine , yew , magic , and redwood logs .

Forestry top.title: Forestry top
Forestry top.intro: The forestry top is a cosmetic variant of the lumberjack top , purchased from the Forestry Shop for 1,250 anima-infused bark , the lumberjack top, and 60 noted oak , willow , teak , maple , mahogany , arctic pine , yew , magic , and redwood logs .

Forestry legs.title: Forestry legs
Forestry legs.intro: The Forestry legs are a cosmetic variant of the Lumberjack legs , purchased from the Forestry Shop for 1,250 anima-infused bark , the lumberjack legs, and 60 noted oak , willow , teak , maple , mahogany , arctic pine , yew , magic , and redwood logs .

Forestry boots.title: Forestry boots
Forestry boots.intro: The forestry boots are a cosmetic variant of the Lumberjack boots , purchased from the Forestry Shop for 1,250 anima-infused bark , the lumberjack boots, and 60 noted oak , willow , teak , maple , mahogany , arctic pine , yew , magic , and redwood logs .

Twitcher's gloves.title: Twitcher's gloves
Twitcher's gloves.intro: Twitcher's gloves are an item purchased from the Forestry Shop for 5,000 anima-infused bark and 500 noted willow logs .

Funky shaped log.title: Funky shaped log
Funky shaped log.intro: The funky shaped log is an item that is used on the beaver pet (and consumed) in order to permanently allow it to metamorphose into a variety of log-based colours.

Log basket.title: Log basket
Log basket.intro: A log basket is an item that allows players to store a combined total of 28 logs of any type. The basket can be purchased from the Forestry Shop for 300 noted oak logs , 300 noted willow logs , and 5,000 anima-infused bark . Players (excluding Ultimate Ironmen ) can sell the basket back to the rewards shop for an 80% return of the cost to purchase. The basket must be closed before being sold back.

Log brace.title: Log brace
Log brace.intro: The log brace is an item purchased from the Forestry Shop for 3,000 anima-infused bark , as well as 300 noted maple and yew logs . These logs can be bought on the Grand Exchange for 34,200 .

Clothes pouch blueprint.title: Clothes pouch blueprint
Clothes pouch blueprint.intro: The clothes pouch blueprint is an item purchased from the Forestry Shop for 10,000 anima-infused bark , as well as 300 noted willow and maple logs . These logs can be bought on the Grand Exchange for 10,500 .

Cape pouch.title: Cape pouch
Cape pouch.intro: The cape pouch is an item purchased from the Forestry Shop for 2,500 anima-infused bark . This pouch is used on the Forestry kit or Forestry basket with level 99 Woodcutting, allowing the player to store the Woodcutting cape within, to receive the skillcape benefits whilst wearing the Forestry kit instead to save an extra inventory slot.

Felling axe handle.title: Felling axe handle
Felling axe handle.intro: The felling axe handle is an item used in the process of creating felling axes . Using the handle on any regular axe within a 3x3 area of an anvil, including through walls, with a hammer in the inventory will irreversibly turn it into a felling axe. The felling axe handle is available from the Forestry Shop for 10,000 anima-infused bark and 500 noted oak logs . These logs can be bought on the Grand Exchange for 20,000 . While

Pheasant hat.title: Pheasant hat
Pheasant hat.intro: The pheasant hat is a piece of the pheasant costume , obtained by using a needle and thread on 15 pheasant tail feathers , which are a possible reward as part of the Pheasant Control Forestry event .

Pheasant legs.title: Pheasant legs
Pheasant legs.intro: The pheasant legs are a piece of the pheasant costume , obtained by using a needle and thread on 15 pheasant tail feathers , which are a possible reward as part of the Pheasant Control Forestry event .

Pheasant boots.title: Pheasant boots
Pheasant boots.intro: The pheasant boots are a piece of the pheasant costume , obtained by using a needle and thread on 15 pheasant tail feathers , which are a possible reward as part of the Pheasant Control Forestry event .

Pheasant cape.title: Pheasant cape
Pheasant cape.intro: The pheasant cape is a piece of the pheasant costume , obtained by using a needle and thread on 15 pheasant tail feathers , which are a possible reward as part of the Pheasant Control Forestry event .

Petal garland.title: Petal garland
Petal garland.intro: The Petal garland is a purely cosmetic neck slot item that can be obtained as a possible reward from the Enchantment Ritual Forestry event . Note that the petal garland cannot be stored in a player-owned house .

Sturdy beehive parts.title: Sturdy beehive parts
Sturdy beehive parts.intro: Sturdy beehive parts is an item that can be obtained as a reward from the Beehive Forestry event . Ten beehive parts are required to build a beehive in the garden and formal garden in a player-owned house .

Scribbled note.title: Scribbled note
Scribbled note.intro: The scribbled note can be found by inserting 100 numulites into one of the stone chests inside the House on the Hill on Fossil Island . There is a chance nothing will happen or a spike shooting out and stabbing the player for 9 damage, wasting the numulites.

Partial note.title: Partial note
Partial note.intro: The partial note can be found by inserting 100 numulites into one of the stone chests inside the House on the Hill on Fossil Island . There is a chance nothing will happen or a spike shooting out and stabbing the player for 9 damage, wasting the numulites.

Ancient note.title: Ancient note

Zenyte shard.title: Zenyte shard
Zenyte shard.intro: The zenyte shard is a rare drop received from tortured and demonic gorillas in the Crash Site Cavern , which can be accessed after completion of Monkey Madness II .

Heavy frame.title: Heavy frame
Heavy frame.intro: A heavy frame is a rare drop from demonic gorillas and tortured gorillas , which can be fought after the Monkey Madness II quest in the Crash Site Cavern .

Light frame.title: Light frame
Light frame.intro: A light frame is a rare drop from demonic gorillas and tortured gorillas , which can be fought after the Monkey Madness II quest in the Crash Site Cavern .

Ballista limbs.title: Ballista limbs
Ballista limbs.intro: Ballista limbs are a component in making heavy or light ballistae . It is dropped by demonic gorillas and tortured gorillas in the Crash Site Cavern .

Monkey tail.title: Monkey tail
Monkey tail.intro: Monkey tails are used to create heavy and light ballistae . They are dropped by demonic gorillas and tortured gorillas in the Crash Site Cavern . They can also be received as a very rare drop (1 in 5,000) from hunting maniacal monkeys with a deadfall trap in Kruk's Dungeon , prompting the message You've caught a monkey's tail. Other than the missing monkey, it's in perfect condition!

Ballista spring.title: Ballista spring
Ballista spring.intro: Ballista springs are a component in making heavy or light ballistae . It is dropped by demonic gorillas and tortured gorillas in the Crash Site Cavern .

Hunter Guild.title: Hunter Guild
Hunter Guild.intro: The Hunter Guild is a members -only guild located within the north-western part of the Avium Savannah , just outside Civitas illa Fortis . To access the guild's amenities, a minimum Hunter level of 46 (not boostable) is required.

Huntsman's kit.title: Huntsman's kit
Huntsman's kit.intro: The huntsman's kit can be obtained from hunters' loot sacks , which are received as rewards upon completing Hunters' Rumours . The huntsman's kit can be used to store various hunting equipment, though they cannot be used whilst stored.

Guild hunter headwear.title: Guild hunter headwear
Guild hunter headwear.intro: The guild hunter headwear is a piece of the guild hunter outfit that can be looted from hunters' loot sacks , which are obtained upon completing Hunters' Rumours .

Guild hunter top.title: Guild hunter top
Guild hunter top.intro: The guild hunter top is a piece of the guild hunter outfit that can be looted from hunters' loot sacks , which are obtained upon completing Hunters' Rumours .

Guild hunter legs.title: Guild hunter legs
Guild hunter legs.intro: The guild hunter legs are a piece of the guild hunter outfit that can be looted from hunters' loot sacks , which are obtained upon completing Hunters' Rumours .

Lost Schematics.title: Lost schematics
Lost Schematics.intro: Lost schematics are unique items that unlock recipes for high-level shipbuilding parts, for use in the Sailing skill. There are a total of 12 schematics, 10 of which have lockboxes that contain them, and 10 corresponding small keys that unlock them. The other two are the ballistic attractor schematic (given by Ava after the completion of Animal Magnetism and Pandemonium quests) and the bosun's workbench schematic (given upon c

rows.text: Completion of Animal Magnetism and Pandemonium

Guild hunter boots.title: Guild hunter boots
Guild hunter boots.intro: The guild hunter boots are a piece of the guild hunter outfit that can be looted from hunters' loot sacks , which are obtained upon completing Hunters' Rumours .

Salvaging station schematic.title: Salvaging station schematic
Salvaging station schematic.intro: The salvaging station schematic is a lost schematic that must be read in order to unlock the ability to build a salvaging station for a boat .

Gale catcher schematic.title: Gale catcher schematic
Gale catcher schematic.intro: The gale catcher schematic is a lost schematic that must be read in order to unlock the ability to build a gale catcher for a boat .

Eternal brazier schematic.title: Eternal brazier schematic
Eternal brazier schematic.intro: The eternal brazier schematic is a lost schematic that must be read in order to unlock the ability to build an eternal brazier for a boat , which is required to navigate the Northern Ocean .

Rosewood cargo hold schematic.title: Rosewood cargo hold schematic
Rosewood cargo hold schematic.intro: The rosewood cargo hold schematic is a lost schematic that must be read in order to unlock the ability to build a rosewood cargo hold for a boat .

Rosewood hull schematic.title: Rosewood hull schematic
Rosewood hull schematic.intro: The rosewood hull schematic is a lost schematic that must be read in order to unlock the ability to build a rosewood hull for a boat .

Rosewood & cotton sails schematic.title: Rosewood & cotton sails schematic
Rosewood & cotton sails schematic.intro: The rosewood & cotton sails schematic is a lost schematic that must be read in order to unlock the ability to build a rosewood mast and cotton sails for a boat .

Dragon helm schematic.title: Dragon helm schematic
Dragon helm schematic.intro: The dragon helm schematic is a lost schematic that must be read in order to unlock the ability to build a dragon helm for a boat .

Dragon keel schematic.title: Dragon keel schematic
Dragon keel schematic.intro: The dragon keel schematic is a lost schematic that must be read in order to unlock the ability to build a dragon keel for a boat .

Dragon salvaging hook schematic.title: Dragon salvaging hook schematic
Dragon salvaging hook schematic.intro: The dragon salvaging hook schematic is a lost schematic that must be read in order to unlock the ability to build a dragon salvaging hook for a boat .

Dragon cannon schematic.title: Dragon cannon schematic
Dragon cannon schematic.intro: The dragon cannon schematic is a lost schematic that must be read in order to unlock the ability to build a dragon cannon for a boat .

Ballistic attractor schematic.title: Ballistic attractor schematic
Ballistic attractor schematic.intro: The ballistic attractor schematic is a lost schematic that must be read in order to unlock the ability to build a ballistic attractor for a boat , which recovers 60% of cannonballs fired.

Bosun's workbench schematic.title: Bosun's workbench schematic
Bosun's workbench schematic.intro: Bosun's workbench schematic is a lost schematic and a quest reward from The Red Reef . Reading it permanently unlocks the ability to construct Bosun's workbench , a facility on players' boats that allows crewmates to automatically make repairs.

Karamjan monkey.title: Karamjan monkey (item)
Karamjan monkey.intro: The Karamjan monkey is an item obtained by selecting the "Transform" option upon right-clicking a Monkey . It resembles the monkeys found on Karamja .

Kruk jr.title: Kruk jr
Kruk jr.intro: Kruk jr is an item obtained by selecting the "Transform" option upon right-clicking a Monkey .

Maniacal monkey.title: Maniacal monkey
Maniacal monkey.intro: Maniacal monkeys are located in Kruk's Dungeon which the player visits during Monkey Madness II .

Princely monkey.title: Princely monkey
Princely monkey.intro: The Princely monkey is an item obtained by selecting the "Transform" option upon right-clicking a Monkey .

Skeleton monkey.title: Skeleton (Ape Atoll)
Skeleton monkey.intro: Skeletons are undead gorillas found in the multi-combat Ape Atoll Dungeon . Players are required to run past them during the Monkey Madness I quest in order to reach Zooknock . Players are advised to use Protect from Melee against these monsters, as they attack accurately and can easily overwhelm with their sheer numbers. They are aggressive to all players who are not using a greegree to turn themselves into a monkey.

Zombie monkey.title: Monkey Zombie
Zombie monkey.intro: Monkey Zombies are encountered during Monkey Madness I in the Ape Atoll Dungeon and Temple of Marimbo Dungeon . They drop monkey bones that are needed to make a zombie greegree . They appear to be green undead monkeys.

Motherlode Mine.title: Motherlode Mine
Motherlode Mine.intro: The Motherlode Mine is a low-intensity members-only Mining training area located in the Dwarven Mine . The activity involves mining ore veins for pay-dirt , depositing that pay-dirt into a hopper to clean it, then collecting ores and golden nuggets after it's been cleaned. The mine can be accessed at any level, but 30 Mining (not boostable ) is required to mine there.

Coal bag.title: Coal bag
Coal bag.intro: The coal bag is a reward purchasable from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop for 100 golden nuggets . The coal bag holds up to 27 pieces of coal (36 if a Smithing cape is equipped). When smelting or superheating , coal in the bag will be used after the coal in the inventory . It is refillable just like essence pouches , though unlike an essence pouch, it does not degrade . This is useful for both mining and smithing as it effectiv

Gem bag.title: Gem bag
Gem bag.intro: The gem bag is a gem container purchasable from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop for 100 golden nuggets . It can hold 60 of each (300 total) uncut gems of the following types:

My Notes.title: My notes
My Notes.intro: My notes is a book given during the Barbarian Training miniquest by Otto Godblessed . It records entries from ancient pages which are sometimes obtained when rummaging barbarian skeletons or as monster drops in the Ancient Cavern . It can be stored in the bookcase of a Player-owned house , where it is called "Records from my discoveries beneath the lake".

Ancient page.title: Ancient page
Ancient page.intro: Ancient pages are pages found within the Ancient Cavern that can be added to My notes . This can be done even without the book in the player's inventory by using the 'Copy to log' action on the page. Ancient pages are lost on death and cannot be recovered from a gravestone.

Ocean Encounters.title: Ocean encounters
Ocean Encounters.intro: Ocean encounters are events that appear randomly while Sailing , offering small rewards and Sailing experience. When a boat is moving, a 120 tick (72 second) timer counts down, and when it hits zero, an event has a 1/6 chance to spawn. If an event doesn't spawn, the chance increases to 2/6 after the next interval, then 3/6 after the third, and so on until an event is guaranteed after six intervals lapse. Events spawn ahead of

rows.text: When sailing into the strong winds, a player can trim their sails repeatedly for additional speed and experience.
Sailing over the mysterious glows will spawn a new mysterious glow a few tiles away, giving increasingly more Sailing experience and rewarding an uncut gem after the final glow.
Arrows Construction supplies Farming seeds Potions Treated animal hides Melee weapons Metals Runes
Lost crates can occasionally be found floating in the water and can be collected. There are multiple tiers of crates, scaling with the player's Sailing level, with increasingly valuable loot.

5x the player's Sailing level as experience upon pick up. 10x the player's Sailing level as experience when the castaway is brought to a dock for a total of 15x. 15x the player's Sailing level as experience when the dog is brought to a dock for a total of 20x.
Castaways can be retrieved, then dropped off at a gangplank or mooring point for an experience reward.
A giant clam can be fed an item, then the next time it is encountered it will have polished that item into a pearl that can be harvested.
Retrieving clue turtles will give a player a clue scroll or scroll box , as long as they have not reached their clue limit for that tier.
When spoken to, Ocean Man will give the player a cocktail .
One roll of the reward casket of the respective tier
Lost caskets can be retrieved that give a single roll of the reward casket of the respective tier.

Tiny pearl.title: Tiny pearl
Tiny pearl.intro: A tiny pearl is an item received from a giant clam after having given it an item whose High Level Alchemy value is up to 199 in a previous encounter with it.

Small pearl.title: Small pearl
Small pearl.intro: A small pearl is an item received from a giant clam after having given it an item whose High Level Alchemy value is 200-999 in a previous encounter with it.

Shiny pearl.title: Shiny pearl
Shiny pearl.intro: A shiny pearl is an item received from a giant clam after having given it an item whose High Level Alchemy value is 1,000-1,999 in a previous encounter with it.

Bright pearl.title: Bright pearl
Bright pearl.intro: A bright pearl is an item received from a giant clam after having given it an item whose High Level Alchemy value is 2,000-4,999 in a previous encounter with it.

Big pearl.title: Big pearl
Big pearl.intro: A big pearl is an item received from a giant clam after having given it an item whose High Level Alchemy value is 5,000-9,999 in a previous encounter with it.

Huge pearl.title: Huge pearl
Huge pearl.intro: A huge pearl is an item received from a giant clam after having given it an item whose High Level Alchemy value is 10,000-19,999 in a previous encounter with it.

Enormous pearl.title: Enormous pearl
Enormous pearl.intro: An enormous pearl is an item received from a giant clam after having given it an item whose High Level Alchemy value is 20,000-49,999 in a previous encounter with it.

Shimmering pearl.title: Shimmering pearl
Shimmering pearl.intro: A shimmering pearl is an item received from a giant clam after having given it an item whose High Level Alchemy value is 50,000-99,999 in a previous encounter with it.

Glistening pearl.title: Glistening pearl
Glistening pearl.intro: A glistening pearl is an item received from a giant clam after having given it an item whose High Level Alchemy value is 100,000-199,999 in a previous encounter with it.

Brilliant pearl.title: Brilliant pearl
Brilliant pearl.intro: A brilliant pearl is an item received from a giant clam after having given it an item whose High Level Alchemy value is 200,000-499,999 in a previous encounter with it.

Radiant pearl.title: Radiant pearl
Radiant pearl.intro: A radiant pearl is an item received from a giant clam after having given it an item whose High Level Alchemy value is at least 500,000 in a previous encounter with it.

Random Events.title: Random events
Random Events.intro: Random events , anti-macro events, or simply randoms refers to a variety of NPCs and their associated areas that appear throughout Gielinor to interact with players . They will appear either to provide an item to a player or to ask the player to play a short minigame to earn a prize. When random events appear, they specify one player with whom they will interact, and only that player will be able to interact with them, besides

Camo top.title: Camo top
Camo top.intro: The Camo top is a possible reward item from the Drill Demon random event .

Camo bottoms.title: Camo bottoms
Camo bottoms.intro: This item can be stored in the fancy dress box of a costume room , as part of the Camo Outfit set. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored.

Lederhosen top.title: Lederhosen top
Lederhosen top.intro: Lederhosen top is a clothing item received as a random reward from the Freaky Forester random event, and is a part of the Lederhosen outfit . Like other random event rewards, the top gives no bonuses and simply serves as a cosmetic item.

Lederhosen shorts.title: Lederhosen shorts
Lederhosen shorts.intro: Lederhosen shorts are cosmetic clothing received as a random reward from the Freaky Forester random event. They are part of the lederhosen outfit .

Camo helmet.title: Camo helmet
Camo helmet.intro: The camo helmet is a possible reward from the Drill Demon random event .

Lederhosen hat.title: Lederhosen hat
Lederhosen hat.intro: The lederhosen hat is a clothing item received as a reward from the Freaky Forester random event , and is a part of the Lederhosen outfit . Like all other random event reward apparel, the hat gives no bonuses and simply serves as a cosmetic item.

Zombie shirt.title: Zombie shirt
Zombie shirt.intro: A zombie shirt is a possible reward from the Gravedigger random event and is part of the Zombie outfit . The shirt offers no stat bonuses and is purely cosmetic.

Zombie trousers.title: Zombie trousers
Zombie trousers.intro: Zombie trousers is a possible reward from the Gravedigger random event and is part of the Zombie outfit . It gives no stat bonuses and is purely cosmetic.

Zombie mask.title: Zombie mask
Zombie mask.intro: A zombie mask is a possible reward from the Gravedigger random event and is part of the Zombie outfit . It offers no stat bonuses and is purely cosmetic.

Zombie gloves.title: Zombie gloves
Zombie gloves.intro: Zombie gloves are a possible reward from the Gravedigger random event and are part of the Zombie outfit . They give no stat bonuses and are purely cosmetic.

Zombie boots.title: Zombie boots
Zombie boots.intro: Zombie boots are a possible reward from the Gravedigger random event and are part of the Zombie outfit . They give no stat bonuses and are purely cosmetic.

Mime mask.title: Mime mask
Mime mask.intro: Mime mask is a head item gained from the Mime random event and is part of the mime outfit . It gives no bonuses apart from its cosmetic appeal.

Mime top.title: Mime top
Mime top.intro: Mime top is a reward from the Mime random event and is part of the mime outfit . It gives no bonuses apart from its cosmetic appeal.

Mime legs.title: Mime legs
Mime legs.intro: Mime legs is an item gained from the Mime random event and is part of the mime outfit . It gives no bonuses apart from its cosmetic appeal.

Mime gloves.title: Mime gloves
Mime gloves.intro: Mime gloves are an item gained from the Mime random event and are part of the mime outfit . They give no bonuses apart from their cosmetic appeal.

Mime boots.title: Mime boots
Mime boots.intro: Mime boots are an item gained from the Mime random event and are part of the mime outfit . They give no bonuses apart from their cosmetic appeal.

Frog token.title: Frog token
Frog token.intro: A Frog token is a reward from the Kiss the frog random event . These tokens can be given to Thessalia in Varrock in exchange for parts of the royal frog costume or a lamp .

Stale baguette.title: Stale baguette
Stale baguette.intro: The stale baguette is a rare reward from random events . It shares the same stat bonuses with all the other fun weapons . This item can be stored in the fancy dress box of a costume room .

Beekeeper's hat.title: Beekeeper's hat
Beekeeper's hat.intro: Beekeeper's hat is an item gained from the Beekeeper random event and are part of the beekeeper's outfit . They give no bonuses apart from their cosmetic appeal.

Beekeeper's top.title: Beekeeper's top
Beekeeper's top.intro: Beekeeper's top is an item gained from the Beekeeper random event and are part of the beekeeper's outfit . They give no bonuses apart from their cosmetic appeal.

Beekeeper's legs.title: Beekeeper's legs
Beekeeper's legs.intro: Beekeeper's legs are an item gained from the Beekeeper random event and are part of the beekeeper's outfit . They give no bonuses apart from their cosmetic appeal.

Beekeeper's gloves.title: Beekeeper's gloves
Beekeeper's gloves.intro: Beekeeper's gloves are an item gained from the Beekeeper random event and are part of the beekeeper's outfit . They give no bonuses apart from their cosmetic appeal. They are also not able to be worn to pick nettles .

Beekeeper's boots.title: Beekeeper's boots
Beekeeper's boots.intro: Beekeeper's boots are an item gained from the Beekeeper random event and are part of the beekeeper's outfit . They give no bonuses apart from their cosmetic appeal.

Revenants.title: Revenants
Revenants.intro: Revenants are the ghostly versions of creatures slain during the God Wars found in the Revenant Caves within the Wilderness in levels 19 to 40. They are capable of hitting high and accurately for their combat levels , although most of the damage can be mitigated with a charged bracelet of ethereum . As the Revenant Caves location is members-only, all revenants are members-only creatures.

Viggora's chainmace (u).title: Viggora's chainmace
Viggora's chainmace (u).intro: Viggora's chainmace is a one-handed spiked weapon that can be received as a drop from revenants found within the Revenant Caves . It was once owned by Viggora , the only human among the generals of Zaros during the Second Age . After his death, it was claimed by a follower of Zamorak, and was extensively used during the God Wars . This item counts as a Zamorakian item in the God Wars Dungeon .

Craw's bow (u).title: Craw's bow
Craw's bow (u).intro: Craw's bow is a shortbow once owned by Craw , one of the more formidable followers among Armadyl 's forces during the God Wars . It can be received as a drop from revenants found within the Revenant Caves . This item counts as an Armadyl item in the God Wars Dungeon .

Thammaron's sceptre (u).title: Thammaron's sceptre
Thammaron's sceptre (u).intro: Thammaron's sceptre is a powered staff requiring 60 Magic to wield, available as a drop from revenants . Like most powered staves, it is only tradeable when it is fully uncharged. It was once owned by Thammaron , a Tsutsaroth demon who was one of Zamorak 's most trusted allies during the reign of Zaros , and later one of his key generals during the God Wars . This item counts as a Zamorakian item in the God Wars Dungeon .

Amulet of avarice.title: Amulet of avarice
Amulet of avarice.intro: The amulet of avarice is an amulet that can be received as a drop from revenants found within the Revenant Caves . The amulet has the same combat bonuses as the amulet of glory , but has an additional 20% increase in accuracy and damage when fighting revenants, similar to a Salve amulet . The effects of the amulet do not stack with the Slayer helmet (i) .

Bracelet of ethereum (uncharged).title: Bracelet of ethereum
Bracelet of ethereum (uncharged).intro: The bracelet of ethereum is a unique drop from revenants in the Revenant Caves . When charged, the bracelet becomes untradeable and damage from revenants is reduced by 75%, with 1 charge being consumed per attack. Revenants are also made tolerant when a charged bracelet is worn. Players can charge the bracelet with up to 16,000 revenant ethers . Players can configure the charges while the bracelet is in their bank by right-cli

Ancient crystal.title: Ancient crystal
Ancient crystal.intro: The ancient crystal is a drop obtained from revenants found in the Revenant Caves .

Ancient relic.title: Ancient relic
Ancient relic.intro: The ancient relic is a drop obtained from revenants found in the Revenant Caves .

Ancient effigy.title: Ancient effigy
Ancient effigy.intro: The ancient effigy is a drop obtained from revenants found in the Revenant Caves .

Ancient medallion.title: Ancient medallion
Ancient medallion.intro: The ancient medallion is a drop obtained from revenants found in the Revenant Caves .

Ancient statuette.title: Ancient statuette
Ancient statuette.intro: The ancient statuette is a drop obtained from revenants found in the Revenant Caves .

Ancient totem.title: Ancient totem
Ancient totem.intro: The ancient totem is a drop obtained from revenants found in the Revenant Caves .

Ancient emblem.title: Ancient emblem
Ancient emblem.intro: The ancient emblem is a drop obtained from revenants found in the Revenant Caves .

Revenant cave teleport.title: Revenant cave teleport
Revenant cave teleport.intro: Revenant cave teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that can teleport the player to any of the three Revenant Caves entrances. They can be obtained from defeating revenants or monsters in the Wilderness Slayer Cave .

Revenant ether.title: Revenant ether
Revenant ether.intro: Revenant ether is always dropped by revenants in the Revenant Caves . The bracelet of ethereum has a feature to automatically absorb ether from defeated revenants.

Rooftop Agility.title: Rooftop Agility Courses
Rooftop Agility.intro: The Rooftop Agility Courses are a set of agility courses that were added to Old School RuneScape on 5 December 2013 . They are player-designed content authored by BigRedJapan , who can be seen at most of the courses as an NPC waving to the player as they finish a lap. There are nine courses in total, each requiring 10 more Agility levels than the last, with the exception of the Draynor course which can be run from levels 1-20.

Mark of Grace.title: Mark of Grace
Mark of Grace.intro: Marks of Grace are a currency obtained while training Agility on certain Agility courses . They can be spent at Grace's Graceful Clothing for pieces of the graceful outfit and amylase , which is the secondary ingredient for creating stamina potions . In addition, marks can be exchanged with Osten in Shayzien to recolour pieces of the graceful outfit.

Sailing Miscellaneous.title: Sailing/Collection log
Sailing Miscellaneous.intro: As of 12 September 2026 , there are 80 collection log items directly related to the Sailing skill.

Dragon metal sheet.title: Dragon metal sheet
Dragon metal sheet.intro: Dragon metal sheets are an item used in high-level shipbuilding , with some of the best facilities on a boat requiring multiple sheets to build.

Dragon nails.title: Dragon nails
Dragon nails.intro: Dragon nails are an item used to make various core boat parts , facilities , and rosewood repair kits . They can also be used to construct certain types of wooden furniture (although this is not advised due to their price).

Dragon cannonball.title: Dragon cannonball
Dragon cannonball.intro: Dragon cannonballs are ammunition used for a boat cannon during boat combat . They can only be fired from dragon cannons .

Echo pearl.title: Echo pearl
Echo pearl.intro: An echo pearl is an item dropped by dolphins and orcas . It is used to build a fathom pearl on a boat .

Swift albatross feather.title: Swift albatross feather
Swift albatross feather.intro: Swift albatross feathers are an item obtained from killing albatrosses . Five are used to build a gale catcher on a boat .

Narwhal horn.title: Narwhal horn
Narwhal horn.intro: A narwhal horn is an item obtained from killing narwhals . It can be crafted into a narwhal horn knife with level 51 Crafting and a chisel , granting 73 experience. When carved into a knife, it becomes untradeable.

Ray barbs.title: Ray barbs
Ray barbs.intro: Ray barbs are an uncommon drop from various rays . They are used to build hemp and cotton trawling nets on a boat .

Broken dragon hook.title: Broken dragon hook
Broken dragon hook.intro: A broken dragon hook is an item dropped by great white sharks . It is used to build a dragon salvaging hook on a boat .

Bottled storm.title: Bottled storm
Bottled storm.intro: A bottled storm is an item dropped by armoured and vampyre krakens . It is used to build a greater teleport focus on a boat .

Dragon cannon barrel.title: Dragon cannon barrel
Dragon cannon barrel.intro: A dragon cannon barrel is an item obtained from sorting opulent salvage and killing veiled krakens . It is used to build a dragon cannon on a boat .

Boat bottle (empty).title: Boat bottle
Boat bottle (empty).intro: Boat bottles are a single-use item obtained rarely from sorting low-tier salvage from shipwrecks . It is used to "place" a player's boat into their inventory, allowing them to transport it to another port from land. This is useful for moving boats without a teleport focus built on them.

Facility bottle (empty).title: Facility bottle
Facility bottle (empty).intro: A facility bottle is an item that can store boat facilities in order to move them to a different facility hotspot or a different boat . They can be purchased from Shipwright Seb at the Shipyard , and are dropped rarely from sorting salvage . They can be banked whether they are empty or full.

Sea Treasures.title: Sailing/Collection log
Sea Treasures.intro: As of 12 September 2026 , there are 80 collection log items directly related to the Sailing skill.

Medallion fragment.title: Medallion fragment
Medallion fragment.intro: Medallion fragments are items found on various islands accessed via the Sailing skill through a variety of activities. There are eight of these fragments, which are assembled into the Medallion of the Deep , an item that allows the wielder to breathe underwater. The medallion is also required for a master clue .

rows.text: I am shut firmly within a rusted chest, slowly asphyxiating in solitude while the wind pushes through palm trees and the ocean laps the shores around me.
Potential loot from the rusty chest on Dognose Island

Sailors' amulet (inert).title: Sailors' amulet
Sailors' amulet (inert).intro: The sailors' amulet is an item that can be obtained as loot when sorting through salvage obtained from shipwreck salvaging . The amulet allows the player to teleport to the Pandemonium , Port Roberts , Red Rock , and Deepfin Point . In order to make use of the amulet's destinations, the player must activate their corresponding Sailors' Marker there.

Rusty locket.title: Rusty locket
Rusty locket.intro: A rusty locket is a relic that is obtained at a rate of 1/3,000 whilst sorting small salvage .

Dull knife.title: Dull knife
Dull knife.intro: A dull knife is a relic that is obtained at a rate of 1/3,000 whilst sorting Barracuda salvage .

Mouldy block.title: Mouldy block
Mouldy block.intro: A mouldy block is a relic that is obtained at a rate of 1/3,000 whilst sorting fishy salvage .

Broken compass.title: Broken compass
Broken compass.intro: A broken compass is a relic that is obtained at a rate of 1/3,000 whilst sorting large salvage .

Rusty coin.title: Rusty coin
Rusty coin.intro: A rusty coin is a relic that is obtained at a rate of 1/3,000 whilst sorting plundered salvage .

Broken sextant.title: Broken sextant
Broken sextant.intro: A broken sextant is a relic that is obtained at a rate of 1/3,000 whilst sorting martial salvage .

Mouldy doll.title: Mouldy doll
Mouldy doll.intro: A mouldy doll is a relic that is obtained at a rate of 1/3,000 whilst sorting opulent salvage .

Smashed mirror.title: Smashed mirror
Smashed mirror.intro: A smashed mirror is a relic that is obtained at a rate of 1/3,000 whilst sorting Fremennik salvage .

Shayzien Armour.title: Shayzien armour
Shayzien Armour.intro: Shayzien armour is armour requiring 20 Defence to wear. Each tier grants slightly higher protection against the green acidic attack of Lizardman shamans . In order to obtain Shayzien armour, players must compete in the Shayzien Combat Ring within Shayzien , or create it by Smithing lovakite bars (11 bars for a full set). The collection log slots are filled regardless of how the armour is obtained. There are 5 different tiers o

Shayzien gloves (1).title: Shayzien gloves (1)
Shayzien gloves (1).intro: The Shayzien gloves (1) are gloves that require 20 Defence to equip, and are part of the Shayzien armour (tier 1) set.

Shayzien boots (1).title: Shayzien boots (1)
Shayzien boots (1).intro: The Shayzien boots (1) are boots that require 20 Defence to equip, and are part of the Shayzien armour (tier 1) set.

Shayzien helm (1).title: Shayzien helm (1)
Shayzien helm (1).intro: A Shayzien helm (1) is the Shayzien armour (tier 1) set helmet requiring 20 Defence to equip. To get the armour, players must fight and defeat the tier 1 soldier at the Combat Ring in the Shayzien Encampment . It can also be created at an anvil with 49 Smithing and 2 lovakite bars .

Shayzien greaves (1).title: Shayzien greaves (1)
Shayzien greaves (1).intro: The Shayzien greaves (1) are platelegs that require 20 Defence to equip, and are part of the Shayzien armour (tier 1) set.

Shayzien platebody (1).title: Shayzien platebody (1)
Shayzien platebody (1).intro: The Shayzien platebody (1) is a platebody that requires 20 Defence to equip, and is part of the Shayzien armour (tier 1) set.

Shayzien helm (5).intro: The Shayzien helm (5) is a helmet that requires 20 Defence to equip, and is part of the Shayzien armour (tier 5) set. It is dropped by the tier 5 soldier at the Combat Ring in the Shayzien Encampment . It can also be created at an anvil with 89 Smithing and 2 lovakite bars .

Shayzien greaves (5).intro: The Shayzien greaves (5) are platelegs that require 20 Defence to equip, and are part of the Shayzien armour (tier 5) set.

Shayzien body (5).intro: The Shayzien body (5) is a body that requires 20 Defence to equip, and is part of the Shayzien armour (tier 5) set.

Shooting Stars.title: Shooting Stars
Shooting Stars.intro: Shooting Stars is a Distraction and Diversion activity in which players mine crashed stars for stardust . A star will crash roughly every 90 minutes on each server (with a variation of up to 15 minutes), falling at a random spot selected from a predetermined list. The activity is notable for providing idle Mining training, only requiring input every 7 minutes while mining a star.

Celestial ring (uncharged).title: Celestial ring
Celestial ring (uncharged).intro: The celestial ring is a mining enhancer from the Shooting Stars activity, purchased from Dusuri's Star Shop for 2,000 stardust .

Star fragment.title: Star fragment
Star fragment.intro: Star fragment is an item that allows one piece of the prospector kit to be recoloured to a gold variant . It can be purchased from Dusuri's Star Shop for 3,000 stardust . As it is a one time use per prospector item, a total of 4 are needed to recolour the full set, costing 12,000 stardust. Just like its uncoloured variant, the full set grants 2.5% extra mining experience. As such, these changes are purely cosmetic.

Slayer.title: Slayer
Slayer.intro: Slayer is a skill that allows players to kill monsters that may otherwise be untargetable by players (players would be prompted with a message stating they do not possess the required Slayer level to attack the monster). Players must visit a Slayer Master , who will assign them a task to kill certain monsters based on the player's Combat level . Slayer experience is awarded each time the player kills an assigned monster, and i

rows.text: South-east Burthorpe - Games necklace teleport or Hot-air balloon Turael 's tasks are simple, small, and easy to find. These assignments are excellent for the Slayer with a low combat level, but his assignments yield such low experience that most players find him unsatisfactory. However, Turael is willing to replace an assignment given by another Slayer Master with an easier one, if the task to be replaced wouldn't normally be given by him (for example, he will replace a player's Black demon task but not a Crawling Hand task). This ability results in more players using his services than normally would. If the player has completed While Guthix Sleeps , he is replaced with his sister, Aya .
Draynor Village - Amulet of glory teleport Spria shares nearly the same task list with Turael, though she can also assign sourhogs and cannot reset the player's current task streak.

Edgeville - Amulet of glory teleport Krystilia 's tasks are monsters found within the Wilderness . Only monsters slain within the Wilderness count towards her tasks. She will assign players any task on her list without regard to the player's Combat level. Monsters killed during her tasks have the ability to drop Slayer enchantments and Larran's keys to compensate for this. Assignments from her have a separate task completion counter to standard assignments, so players will have to complete five of her Slayer tasks to begin earning Slayer reward points .

North-east Canifis on the bridge - Ectophial , fairy ring C K S or Kharyrll Teleport (can be via house) Mazchna gives fairly easy tasks too, but sometimes he may give a very small amount of more difficult monsters. Mazchna also has the habit of giving assignments which can be completed very close to him, making it convenient to get new assignments once completed. During While Guthix Sleeps , he is replaced by Achtryn .

Edgeville Dungeon , east of the Wilderness gate - Paddewwa Teleport or Amulet of glory Vannaka is one of the most popular Slayer Masters . His tasks are usually suitable for slayers with medium and even high combat skills. He can also be found on Tutorial Island , where he is the Melee and Ranged combat teacher.
Zanaris Fairy Queen 's court - fairy ring hub Chaeldar is infamous for sometimes handing out dangerous tasks.

Mount Karuulm - fairy ring C I R then run north. Konar quo Maten is the fourth hardest Slayer Master. To receive Slayer tasks from her, a combat level of 75 is required. Unlike other Slayer Masters, her Slayer tasks also include the location in which she asks you to slay. However, she will not assign any tasks in the Wilderness , as Krystilia already does this. Additionally, when on a Slayer task assigned by Konar, all kills on task have a chance of dropping a Brimstone key , which opens the Brimstone chest beside Konar. The chance of getting this drop is scaled by the combat level of the NPC players are fighting, and the key is granted in addition to the primary drop you would receive.

Tree Gnome Stronghold , near the magic trees and the southern bank . Nieve is the third most difficult Slayer Master. If players have completed Monkey Madness II , she is replaced by her little cousin, Steve .

Shilo Village , top floor of the Fishing store - fairy ring C K R , Gnome glider , Karamja gloves 3 or the Shilo Village cart system Duradel is the second most difficult Slayer Master . His assignments are generally high-levelled monsters, both in combat and Slayer levels. He also assigns waterfiends . If the player has completed While Guthix Sleeps , he is replaced with his daughter, Kuradal .

Wyrmscraig Cavern , near the mooring point - Teleport to boat , Slayer ring , Necklace of passage , or Ardeaglais teleport Mortimer is the most difficult Slayer Master . His assignments exclusively focus on monsters with superior variants . Unlike other Slayer Masters, Mortimer offers a choice between multiple task options, initially 2, but increasing to 3 after 50 completed tasks from him. These tasks provide special modifiers , offering certain bonuses. However, his tasks are more expensive to skip, only offer 2 block slots, and cannot be replaced by taking an assignment from Turael . Mortimer's tasks have a separate task completion counter from other Slayer Masters, and only give reward points if a points modifier is chosen.
