Cockatrice head.title: Cockatrice head
Cockatrice head.intro: A cockatrice head is a rare drop from cockatrices and moonlight cockatrices , requiring 25 Slayer to kill. It can be stuffed at the Taxidermist in Canifis by using the item on her and paying 2,000 coins, returning a stuffed cockatrice head . When players take it to her, she will tell players "A cockatrice! Beautiful, isn't it? Look at the plumage!"

Crawling hand.title: Crawling Hand
Crawling hand.intro: Crawling Hands are Slayer monsters that require level 5 Slayer to kill. The Crawling hands are the first Slayer monster a player can defeat upon reaching the required level. They are also one of the creatures that will sometimes "die" in a perfect form allowing you to get it stuffed by a taxidermist and mounted in your player-owned house .

Basilisk head.title: Basilisk head
Basilisk head.intro: A basilisk head is a rare drop from basilisks and basilisk knights , requiring 40 and 60 Slayer to kill respectively. It can be stuffed at the Taxidermist in Canifis by using the item on her and paying 4,000 coins, returning a stuffed basilisk head . When players take it to her, she will tell players "My, he's a scary-looking fellow, isn't it? He'll look good on your wall!"

Kurask head.title: Kurask head
Kurask head.intro: A kurask head is a rare drop from kurasks , requiring 70 Slayer to kill. It can be stuffed at the Taxidermist in Canifis by using the item on her and paying 6,000 coins, returning a stuffed kurask head . When players take it to the taxidermist, she will tell players "A kurask? Splendid! Look at those horns!"

Imbued heart.title: Imbued heart
Imbued heart.intro: The imbued heart is a magic-boosting item dropped by superior slayer monsters , which are rare encounters unlocked after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Eternal gem.title: Eternal gem
Eternal gem.intro: The eternal gem is an upgraded version of the enchanted gem , offering unlimited charges when crafted into a slayer ring . It has no additional benefit in its base form. It is dropped by superior slayer monsters , which are rare encounters unlocked after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Dust battlestaff.title: Dust battlestaff
Dust battlestaff.intro: A dust battlestaff is a dust elemental staff which provides unlimited amounts of air and earth runes as well as the autocast option when equipped. It requires 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield.

Mist battlestaff.title: Mist battlestaff
Mist battlestaff.intro: A mist battlestaff is a mist elemental staff which provides unlimited amounts of air and water runes as well as the autocast option when equipped. It requires 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield.

Granite maul.title: Granite maul
Granite maul.intro: The granite maul is a two-handed melee weapon that requires 50 Strength and Attack to wield. They are dropped by gargoyles (75 Slayer required), which are in the Slayer Tower .

Mudskipper hat.title: Mudskipper hat
Mudskipper hat.intro: The mudskipper hat is an uncommon cosmetic item dropped by Mogres , which require 32 Slayer and completion of the mogre miniquest , or ocean Mogres in order to obtain. It is worn in the head slot and gives no bonuses. They are occasionally worn with flippers , another uncommon item dropped by both types of Mogres .

Flippers.title: Flippers
Flippers.intro: Flippers are an uncommon drop from mogres and sea mogres , which require 32 Slayer to kill. They are worn in the footwear slot and allow players to ' run ' while in the underwater area beneath Fossil Island . Once the player enters the water wearing flippers, the ability to run remains active even if the player switches to other footwear.

Brine sabre.title: Brine sabre
Brine sabre.intro: The brine sabre is a one-handed weapon that requires 40 Attack to wield. It is dropped by brine rats in the small cave accessed during Olaf's Quest . The brine sabre is a slightly better alternative to a rune scimitar , boasting 2 higher strength and slash attack bonuses when compared to the former. However, it is significantly more expensive due to the fact it is only dropped by the rarely-killed brine rat at a low rate.

Leaf-bladed sword.title: Leaf-bladed sword
Leaf-bladed sword.intro: The leaf-bladed sword is one of three melee weapons used to harm turoths and kurasks , along with the leaf-bladed spear and battleaxe .

Necklace of Fangs.title: Necklace of Fangs
Necklace of Fangs.intro: The necklace of fangs is a piece of combat jewellery that gives combat bonuses to Ranged . It is dropped from turoths and spiked turoths .

Leaf-bladed battleaxe.title: Leaf-bladed battleaxe
Leaf-bladed battleaxe.intro: The leaf-bladed battleaxe is a one-handed axe requiring an Attack level of 65 and a Slayer level of 55 to wield. It is one of three melee weapons used to harm turoths and kurasks , the others being the leaf-bladed spear and sword . When fighting these monsters with the battleaxe, it has an added 17.5% damage, stacking with the Slayer helmet .

Black mask (10).title: Black mask
Black mask (10).intro: The black mask is a unique mask worn in the head slot. The mask has the same stats as a black med helm . It provides a player 16.67% Attack and Strength boost against all monsters on the player's current Slayer task . It requires 20 Strength, 10 Defence , and 40 Combat to equip.

Granite longsword.title: Granite longsword
Granite longsword.intro: The granite longsword is the fourth strongest longsword available in Old School RuneScape , and can only be wielded by players who have at least 50 Attack and Strength .

Granite boots.title: Granite boots
Granite boots.intro: Granite boots are boots made out of granite rock. They require level 50 Defence and Strength to equip, offering strength bonus and defensive stats superior to rune boots . Unlike most melee boots, they also provide a Ranged defence bonus.

Granite legs.title: Granite legs
Granite legs.intro: Granite legs are platelegs which require 50 defence and 50 strength to be worn. They can only be obtained by killing Skeletal Wyverns .

Bronze boots.title: Bronze boots
Bronze boots.intro: Bronze boots are members only armour that are worn in the footwear slot . There are no requirements for wearing these boots. To obtain the boots, the player can either get them as an uncommon drop from Cave crawlers , which require Slayer level 10 to kill, or buy them from another player. They have the same stats as Fighting boots and Fancy boots .

Wyvern visage.title: Wyvern visage
Wyvern visage.intro: The wyvern visage is an item obtained as a very rare drop from Fossil Island wyverns found in the Wyvern Cave . Skeletal Wyverns do not drop the wyvern visage; they drop the draconic visage instead.

Iron boots.title: Iron boots
Iron boots.intro: Iron boots are member's only armour pieces that are worn in the footwear slot . There are no requirements for wearing these boots. To obtain Iron boots the player can either obtain them as a drop from Cockatrices and Cave slimes , defeated using the Slayer skill, or from trading with another player.

Steel boots.title: Steel boots
Steel boots.intro: Steel boots are boots made from steel , requiring level 5 Defence to wear. To obtain steel boots, players can either obtain them as a drop from Pyrefiends and Harpie bug swarms , defeated using the Slayer skill, or from trading with another player.

Black boots.title: Black boots
Black boots.intro: Black boots are armour pieces worn in the footwear slot . They require 10 Defence to wear.

Mithril boots.title: Mithril boots
Mithril boots.intro: Mithril boots are members only armour pieces that are worn in the footwear slot . Players need at least 20 Defence to wear these armoured boots.

Adamant boots.title: Adamant boots
Adamant boots.intro: Adamant boots are a pair of boots made of adamantite . The player needs at least 30 Defence to wear these armoured boots. These are the first tier of metal boots to offer a strength bonus. Players without the required Defence level can choose to wear climbing boots instead, which have one more strength bonus, but lower defence bonuses.

Rune boots.title: Rune boots
Rune boots.intro: Rune boots are a pair of boots made of runite . They require a Defence level of 40 to equip. Players without the required Defence level can choose to wear climbing boots instead, which have the same strength bonus but lower defence bonuses.

Dragon boots.title: Dragon boots
Dragon boots.intro: Dragon boots are melee footwear requiring 60 Defence to wear. Like most other dragon items , they cannot be made using the Smithing skill.

Uncharged trident.title: Trident of the Seas
Uncharged trident.intro: The trident of the seas is a one-handed powered staff requiring 75 Magic to wield. Once charged with runes and coins, it can be used to attack with a built-in magic spell regardless of the player’s current spellbook .

Dark bow.title: Dark bow
Dark bow.intro: The dark bow is a two-handed ranged weapon that requires level 60 in Ranged to wield. It can only be obtained as a drop from dark beasts and their superior variant, night beasts . With an attack speed of 9 (5.4 seconds), and 8 on rapid (4.8 seconds), this bow stands out as the slowest weapon in the game. It fires two arrows per attack which roll independent accuracy checks. It has the maximum possible attack range of 10, so th

Dragon sword.title: Dragon sword
Dragon sword.intro: The dragon sword is a one-handed stab weapon obtained as a rare drop from wyrms or lost ironwood crates , and requires 60 Attack to wield. It is the best standard sword , but outclassed by other higher tier stab weapons such as Osmumten's fang and the Zamorakian hasta .

Broken dragon hasta.title: Broken dragon hasta
Broken dragon hasta.intro: A broken dragon hasta is a broken form of the dragon hasta and can be received as loot from the brimstone chest . Players can show the broken dragon hasta to Otto Godblessed for a free repair. Players do not have to learn Barbarian Smithing via the Barbarian Training miniquest to do this. Players do however need to have completed the smithing portion of the miniquest in order to wield the repaired hasta.

Drake's tooth.title: Drake's tooth
Drake's tooth.intro: A drake's tooth is an item obtained from drakes found within the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon . It can be combined with the holy sandals to create devout boots , which require level 60 Prayer to wear and increase the prayer bonus from +3 to +5.

Drake's claw.title: Drake's claw
Drake's claw.intro: A drake's claw is an item obtained from drakes found within the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon . It can be combined with the boots of stone to create the boots of brimstone , which has increased stats and can also protect players from the extremely hot ground within the dungeon.

Mystic hat (light).title: Mystic hat (light)
Mystic hat (light).intro: A mystic hat (light) is a component of the light mystic robes set that is worn in the head slot . The mystic hat requires 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Mystic robe top (light).title: Mystic robe top (light)
Mystic robe top (light).intro: A mystic robe top (light) is magic armour that is part of the Mystic robe set worn in the body slot. It comes in blue, light, dark, and dusk, but all offer the same bonuses. All mystic robe tops require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Mystic robe bottom (light).title: Mystic robe bottom (light)
Mystic robe bottom (light).intro: A mystic robe bottom (light) is magic armour that is part of the mystic robe set worn in the legwear slot. It comes in blue, white, black, and the special enchanted version, but all offer the same bonuses. All mystic robe bottoms require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Mystic gloves (light).title: Mystic gloves (light)
Mystic gloves (light).intro: Mystic gloves (light) are magic armour that is part of the mystic robe set worn in the gloves slot. Mystic gloves come in blue, white and black, but all offer the same bonuses. All mystic gloves require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Mystic boots (light).title: Mystic boots (light)
Mystic boots (light).intro: Mystic boots (light) are a piece of magic armour worn in the feet slot . Like all parts of the mystic robes set , they require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear, and can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house .

Mystic hat (dark).title: Mystic hat (dark)
Mystic hat (dark).intro: A mystic hat (dark) is a component of the dark mystic robes set that is worn in the head slot . It comes in blue, light, and dark. Each may differ in price and aesthetics, but they all offer the same bonuses. The mystic hat require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Mystic robe top (dark).title: Mystic robe top (dark)
Mystic robe top (dark).intro: A mystic robe top (dark) is magic armour that is part of the Mystic robe set worn in the body slot. It comes in blue, light, and dark, but all offer the same bonuses. All mystic robe tops require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Mystic robe bottom (dark).title: Mystic robe bottom (dark)
Mystic robe bottom (dark).intro: A Mystic robe bottom is magic armour that is part of the mystic robe set worn in the legwear slot. All mystic robe bottoms require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear.

Mystic gloves (dark).title: Mystic gloves (dark)
Mystic gloves (dark).intro: Mystic gloves (dark) are magic armour that is part of the mystic robe set worn in the gloves slot. Mystic gloves come in blue, white and black, but all offer the same bonuses. All mystic gloves require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. Dark mystic gloves are rarely dropped by Banshees, which require 15 slayer to kill. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Mystic boots (dark).title: Mystic boots (dark)
Mystic boots (dark).intro: Mystic boots (dark) are an item part of the Mystic robes set worn in the feet slot. They are a type of foot armour for mages. It comes in blue, white and black, but all offer the same bonuses. All mystic items require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. The dark mystic boots can be bought from other players or rarely dropped by Infernal Mages , which require 45 Slayer to kill. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owne

Mystic hat (dusk).title: Mystic hat (dusk)
Mystic hat (dusk).intro: The mystic hat (dusk) is a part of the dusk Mystic robes set worn in the head slot. Mystic hats come in many colours but all share the same bonuses, and all mystic items require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Mystic robe top (dusk).title: Mystic robe top (dusk)
Mystic robe top (dusk).intro: The mystic robe top (dusk) is a part of the dusk Mystic robes set worn in the body slot. Mystic robe tops come in many colours but all share the same bonuses, and all mystic items require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Mystic robe bottom (dusk).title: Mystic robe bottom (dusk)
Mystic robe bottom (dusk).intro: The mystic robe bottom (dusk) is a part of the dusk Mystic robes set worn in the legs slot. Mystic robe bottoms come in many colours but all share the same bonuses, and all mystic items require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Mystic gloves (dusk).title: Mystic gloves (dusk)
Mystic gloves (dusk).intro: Mystic gloves (dusk) are a part of the dusk Mystic robes set worn in the hands slot. Mystic gloves come in many colours but all share the same bonuses, and all mystic items require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Mystic boots (dusk).title: Mystic boots (dusk)
Mystic boots (dusk).intro: Mystic boots (dusk) are a part of the dusk Mystic robes set worn in the feet slot. Mystic boots come in many colours but all share the same bonuses, and all mystic items require 40 Magic and 20 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Basilisk jaw.title: Basilisk jaw
Basilisk jaw.intro: The basilisk jaw is a unique drop from basilisk knights . It can be combined with the helm of Neitiznot , after the completion of The Fremennik Exiles , to create an untradeable Neitiznot faceguard . Doing so requires asking Olaf the Bard for stories about basilisk jaws while having it in their inventory. Completion of The Fremennik Exiles is also required to equip the helmet.

Aquanite tendon.title: Aquanite tendon
Aquanite tendon.intro: An aquanite tendon is an item obtained from aquanites found within the Ynysdail Cavern . Players with level 60 Smithing can create the aquanite hopper by using the tendon on an anvil with a mithril bar and hammer in the inventory, granting 350 experience.

Dagon'hai hat.title: Dagon'hai hat
Dagon'hai hat.intro: The Dagon'hai hat is a piece of magic armour obtained as a rare loot from Larran's big chest . It is part of the Dagon'hai robes set, and requires level 70 Magic and 40 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Dagon'hai robe top.title: Dagon'hai robe top
Dagon'hai robe top.intro: The Dagon'hai robe top is a piece of magic armour obtained as a rare loot from Larran's big chest . It is part of the Dagon'hai robes set, and requires level 70 Magic and 40 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Dagon'hai robe bottom.title: Dagon'hai robe bottom
Dagon'hai robe bottom.intro: The Dagon'hai robe bottom is a piece of magic armour obtained as a rare loot from Larran's big chest . It is part of the Dagon'hai robes set, and requires level 70 Magic and 40 Defence to wear. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Ancient ceremonial mask.title: Ancient ceremonial mask
Ancient ceremonial mask.intro: The ancient ceremonial mask is an item dropped by all NPCs in the Ancient Prison , excluding Nex . Part of the ancient ceremonial robes set, the mask has no requirements to wear. In addition, as a Zarosian item , it will also grant god protection towards Zarosian NPCs in the God Wars Dungeon .

Blood shard.title: Blood shard
Blood shard.intro: The blood shard is a drop from vyrewatch sentinels , venators , and from pickpocketing vampyres in Darkmeyer . The blood shard can be added to an amulet of fury , making it an amulet of blood fury . This amulet has the same stats as a regular amulet of fury, but grants a 20% chance of healing 30% of the damage dealt to a target when using melee , resulting in a 6% lifesteal on average. A blood shard provides the amulet with 10

Ancient ceremonial top.title: Ancient ceremonial top
Ancient ceremonial top.intro: The ancient ceremonial top is an item dropped by all NPCs in the Ancient Prison , excluding Nex . Part of the ancient ceremonial robes set, the top has no requirements to wear. In addition, as a Zarosian item , it will also grant god protection towards Zarosian NPCs in the God Wars Dungeon . It has the same stats as a monk's robe top .

Ancient ceremonial legs.title: Ancient ceremonial legs
Ancient ceremonial legs.intro: The ancient ceremonial legs are an item dropped by all NPCs in the Ancient Prison , excluding Nex . Part of the ancient ceremonial robes set, the legs have no requirements to wear. In addition, as a Zarosian item , it will also grant god protection towards Zarosian NPCs in the God Wars Dungeon . It has the same stats as a monk's robe .

Ancient ceremonial gloves.title: Ancient ceremonial gloves
Ancient ceremonial gloves.intro: The ancient ceremonial gloves are an item dropped by all NPCs in the Ancient Prison , excluding Nex . Part of the ancient ceremonial robes set, the gloves have no requirements to wear. In addition, as a Zarosian item , it will also grant god protection towards Zarosian NPCs in the God Wars Dungeon .

Ancient ceremonial boots.title: Ancient ceremonial boots
Ancient ceremonial boots.intro: The ancient ceremonial boots are an item dropped by all NPCs in the Ancient Prison , excluding Nex . Part of the ancient ceremonial robes set, the boots have no requirements to wear. In addition, as a Zarosian item , it will also grant god protection towards Zarosian NPCs in the God Wars Dungeon .

Warped sceptre (uncharged).title: Warped sceptre
Warped sceptre (uncharged).intro: The warped sceptre is a powered staff requiring 62 Magic to wield, available as a drop from warped terrorbirds or warped tortoises with level 56 Slayer . Like most powered staves, it is only tradeable when it is fully uncharged.

Sulphur blades.title: Sulphur blades
Sulphur blades.intro: Sulphur blades are a two-handed weapon that requires level 55 Attack to wield, obtained as a rare drop from sulphur nagua in Neypotzli . Like their crush and stab equivalents, the glacial temotli and earthbound tecpatl , it performs two independently rolled hits per attack . The maximum damage of each hit is determined by calculating the combined max hit as normal and dividing it by two. If the combined max hit is odd, one max

Teleport anchoring scroll.title: Teleport anchoring scroll
Teleport anchoring scroll.intro: A teleport anchoring scroll is an item obtained as loot from zombie pirates and Zombie Pirate's Lockers . It can be read to become permanently impervious to teleport attacks by elder chaos druids and abyssal demons . This effect will not apply to teleport attacks from the Abyssal Sire , the Confusion attack of the Chaos Elemental , or the Tele Block spell.

Aranea boots.title: Aranea boots
Aranea boots.intro: Aranea boots are a pair of boots dropped by araxytes . With no requirements to wear, they are currently the best-in-slot boots for one-defence pures and zerkers , due to the tribrid stats they have, with a ranged attack bonus between that of mixed hide boots and blessed dragonhide boots , a magic attack bonus equal to infinity boots , and a melee strength bonus equal to dragon boots .

Earthbound tecpatl.title: Earthbound tecpatl
Earthbound tecpatl.intro: Earthbound tecpatl are a two-handed stab sword that require level 55 Attack to wield, obtained as a rare drop from earthen nagua in the Tonali Cavern . Like their crush and slash equivalents, the glacial temotli and sulphur blades , it performs two independently rolled hits per attack . The maximum damage of each hit is determined by calculating the combined max hit as normal and dividing it by two. If the combined max hit is

Antler guard.title: Antler guard
Antler guard.intro: The antler guard is a tribrid shield slot item dropped by mature and elder custodian stalkers .

Alchemist's signet.title: Alchemist's signet
Alchemist's signet.intro: Alchemist's signet is a drop from elder custodian stalkers that can be used to open the chest next to the staircase downstairs in the Alchemical Society 's headquarters, where the Mastering Mixology minigame is played. 60 Herblore is required to gain access to the basement. The chest contains a variety of useful Herblore supplies, including herbs , herb seeds , and secondaries . The signet is consumed once the chest is opened.

Broken antler.title: Broken antler
Broken antler.intro: Broken antlers are obtained as drops from Custodian stalkers within the Stalker Den .

Horn of Plenty (empty).title: Horn of Plenty
Horn of Plenty (empty).intro: The horn of plenty is an off-hand item obtained as a drop from gryphons . Requiring level 50 Hunter to equip, the horn provides a passive invisible +2 boost to the Hunter skill. Upon equipping the horn, the player will blow the horn; this can be repeated by selecting the "Blow" option in the Worn Equipment tab.

Venator tooth.title: Venator tooth
Venator tooth.intro: Venator teeth are an item dropped by venators and the Maggot King . These can be traded in for dragon dart tips at a 1:1 ratio by speaking to the aranei by the aranei shrines in the Apsul or Virer Hunting Grounds , or by choosing their right-click "Trade-teeth" option.

Venator fang.title: Venator fang
Venator fang.intro: Venator fangs are an item dropped by venators and the Maggot King . These can be traded in for dragon arrowtips at a 1:1 ratio by speaking to the aranei by the aranei shrines in the Apsul or Virer Hunting Grounds , or by choosing their right-click "Trade-teeth" option.

Air diamond.title: Air diamond
Air diamond.intro: The air diamond is an elemental gem obtained by killing killerwatts . It is used in the creation of the amulet of air , the air diamond must be used on the Air Altar along with an amulet of magic and 100 air runes .

Water sapphire.title: Water sapphire
Water sapphire.intro: The water sapphire is an elemental gem obtained by killing sea snakes in the Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon . It is used in the creation of the amulet of water , the water sapphire must be used on the Water Altar along with an amulet of magic and 100 water runes .

Earth emerald.title: Earth emerald
Earth emerald.intro: The earth emerald is an elemental gem obtained by killing molanisks . It is used in the creation of the amulet of earth ; the earth emerald must be used on the Earth Altar along with an amulet of magic and 100 earth runes .

Fire ruby.title: Fire ruby
Fire ruby.intro: The fire ruby is an elemental gem obtained by killing infernal mages . It is used in the creation of the amulet of fire ; the fire ruby must be used on the Fire Altar along with an amulet of magic and 100 fire runes .

Tormented Demons.title: Tormented Demon
Tormented Demons.intro: Tormented Demons are extremely powerful demons bound into a state of perpetual agony, healing their bodies as they burn, summoned by the Mahjarrat Lucien after he teleports away the Stone of Jas during While Guthix Sleeps . They can be found throughout the Ancient Guthixian Temple after completion of the quest.

Tormented synapse.title: Tormented synapse
Tormented synapse.intro: The tormented synapse is an item obtained as a rare drop from tormented demons , found in the Ancient Guthix Temple after completion of While Guthix Sleeps .

Burning claw.title: Burning claw
Burning claw.intro: A burning claw is an item rarely dropped by Tormented Demons . Two are used on each other in order to create the burning claws .

Guthixian temple teleport.title: Guthixian temple teleport
Guthixian temple teleport.intro: Guthixian temple teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the entrance of the Ancient Guthixian Temple . They can be obtained as a drop from Tormented Demons . They can be stored in the master scroll book .

TzHaar.title: TzHaar
TzHaar.intro: The TzHaar ( Jagex : / z ɑːr / ZAR ) are a race of golem-like creatures that inhabit the city of Mor Ul Rek , a lava-filled region beneath the Karamja Volcano . The word "TzHaar" means "holy (sacred) fire".

Obsidian cape.title: Obsidian cape
Obsidian cape.intro: The obsidian cape is a piece of the Obsidian armour . Due to its lack of requirements and high defensive bonuses, it is a popular choice for players who lack a fire cape or a Cape of Accomplishment . It is one of few capes to count as warm clothing at the Wintertodt , although for this purpose some players may instead opt for the free, easily obtainable clue hunter cloak .

Toktz-ket-xil.title: Toktz-ket-xil
Toktz-ket-xil.intro: The toktz-ket-xil is an obsidian shield requiring 60 Defence to wield. Its defensive stats are equal to a granite shield 's stats with an additional +5 Strength bonus; it also weighs less. It has lower Melee defence bonuses than a rune kiteshield , but higher Ranged defence. Compared to the rune defender , it has the same strength bonus but swaps Melee accuracy bonuses for higher defensive bonuses.

Tzhaar-ket-om.title: Tzhaar-ket-om
Tzhaar-ket-om.intro: The Tzhaar-ket-om , also known as the obsidian maul , is a two-handed blunt weapon that requires a Strength level of 60 to wield. It is affected by the Berserker necklace , receiving a 20% damage increase when the necklace is worn. It is also affected by the Obsidian armour ( helmet , platebody and platelegs ) which will increase the melee attack and melee strength by 10%. These damage bonuses do stack with each other. It is p

Toktz-xil-ak.title: Toktz-xil-ak
Toktz-xil-ak.intro: The toktz-xil-ak , also known as the obsidian splitsword or obby sword , is a one-handed stab sword requiring an Attack level of 60 to wield. It has stats similar to a rune longsword but with a faster attack speed of 4 ticks . It is part of the set of obsidian weapons .

Toktz-xil-ek.title: Toktz-xil-ek
Toktz-xil-ek.intro: The toktz-xil-ek (also known as the obsidian knife or obsidian dagger ) is a one-handed slash sword that requires 60 Attack to wield. Despite often being referred to as a dagger , the toktz-xil-ek is not a stab sword , has no magic attack bonus , and cannot be poisoned . It is part of the set of obsidian weapons .

Toktz-mej-tal.title: Toktz-mej-tal
Toktz-mej-tal.intro: A toktz-mej-tal (also known as an obsidian staff ) is a two-handed staff wielded by the TzHaar-Mej , and can be obtained as a very rare drop from them. Level 60 Magic and Attack are required to equip it. As well as being able to cast Magic spells , it can be sufficiently used as a melee weapon due to its significant crush and strength bonuses. It is part of the set of obsidian weapons .

Toktz-xil-ul.title: Toktz-xil-ul
Toktz-xil-ul.intro: Toktz-xil-ul , also known as obsidian throwing rings , are a one-handed thrown weapon that require level 60 Ranged . They are quite powerful, having stats equivalent to a magic shortbow in conjunction with rune arrows , making them one of the more powerful thrown weapons. Because of this, and the fact that they can be equipped with a shield , they are seen in PvP scenarios quite often even after the introduction of dragon kniv

Obsidian platebody.title: Obsidian platebody
Obsidian platebody.intro: Obsidian platebody is a piece of the obsidian armour set and can be purchased in TzHaar-Hur-Zal's Equipment Store for 126,000 Tokkul (109,200 with Karamja gloves ). It requires level 60 in Defence to wear.

Obsidian helmet.title: Obsidian helmet
Obsidian helmet.intro: Obsidian helmet is a piece of obsidian armour that can be purchased from TzHaar-Hur-Zal's Equipment Store for 84,480 Tokkul (73,216 with Karamja gloves ). It requires level 60 in Defence to wear.

Obsidian platelegs.title: Obsidian platelegs
Obsidian platelegs.intro: Obsidian platelegs are a piece of the obsidian armour set and can be purchased in TzHaar-Hur-Zal's Equipment Store for 100,500 Tokkul (87,100 with Karamja gloves ). It requires level 60 in Defence to wear.

Dragon warhammer.title: Dragon warhammer
Dragon warhammer.intro: The dragon warhammer is a warhammer that requires 60 Strength to wield and is currently one of the strongest warhammers available (second only to the Statius Warhammer ) in Old School RuneScape . It is obtained as an extremely rare drop from Lizardman shamans .

Miscellaneous.title: Collection log
Miscellaneous.intro: The collection log is a book that players can receive from The Collector near the stairs in the Varrock Museum 's ground floor 1 floor . It records nearly every unique drop the player has obtained from various content in Old School RuneScape . The player does not need to have claimed a collection log for it to start tracking drops.

Big swordfish.title: Big swordfish
Big swordfish.intro: A big swordfish is an abnormally large swordfish caught while fishing for swordfish at any cage/harpoon fishing spot , requiring 50 Fishing to catch (or 70 Fishing and 50 Strength for barehanded fishing ). Players have a 1/2,500 chance to receive a big swordfish in place of a raw swordfish; catching one results in the game message You catch an enormous swordfish! instead of the usual You catch a raw swordfish. If fishing with

rows.text: Boat fishing spot (Piscatoris Fishing Colony) Harpoon

Big shark.title: Big shark
Big shark.intro: A big shark is an abnormally large shark caught while fishing at any harpoon/big net fishing spot , requiring 76 Fishing to catch (or 96 Fishing and 76 Strength for barehanded fishing ). Players have a 1/5,000 chance to receive a big shark in place of a raw shark; catching one results in the game message You catch an enormous shark! instead of the usual You catch a shark! If fishing with a fish barrel , a big shark will be pla

rows.text: Boat fishing spot (big net, harpoon) Harpoon

Big bass.title: Big bass
Big bass.intro: A big bass is an abnormally large bass caught while fishing at any big net/harpoon fishing spot , requiring 46 Fishing to catch. Players have a 1/1,000 to receive a big bass in place of a raw bass; catching one results in the game message You catch an enormous bass! instead of the usual You catch a raw bass. If fishing with a fish barrel , a big bass will be placed into the inventory. Additionally, big bass cannot be cooked.

rows.text: Fishing spot (big net, harpoon) Big net
Boat fishing spot (big net, harpoon) Big net

Giant blue krill.title: Giant blue krill
Giant blue krill.intro: A giant blue krill is an abnormally coloured giant krill caught while rod fishing or trawling at a krill or shimmering shoal . Upon a successful roll for a catch, players or crewmates have a 1/2,000 chance to obtain one from a krill shoal, as well as a 1/1,000 chance to roll a rare fish from a shimmering shoal (then a 45/100 chance to roll the giant blue krill), which comes out to an effective rate of ~1/2,222.22.

Golden haddock.title: Golden haddock
Golden haddock.intro: Golden haddock is an abnormally coloured haddock caught while rod fishing or trawling at a haddock or shimmering shoal . Upon a successful roll for a catch, players or crewmates have a 1/2,000 chance to obtain one from a haddock shoal, as well as a 1/1,000 chance to roll a rare fish from a shimmering shoal (then a 40/100 chance to roll the golden haddock), which comes out to an effective rate of 1/2,500.

Orangefin.title: Orangefin
Orangefin.intro: An orangefin is an abnormally coloured yellowfin caught while rod fishing or trawling at a yellowfin , shimmering , or glistening shoal . Upon a successful roll for a catch, players or crewmates have a 1/4,000 chance to obtain one from a yellowfin shoal, an effective 1/10,000 chance from a shimmering shoal, and an effective ~1/4,444.44 chance from a glistening shoal.

Huge halibut.title: Huge halibut
Huge halibut.intro: A huge halibut is an abnormally large halibut caught while rod fishing or trawling at a halibut , shimmering , or glistening shoal . Upon a successful roll for a catch, players or crewmates have a 1/4,000 chance to obtain one from a halibut shoal, an effective 1/20,000 chance from a shimmering shoal, and an effective 1/5,000 chance from a glistening shoal.

Purplefin.title: Purplefin
Purplefin.intro: A purplefin is an abnormally coloured bluefin caught while rod fishing or trawling at a bluefin , glistening , or vibrant shoal . Upon a successful roll for a catch, players or crewmates have a 1/6,000 chance to obtain one from a bluefin shoal, an effective 1/20,000 chance from a glistening shoal, and an effective 1/6,000 chance from a vibrant shoal.

Swift marlin.title: Swift marlin
Swift marlin.intro: A swift marlin is a rare variant of marlin caught while rod fishing or trawling at a marlin , glistening , or vibrant shoal . Upon a successful roll for a catch, players or crewmates have a 1/6,000 chance to obtain one from a marlin shoal, an effective 1/40,000 chance from a glistening shoal, and an effective 1/6,000 chance from a vibrant shoal.

Long bone.title: Long bone
Long bone.intro: A long bone is a drop from various monsters , typically those that also drop big bones , at a nearly universal rate of 1/400.

Curved bone.title: Curved bone
Curved bone.intro: A curved bone is an item dropped by any monster that drops big bones or giant bones , as well as Venenatis and Sotetseg . Curved bones are dropped at a universal rate of 1/5,012.5.

Ecumenical key.title: Ecumenical key
Ecumenical key.intro: An ecumenical key is an item dropped by all monsters in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon , east of the Forgotten Cemetery , which can be used to instantly access the boss room of any one of the five Godwars bosses ( General Graardor , Kree'arra , Commander Zilyana , K'ril Tsutsaroth , and Nex ) without having to obtain the kill count normally required.

Pharaoh's sceptre (uncharged).title: Pharaoh's sceptre
Pharaoh's sceptre (uncharged).intro: The pharaoh's sceptre is a polestaff found during the Pyramid Plunder minigame in Sophanem , from the golden chests and sarcophagi . It requires 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield.

Dark totem base.title: Dark totem base
Dark totem base.intro: The dark totem base is an item obtained from monsters found within the Catacombs of Kourend (excluding ghosts ). All Superior Slayer monsters encountered in the Catacombs are guaranteed to drop a dark totem piece.

Dark totem middle.title: Dark totem middle
Dark totem middle.intro: The dark totem middle is an item obtained from monsters found within the Catacombs of Kourend (excluding ghosts ). All Superior Slayer monsters encountered in the Catacombs are guaranteed to drop a dark totem piece.

Dark totem top.title: Dark totem top
Dark totem top.intro: The dark totem top is an item obtained from monsters found within the Catacombs of Kourend (excluding ghosts ). All Superior Slayer monsters encountered in the Catacombs are guaranteed to drop a dark totem piece.

Chewed bones.title: Chewed bones
Chewed bones.intro: Chewed bones are obtained exclusively as a drop from mithril dragons in the Ancient Cavern at a rate of 3/128. No other monsters in the Ancient Cavern will drop chewed bones, and looting the skeletons won't give chewed bones either (only mangled bones ). The bones can be burnt on a pyre ship for rewards, including the dragon full helm .

Dragon full helm.title: Dragon full helm
Dragon full helm.intro: The dragon full helm is a helmet that requires 60 Defence to equip. The dragon full helm gives better defence bonuses than its medium helm counterpart. Due to its high price, and lack of prayer or strength bonuses, it is more often used as a sign of wealth, rather than in combat.

Shield left half.title: Shield left half
Shield left half.intro: The shield left half is an item that can be joined with the right half to create the dragon square shield with level 60 Smithing . Joining the right half with the left half nets 75 Smithing experience. The other half of the shield is sold by Siegfried Erkle in the Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items for 750,000 coins.

Dragon metal slice.title: Dragon metal slice
Dragon metal slice.intro: The dragon metal slice is an item dropped exclusively by adamant dragons .

Dragon metal lump.title: Dragon metal lump
Dragon metal lump.intro: Dragon metal lumps are dropped by rune dragons . The lump, along with a dragon metal shard and a dragon chainbody , is used to create a dragon platebody . Doing so requires level 90 in Smithing and grants the player 2,000 experience.

Dragon limbs.title: Dragon limbs
Dragon limbs.intro: Dragon limbs are crossbow limbs made from orikalkum . They cannot be made with Smithing .

Dragon spear.title: Dragon spear
Dragon spear.intro: The dragon spear is a two-handed melee weapon that requires level 60 Attack to wield. It does not require the completion of a quest to equip. Like most spears , it can be poisoned .

Amulet of eternal glory.title: Amulet of eternal glory
Amulet of eternal glory.intro: The amulet of eternal glory is a special dragonstone amulet possessing identical stats and features of a regular amulet of glory , except it has unlimited teleport charges instead of the regular four or six maximum charges. However, it cannot be mounted in a player-owned house .

Shaman mask.title: Shaman mask
Shaman mask.intro: The shaman mask is a rare drop from Ogress Warriors and Shamans in the Corsair Cove Dungeon . It has similar defensive stats to an iron full helm and is tied with the wizard hat as well as blue wizard hat for the highest magic attack bonus in free-to-play .

Evil chicken head.title: Evil chicken head
Evil chicken head.intro: The evil chicken head is an item that can be obtained from offering bird's eggs to the shrine in the Woodcutting Guild . It is part of the evil chicken outfit . There is a 1/300 chance of obtaining a piece of the outfit. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Evil chicken wings.title: Evil chicken wings
Evil chicken wings.intro: Evil chicken wings are an item that can be obtained from offering bird's eggs to the shrine in the Woodcutting Guild . They are part of the evil chicken outfit . There is a 1/300 chance of obtaining a piece of the outfit. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Evil chicken legs.title: Evil chicken legs
Evil chicken legs.intro: Evil chicken legs are an item that can be obtained from offering bird's eggs to the shrine in the Woodcutting Guild . They are part of the evil chicken outfit . There is a 1/300 chance of obtaining a piece of the outfit. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Evil chicken feet.title: Evil chicken feet
Evil chicken feet.intro: Evil chicken feet are an item that can be obtained from offering bird's eggs to the shrine in the Woodcutting Guild . They are part of the evil chicken outfit . There is a 1/300 chance of obtaining a piece of the outfit. It can be stored in a magic wardrobe in a player-owned house.

Mining gloves.title: Mining gloves
Mining gloves.intro: Mining gloves are a pair of gloves purchasable from Belona 's shop, Mining Guild Mineral Exchange , for 40 unidentified minerals . Despite technically only requiring level 20 Mining to equip, level 60 is required to enter the guild to purchase them.

Superior mining gloves.title: Superior mining gloves
Superior mining gloves.intro: Superior mining gloves are a pair of gloves purchasable from Belona 's shop, Mining Guild Mineral Exchange , for 100 unidentified minerals . Despite technically only requiring level 55 Mining to equip, level 60 is required to enter the guild to purchase them.

Expert mining gloves.title: Expert mining gloves
Expert mining gloves.intro: Expert mining gloves are a pair of gloves that can be obtained by asking Belona in the Mining Guild to combine a pair of mining gloves with a pair of superior mining gloves , for a fee of 40 unidentified minerals . They require 70 Mining to wear. Unlike the other pairs of mining gloves, these gloves cannot be sold back to Belona.

Left skull half.title: Left skull half
Left skull half.intro: The left skull half is part of the skull sceptre . The left skull half is used with the right skull half to obtain a strange skull . Doing so will result in a chatbox message stating: "The two halves of the skull fit perfectly, they appear to have a fixing point, perhaps they are to be mounted on something?" It is dropped by ankou on the fourth level of the Stronghold of Security . The left skull half cannot be traded or withd

Right skull half.title: Right skull half
Right skull half.intro: A right skull half is one of 4 parts needed to make a skull sceptre , and can be found by killing a minotaur on the first level of the Stronghold of Security , the Vault of War. These minotaurs can be either low or high level and are not aggressive . It is combined with a left skull half to make a strange skull . Doing so will result in a chatbox message stating: "The two halves of the skull fit perfectly, they appear to have

Top of sceptre.title: Top of sceptre
Top of sceptre.intro: The top of sceptre is a part of the runed sceptre and eventually the skull sceptre . It is dropped by Catablepon on the third level of the Stronghold of Security . Combining it with the bottom of sceptre makes the runed sceptre . Using it with a chisel makes bone fragments , 3 if none of the Varrock Diary is complete and 4, 5, 6, or 7 respectively depending on which tier of the diary is complete. Bone fragments can be added to

Bottom of sceptre.title: Bottom of sceptre
Bottom of sceptre.intro: The bottom of sceptre is a part of the runed sceptre and eventually the skull sceptre . It is dropped by Flesh Crawlers on the second level of the Stronghold of Security . Combining it with the top of sceptre makes the runed sceptre . Using it with a chisel makes bone fragments , 3 if none of the Varrock Diary is complete and 4, 5, 6, or 7 respectively depending which tier of the diary is complete.

Mossy key.title: Mossy key
Mossy key.intro: A mossy key grants players access to Bryophyta 's lair in the moss giant section of the Varrock Sewers and unlocks Bryophyta's chest after defeating her.

Giant key.title: Giant key
Giant key.intro: A giant key grants players access to Obor 's lair in the Hill Giant section of the Edgeville Dungeon . The key is not consumed when unlocking access to Obor's lair for the first time.

Hespori seed.title: Hespori seed
Hespori seed.intro: Hespori seeds are a type of seed requiring level 65 Farming to plant, and that can only be planted in the Hespori patch with a seed dibber in the cave found in the west wing of the Farming Guild . They can be randomly obtained from checking the health of fully grown trees , bushes or cacti , from the last harvest of a regular plant such as herbs , hops , allotments , flowers , mushrooms , cacti , giant seaweed , coral , or fro

Fresh crab claw.title: Fresh crab claw
Fresh crab claw.intro: A fresh crab claw can be crafted into a crab claw with a chisel and 15 Crafting , yielding 32.5 Crafting experience . However, there is a chance of failure so that a broken crab claw is crafted instead, yielding no experience.

Fresh crab shell.title: Fresh crab shell
Fresh crab shell.intro: A fresh crab shell is a common drop from crabs , and can be crafted into a crab helmet with a chisel with level 15 Crafting , but there is a chance that the player will fail and result in a broken crab shell instead, yielding no experience.

Xeric's talisman (inert).title: Xeric's talisman
Xeric's talisman (inert).intro: Xeric's talisman is an amulet that allows players to teleport to locations around Great Kourend . The talisman was invented by Xamphur for Xeric , a tyrannical ruler who reigned over Great Kourend during the Age of Strife .

Mask of Ranul.title: Mask of Ranul
Mask of Ranul.intro: The mask of Ranul is worn by the Undead Druids in the Forthos Dungeon and can be received from them as a drop.

Crystal grail.title: Crystal grail
Crystal grail.intro: The crystal grail is obtained as a drop from killing the powerful rabbit located in the cave in the Gwenith Hunter area north of Prifddinas , requiring completion of Song of the Elves to access.

Enhanced crystal teleport seed.title: Enhanced crystal teleport seed
Enhanced crystal teleport seed.intro: The enhanced crystal teleport seed is a crystal seed that can be used with 100 crystal shards at a singing bowl to create an eternal teleport crystal —which functions as a teleport crystal with unlimited teleport charges.

Elven signet.title: Elven signet
Elven signet.intro: The elven signet is a unique ring obtainable only from crystal implings . When worn, it offers a 10% chance to not use a charge when using crystal equipment , excluding the blade of Saeldor and the bow of Faerdhinen .

Dragonstone full helm.title: Dragonstone full helm
Dragonstone full helm.intro: The dragonstone full helm can be found as a rare reward upon opening the Elven Crystal Chest within Prifddinas . It has the same stats as rune full helm and requires 40 Defence to equip.

Dragonstone platebody.title: Dragonstone platebody
Dragonstone platebody.intro: The dragonstone platebody can be found as a rare reward upon opening the Elven Crystal Chest within Prifddinas . It has the same stats as rune platebody and requires 40 Defence and completion of the Dragon Slayer I quest to equip.

Dragonstone platelegs.title: Dragonstone platelegs
Dragonstone platelegs.intro: The dragonstone platelegs can be found as a rare reward upon opening the Elven Crystal Chest within Prifddinas . It has the same stats as rune platelegs and requires 40 Defence to equip.

Dragonstone gauntlets.title: Dragonstone gauntlets
Dragonstone gauntlets.intro: The dragonstone gauntlets can be found as a rare reward upon opening the Elven Crystal Chest within Prifddinas . They have similar stats to rune gloves , except with negative magic and ranged attack and a half as much strength bonus. Unlike rune gloves , they require 40 Defence to equip.

Dragonstone boots.title: Dragonstone boots
Dragonstone boots.intro: The dragonstone boots can be found as a rare reward upon opening the Elven Crystal Chest within Prifddinas . They require 40 Defence to equip and have the same stats as rune boots .

Merfolk trident.title: Merfolk trident
Merfolk trident.intro: A merfolk trident can be bought from Mairin's Market in the underwater area of Fossil Island for 400 mermaid's tears obtained from Underwater Agility and Thieving .

Orange egg sac.title: Orange egg sac
Orange egg sac.intro: The orange egg sac is an item obtained from looting the Grubby Chest in the south-west corner of the Forthos Dungeon . Using it on Sraracha allows it to metamorphose into the orange-coloured melee-attacking Spawn of Sarachnis .

Blue egg sac.title: Blue egg sac
Blue egg sac.intro: The blue egg sac is an item obtained from looting the Grubby Chest in the south-west corner of the Forthos Dungeon . Using it on Sraracha allows it to metamorphose into the blue-coloured magic-attacking Spawn of Sarachnis .

Broken zombie axe.title: Broken zombie axe
Broken zombie axe.intro: The broken zombie axe is the broken version of the zombie axe . It is dropped by armoured zombies in Zemouregal's Base , and by their higher-level variants in Zemouregal's Fort . Players with 70 Smithing can repair the axe at an anvil with a hammer in the inventory; boosts can be used. Repairing the axe grants the player 500 Smithing experience.

Broken zombie helmet.title: Broken zombie helmet
Broken zombie helmet.intro: The broken zombie helmet is the broken version of the zombie helmet , and is dropped by armoured zombies found within Zemouregal's Fort . Players with 70 Smithing can repair the helmet at an anvil with a hammer in the inventory, or boosted from level 65 with an orange spicy stew . Repairing the helmet grants the player 500 Smithing experience.

Helmet of the moon.title: Helmet of the moon
Helmet of the moon.intro: The helmet of the moon is an item obtainable as a rare drop from the moon chest , requiring a moon key to open. It is identical to the helmet worn by Chosen Aluinus , and wearing it whilst investigating the green campfire at Shipwreck Cove will result in unique dialogue from him.

Squid beak.title: Squid beak
Squid beak.intro: A squid beak is an item that is used to create wooden blowpipes , obtained while cutting raw swordtip and jumbo squids at a rate of 1/1,024 and 1/512 respectively per cutting action.

Jeweller's chisel.title: Jeweller's chisel
Jeweller's chisel.intro: The jeweller's chisel is a reward from golem crafting on the island of Wyrmscraig . It is an improved version of the chisel with passive effects when cutting gems .

Dagannoth Prime.title: Dagannoth Prime
Dagannoth Prime.intro: Dagannoth Prime is the Magic -based Dagannoth King found in the depths of the Waterbirth Island Dungeon , along with fellow Dagannoth Kings, Dagannoth Rex and Dagannoth Supreme . Prime is the only monster to drop the Seers ring and Mud battlestaff . He, along with the other Dagannoth Kings, can also drop the dragon axe .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Dagannoth Rex.title: Dagannoth Rex
Dagannoth Rex.intro: Dagannoth Rex is the Melee -based Dagannoth King found in the depths of the Waterbirth Island Dungeon , along with fellow Dagannoth Kings, Dagannoth Supreme and Dagannoth Prime . Rex is the only monster to drop the Berserker and Warrior rings . He, along with the other Dagannoth Kings, can also drop the rare dragon axe .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Dagannoth Supreme.title: Dagannoth Supreme
Dagannoth Supreme.intro: Dagannoth Supreme is the Ranged -based Dagannoth King found in the depths of the Waterbirth Island Dungeon , along with fellow Dagannoth Kings, Dagannoth Rex and Dagannoth Prime . Supreme is the only monster to drop the archers ring and seercull . He, along with the other Dagannoth Kings, can also drop the dragon axe .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Barbarian Assault/Gambles.title: Barbarian Assault/Gambles
Barbarian Assault/Gambles.intro: Honour points can be spent (referred to in-game as gambles ) at Commander Connad in the Barbarian Outpost for a loot drop and the chance of getting the rare pet Penance Queen . These gambles are known on mobile as lucky dips , and are spent from a single role of the player's choice.

tables.heading: Contents › High Gambles › Tertiary rewards (high gamble only)

Thermonuclear smoke devil.title: Thermonuclear smoke devil
Thermonuclear smoke devil.intro: The thermonuclear smoke devil , often referred to as thermy , is the boss version of the smoke devil . It requires a minimum of 93 Slayer to damage. Located at the Smoke Devil Dungeon south of Castle Wars , the Thermonuclear smoke devil can only be attacked on a smoke devil task, with the exception of one kill for the Western Provinces Diary (provided that the player has 93 Slayer without boosting).

Chompy bird.title: Chompy bird
Chompy bird.intro: Chompy birds are part of the chompy bird hunting activity. They can only be killed after completing the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest . Killing them requires a comp ogre bow or ogre bow with brutal arrows or ogre arrows . They cannot be killed with melee or Magic . Thralls will also not attack them. Bloated toads must be used as bait to lure them to the area. Bloated toads are made by using ogre bellows filled with swamp gas o

Venenatis.title: Venenatis
Venenatis.intro: Venenatis is a large spider that resides in the Silk Chasm , at level 35 Wilderness .

Spindel.title: Spindel
Spindel.intro: Spindel is a weaker variant of Venenatis who is fought in the Web Chasm , a singles-plus combat area in level 29 Wilderness . To enter Spindel's lair, players must have completed the hard Wilderness diary , OR they must have a Venenatis boss Slayer task (a spider Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement).

Callisto.title: Callisto
Callisto.intro: Callisto is an enormous bear empowered by the corruption of the Wilderness that resides in Callisto's Den at level 40 Wilderness and is the one of two monsters to drop the tyrannical ring .

Artio.title: Artio
Artio.intro: Artio is a weaker variant of Callisto who is fought in the Hunter's End , a singles-plus combat area in level 21 Wilderness . To enter Artio's lair, players must have completed the hard Wilderness diary , OR they must have a Callisto boss Slayer task (a bear Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement).

Vet'ion.title: Vet'ion
Vet'ion.intro: Vet'ion (pronounced / ˈ v ɛ t iː ə n / VET -ee-ən ) is a Zamorakian skeletal champion that resides in Vet'ion's Rest , at level 35 Wilderness . Like other bosses in the Wilderness, he can also drop the dragon pickaxe .

Calvar'ion.title: Calvar'ion
Calvar'ion.intro: Calvar'ion is a weaker variant of Vet'ion who is fought in the Skeletal Tomb , a singles-plus combat area in level 21 Wilderness . To enter Calvar'ion's lair, players must have completed the hard Wilderness diary , OR they must have a Vet'ion boss Slayer task (a skeleton Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement).

TzTok-Jad.title: TzTok-Jad
TzTok-Jad.intro: TzTok-Jad (translated as Hard/Rock/Obsidian Fire Elemental ), commonly called Jad for short, is a volcanic creature and the boss of the TzHaar Fight Cave minigame .

Reward Cart.title: Reward Cart
Reward Cart.intro: The reward cart is a cart of "magical mystery rewards" found just outside the Wintertodt Camp bank. After earning at least 500 points during the fight against the Wintertodt , players are able to search the cart for rewards. It can reward many useful items for skilling such as ores, logs, herbs, seeds, gems, and fish. Searching the cart also gives the opportunity for items only obtainable through defeating the Wintertodt, such

Ancient chest.title: Ancient chest
Ancient chest.intro: The ancient chest is found in the Great Olm 's room in the Chambers of Xeric raid, and can be searched for rewards after defeating the Great Olm. If players leave the Chambers without looting the reward chest, any unclaimed regular loot is placed on the ground upon leaving the raid.

TzKal-Zuk.title: TzKal-Zuk
TzKal-Zuk.intro: TzKal-Zuk , often referred to as Zuk , is the last monster encountered in the Inferno . It is currently the fourth strongest monster in Old School RuneScape , and the third strongest monster that must be challenged alone.

Monumental chest.title: Monumental chest
Monumental chest.intro: Monumental chests are large treasure chests found inside Verzik Vitur 's treasure vault, which is accessed after defeating her in the Theatre of Blood . They can be searched for the player's rewards; an arrow above the chest indicates the specific chest for the player to search.

Reward Chest (The Gauntlet).title: Reward Chest (The Gauntlet)
Reward Chest (The Gauntlet).intro: The reward chest can be found in the lobby of The Gauntlet . After attempting The Gauntlet, players can loot the chest to find rewards for their efforts. If your inventory is full when attempting to loot the reward chest, you will receive the chat message: "You need a free inventory space for whatever you may find in the chest." If you have a space free and you receive multiple items, the extra items will be dropped on the gro

Spoils of War.title: Spoils of War
Spoils of War.intro: The spoils of war is a reward from the Soul Wars Minigame . It can be purchased from Nomad on the Isle of Souls for 30 Zeal Tokens .

Reward pool.title: Reward pool
Reward pool.intro: The reward pool is a pool found in the Ruins of Unkah , just outside the bank. After subduing Tempoross , players can fish with a big or small fishing net near the dock to get their rewards, granting 10 Fishing experience per reward. Attempting to fish from the reward pool without a net will cause the nearby Spirit Angler to offer a free small fishing net.

Rewards Guardian.title: Rewards Guardian
Rewards Guardian.intro: The Rewards Guardian is a rift guardian found outside the barrier in the Temple of the Eye . Players can search the guardian's rift to receive their rewards after completing a round of Guardians of the Rift .

Rewards Chest (Fortis Colosseum).title: Rewards Chest (Fortis Colosseum)
Rewards Chest (Fortis Colosseum).intro: A Rewards Chest can be found upon completion of waves during the Fortis Colosseum minigame , containing all accumulated rewards from each wave.

Eldric the Ice King.title: Eldric the Ice King
Eldric the Ice King.intro: Eldric the Ice King is a giant boss, being one of the Royal Titans , along with Branda the Fire Queen . Like Scurrius and Amoxliatl , the Royal Titans are considered an entry-level boss designed for players with 70-90+ combat level, and is meant to introduce the practice of gear switching.

Branda the Fire Queen.title: Branda the Fire Queen
Branda the Fire Queen.intro: Branda the Fire Queen is a giant boss, being one of the Royal Titans , along with Eldric the Ice King . Like Scurrius and Amoxliatl , the Royal Titans are considered an entry-level boss designed for players with 70-90+ combat level, and is meant to introduce the practice of gear switching.

Demonic Brutus.title: Demonic Brutus
Demonic Brutus.intro: Demonic Brutus is the hard mode variant of Brutus that can be fought by having an abyssal potato in the inventory, after which the game will send a prompt asking the player if they would like to feed it to him. Because abyssal potatoes only come from plucking the growth found within the Scar , fighting Demonic Brutus requires completion of Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire .

Mad Angel.title: Mad Angel
Mad Angel.intro: The Mad Angel is a golem boss found in Ardeaglais , a cathedral on the island of Wyrmscraig . A weak version of it is fought during the quest Fallen From Grace , and a stronger, repeatable version becomes available after quest completion.

Herbiboar.title: Herbiboar
Herbiboar.intro: The herbiboar is a creature that players can capture with 80 Hunter and 31 Herblore , granting between 1,950 and 2,461 Hunter experience depending on the player's Hunter level. It can be caught by first tracking down footsteps left across Fossil Island , until reaching a point where the footsteps enter a burrow . Players can then kick the burrow, causing the herbiboar to appear and get stunned just outside the hole. Players ma

Hunters' loot sack (master).title: Hunters' loot sack (master)
Hunters' loot sack (master).intro: Master hunters' loot sacks are a reward for successfully completing master Hunters' Rumours assigned by Guild Hunter Wolf .

Phosani's Nightmare.title: Phosani's Nightmare
Phosani's Nightmare.intro: Phosani's Nightmare is a more difficult version of The Nightmare , encountered by selecting Drink-from on the Pool of Nightmares in the Sisterhood Sanctuary .

tables.heading: Drops › Uniques › Inquisitor's and Nightmare staff table

Hunters' loot sack (expert).title: Hunters' loot sack (expert)
Hunters' loot sack (expert).intro: Expert hunters' loot sacks are a reward for successfully completing expert Hunters' Rumours assigned by Guild Hunter Aco or Teco .

Chest (Tombs of Amascut).title: Chest (Tombs of Amascut)
Chest (Tombs of Amascut).intro: The chest is found in Osmumten 's burial chamber in the Tombs of Amascut raid, and can be searched for rewards after defeating Tumeken's Warden and Elidinis' Warden .

Reward casket (master).title: Reward casket (master)
Reward casket (master).intro: A reward casket (master) is received after completing the final clue of a master clue scroll trail, and contains the final reward for the trail. Opening the reward casket is required for treasure trail completion to be tracked on the HiScores and collection log .

Wyrmscraig Goat.title: Wyrmscraig Goat
Wyrmscraig Goat.intro: The Wyrmscraig goat is a hunter creature found on Wyrmscraig , requiring level 60 Hunter and completion of the Sheep Herder quest to catch. A cattleprod , the Telekinetic Grab spell, or the Dark Lure spell are needed to move them to the goat pit as part of the goat hunting activity.

Abyssal demon.title: Abyssal demon
Abyssal demon.intro: Abyssal demons are one of the strongest types of demons , requiring level 85 Slayer to be damaged. Alongside their boss variant , they are the only creatures in the game to drop the abyssal whip and abyssal dagger . They have relatively high accuracy but their max hit of 8 is low for their combat level.

Greater abyssal demon.title: Greater abyssal demon
Greater abyssal demon.intro: The greater abyssal demon is a superior variant of the abyssal demon . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Hydra.title: Hydra
Hydra.intro: Hydras are draconic creatures found in the lower level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm , requiring level 95 Slayer to kill. They were created by a dragonkin named Karuulm as a project which is not based on any prior work done by his fellow kin.

Colossal Hydra.title: Colossal Hydra
Colossal Hydra.intro: The colossal hydra is a superior variant of the hydra . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Like their standard variant, they will alternate between ranged and magic every three attacks.

Wyrm.title: Wyrm
Wyrm.intro: Wyrms are draconic creatures requiring level 62 Slayer to kill, found in the lower level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm as well as in the Wyrmscraig Cavern after partial completion of Fallen From Grace . Players can travel to Mount Karuulm quickly by using the fairy ring C I R located south of the mountain. Players can also directly teleport to Mount Karuulm with Rada's blessing 3 or 4. Wyrms located in Wyrmscr

Drake.title: Drake
Drake.intro: Drakes are wingless dragons found in the middle level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm , requiring level 84 Slayer to kill. As they are only found within the volcano, players must wear the boots of stone , boots of brimstone , or granite boots to protect themselves from the extreme heat of the dungeon floor. Alternatively, players who have completed the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary have protection from the burn ef

Shadow Wyrm.title: Shadow Wyrm
Shadow Wyrm.intro: The shadow wyrm is a superior variant of the wyrm . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Bag full of gems.title: Bag full of gems
Bag full of gems.intro: A bag full of gems is a bag that contains an assortment of 40 noted uncut gems . These bags are obtainable from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop for 40 golden nuggets , from Belona 's Mining Guild Mineral Exchange for 20 unidentified minerals , or from Dusuri's Star Shop for 300 stardust .

Guardian Drake.title: Guardian Drake
Guardian Drake.intro: The guardian drake is a superior variant of the drake . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Elven Crystal Chest.title: Elven Crystal Chest
Elven Crystal Chest.intro: The Elven Crystal Chest is a chest found in the upper level of the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas . It can be opened with an enhanced crystal key , and gives better average loot than the crystal chest in Taverley .

Rewards possibilities › Possibility 8 - Rune platelegs or plateskirt

Shop Counter (gems).title: Shop Counter (gems)
Shop Counter (gems).intro: The gems shop counter is a unique gem stall found in Mor Ul Rek . The stall is owned by TzHaar-Hur-Rin as part of TzHaar-Hur-Rin's Ore and Gem Store and players can steal from it if they have a Thieving level of 75 or higher. A variety of gems can be stolen and unlike most other gem stalls they have a chance to be cut rather than uncut. There is a respawn time of 105 seconds.

Chest (moon key).title: Chest (moon key)
Chest (moon key).intro: The moon chest can be found in the northern section of the Ruins of Tapoyauik . The chest is locked and can only be opened using a moon key , which is made by combining a loop half of key (moon key) and a tooth half of key (moon key) .

Medium port reward bag.title: Medium port reward bag
Medium port reward bag.intro: Medium port reward bags are possible rewards from completing a courier task . They may contain either loot from a shared drop table, or loot that is unique to the task's destination port . The size of port reward bag given from a task is determined by the Sailing experience awarded for that task; medium bags are given from Courier Tasks giving 1,000–2,499 XP. Several types of medium reward bag are not obtainable, as some ports

Huge port reward bag.title: Huge port reward bag
Huge port reward bag.intro: Huge port reward bags are possible rewards from completing a courier task . They may contain either loot from a shared drop table, or loot that is unique to the task's destination port . The size of port reward bag given from a task is determined by the Sailing experience awarded for that task; huge bags are given from courier Tasks giving 6,000 XP or more.

Large port reward bag.title: Large port reward bag
Large port reward bag.intro: Large port reward bags are possible rewards from completing a courier task . They may contain either loot from a shared drop table, or loot that is unique to the task's destination port . The size of port reward bag given from a task is determined by the Sailing experience awarded for that task; large bags are given from Courier Tasks giving 2,500–5,999 XP.

Tekton.title: Tekton
Tekton.intro: Tekton is one of the bosses encountered in the Chambers of Xeric . He was the artisan that created the chambers.

Frost Nagua.title: Frost Nagua
Frost Nagua.intro: Frost naguas are Slayer monsters that require level 48 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Ruins of Tapoyauik , accessed from the Twilight Temple , after completion of the The Heart of Darkness quest.

Icefiend.title: Icefiend
Icefiend.intro: Icefiends are demons made of ice and freezing rock found on top of the Ice Mountain , in various locations around Varlamore , the southern part of the God Wars Dungeon , and summoned during fights with the Ice demon in the Chambers of Xeric . Killing an icefiend is one of the three options to cool down the Dwarven rock cake in Recipe for Disaster .

Ice warrior.title: Ice warrior
Ice warrior.intro: Ice warriors are mid-level ice elementals. They have a 100% elemental weakness to fire spells . Ice warriors can be assigned by Krystilia for a Wilderness Slayer task , or by Vannaka or Mazchna for normal tasks.

Cave crawler.title: Cave crawler
Cave crawler.intro: Cave crawlers are Slayer monsters that require level 10 Slayer to kill. A form of poison protection is recommended when killing them, as they inflict a strong poison with their barbed tongue. They are the only enemy to drop bronze boots . They also drop a variety of Herblore ingredients, which can be helpful for lower level players looking for an alternative source of herbs over more popular sources, such as chaos druids . Low

Blue dragon.title: Blue dragon
Blue dragon.intro: Blue dragons are the third strongest of the chromatic dragons , behind red dragons and black dragons . Like all dragons, they can breathe dragonfire , which can inflict up to 50 damage if proper protections aren't used. Dragonfire can be mitigated by equipping an anti-dragon shield or a dragonfire shield – alongside the usage of an antifire potion , which will completely negate dragonfire damage. On top of the strong dragonfir

Baby blue dragon.title: Baby blue dragon
Baby blue dragon.intro: Baby blue dragons are the young of adult blue dragons found in Taverley Dungeon , the Isle of Souls Dungeon , the bottom floor of the Ruins of Tapoyauik , and in the basement of the Myths' Guild . Unlike their adult forms, they do not breathe fire.

Ice giant.title: Ice giant
Ice giant.intro: Ice giants are tall, light blue giants that appear at certain icy areas of the game. They are the second strongest giant type out of the standard giants, weaker than Fire giants , but stronger than Moss and Hill giants .

Ice spider.title: Ice spider
Ice spider.intro: Ice spiders are one of the stronger species of spider . They are seldom killed due to having very few drops except when on a Wilderness Slayer task .

Brutal blue dragon.title: Brutal blue dragon
Brutal blue dragon.intro: Brutal blue dragons are a tougher version of blue dragons and can be killed as an alternative for a blue dragon Slayer task . They can be found in the Catacombs of Kourend and Ruins of Tapoyauik .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Frost Crab.title: Frost Crab
Frost Crab.intro: Frost Crabs are aggressive monsters that look like harmless ice blocks while disguised, but attack when walked by. They are found within the Ruins of Tapoyauik in Varlamore .

Chilled jelly.title: Chilled jelly
Chilled jelly.intro: Chilled jellies are stronger variants of jellies that require level 52 Slayer to kill. They also require either completion of The Heart of Darkness or level 87 Sailing to reach, due to their locations: within the Ruins of Tapoyauik and inside the dungeon on Grimstone .

Vitreous Chilled Jelly.title: Vitreous Chilled Jelly
Vitreous Chilled Jelly.intro: The vitreous chilled jelly is a superior variant of chilled jellies . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Araxyte.title: Araxyte
Araxyte.intro: Araxytes are a venomous species of arachnid with seven eyes found exclusively in the Morytania Spider Cave , requiring level 92 Slayer to kill. As they are abundant in numbers, able to inflict venom , and in a multicombat area , it is dangerous to fight them without prayer and a method to stave off venom.

Dreadborn Araxyte.title: Dreadborn Araxyte
Dreadborn Araxyte.intro: The dreadborn araxyte is a superior variant of the araxyte , which can spawn after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Unlike other superior creatures, the dreadborn araxyte can only spawn if the level 146 araxytes are killed.

Chest (Barrows).title: Chest (Barrows)
Chest (Barrows).intro: This chest is located at the centre of the tunnels beneath the crypts of the Barrows brothers . It serves as the rewards chest for the Barrows activity.

Chest (Bryophyta's lair).title: Chest (Bryophyta's lair)
Chest (Bryophyta's lair).intro: The chest is found in Bryophyta 's lair in Varrock Sewers , and can be opened with a mossy key after defeating Bryophyta, once per kill. It is the only source of Bryophyta's essence , a unique material used to create Bryophyta's staff .

Hellhound.title: Hellhound
Hellhound.intro: Hellhounds are demonic dogs that are often given as a Slayer task to mid-to-high level players. Hellhounds are primarily killed for their hard clue scroll drops, as they drop them at a much higher rate compared to most other non-boss/superior monsters. As they are demonic , they are weak to demonbane weapons .
