Level 136 (Wilderness Slayer Cave) drops › Wilderness Slayer Cave tertiary

Starlight.title: Starlight
Starlight.intro: Starlight the unicorn is a bodyguard of Commander Zilyana , along with Growler and Bree . She uses powerful melee attacks to bring down her enemies, which has a max hit of 15. She is the strongest Unicorn in the game.

tables.heading: Drops › Regular drops › Food and ammunition

Bree.title: Bree
Bree.intro: Bree is the centaur bodyguard of Commander Zilyana , commander of Saradomin's Encampment, along with Growler and Starlight . He uses ranged attacks with a max hit of 16 and has a chance to drop the Saradomin sword .

tables.heading: Drops › Regular drops › Food and ammunition

Growler.title: Growler
Growler.intro: Growler is a bodyguard of Commander Zilyana , along with Starlight and Bree . It attacks using an accurate magic attack which has a max hit of 16.

tables.heading: Drops › Regular drops › Food and ammunition

Balfrug Kreeyath.title: Balfrug Kreeyath
Balfrug Kreeyath.intro: Balfrug Kreeyath is a three-faced black demon who destroyed the desert city of Ullek during the God Wars . He is one of K'ril Tsutsaroth 's bodyguards, along with Zakl'n Gritch and Tstanon Karlak . He attacks with Magic by launching huge fireballs at the player and has a maximum hit of 16.

tables.heading: Drops › Regular drops › Runes and ammunition

Sergeant Strongstack.title: Sergeant Strongstack
Sergeant Strongstack.intro: Sergeant Strongstack is one of the three sergeants fighting for General Graardor , along with Sergeant Grimspike and Sergeant Steelwill . Strongstack uses melee attacks and attacks by drifting to each player in the room assuming there is more than one.

tables.heading: Drops › Regular drops › Food and ammunition

Sergeant Steelwill.title: Sergeant Steelwill
Sergeant Steelwill.intro: Sergeant Steelwill is one of the three sergeants found guarding General Graardor in the Bandos section of the God Wars Dungeon , along with Sergeant Strongstack and Sergeant Grimspike . Sergeant Steelwill uses a magic attack with a max hit of up to 15 hitpoints .

tables.heading: Drops › Regular drops › Food and ammunition

Sergeant Grimspike.title: Sergeant Grimspike
Sergeant Grimspike.intro: Sergeant Grimspike is one of three sergeants found guarding General Graardor in the Bandos section of the God Wars Dungeon , alongside Sergeant Strongstack and Sergeant Steelwill . Sergeant Grimspike uses rather accurate ranged attacks with a max hit of 21 Hitpoints .

tables.heading: Drops › Regular drops › Food and ammunition

Flight Kilisa.title: Flight Kilisa
Flight Kilisa.intro: Flight Kilisa is one of the aviansie bodyguards of Kree'arra , along with Wingman Skree and Flockleader Geerin . She uses melee attacks with a max hit of 15 hitpoints .

tables.heading: Drops › Regular drops › Food and ammunition

Wingman Skree.title: Wingman Skree
Wingman Skree.intro: Wingman Skree is one of the aviansie bodyguards of Kree'arra , along with Flight Kilisa and Flockleader Geerin . He uses magic attacks with a max hit of 16 hitpoints . He wears what appears to be a modified set of the Armadyl armour dropped by Kree'arra and his bodyguards.

tables.heading: Drops › Regular drops › Food and ammunition

Flockleader Geerin.title: Flockleader Geerin
Flockleader Geerin.intro: Flockleader Geerin is one of the Aviansie bodyguards of Kree'arra , along with Flight Kilisa and Wingman Skree . She uses Ranged attacks with a max hit of 25 hitpoints . When fighting Kree'arra, it is very unlikely Flockleader Geerin will do any damage at all, as most players use the Protect from Missiles prayer to defend from Kree'arra.

tables.heading: Drops › Regular drops › Food and ammunition

Zakl'n Gritch.title: Zakl'n Gritch
Zakl'n Gritch.intro: Zakl'n Gritch is one of K'ril Tsutsaroth 's bodyguards, along with Balfrug Kreeyath and Tstanon Karlak . Zakl'n Gritch attacks with Ranged by throwing large snowballs and has a maximum hit of 21.

tables.heading: Drops › Regular drops › Runes and ammunition

Tstanon Karlak.title: Tstanon Karlak
Tstanon Karlak.intro: Tstanon Karlak is one of K'ril Tsutsaroth 's bodyguards and can be found in the God Wars Dungeon , along with Zakl'n Gritch and Balfrug Kreeyath . Tstanon attacks with Melee and has a maximum hit of 15. Tstanon is usually not considered a threat compared to K'ril, since most players already have Protect from Melee active while fighting the Zamorak bosses.

tables.heading: Drops › Regular drops › Runes and ammunition

Crazy archaeologist.title: Crazy archaeologist
Crazy archaeologist.intro: Bellock , the crazy archaeologist , is a relatively simple boss that resides in the ruins south of The Forgotten Cemetery within level 23 Wilderness . His special attack mechanic is similar to that of the Deranged archaeologist and the Chaos Fanatic .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Extra supply crate.title: Extra supply crate
Extra supply crate.intro: Extra supply crates are obtained by exchanging certain items to Ignisia . Unlike regular pulls from the reward cart , these typically only come with one roll on the drop table.

Deranged archaeologist.title: Deranged archaeologist
Deranged archaeologist.intro: The Deranged archaeologist is a relatively simple boss that resides at the southern end of the Tar Swamp on Fossil Island . His special attack mechanic is similar to that of the Crazy archaeologist and the Chaos Fanatic .

Infected root.title: Infected root
Infected root.intro: Infected roots can be found at the northern end of the Ruins of Mokhaiotl and cut with 80 Woodcutting , after completion of the The Final Dawn quest.

Fishing spot (The Stranglewood).title: Fishing spot (The Stranglewood)
Fishing spot (The Stranglewood).intro: A fishing spot can be found by a small dock in the south-western area of The Stranglewood . Besides raw pike , the fishing spot can also give a variety of odd items such as newspapers , old boots , acorns , and chromium ingots .

Bandosian guard.title: Bandosian guard
Bandosian guard.intro: Bandosian guards are orks that appear and attack the player when doing coordinate steps of elite clue scrolls . Bandosian guards use only melee attacks, so Protect from Melee will prevent all damage taken from them. Upon killing the guard, players can dig a second time in the correct location in order to receive the next clue.

Armadylean guard.title: Armadylean guard
Armadylean guard.intro: Armadylean guards are aviansie that appear and attack the player when doing coordinate steps of elite clue scrolls . They call out " No warning! Begone! " upon appearing.

Sunlight antelope.title: Sunlight antelope
Sunlight antelope.intro: The sunlight antelope is a creature that players can capture with the Hunter skill at level 72 by using a pitfall trap . They can be found in the Avium Savannah , east of the Locus Oasis . The fairy ring A J P is located west of the hunter spot.

Molanisk.title: Molanisk
Molanisk.intro: Molanisks are Slayer monsters that require level 39 Slayer to kill giving 52 Slayer experience per kill. A Slayer bell is necessary to initiate combat with them. Since they are only found in the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon , completion of Death to the Dorgeshuun is required to fight molanisks and it is advisable to bring a light source . Molanisks do unusually low damage, meaning a player with half-decent armour should easily b

Experiment No.2.title: Experiment No.2
Experiment No.2.intro: Experiment No.2 is found in the manhole near the witch's house during and after the Grim Tales quest.

Elder custodian stalker.title: Elder custodian stalker
Elder custodian stalker.intro: Elder custodian stalkers are Slayer monsters that require level 76 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Stalker Den near Auburnvale . They are an elder version of the strange creature fought during the quest Shadows of Custodia . They drop the unique alchemist's signet as well as the antler guard .

Ancient Custodian.title: Ancient Custodian
Ancient Custodian.intro: The Ancient Custodian is a superior variant of custodian stalkers . It has a chance of spawning upon the death of an elder Custodian stalker after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Mature custodian stalker.title: Mature custodian stalker
Mature custodian stalker.intro: Mature custodian stalkers are slayer monsters that require level 67 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Stalker Den near Auburnvale . They are a Mature version of the stalker creature fought during the quest Shadows of Custodia . They drop the unique Antler Guard , as well as broken antlers and huasca seeds .

Dust devil.title: Dust devil
Dust devil.intro: A dust devil is a Slayer monster that requires level 65 Slayer to kill. They are located in the Smoke Dungeon , the Catacombs of Kourend , and the Wilderness Slayer Cave . A facemask (or a Slayer helmet / Slayer helmet (i) ) must be equipped to fight dust devils effectively. Without a facemask, dust devils will always hit for 16 damage, fully drain the player's Attack , Strength , Ranged , and Magic levels, and drain 50% of th

Smoke devil.title: Smoke devil
Smoke devil.intro: The smoke devil is a stronger variant of the dust devil , and can be found exclusively in the Smoke Devil Dungeon . These require a minimum of 93 Slayer and an active Slayer task to be harmed. A slayer helmet , slayer helmet (i) , or a facemask is required to kill these. This monster, along with its boss variant and superior variant , are the only monsters to drop the occult necklace . However, only the boss variant drops the

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and gem drop table

Choke devil.title: Choke devil
Choke devil.intro: The choke devil is a superior variant of the dust devil . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Like their standard variant, a facemask , Slayer helmet , or Slayer helmet (i) is required to safely engage them, otherwise the player will take rapid damage and have their stats drained.

Nuclear smoke devil.title: Nuclear smoke devil
Nuclear smoke devil.intro: The nuclear smoke devil is a superior variant of the smoke devil . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Mithril dragon.title: Mithril dragon
Mithril dragon.intro: Mithril dragons can be found and fought in the Ancient Cavern . To access the Ancient Cavern, the player needs to start the pyre ship section of the Barbarian Training miniquest . Be wary as these monsters are extremely powerful. Their release broke the King Black Dragon 's long-standing record as being the strongest dragon. They are the only monster from which the dragon full helm can be obtained, either as a very rare drop,

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Skeletal Wyvern.title: Skeletal Wyvern
Skeletal Wyvern.intro: Skeletal wyverns are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 72 in order to be harmed. They are found at the end of the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon . There is a shortcut at the ladder to the Ice Dungeon leading to the skeletal wyverns requiring level 82 Agility (or level 77 Agility with a Summer pie ). Like other wyverns , they require an elemental shield , mind shield , dragonfire shield , dragonfire ward , or ancient wyvern

Steel dragon.title: Steel dragon
Steel dragon.intro: Steel dragons are the third weakest of the six types of metal dragons . Like all metal dragons, they can attack from a distance with dragonfire . Complete protection requires an antifire potion together with either an anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield . Using only one of these forms of protection reduces, but does not prevent, dragonfire damage. The Protect from Magic prayer provides no protection against dragonfire from

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Black dragon.title: Black dragon
Black dragon.intro: Black dragons are the most powerful adult chromatic dragons . As with all adult dragons, protection from dragonfire (such as an anti-dragon shield ) is recommended when fighting them, although like other common chromatic dragons, they only use dragonfire at melee range.

Iron dragon.intro: Iron dragons are the second weakest of the six types of metal dragons . Like all metal dragons, they can attack from a distance with dragonfire . Lava dragon.title: Lava dragon
Lava dragon.intro: Lava dragons are former red dragons that have been transformed after being surrounded by lava for too long. They reside in the Lava Dragon Isle in the Wilderness (between level 36 and 42 Wilderness), and attack with melee as well as with dragonfire . Due to their low Magic level they are particularly weak to Magic, which combined with their weakness to water spells makes water bolt a slow but profitable method of killing them.

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Frost dragon.title: Frost dragon
Frost dragon.intro: Frost dragons are a type of adult dragon located in the dungeon on the island of Grimstone , requiring 87 Sailing to access. A combat level of 85 is required to be assigned them as a slayer task, along with the Sailing requirement to access the island. Once players have moored on the island at least once, it can also be accessed via fairy ring code D L P .

Brutal black dragon.title: Brutal black dragon
Brutal black dragon.intro: Brutal black dragons are slayer monsters found in the Catacombs of Kourend . Requiring level 77 Slayer in order to be damaged, they are a tougher but more rewarding version of black dragons and as such can be killed as an alternative for a black dragon Slayer task .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Brutal red dragon.title: Brutal red dragon
Brutal red dragon.intro: Brutal red dragons are found in the Catacombs of Kourend . They are a tougher version of red dragons and as such can be killed as an alternative for a red dragon Slayer task .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Rune dragon.title: Rune dragon
Rune dragon.intro: Rune dragons are metal dragons first encountered during Dragon Slayer II , in which the player must fight one during Zorgoth 's assault. After completion of the quest , they can be found in the eastern chamber of the Lithkren Vault .

Adamant dragon.title: Adamant dragon
Adamant dragon.intro: Adamant dragons are metal dragons first encountered during Dragon Slayer II , in which the player must fight against one during Zorgoth 's assault. After completion of the quest, they can be found in the western chamber of the Lithkren Vault .

Cave kraken.title: Cave kraken
Cave kraken.intro: Cave kraken are slayer monsters that are found in the Kraken Cove . They can only be attacked if players have them as a Slayer task . To be assigned cave krakens, players require level 87 Slayer and 50 Magic . Along with their boss variant, the Kraken , they are the only monsters to drop the kraken tentacle and the trident of the seas .

Lunar Chest.title: Lunar Chest
Lunar Chest.intro: The Lunar Chest is a chest found in the Ancient Shrine within Neypotzli . It can be opened after defeating at least one of the Moons of Peril , although all Moons must be defeated once in order to unlock the chest for the first time. On average it takes approximately 320 openings in order to receive all uniques.

Spiritual mage.title: Spiritual mage
Spiritual mage.intro: The Spiritual mage is a potent Magic Slayer monster found in the God Wars Dungeon . Like all monsters there, they are aggressive to any players that do not wear items showing loyalty to their god. Spiritual mages require 83 Slayer to kill. Completion of Death Plateau is required before Spiritual creatures can be assigned as a Slayer task . Just like Spiritual rangers and Spiritual warriors , which require 63 and 68 Slayer resp

Spiritual ranger.title: Spiritual ranger
Spiritual ranger.intro: Spiritual rangers are powerful Ranged Slayer monsters found in the God Wars Dungeon . There are five types of spiritual rangers: Saradominists , Zamorakians , Bandosians , Armadyleans , and Zarosians . Spiritual rangers require 63 Slayer to kill, and the Troll Stronghold quest must be partially complete to gain access to the God Wars Dungeon. Spiritual creatures cannot be given as a Slayer task if the player has not completed

Spiritual warrior.title: Spiritual warrior
Spiritual warrior.intro: The Spiritual warrior is a powerful Slayer monster found in the God Wars Dungeon . There are five types of spiritual warriors: Saradominists , Zamorakians , Bandosians , Armadyleans , and Zarosians . Spiritual warriors require 68 Slayer to kill (note Spiritual creatures cannot be given as a Slayer task if the player has not completed the Death Plateau quest). Just like Spiritual rangers and Spiritual mages , there are Spiritua

Blood Reaver.title: Blood Reaver
Blood Reaver.intro: Blood Reavers are a type of demon in the service of Zaros found in the Ancient Prison within the God Wars Dungeon . They attack using a spell that resembles Blood Rush and can heal themselves a percentage of damage inflicted. Damaging a Blood Reaver heals the player for 50% of the damage dealt. This applies to Blood Reavers in both the Ancient Prison and in the Nex encounter.

Chest (Obor's lair).title: Chest (Obor's lair)
Chest (Obor's lair).intro: The chest is found in Obor 's lair in Edgeville Dungeon , and can be opened with a giant key after defeating Obor , once per kill. It is the only source of the hill giant club , a unique and powerful two-handed melee weapon.

Ancient essence crystals.title: Ancient essence crystals
Ancient essence crystals.intro: Ancient essence crystals are the fourth highest level rock in Old School RuneScape , requiring 75 Mining to mine. They are located exclusively in Ghorrock Dungeon 's mine , which can only be accessed once the Secrets of the North quest has been completed.

Shellbane gryphon.title: Shellbane gryphon
Shellbane gryphon.intro: The shellbane gryphon is the boss version of gryphons found in a cave in the centre of the Great Conch , requiring level 51 Slayer and completion of Troubled Tortugans to kill. As a Slayer boss , it may only be killed while on a gryphons Slayer task . Gryphon Slayer tasks must be unlocked by purchasing the 'Wings Spread' reward from a Slayer master for 80 Slayer Points in order to be assigned them by Nieve / Steve or Duradel /

Gryphon.title: Gryphon
Gryphon.intro: Gryphons are Slayer monsters requiring 51 Slayer to kill. They inhabit the Great Conch and require completion of the Troubled Tortugans quest and 45 Sailing to access. Wings Spread must be unlocked at a slayer master for 80 points to be given as a task by Nieve or Duradel . You can also get this task from Chaeldar , Vannaka or Mortimer without unlocking them with points as long as the quest is completed. They commonly attack T

Dire gryphon.title: Dire gryphon
Dire gryphon.intro: The dire gryphon is the superior variant of the gryphon . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Fire giant.title: Fire giant
Fire giant.intro: Fire giants are powerful giants that are popular for training Ranged and Slayer . They are also the strongest of the standard giants, being significantly stronger than their Ice , Moss , and Hill giant relatives.

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Moss giant.title: Moss giant
Moss giant.intro: Moss giants are large giants , found in areas that are tied to nature. Moss giants are very commonly trained on, since their Defence level is rather low in comparison to other monsters of the same combat level , and they are vulnerable to Fire spells .

Lesser demon.title: Lesser demon
Lesser demon.intro: Lesser demons are the second weakest standard demon , above the imp . They are sometimes killed by Free-to-play players, as they are one of the strongest monsters on those servers and can drop the desirable rune med helm . Lesser demons have a somewhat low Defence , which can make them a good source of combat experience . They are susceptible to the effects of demonbane weapons .

Greater demon.intro: Greater demons are large demonic monsters . They are well known for their rune full helm and hard clue scroll drops.

Ankou.title: Ankou
Ankou.intro: Ankou are skeletal, ghostly monsters. Ankou in the fourth level of the Stronghold of Security can drop the left skull half , one of four parts of the skull sceptre .

Black demon.intro: Black demons are large demons that inhabit various dungeons throughout Gielinor . They are weak to demonbane weapons ; as with most demons, they are also weak to magical attacks.

Dagannoth.title: Dagannoth
Dagannoth.intro: Dagannoth are sea-based monsters that live in the Lighthouse basement (close to fairy ring code A L P ) after players complete Horror from the Deep (type 1 in the table). They can also be found in the southern part of the Catacombs of Kourend , as well as the Jormungand's Prison after completion of The Fremennik Exiles (type 2 in the table).

Magic axe.title: Magic axe
Magic axe.intro: The axes in the magic axe hut can be given as a wilderness Slayer assignment by Krystilia . Players require 23 Thieving for magic axes to be assigned as a task.

Possessed pickaxe.title: Possessed pickaxe
Possessed pickaxe.intro: Possessed pickaxes are an animated NPC found in the Haunted Mine and the Catacombs of Kourend . They look like a normal pickaxe until the player walks past them, when they become animated. Possessed pickaxes are weak against magic and crushing attacks.

tables.heading: Catacombs of Kourend drops › Catacombs tertiary

Hill Giant.title: Hill Giant
Hill Giant.intro: A Hill Giant is a type of giant found in several locations around Gielinor . For free-to-play , the Edgeville Dungeon offers the most spawns, while for members , the Shayzien Giant Pit also has numerous spawns. The Edgeville dungeon may be accessed through the entrance located in the house north-east of Barbarian Village and west of the Cooks' Guild if the player has a brass key . The Edgeville Dungeon area is usually very cro

Shade.title: Shade
Shade.intro: Shades are monsters that reside on the fourth level of the Stronghold of Security (the Sepulchre of Death ) and in the Catacombs of Kourend .

Deviant spectre.title: Deviant spectre
Deviant spectre.intro: Deviant spectres are stronger variants of aberrant spectres that require level 60 Slayer to kill, and completion of Priest in Peril to receive as a Slayer task . They are found exclusively within the Catacombs of Kourend .

King Sand Crab.title: King Sand Crab
King Sand Crab.intro: King Sand Crabs are aggressive monsters that look like sandy boulders while disguised, but attack when walked by. They are found inside the Catacombs of Kourend in the south-east section of the dungeon, as well as the Crabclaw Caves found south-east of the Woodcutting Guild .

Warped Jelly.title: Warped Jelly
Warped Jelly.intro: Warped jellies are stronger variants of jellies that require level 52 Slayer to kill. They are found exclusively within the Catacombs of Kourend , both southern and eastern. Warped jellies count towards a Jellies Slayer task , but they do not count towards a Warped creatures Slayer task .

Greater Nechryael.title: Greater Nechryael
Greater Nechryael.intro: Greater nechryael are stronger variants of nechryael that require level 80 Slayer to harm, plus completion of Priest in Peril to be assigned as a Slayer task . Krystilia will only assign them if I Wildy More Slayer is unlocked. They are found within the Catacombs of Kourend , Iorwerth Dungeon and the Wilderness Slayer Cave .

Twisted Banshee.title: Twisted Banshee
Twisted Banshee.intro: Twisted Banshees are stronger variants of banshees that require level 15 Slayer to kill. They are found exclusively within the Catacombs of Kourend , in a multicombat area . There is a safespot in the walkway between the two rooms. Players must wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet while fighting them in order to avoid the effects of their screams, which cause the player to take 7 damage and have their stats greatly reduced in Atta

Mutated Bloodveld.title: Mutated Bloodveld
Mutated Bloodveld.intro: Mutated Bloodvelds are stronger variants of bloodvelds that require level 50 Slayer to kill. They are found within the Catacombs of Kourend , Iorwerth Dungeon , Meiyerditch Laboratories , and Buccaneers' Laboratory .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Nechryarch.title: Nechryarch
Nechryarch.intro: The nechryarch is a superior variant of nechryael and greater nechryael . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Repugnant spectre.title: Repugnant spectre
Repugnant spectre.intro: The repugnant spectre is a superior variant of the deviant spectre . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Like their standard variant, a nose peg or Slayer helmet is required to safely engage them, as otherwise the player will take rapid damage and have their stats drained.

Insatiable mutated Bloodveld.title: Insatiable mutated Bloodveld
Insatiable mutated Bloodveld.intro: The insatiable mutated bloodveld is a superior version of the mutated bloodveld . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Vitreous Warped Jelly.title: Vitreous Warped Jelly
Vitreous Warped Jelly.intro: The vitreous warped jelly is a superior variant of warped jellies . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Screaming twisted banshee.title: Screaming twisted banshee
Screaming twisted banshee.intro: The screaming twisted banshee is a superior variant of the twisted banshee . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Skeleton (Catacombs of Kourend).title: Skeleton (Catacombs of Kourend)
Skeleton (Catacombs of Kourend).intro: Skeletons are a specific variant of regular skeletons that exist only within the Catacombs of Kourend .

Cyclops (Catacombs of Kourend).title: Cyclops (Catacombs of Kourend)
Cyclops (Catacombs of Kourend).intro: These versions of cyclops can be found in the Catacombs of Kourend . They have near-identical drops to the regular cyclopes in the Warriors' Guild , except that they can not drop defenders and have access to unique Catacombs drops like dark totem pieces.

Tiny port reward bag.title: Tiny port reward bag
Tiny port reward bag.intro: Tiny port reward bags are possible rewards from completing a courier task . They may contain either loot from a shared drop table, or loot that is unique to the task's destination port . The size of port reward bag given from a task is determined by the Sailing experience awarded for that task; tiny bags are given from Courier Tasks giving 0–399 XP.

Small port reward bag.title: Small port reward bag
Small port reward bag.intro: Small port reward bags are possible rewards from completing a courier task . They may contain either loot from a shared drop table, or loot that is unique to the task's destination port . The size of port reward bag given from a task is determined by the Sailing experience awarded for that task; small bags are given from Courier Tasks giving 400–999 XP.

Reward casket (beginner).title: Reward casket (beginner)
Reward casket (beginner).intro: A reward casket (beginner) is received after completing the final clue of a beginner clue scroll trail, and contains the final reward for the trail. Opening the reward casket is required for treasure trail completion to be tracked on the HiScores and collection log .

Reward casket (easy).title: Reward casket (easy)
Reward casket (easy).intro: A reward casket (easy) is received after completing the final clue of an easy clue scroll trail, and contains the final reward for the trail. Opening the reward casket is required for treasure trail completion to be tracked on the HiScores and collection log .

The Mimic.title: The Mimic
The Mimic.intro: The Mimic is a sporadic boss who can be fought by presenting a mimic casket to the strange casket found upstairs in Watson's house . Mimics can be obtained from an elite or master reward casket after asking the strange casket to enable the chance to obtain a mimic casket (which is disabled by default). The elite reward casket has a 1/35 chance of being a mimic, while master reward caskets have a 1/15 chance. There is a one-tim

Reward casket (elite).title: Reward casket (elite)
Reward casket (elite).intro: A reward casket (elite) is received after completing the final clue of an elite clue scroll trail, and contains the final reward for the trail. Opening the reward casket is required for treasure trail completion to be tracked on the HiScores and collection log .

Terror dog.title: Terror dog
Terror dog.intro: Terror dogs are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 40 (not boostable) to kill. Being the personal pets of Tarn Razorlor , they are first encountered during the miniquest Lair of Tarn Razorlor , in which the player must fight two terror dogs, alongside some animated armour in addition to Tarn himself. Upon completion of the miniquest, more terror dogs can be found in the room.

Brambickle.title: Brambickle
Brambickle.intro: Brambickle is a gnomish explorer located atop the Trollweiss Mountain . He may ask for a hard order in the Gnome Restaurant minigame . To get to Brambickle you do not need to have completed Troll Romance . Many players find it tedious to deliver to him, so most usually refuse to take the order, and wait five minutes for another one.

Wingstone.title: Wingstone
Wingstone.intro: Wingstone is a gnome traveller wandering the desert between Nardah and the Agility Pyramid . Players who have to deliver food to him during the Gnome Restaurant minigame may find it difficult to immediately locate him due to his large wander radius. Hopping worlds while south-west of Nardah may be quicker than searching for him.

Professor Manglethorp.title: Professor Manglethorp
Professor Manglethorp.intro: Professor Manglethorp is a gnome professor currently visiting the dwarven capital city of Keldagrim to investigate the dwarves ' advancements in technology. He can be found on the ground level of the west wing of Keldagrim Palace , which houses the Consortium .

Penwie.title: Penwie
Penwie.intro: Penwie can be found south-west of the Gnome glider among the Jogres on Karamja . He can also be found near the tribesmen directly west of the Gnome glider. Penwie is difficult to see because the clothes he wears blend in with his surroundings. He is involved in the Gnome restaurant minigame as a hard order. Penwie has a chance of giving the unique reward of a raw oomlie , but does not award the special rewards of a gnome scarf

Captain Ninto.title: Captain Ninto
Captain Ninto.intro: Captain Ninto is a drunk, off-duty Gnome glider pilot that can be found inside the dwarven passage under the White Wolf Mountain (Sindarpos). He can only be reached after the player has completed the Fishing Contest quest .

Captain Daerkin.title: Captain Daerkin
Captain Daerkin.intro: Captain Daerkin is an off-duty gnome glider pilot who enjoys watching fights at the Emir's Arena viewing area.

Coffin (Hallowed Sepulchre).title: Coffin (Hallowed Sepulchre)
Coffin (Hallowed Sepulchre).intro: Coffins can be found on all floors of the Hallowed Sepulchre . They require 66 Thieving to loot, granting 200 experience when successfully looted. The player will need to pass a skilling challenge and there must be time left before they can attempt to loot it. When failing to loot the coffin, the player will be poisoned .

Grand Hallowed Coffin.title: Grand Hallowed Coffin
Grand Hallowed Coffin.intro: The Grand Hallowed Coffin can be found at the end of the fifth floor in the Hallowed Sepulchre . It requires either 84 Thieving , or 66 Thieving with 92 Agility , to open and grants 200 experience when successfully looted. The player has unlimited time to loot the coffin (if it was reached within the time limit) once they jump over the pedestal, as the timer will pause by then. Occasionally when failing to loot the coffin, the

Rogue's equipment crate.title: Rogue's equipment crate
Rogue's equipment crate.intro: Rogue's equipment crates are obtained as a reward from the Rogues' Den minigame . Searching it gives the player the choice to either receive one piece of rogue equipment or a rogue kit .

Silver Chest (red).title: Silver Chest (red)
Silver Chest (red).intro: A Silver Chest with red locks can be found in the Shade Catacombs during the Shades of Mort'ton minigame . A silver key red is needed to open the chest, after which the key dissolves.

Bronze Chest (purple).intro: A bronze chest with purple locks can be found in the Shade Catacombs during the Shades of Mort'ton minigame . A bronze key purple is needed to open the chest, after which the key dissolves.

Undead Lumberjack.title: Undead Lumberjack
Undead Lumberjack.intro: Undead Lumberjacks are found during Temple Trekking , spawning during the second version of the broken bridge event. When spawning, they continuously spawn in groups of 5 and come out of the water one by one. After a group has spawned it takes about 30 seconds for the next group to spawn. Alternatively, players can also log out and back in to start the event from the beginning.

Drink troll.title: Drink troll
Drink troll.intro: Drink troll is a drink troll that appears during the Prying Times quest when drinking the bottle of fish bladder stout obtained by opening a sealed crate.

Plundered salvage.title: Plundered salvage
Plundered salvage.intro: Plundered salvage is an item recovered from pirate shipwrecks via shipwreck salvaging . Level 64 Sailing is required to salvage these, granting 76 experience.

Barracuda salvage.title: Barracuda salvage
Barracuda salvage.intro: Barracuda salvage is an item recovered from Barracuda shipwrecks via shipwreck salvaging . Level 35 Sailing is required to salvage these, granting 31 experience.

Dinky the drink troll.title: Dinky the drink troll
Dinky the drink troll.intro: Dinky the drink troll is a small drink troll that spawns upon drinking the Bottle of fish bladder stoutier . He attacks with melee, which can be completely negated with Protect from Melee . He does not display a combat level but is extremely dangerous, as his high max hit and accuracy can easily kill an unprepared player.

Vale offerings.title: Vale offerings
Vale offerings.intro: Vale offerings are items obtained from claiming offerings during the Vale Totems minigame and serve as the reward for participating.

Ore pack (Volcanic Mine).title: Ore pack (Volcanic Mine)
Ore pack (Volcanic Mine).intro: Ore packs are an item purchased from the Volcanic Mine reward shop for 4,000 points. A pack contains an assortment of ores such that their total point value, had they been purchased directly from the shop instead, never exceeds 3,300. Since the packs always cost more points than their contents, they should never be purchased except by players looking to obtain a broken dragon pickaxe which they drop at a rate of 1/100 openings

Fishing spot (aerial fishing).title: Fishing spot (aerial fishing)
Fishing spot (aerial fishing).intro: Fishing spots can be found on the island in Lake Molch . These spots are used to catch Bluegill , Common tench , Mottled eel , Greater siren and a Golden tench .

Pygmy kraken.title: Pygmy kraken
Pygmy kraken.intro: Pygmy krakens are sea krakens that can be found in the Shrouded Ocean , Western Ocean , and Sunset Ocean . The player may be assigned to kill them as a bounty task starting at 50 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from the Void Knights' Outpost .

Spined kraken.title: Spined kraken
Spined kraken.intro: Spined krakens are sea krakens that can be found in the Northern Ocean , Sunset Ocean , and Unquiet Ocean . The player may be assigned to kill them as a bounty task starting at 65 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Aldarin .

Armoured kraken.title: Armoured kraken
Armoured kraken.intro: Armoured kraken are powerful sea krakens that are found in the Northern Ocean and Western Ocean . As their name suggests, they have significantly more defence against non-magic attacks than other krakens, due to a higher Defence level and double ranged defence bonuses. As such, cannons are not recommended, and instead magic, especially earth magic, is the preferred way to kill them.

Vampyre kraken.title: Vampyre kraken
Vampyre kraken.intro: Vampyre kraken are powerful sea krakens that are exclusively found in the Northern Ocean . This essentially gives them a requirement of 78 Sailing for the Eternal brazier , which in turn has an unboostable 76 Sailing requirement to acquire the eternal brazier schematic . They do not count towards Cave Kraken or Vampyre slayer tasks.

Veiled kraken.title: Veiled kraken
Veiled kraken.intro: Veiled krakens are powerful sea krakens that are exclusively found throughout the Southern Expanse , requiring an adamant helm to reach. Starting at level 80 Sailing , they may be assigned as bounty tasks at Port Tyras and Deepfin Point . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Deepfin Point. Veiled krakens can drop inky paint like other kraken. Their unique drop is the dragon cannon barrel ; although shared with opulent

Courier tasks.intro: Courier tasks are a type of port task where players deliver crates of cargo between two ports. A task has the following steps:

Bounty tasks.title: Bounty tasks
Bounty tasks.intro: Bounty tasks are a type of port task involving boat combat available at level 30 Sailing where players collect a particular sea monster 's body parts. A task has the following steps:

Glistening shoal.title: Glistening shoal
Glistening shoal.intro: Glistening shoals are a type of mixed shoal requiring level 76 Fishing to fish from, which have a 10% chance to spawn in place of a yellowfin shoal or halibut shoal whilst deep sea trawling . Like the aforementioned shoals, glistening shoals swim at shallow and moderate depths, and as such must be caught with a linen trawling net or greater to consistently catch them.

Shimmering shoal.title: Shimmering shoal
Shimmering shoal.intro: Shimmering shoals are a type of mixed shoal requiring level 69 Fishing to fish from, which have a 10% chance to spawn in place of a giant krill shoal or haddock shoal whilst deep sea trawling . Like the aforementioned shoals, shimmering shoals only swim at a shallow depth, and as such can be caught with a rope trawling net .

Vibrant shoal.title: Vibrant shoal
Vibrant shoal.intro: Vibrant shoals are a type of mixed shoal requiring level 86 Fishing to fish from, which have a 10% chance to spawn in place of a bluefin shoal or marlin shoal whilst deep sea trawling . Like the aforementioned shoals, vibrant shoals swim at shallow, moderate, and deep depths, and as such must be caught with a hemp trawling net or greater to consistently catch them.

Giant krill shoal.title: Giant krill shoal
Giant krill shoal.intro: Giant krill shoals are a type of fish shoal found out at sea. They can be fished for raw giant krill via deep sea trawling , requiring level 69 Fishing and granting 112.5 experience per successful catch with a trawling net , or 22.5 if caught with a fishing rod .

Haddock shoal.title: Haddock shoal
Haddock shoal.intro: Haddock shoals are a type of fish shoal found out at sea. They can be fished for raw haddock via deep sea trawling , requiring level 73 Fishing and granting 128.5 experience per successful catch with a trawling net , or 25.7 if caught with a fishing rod .

Yellowfin shoal.title: Yellowfin shoal
Yellowfin shoal.intro: Yellowfin shoals are a type of fish shoal found out at sea. They can be fished for raw yellowfin via deep sea trawling , requiring level 79 Fishing and granting 155.5 experience per successful catch with a trawling net , or 31.1 if caught with a fishing rod .

Halibut shoal.title: Halibut shoal
Halibut shoal.intro: Halibut shoals are a type of fish shoal found out at sea. They can be fished for raw halibut via deep sea trawling , requiring level 83 Fishing and granting 195.5 experience per successful catch with a trawling net , or 39.1 if caught with a fishing rod .

Marlin shoal.title: Marlin shoal
Marlin shoal.intro: Marlin shoals are a type of fish shoal found out at sea. They can be fished for raw marlin via deep sea trawling , requiring level 91 Fishing and granting 265.5 experience per successful catch with a trawling net , or 53.1 if caught with a fishing rod .

Bluefin shoal.title: Bluefin shoal
Bluefin shoal.intro: Bluefin shoals are a type of fish shoal found out at sea. They can be fished for raw bluefin via deep sea trawling , requiring level 87 Fishing and granting 220.5 experience per successful catch with a trawling net , or 44.1 if caught with a fishing rod .

Martial salvage.title: Martial salvage
Martial salvage.intro: Martial salvage is an item recovered from mercenary shipwrecks via shipwreck salvaging . Level 73 Sailing is required to salvage these, granting 138 experience.

Hermit crab.title: Hermit crab
Hermit crab.intro: Hermit crabs are aggressive monsters that look like harmless shells while disguised, but attack when walked by. Unlike most other enemies and NPCs , hermit crabs are not marked with yellow dots on the player's minimap ; this is probably due to the crabs' appearance, which camouflages them as shells.

Barronite deposit.title: Barronite deposit
Barronite deposit.intro: Barronite deposits are found whilst mining barronite rocks within the Ruins of Camdozaal . Each deposit mined yields 32 Mining experience . Mining barronite does not consume celestial ring charges, but the +4 invisible Mining boost still applies.

Body Golem.title: Body Golem
Body Golem.intro: The Body Golem is one of the golems found in the Ruins of Camdozaal . It can be found by awakening the rubble lying in the section north-east of the bank chest. It is fueled by runic energies and imbued with the power of the nearby Body Altar .

Fishing spot (Camdozaal).title: Fishing spot (Camdozaal)
Fishing spot (Camdozaal).intro: Seven fishing spots can be found in the Ruins of Camdozaal : four next to the preparation table and offering altar , and three near the mine.

Chaos Golem.title: Chaos Golem
Chaos Golem.intro: The Chaos Golem is one of the golems found in the Ruins of Camdozaal . It can be found by awakening the Rubble lying in the far south-east section of Camdozaal, south of the body golems . It is fueled by runic energies and corrupted by the unstable energies of the nearby Chaos Altar .

Flawed Golem.title: Flawed Golem
Flawed Golem.intro: The Flawed Golem is one of the golems found in the Ruins of Camdozaal . It can be found by awakening the Rubble lying in the section south of the bank chest.

Mind Golem.title: Mind Golem
Mind Golem.intro: The Mind Golem is one of the golems found in the Ruins of Camdozaal . It can be found by awakening the Rubble lying in the section south of the bank chest, in the enclave containing six piles of rubble that is located east of the Flawed Golems . It is fueled by runic energies and imbued with the power of the nearby Mind Altar .

Earth warrior.title: Earth warrior
Earth warrior.intro: Earth warriors are a type of humanoid earth elemental found in a dirt-lined chamber in the Edgeville Dungeon . This area is in the Wilderness so it is advised to come prepared for player killers . Earth warriors can be safe-spotted in the bottom right corner or top of the first chamber.

Ghoul.title: Ghoul
Ghoul.intro: Ghouls are found just west of Canifis , north of the swamp and west of the fairy ring code C K S . Though they may appear to be undead and are often mistaken for such, they are in fact still alive and thus immune to both the Crumble Undead spell and to the effects of the salve amulet and salve amulet (e) . A ghoul bone is needed to complete the Rag and Bone Man II . Killing a ghoul is a requirement for the easy Morytania Diary

Black Knight Titan.title: Black Knight Titan
Black Knight Titan.intro: The Black Knight Titan is a hill giant encountered during the Holy Grail quest . He is reasonably powerful for his level; but his attacks are inaccurate and very slow. He should be fought with Melee, as he has incredibly high Ranged and Magic defence. He does not move from his tile .

Reanimated giant.title: Reanimated giant
Reanimated giant.intro: A reanimated giant can be spawned by casting the Arceuus spell Adept Reanimation on an ensouled giant head . Reanimation can be cast on any ensouled head within an 31x31 area where that head was dropped by a monster. This will work indefinitely, even if the ensouled head is picked up, so long as it is not put into the bank , trade screen, Grand Exchange , or price checker . If the player has done one of these things, they will

Cyclops (Ardougne Zoo).title: Cyclops (Ardougne Zoo)
Cyclops (Ardougne Zoo).intro: A solitary cyclops is located in a cage in the Ardougne Zoo . Unlike all other cyclopes , this cyclops has the same drop table as a regular hill giant .

Moss Giant (Iorwerth Dungeon).title: Moss Giant (Iorwerth Dungeon)
Moss Giant (Iorwerth Dungeon).intro: Moss Giants are large, humanoid creatures found in the Iorwerth Dungeon .

Goblin.title: Goblin
Goblin.intro: Goblins are one of the most common, low- level monsters found around Gielinor . They are popularly killed by low-level players training their combat skills .

Cave goblin (monster).title: Cave goblin (monster)
Cave goblin (monster).intro: Cave goblins are goblins of the Dorgeshuun who can be found in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves . They are friendly creatures and are willing to give many adventurers a lit torch (if the player has no light source) or a tinderbox (if the player does not have one) when spoken to after the player assures that they are not there to hurt the cave goblins. Upon being attacked, they will scream "Nooo!", "Don't hurt us!" or "Eeek!", and oth

Cave goblin guard.title: Cave goblin guard
Cave goblin guard.intro: The cave goblin guards guard the Dorgeshuun Mines . They can be seen patrolling the mines with their boney spears or clubs . They protect the cave goblin miners , and will command, Stop that , and begin to attack you if you are spotted assaulting a miner.

Goblin guard.title: Goblin guard
Goblin guard.intro: The Goblin guard (known as Sleeping guard before being woken up) is a level 42 goblin with 43 hitpoints, who is guarding the kitchen gate in the dungeon near the Observatory . During the Observatory Quest players must "prod" him to wake him up, he then attacks the player while saying "Oi, how dare you wake me up!" . He can be fought after the quest is complete as he respawns in the same place.

Reanimated goblin.title: Reanimated goblin
Reanimated goblin.intro: A reanimated goblin can be spawned by casting the spell Basic Reanimation on an ensouled goblin head . Reanimation can be cast on any ensouled head within an 31x31 area where that head was dropped by a monster. This will work indefinitely, even if the ensouled head is picked up, so long as it is not put into the bank , trade screen, Grand Exchange , or price checker . If the player has done one of these things, they will no lo

Revenant goblin.title: Revenant goblin
Revenant goblin.intro: The revenant goblin is a type of revenant that inhabits the Revenant Caves , which is a PvP-enabled area that is part of the Wilderness . Like all revenants, they can restore their health when it falls below 50% and will react to a player's protection prayers; wearing a charged bracelet of ethereum will reduce all revenants' damage by 75%.

Guard (Cave goblin).title: Guard (Cave goblin)
Guard (Cave goblin).intro: The cave goblin guards keep order in Dorgesh-Kaan . When spoken to they will sometimes tease the player. If the player fails to pickpocket a cave goblin in the vicinity of cave goblin guards, they may shout "Stop that!" and attack the player.

Goblin (Goblin Village).title: Goblin (Goblin Village)
Goblin (Goblin Village).intro: The goblins of Goblin Village are a specific tribe of goblins which seem to be at war amongst themselves over which colour their armour should be. During the Goblin Diplomacy quest, the village leaders General Bentnoze and General Wartface temporarily settle their dispute over armour colour by choosing to wear brown goblin mail instead of the red or green armour, but as becomes evident directly after this quest, this settlemen

Goblin (Vault of War).title: Goblin (Vault of War)
Goblin (Vault of War).intro: Goblins are some of the creatures that can be found in the Vault of War inside the Stronghold of Security , which is the first level of the stronghold. The fact this area in the stronghold is named after war makes this a very fitting location for goblins to be found, considering they are avid followers of Bandos , the god of war.

Goblin (God Wars Dungeon).title: Goblin (God Wars Dungeon)
Goblin (God Wars Dungeon).intro: Goblins in the God Wars Dungeon are troops for the Bandosian army from the Rekeshuun goblin tribe , fighting against the other monsters inside the dungeon. While stronger than most goblins found elsewhere, they are still relatively weak followers of Bandos and often killed for kill count .

Hobgoblin.title: Hobgoblin
Hobgoblin.intro: Hobgoblins are low-to-medium levelled monsters which hit fairly accurately for their combat level. They come in two variations outside of the God Wars Dungeon , with the level 28 variant usually unarmed and the level 42 variant wielding a spear, although some level 28 hobgoblins found north-east of the Vinery in Hosidius as well as one west of the Crafting Guild wield spears too.

Revenant hobgoblin.title: Revenant hobgoblin
Revenant hobgoblin.intro: The revenant hobgoblin is a type of revenant that inhabits the Revenant Caves , which is a PvP-enabled area that is part of the Wilderness . Like all revenants, they can restore their health when it falls below 50% and will react to a player's protection prayers; wearing a charged bracelet of ethereum will reduce all revenants' damage by 75%.

Imp.title: Imp
Imp.intro: Imps are amongst the smallest creatures in Gielinor . They are central in the Imp Catcher quest due to their unique bead drops. Every 30–120 seconds there is a 25% chance for an imp to disappear into a puff of smoke and teleport a short distance away. At level 71 Hunter players may catch imps with magic boxes , including imps found in the God Wars Dungeon .

Reanimated imp.title: Reanimated imp
Reanimated imp.intro: A reanimated imp can be spawned by casting the spell Basic Reanimation on an ensouled imp head . The spell can be cast within a 31x31 area where the head was dropped by an imp . This will work indefinitely, even if the ensouled head is picked up, so long as it is not put into the bank , a trade screen, the Grand Exchange , or the price checker . If the player has done one of these things, they will no longer be able to reanima

Revenant imp.title: Revenant imp
Revenant imp.intro: The revenant imp is a type of revenant that inhabits the Revenant Caves , which is a PvP-enabled area that is part of the Wilderness . Like all revenants, they can restore their health when it falls below 50% and will react to a player's protection prayers; wearing a charged bracelet of ethereum will reduce all revenants' damage by 75%.

Jogre.title: Jogre
Jogre.intro: Jogres are a type of ogre that live in the jungles of Karamja . Their attacks are slow but powerful, however their low defence allows them to be killed quickly. They are a threat mostly to lower-level players exploring Karamja due to their high damage hits.

Lesser demon (The Scar).title: Lesser demon (The Scar)
Lesser demon (The Scar).intro: Lesser Demons are a monster located in The Scar . Unlike Scarred lesser demon , these lesser demons have not yet been corrupted by the power of the Abyssal Space .

Zogre.title: Zogre
Zogre.intro: Zogres are encountered during the Zogre Flesh Eaters quest, and can be found in Jiggig and Jiggig Dungeon south-east of Castle Wars . When burying their bones in Jiggig, a skogre may appear and attack. Their name is a portmanteau of 'zombie ogre'. According to Juna , zogres fought for Zamorak during the God Wars and 'could repel the forces of Saradomin with their stench alone.'

Zombie pirate (Harmony Island).title: Zombie pirate (Harmony Island)
Zombie pirate (Harmony Island).intro: Zombie pirates are encountered during The Great Brain Robbery on Harmony Island . If the player has completed The Great Brain Robbery, they will cease being aggressive.

Skogre.title: Skogre
Skogre.intro: Skogres are skeletal ogres encountered during the Zogre Flesh Eaters quest, and can be found in Jiggig and Jiggig Dungeon south-east of Castle Wars . An aggressive skogre may also appear when you bury zogre bones inside Jiggig .

Sorebones.title: Sorebones
Sorebones.intro: Sorebones are the surgical zombie pirates under the command of the evil and short surgeon Mi-Gor . After the player defeats Barrelchest , the monks inform the player that they have escaped with Mi-Gor back into the ocean. Their name seems to be a parody of the term "sawbone", a title given to surgeons.

Slash Bash.title: Slash Bash
Slash Bash.intro: Slash Bash is an undead ourg encountered during Zogre Flesh Eaters . Attacking with both melee and ranged , his attacks inflict disease , a status effect draining a random stat (excluding Hitpoints and Prayer ) by up to 15. Disease will drain your Hitpoints instead if the chosen stat is already at level 1. Five doses of Relicym's balm or two doses of Sanfew serum is required to cure it. The 15 minutes of immunity from the Sanf

Nazastarool.title: Nazastarool
Nazastarool.intro: Nazastarool is an undead encountered during the Shilo Village quest after searching a dolmen in Rashiliyia's Tomb . He has three forms; the first being a level 91 Zombie , second a 68 Skeleton and finally a 93 Ghost . All three forms have to be fought during the quest. A very easy way to kill him is to either range or use magic on him, as he can get stuck behind obstacles. All three forms may also be safespotted with a Halberd

Afflicted.title: Afflicted
Afflicted.intro: The afflicted are the local villagers of Mort'ton who were cursed by a strange mist sent from the Sanguinesti region by Lord Lowerniel Vergidiyad Drakan . They speak nonsense to the player if talked to.

Monkey Zombie.title: Monkey Zombie
Monkey Zombie.intro: Monkey Zombies are encountered during Monkey Madness I in the Ape Atoll Dungeon and Temple of Marimbo Dungeon . They drop monkey bones that are needed to make a zombie greegree . They appear to be green undead monkeys.

Zombie swab.title: Zombie swab
Zombie swab.intro: Zombie swabs are zombies that can be fought after starting the Rum Deal quest . There is also an intimidate option, which scares the zombie and no longer makes it aggressive towards the player (it only needs to be done once per zombie). However, this does not work between attacks, so the player might want to find a safespot in order to use this option.

Undead one.title: Undead one
Undead one.intro: The Undead ones play a critical part in the Shilo Village quest . Both skeletal and zombie undead ones are found in Ah Za Rhoon and Rashiliyia's Tomb , whereas the zombie undead ones are also found at the entrance to Shilo Village .

Zombie (Tarn's Lair).title: Zombie (Tarn's Lair)
Zombie (Tarn's Lair).intro: Zombies are found in the labyrinth before Tarn 's personal chamber. They have a massive span of combat levels and highly varied drops . Some of the drops are valuable such as rune and adamant armours and weapons . These monsters can be dangerous as they are in a multicombat area . It is very easy to get lost in the tunnels, and without a teleport low level players may quickly die.

Zombie.title: Zombie
Zombie.intro: Zombies are generic monsters found throughout Gielinor , often located in cemeteries, sewers, and dungeons. They count as undead and are weak to the effects of both the Salve amulet and the Crumble Undead spell.

Armoured zombie (Zemouregal's Base).title: Armoured zombie (Zemouregal's Base)
Armoured zombie (Zemouregal's Base).intro: Armoured zombies are level 82 undead found in Zemouregal's Base during the quest Defender of Varrock . They are notable for their unique drop, the broken zombie axe . As they reside in a multicombat area and spawn in close proximity to each other, they can be attacked with multi-hitting weapons such as burst spells and the venator bow as an effective training method. After defeating armoured zombies, a red mist will linger aro

Zombie (Zogre Flesh Eaters).title: Zombie (Zogre Flesh Eaters)
Zombie (Zogre Flesh Eaters).intro: The zombie is a monster encountered in the Jiggig Dungeon during the Zogre Flesh Eaters quest . When killed, it drops the ruined backpack , which must be opened to progress through the quest.

Zombie (Temple Trekking).title: Zombie (Temple Trekking)
Zombie (Temple Trekking).intro: A zombie wielding a bronze axe can be encountered during the Temple Trekking minigame , during the bridge puzzle event. The zombie is guaranteed to drop a bronze axe when killed, which can be used to cut the nearby trees for logs to fill the gaps in the bridge.

Zombie (Melzar's Maze).title: Zombie (Melzar's Maze)
Zombie (Melzar's Maze).intro: Two zombies can be found in the basement of Melzar's Maze . They must be killed in order to obtain the blue key , which can unlock the blue door to progress through the maze.

Zombie (Shayzien Crypts).title: Zombie (Shayzien Crypts)
Zombie (Shayzien Crypts).intro: Zombies are level 132 undead monsters found in the Shayzien Crypts . The crypts were constructed long before the founding of Great Kourend 1,510 years ago, but within the last few hundred years were overrun by zombies and skeletons.

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Undead Druid.title: Undead Druid
Undead Druid.intro: Undead Druids are followers of Ranul , the god of the moon, who have become corrupted and undead . They can be found in various sections of the Forthos Dungeon : the Crypt of the Moon east of the western dungeon entrance, the Temple Library (which has a nearby altar where players can recharge prayer ) and the small chamber south of the Spider Den near Brother Aimeri , which requires a knife or slash weapon to access.

Zombie (Entrana Dungeon).title: Zombie (Entrana Dungeon)
Zombie (Entrana Dungeon).intro: Zombies can be found in the Entrana Dungeon , near the entrance. While visually similar to generic zombies , the ones in the Entrana Dungeon are the only zombies with a combat level of 25, and have a unique drop table as well.

Undead Zealot.title: Undead Zealot
Undead Zealot.intro: Undead Zealot are zombies that have a 5% chance to spawn when a player opens any chest in the Shade Catacombs . Only the player who opens the chest to spawn them will be able to attack them.

Zombie pirate (Braindeath Island).title: Zombie pirate (Braindeath Island)
Zombie pirate (Braindeath Island).intro: Zombie pirates are encountered during Rum Deal on Braindeath Island . These zombies are located in the farming fields south of the plantation, and they are in a multi-combat area.

Armoured zombie (Zemouregal's Fort).title: Armoured zombie (Zemouregal's Fort)
Armoured zombie (Zemouregal's Fort).intro: Armoured zombies can be found in the tunnels west of the basement in Zemouregal's Fort , who appear after the completion of The Curse of Arrav . They have slightly higher stats than the regular armoured zombies found in Zemouregal's Base , with their drop table being slightly more generous; notably, they exclusively drop the broken zombie helmet while also dropping the broken zombie axe at a higher rate than the zombies in Zem

Zombie pirate.title: Zombie pirate
Zombie pirate.intro: Zombie pirates can be found at the Chaos Temple in level 11 Wilderness . Zombie pirates have an uncommon chance to drop adamant seeds , teleport anchoring scrolls and zombie pirate keys . Wearing an amulet of avarice will note zombie pirate drops.

Zombie (Wilderness).title: Zombie (Wilderness)
Zombie (Wilderness).intro: Zombies are monsters found in the Wilderness at the Graveyard of Shadows and the Eastern Ruins . They have combat levels of 18 and 24 and are aggressive to players.

Zombie (Stronghold of Security).title: Zombie (Stronghold of Security)
Zombie (Stronghold of Security).intro: Zombies are monsters found in the second level of the Stronghold of Security . They have combat levels of 30, 44, and 53 and are aggressive to players running through the stronghold.

Zombie (Kourend).title: Zombie (Kourend)
Zombie (Kourend).intro: Zombies are monsters found in Kourend to the south of Shayzien and in the woods between Lovakengj and Arceuus . They have combat levels of 56, 70, 72, and 76 and are aggressive to players. The level 72 variant is only found near Shayzien.

Armoured zombie (Defender of Varrock).title: Armoured zombie (Defender of Varrock)
Armoured zombie (Defender of Varrock).intro: Armoured zombies are level 82 undead found invading Varrock Palace during the Defender of Varrock quest. They are engaged in combat with the palace guards , and will not attack the player unless attacked first.

Skeleton.title: Skeleton
Skeleton.intro: Skeletons are undead monsters found in various locations across Gielinor , often in graveyards and dungeons . Being an undead monster, they are susceptible to Crumble Undead and the Salve amulet . They are also often weak against crush attacks.

Skeleton brute.title: Skeleton brute
Skeleton brute.intro: The skeleton brute can be found in the Ancient Cavern , which is accessible from the Baxtorian Falls after progressing the firemaking section of Barbarian Training .

Skeleton (Ape Atoll).title: Skeleton (Ape Atoll)
Skeleton (Ape Atoll).intro: Skeletons are undead gorillas found in the multi-combat Ape Atoll Dungeon . Players are required to run past them during the Monkey Madness I quest in order to reach Zooknock . Players are advised to use Protect from Melee against these monsters, as they attack accurately and can easily overwhelm with their sheer numbers. They are aggressive to all players who are not using a greegree to turn themselves into a monkey.

Skeleton heavy.title: Skeleton heavy
Skeleton heavy.intro: The skeleton heavy can be found in the Ancient Cavern , which is accessible from the Baxtorian Falls after progressing the firemaking section of Barbarian Training .

Skeleton hero.title: Skeleton hero
Skeleton hero.intro: The skeleton hero can be found in the Ancient Cavern , which is accessible from the Baxtorian Falls after progressing the firemaking section of Barbarian Training .

Skeleton thug.title: Skeleton thug
Skeleton thug.intro: The skeleton thug can be found wandering around the Ancient Cavern , which is accessible from the Baxtorian Falls after progressing the firemaking section of Barbarian Training . It is one of the weaker monsters in the Ancient Cavern.

Skeleton warlord.title: Skeleton warlord
Skeleton warlord.intro: Skeleton warlords can be found in the Ancient Cavern , which is accessible from the Baxtorian Falls after progressing the firemaking section of Barbarian Training .

Skeleton Hellhound (Vet'ion).title: Skeleton Hellhound (Vet'ion)
Skeleton Hellhound (Vet'ion).intro: The Skeleton Hellhound is a monster summoned by Vet'ion . Two spawn during the first form of Vet'ion after half of his health has depleted and must be killed as he is immune to attacks while they are present.

Greater Skeleton Hellhound (Vet'ion).title: Greater Skeleton Hellhound (Vet'ion)
Greater Skeleton Hellhound (Vet'ion).intro: The Greater Skeleton Hellhound is a monster summoned by Vet'ion . Two spawn during the second form of Vet'ion after half of his health has depleted and must be killed as he is immune to attacks while they are present.

Giant skeleton (Tarn's Lair).title: Giant skeleton (Tarn's Lair)
Giant skeleton (Tarn's Lair).intro: Giant skeletons are a more powerful variant of skeleton found in Tarn's Lair . They are seldom killed due to their significantly higher combat stats than regular skeletons and dangerous location.

Giant skeleton (Shadow Dungeon).title: Giant skeleton (Shadow Dungeon)
Giant skeleton (Shadow Dungeon).intro: Giant skeletons are a more powerful variant of skeleton found in the Shadow Dungeon , which can be accessed using a ring of visibility during or after the Desert Treasure I quest . They are seldom killed due to their significantly higher combat stats than regular skeletons, being located in a multicombat area , as well as lacklustre drops. As with most monsters in the Shadow Dungeon, they allow other monsters to pass through t

Skeleton Mage.title: Skeleton Mage
Skeleton Mage.intro: Skeleton Mages are a rare variant of skeleton that make use of Magic to attack. Thus, it is recommended to wear magic-resistant armour such as dragonhide armour . They play a role in the Swan Song quest , where the player creates an army of them to help defeat the sea trolls .

Skeleton (mage).title: Skeleton (mage)
Skeleton (mage).intro: Skeletons are found in Tarn's Lair . They have the same appearance as Skeleton Mages , and also share the same stat-reducing attack which reduces Attack , Strength and Defence stats by 3-4 levels, exclaiming I infect your body with rot... They are able to recognise the player's protection prayers and will switch attack styles accordingly, although their melee attack is weaker and less accurate than their Magic attack.

Skeleton (Tarn's Lair).title: Skeleton (Tarn's Lair)
Skeleton (Tarn's Lair).intro: Skeletons are undead monsters that can be found inside Tarn's Lair , the Abandoned Mine , and around the Ruins of Ullek . These skeletons are unique in appearance and their item drops are unlike their regular counterparts .

Skeleton (The Restless Ghost).title: Skeleton (The Restless Ghost)
Skeleton (The Restless Ghost).intro: The skeleton is an undead monster encountered during the quest The Restless Ghost . When the player takes the ghost's skull from the altar in the basement of the Wizards' Tower , the skeleton animates and attacks them. The skeleton is not a particularly dangerous enemy, and it is not required to kill it in order to complete the quest. The player can simply leave after retrieving the skull, and the skeleton will disappear after

Skeleton (Barrows).title: Skeleton (Barrows)
Skeleton (Barrows).intro: Skeletons are undead monsters lurking in the Barrows tunnels. Skeletons are one of the many obstacles between a player and the chest containing rewards where they constantly distract players from completing puzzles. As with all monsters in the crypts, they are aggressive to any player regardless of their Combat level . Two of them are commonly killed alongside a bloodworm each run as a quick way to optimise the player's reward

Skeleton (Melzar's Maze).title: Skeleton (Melzar's Maze)
Skeleton (Melzar's Maze).intro: Five skeletons can be found on the 2 floor 3 floor of Melzar's Maze . They must be killed in order to obtain the yellow key , which can unlock the yellow doors and progress through the maze.

Skeleton (Shayzien Crypts).title: Skeleton (Shayzien Crypts)
Skeleton (Shayzien Crypts).intro: Skeletons are level 132 undead monsters found in the Shayzien Crypts . The crypts were constructed long before the founding of Great Kourend 1,510 years ago, but within the last few hundred years were overrun by zombies and skeletons.

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Greater Skeleton Hellhound (Calvar'ion).title: Greater Skeleton Hellhound (Calvar'ion)
Greater Skeleton Hellhound (Calvar'ion).intro: The Greater Skeleton Hellhound is a monster summoned by Calvar'ion . Two spawn during the second form of Calvar'ion after half of his health has depleted and must be killed as he is immune to attacks while they are present.

Skeleton Hellhound (Calvar'ion).title: Skeleton Hellhound (Calvar'ion)
Skeleton Hellhound (Calvar'ion).intro: The Skeleton Hellhound is a monster summoned by Calvar'ion . Two spawn during the first form of Calvar'ion after half of his health has depleted and must be killed as he is immune to attacks while they are present.

Skeleton (Forthos Ruin).title: Skeleton (Forthos Ruin)
Skeleton (Forthos Ruin).intro: Skeletons are a variant of regular skeletons that exist only at the Forthos Ruin .

Skeleton (Stronghold of Security).title: Skeleton (Stronghold of Security)
Skeleton (Stronghold of Security).intro: Skeletons are variants of regular skeletons that exist only within the Stronghold of Security .

Skeleton (Wilderness Agility Course).title: Skeleton (Wilderness Agility Course)
Skeleton (Wilderness Agility Course).intro: Skeletons are a variant of regular skeletons that exist only at the Wilderness Agility Course . They never lose aggressiveness regardless of how much time is spent in their tolerance region. The dungeon underneath the course is home to regular level 25 skeletons.

Skeleton (Lucien's camp).title: Skeleton (Lucien's camp)
Skeleton (Lucien's camp).intro: Skeletons are level 132 undead monsters found in Lucien's camp . When killed, they are shortly resurrected by a nearby undead mage .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Unicow.title: Unicow
Unicow.intro: A unicow is a hybrid of a cow and a unicorn . Players can create unicows in Creature Creation , in the basement dungeon of the Tower of Life building at the north-west altar once they complete the Tower of Life quest.

Newtroost.title: Newtroost
Newtroost.intro: A newtroost is a hybrid of a newt and a rooster . Players can create newtroosts in Creature Creation , in the basement dungeon of the Tower of Life building once they complete the Tower of Life quest .

Spidine.title: Spidine
Spidine.intro: A spidine is a hybrid of a sardine and a deadly red spider . Players can create spidines in Creature Creation , at the south-east altar in the basement dungeon of the Tower of Life building , once they complete the Tower of Life quest.

Frogeel.title: Frogeel
Frogeel.intro: A frogeel is a hybrid of a giant frog and a raw cave eel . Players can create frogeels in Creature Creation , in the basement dungeon of the Tower of Life building once they complete the Tower of Life quest.

Swordchick.title: Swordchick
Swordchick.intro: A swordchick is a hybrid of a chicken and a swordfish. Players can create swordchicks in Creature Creation , in South-West of the basement dungeon of the Tower of Life building once they complete the Tower of Life quest .

Jubster.title: Jubster
Jubster.intro: A jubster is a hybrid of a lobster and a jubbly bird . Players can create jubsters in Creature Creation , in the basement dungeon of the Tower of Life once they complete the Tower of Life quest.

Cyclops.title: Cyclops
Cyclops.intro: A cyclops (plural cyclopes ) is a large one-eyed giant . They are known for dropping many alchable drops, so bringing nature and fire runes is helpful as it allows players to make longer trips and more money without banking or taking up inventory space. The cyclopes found in the Warriors' Guild were brought over by Harrallak Menarous from the Wushanko Isles when he went on an expedition there.

Elder Chaos druid.title: Elder Chaos druid
Elder Chaos druid.intro: Elder Chaos druids are high-level mages found at the Chaos Temple in the Wilderness . They are substantially stronger and more accurate than their lower-level counterparts , and are capable of teleblocking players and re-applying it consistently. Additionally, they can teleport fleeing players within melee distance, similar to abyssal demons . The teleportation spell has a maximum range of 20 tiles. Having read a teleport anch

Poachers (Forestry event).title: Poachers (Forestry event)
Poachers (Forestry event).intro: Poachers is a group Forestry event where players attempt to disarm fox traps to prevent poachers from capturing a frightened fox .

Pheasant Control.title: Pheasant Control
Pheasant Control.intro: Pheasant Control is a Forestry event where players attempt to help a Freaky Forester steal pheasant eggs from empty pheasant nests without getting caught by nearby pheasants .

Enchantment Ritual.title: Enchantment Ritual
Enchantment Ritual.intro: Enchantment Ritual is a Forestry event where players attempt to help a Dryad complete an eight-step ritual by standing on ritual circles that are unique to its group.

Beehive (Forestry event).title: Beehive (Forestry event)
Beehive (Forestry event).intro: Beehive is a Forestry event where a Bee keeper appears asking for help in constructing beehives to rehome friendly bees from a wild beehive .

tables.heading: Rewards › When adding a log to an unfinished hive
Rewards › When completing a hive › Tertiary

Stone chest (House on the Hill).title: Stone chest (House on the Hill)
Stone chest (House on the Hill).intro: Stone chests can be found inside the House on the Hill . The chest can be searched to reveal that numulites need to be inserted into it. 100 numulites can be inserted into the chest for a chance to receive a note written by Skeka which can be added to the Fossil island note book .

Tortured gorilla.title: Tortured gorilla
Tortured gorilla.intro: Tortured gorillas are found in the Crash Site Cavern after completion of Monkey Madness II . Nine tortured gorillas are fought during Monkey Madness II; three level 142 gorillas while riding a stunted demonic gorilla in Glough 's laboratory, four level 142 gorillas in the Tree Gnome Stronghold , and two level 141 gorillas during the penultimate fight of the quest.

Demonic gorilla.title: Demonic gorilla
Demonic gorilla.intro: Demonic gorillas are powerful creatures found in the Crash Site Cavern . Two of them are fought during Monkey Madness II , in the penultimate stage of the fight. After the quest is completed, more demonic gorillas can be found in the caverns alongside their tortured brethren. They are primarily killed for their zenyte shard and ballista component drops.

Maniacal monkey (Hunter).title: Maniacal monkey (Hunter)
Maniacal monkey (Hunter).intro: The maniacal monkey is a creature that players can capture starting at level 60 Hunter , granting 1,000 Hunter experience . Completion of the Monkey Madness II quest is also required to be able to access Glough's Laboratory.

Angry barbarian spirit.title: Angry barbarian spirit
Angry barbarian spirit.intro: An angry barbarian spirit is found in the Ancient Cavern , along with many other high-levelled monsters, including Mithril dragons . They are quite high hitting (with a maximum hit of 18) but have low accuracy.

Hunters' loot sack (adept).title: Hunters' loot sack (adept)
Hunters' loot sack (adept).intro: Adept hunters' loot sacks are a reward for successfully completing adept Hunters' Rumours assigned by Guild Hunter Cervus or Ornus .

Berserk barbarian spirit.title: Berserk barbarian spirit
Berserk barbarian spirit.intro: A berserk barbarian spirit is a monster found in the Ancient Cavern , where one spawns in the south-east corner of the main floor. According to Otto Godblessed , these are the spirits of barbarians that were killed while voyaging down into the Ancient Cavern.

Enraged barbarian spirit.title: Enraged barbarian spirit
Enraged barbarian spirit.intro: The enraged barbarian spirit is a level 166 spirit that can be found in the Ancient Cavern alongside many other high-levelled monsters , including mithril dragons and waterfiends . They are capable of large amounts of damage, with 18 being their highest hit, but they have low accuracy. Protect from Melee can be used to completely avoid damage.

Skeleton (Ancient Cavern).title: Skeleton (Ancient Cavern)
Skeleton (Ancient Cavern).intro: Barbarian skeletons are interactive scenery scattered around the ground floor 1 floor of the Ancient Cavern . They can be searched for bones , ancient pages , and mangled bones , prompting a variety of results. The skeleton will respawn after 2 minutes.

One of the items will be added to your inventory.
