Drill Demon.title: Drill Demon
Drill Demon.intro: Drill Demon is a random event . During this event, the player is teleported to a training area and ordered by Sergeant Damien to do some physical training ( push ups , sit ups , jog in place or star jumps ). The signs in front of each exercise mat indicate what they are used for. Note that the signs are randomly rearranged after each player action performed on a mat.

Freaky Forester.title: Freaky Forester
Freaky Forester.intro: The Freaky Forester is a random event in which players are teleported to a small clearing in a forest and asked to kill a pheasant with a certain number of tails. After successfully completing this random event by delivering any pheasant carcass to the Freaky Forester, players are rewarded with a piece of the Lederhosen set, or a lamp if they already own the set, and the player is taken back to the player's former location bef

Gravedigger.title: Gravedigger
Gravedigger.intro: Gravedigger is a random event in which the player is teleported to a small enclosed cemetery with five open gravesites, each containing a coffin and marked headstones. The area also contains a mausoleum , which functions as a bank deposit box , which can be useful if the player is doing some activity that involves gathering resources, to save a trip to the bank. The player has the option to deposit anything in their inventory

Mime (Random Event).title: Mime (Random Event)
Mime (Random Event).intro: The Mime is a random event in which the Mysterious Old Man appears and offers to teleport players to the mime artist's stage. The player must copy the mime's actions to complete the event. The mime will perform one of 8 emotes ( Think , Laugh , Cry , Dance , Climb Rope , Lean , Glass Box , and Glass Wall ) that the player will need to copy. If the player gets it right, they will Cheer , and if wrong, they will Cry . If the pla

Kiss the frog.title: Kiss the frog
Kiss the frog.intro: Kiss the frog is a random event . The player must either kiss or pat the frog wearing the crown, who is really a prince or princess , in order to restore them to their true form. The newly transformed prince or princess will give you a frog token for helping them, and this may be redeemed at the Varrock clothes shop to get a frog mask , a royal frog costume , or an experience lamp .

Mystery box.title: Mystery box
Mystery box.intro: Mystery boxes can be obtained from the Quiz Master random event . Players can choose between 1,000 coins or the mystery box upon successfully completing the event. Multiple mystery boxes can be owned at once, and they can be banked. Five are received as a one-off reward from drinking a bottle of puzzlers poteen .

Sandwich lady.title: Sandwich lady
Sandwich lady.intro: The sandwich lady is a random event . She appears anywhere to offer players a selection from her tray of food . Players have to be sure to take the one she offers.

Beekeeper (random event).title: Beekeeper (random event)
Beekeeper (random event).intro: The Beekeeper is a random event in which the Bee keeper teleports players to a field of beehives and requests help to repair a broken beehive. Players have to assemble the beehive from its four main parts by dragging them into their places marked in the centre of the screen. After all the pieces are placed, they have to click the 'build' button at the bottom of the screen to finally assemble the hive. The player is allowed six

Revenant dragon.title: Revenant dragon
Revenant dragon.intro: The revenant dragon is a type of revenant that inhabits the Revenant Caves , which is a PvP-enabled area that is part of the Wilderness . Like all revenants, they can restore their health when it falls below 50% and will react to a player's protection prayers; wearing a charged bracelet of ethereum will reduce all revenants' damage by 75%.

Revenant maledictus.intro: The Revenant maledictus is the demi-boss variant of the ethereal revenants , an undead spectral being shrouded in Zarosian power. It has a rare chance to appear whenever any revenant is slain in the Revenant Caves . It guarantees an ancient emblem or ancient totem drop for the top-damaging player, in addition to giving the player the Forinthry Surge buff if they had an amulet of avarice worn.

Bounty crate (tier 1).title: Bounty crate (tier 1)
Bounty crate (tier 1).intro: A tier 1 bounty crate is an item obtained upon successfully killing a target in Bounty Hunter . The tier of crate received is dependent on the player's Earning Potential (EP) at the time of the kill, which is reset to 0% upon receiving a bounty crate .

Green dragon.title: Green dragon
Green dragon.intro: Green dragons are the weakest of the adult chromatic dragons . They are found in various locations within the Wilderness as well as in the Corsair Cove Dungeon . Green dragons are capable of breathing dragonfire , which can hit up to 50 damage on players who are not wielding an Anti-dragon shield or Dragonfire shield . Using one of these shields will partially block the dragonfire, and using one of these shields with an antifi

Jelly.title: Jelly
Jelly.intro: Jellies are Slayer monsters found in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon and Wilderness Slayer Cave that require a Slayer level of 52 to kill. They give 75 Slayer experience per kill and drop hard clue scrolls and steel weaponry . Jellies and their variants are the only creatures to drop mithril boots .

Great white shark.title: Great white shark
Great white shark.intro: Great white sharks are monsters that can be found in several oceans. Starting at level 75 Sailing, they can be assigned as a bounty task . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Port Roberts .

Lost ironwood crate.title: Lost ironwood crate
Lost ironwood crate.intro: Lost ironwood crate is a lost crate ocean encounter requiring level 95 Sailing that can be found floating in various oceans , and retrieving it grants 450 Sailing experience. Players must make sure they stop the boat and are near the item; lost ironwood crates cannot be retrieved whilst the player's boat or raft is directly over them.

Lava Strykewyrm.title: Lava Strykewyrm
Lava Strykewyrm.intro: Lava Strykewyrms are Slayer monsters requiring 62 Slayer to kill, located in the Charred Dungeon beneath Charred Island , requiring 60 Sailing to reach, as well as in the Wyrmscraig Cavern after partial completion of Fallen From Grace . They can be killed as part of a wyrm task, and are known for their dragon metal sheet drop, which is significantly more common when on a wyrm task.

Magma strykewyrm.title: Magma strykewyrm
Magma strykewyrm.intro: The magma strykewyrm is the superior variant of the lava strykewyrm . It has a chance of spawning while on a wyrm slayer task, after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Orca.title: Orca
Orca.intro: Orcas are monsters that can be found in the Northern Ocean . The player may be assigned to kill them as a bounty task starting at 80 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Etceteria .

Opulent salvage.title: Opulent salvage
Opulent salvage.intro: Opulent salvage is an item recovered from merchant shipwrecks via shipwreck salvaging . Level 87 Sailing is required to salvage these, granting 200 experience if a player is using the salvaging hook.

Narwhal.title: Narwhal
Narwhal.intro: Narwhals are monsters that can be found in the Northern Ocean . The player may be assigned to kill them as a bounty task starting at 62 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Rellekka .

Aquanite.title: Aquanite
Aquanite.intro: Aquanites are Slayer monsters found in the Ynysdail Cavern beneath Ynysdail . They require level 78 Slayer to fight, and Ynysdail requires level 73 Sailing to access. Aquanites can be assigned by Nieve and Duradel after purchasing the Lured In unlock for 80 Slayer reward points , or by Mortimer regardless if Lured In has been unlocked. There is also a task extension unlock available for 100 points.

Cannonball stall.title: Cannonball stall
Cannonball stall.intro: The cannonball stall is a stall in Port Roberts which may be stolen from starting at level 87 Thieving , granting 223 Thieving experience . This stall does not deplete when stolen from unlike other stalls throughout Gielinor. Three market guards patrol the area in a set pattern, allowing the player to steal several times before they can be caught.

Elder aquanite.title: Elder aquanite
Elder aquanite.intro: Elder aquanites are the superior variant of aquanites . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Dolphin.title: Dolphin
Dolphin.intro: Dolphins can be found in many of Gielinor's oceans . They drop the echo pearl , used to build a fathom pearl . They do not have any associated bounty tasks .

Albatross.title: Albatross
Albatross.intro: Albatrosses are monsters that can be found in the Sunset Ocean , Shrouded Ocean , Northern Ocean , and Unquiet Ocean . They may be assigned as a bounty task starting at 50 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from The Summer Shore .

Stingray.title: Stingray
Stingray.intro: Stingrays are monsters that can be found in the Unquiet Ocean , Sunset Ocean , and Shrouded Ocean . They can be assigned as bounty tasks starting at level 45 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Corsair Cove . They commonly drop ray barbs which can be used to make trawling nets .

Butterfly ray.title: Butterfly ray
Butterfly ray.intro: Butterfly rays are a monster which can be found in the Shrouded Ocean , Unquiet Ocean , and Sunset Ocean . They may assigned as a bounty task starting at level 40 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Land's End . They drop ray barbs which can be used to make trawling nets .

Eagle ray.title: Eagle ray
Eagle ray.intro: Eagle rays are a monster which can be found in the Shrouded Ocean , Unquiet Ocean , and Sunset Ocean . They may assigned as a bounty task starting at level 30 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from the Ruins of Unkah . They drop ray barbs which can be used to make trawling nets .

Manta ray (monster).title: Manta ray (monster)
Manta ray (monster).intro: Manta rays are monsters that can be found in the Shrouded Ocean . They may be assigned as a bounty task starting at 50 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Port Tyras . They commonly drop ray barbs which can be used to make trawling nets .

Small salvage.title: Small salvage
Small salvage.intro: Small salvage is an item recovered from small shipwrecks via shipwreck salvaging . Level 15 Sailing is required to salvage these, granting 10 experience.

Fishy salvage.title: Fishy salvage
Fishy salvage.intro: Fishy salvage is an item recovered from fisherman shipwrecks via shipwreck salvaging . Level 26 Sailing is required to salvage these, granting 17 experience.

Large salvage.title: Large salvage
Large salvage.intro: Large salvage is an item recovered from large shipwrecks via shipwreck salvaging . Level 53 Sailing is required to salvage these, granting 48 experience.

Fremennik salvage.title: Fremennik salvage
Fremennik salvage.intro: Fremennik salvage is an item recovered from Fremennik shipwrecks via shipwreck salvaging . Level 80 Sailing is required to salvage these, granting 162 experience.

Rusty chest.title: Rusty chest
Rusty chest.intro: The rusty chest is located on Dognose and Vatrachos Islands requiring level 40 and 46 Sailing respectively to moor at. It requires 33 Thieving level to picklock. A lockpick is not required to open it, but increases the success rate of opening the chest.

Pirate (Thieving).title: Pirate (Thieving)
Pirate (Thieving).intro: Pirates are a stronger variant of pirate who can be pickpocketed at level 60 Thieving, granting 72 experience alongside some loot.

Silver stall (Port Roberts).title: Silver stall (Port Roberts)
Silver stall (Port Roberts).intro: Silver stall is a stall in Port Roberts which may be stolen from starting at level 50 Thieving , granting 80 Thieving experience . This stall does not deplete when stolen from unlike other stalls throughout Gielinor. Three market guards patrol the area in a set pattern, allowing the player to steal several times before they can be caught.

Teak tree.title: Teak tree
Teak tree.intro: A teak tree is a tropical hardwood lumber tree that requires level 35 Woodcutting to cut, granting 85 Woodcutting experience for each set of teak logs received. Teak trees provide some of the highest Woodcutting experience per hour, so it is common to find multiple players attempting to cut teak trees.

Soldier (tier 1).title: Soldier (tier 1)
Soldier (tier 1).intro: A soldier (tier 1) is a Shayzien soldier from Great Kourend . Players can fight him in the Combat Ring to obtain Shayzien armour (tier 1) , providing they have at least level 20 Defence .

Soldier (tier 3).title: Soldier (tier 3)
Soldier (tier 3).intro: A soldier (tier 3) is a Shayzien soldier from Great Kourend . Players can fight her in the Combat Ring to obtain shayzien armour (tier 3) , providing they have at least level 20 Defence .

Soldier (tier 2).title: Soldier (tier 2)
Soldier (tier 2).intro: A soldier (tier 2) is a Shayzien soldier from Great Kourend . Players can fight him in the Combat Ring to obtain Shayzien armour (tier 2) , providing they have at least level 20 Defence .

Soldier (tier 4).title: Soldier (tier 4)
Soldier (tier 4).intro: A soldier (tier 4) is a Shayzien soldier from Great Kourend . Players can fight him in the Combat Ring to obtain Shayzien armour (tier 4) , providing they have at least level 20 Defence .

Cockatrice.title: Cockatrice
Cockatrice.intro: Cockatrice are Slayer monsters that require level 25 Slayer to kill. A mirror shield or V's shield is required to defend against their piercing gaze, or else they will reduce your combat stats every hit, even while safespotting. As 20 Defence is needed to be able to wield a mirror shield, players who do not meet this requirement will not be assigned them as a task. Their strength lies purely in their piercing gaze ability; wit

Soldier (tier 5).title: Soldier (tier 5)
Soldier (tier 5).intro: A soldier (tier 5) is a Shayzien soldier from Great Kourend . Players can fight her in the Combat Ring to obtain Shayzien armour (tier 5) , provided that they have a set of tier 4 or 5 Shayzien armour on them or in their bank or Armour case , as well as at least level 20 Defence .

Cockathrice.title: Cockathrice
Cockathrice.intro: The cockathrice is a superior variant of the cockatrice and moonlight cockatrice . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Like their standard variant, a mirror shield or V's shield is required to safely engage them, as otherwise the player will take rapid damage and have their stats drained.

Moonlight Cockatrice.title: Moonlight Cockatrice
Moonlight Cockatrice.intro: Moonlight Cockatrice are Slayer monsters that require level 25 Slayer to kill, who are found in the Earthbound Cavern within Neypotzli which requires level 48 Slayer for partial completion of Perilous Moons to enter. Please note that if you have only partially completed Perilous Moons to access them for a slayer task, they will not re-spawn on their own after being killed. You must leave the room and re-enter before they will

Basilisk.title: Basilisk
Basilisk.intro: A basilisk is a Slayer monster that requires a Slayer level of 40 to kill. Like cockatrice , players must equip a mirror shield or V's shield when fighting these monsters. Players require a Defence level of 20 in order to receive basilisks as a Slayer task , as this is required to wield the shield. To get a basilisk task from Duradel , Nieve , or Konar , players must have also purchased the "Basilocked" slayer reward , costing

Monstrous basilisk.title: Monstrous basilisk
Monstrous basilisk.intro: The monstrous basilisk is a superior variant of the basilisk . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Like their standard variant, a mirror shield or V's shield is required to safely engage them, as otherwise the player will take rapid damage and have their stats drained.

Basilisk Sentinel.title: Basilisk Sentinel
Basilisk Sentinel.intro: The basilisk sentinel is a superior variant of the basilisk knight . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Like their standard variant, a mirror shield or V's shield is required to safely engage them, as otherwise the player will take rapid damage and have their stats drained.

Kurask.title: Kurask
Kurask.intro: Kurask are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 70 to kill. Like turoth , they can only be damaged with leaf-bladed weapons , broad ammunition , or the Magic Dart spell due to their tough hides; they are immune to any other types of attacks. They are, however, susceptible to burn damage from weapons such as burning claws .

Basilisk Knight.title: Basilisk Knight
Basilisk Knight.intro: Basilisk Knights are a Slayer creature that can be found in Jormungand's Prison beneath the Island of Stone , requiring level 60 Slayer and completion of The Fremennik Exiles to kill. Like cockatrice and basilisks , players must equip a mirror shield or V's shield when fighting these monsters or they will take heavy damage and their stats will be drained. Uniquely, the attack speed of Basilisk Knights will match the player's c

King kurask.title: King kurask
King kurask.intro: The king kurask is a superior variant of the kurask . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Night beast.title: Night beast
Night beast.intro: The night beast is a superior variant of the dark beast . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer Master . Unlike their normal variants, a night beast's initial attack is always magic, regardless if the player hits it first or if it made to aggro with a goading potion . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Like their standard variant, a nose peg or Slayer helmet is required to safely engage them, as otherwise the player will take rapid damage and have their stats drained.

Crushing hand.intro: The crushing hand is a superior variant of the crawling hand . It has a chance of spawning after killing a crawling hand if you have purchased the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Spiked Turoth.intro: The spiked turoth is a superior variant of the turoth . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Infernal pyrelord.intro: The infernal pyrelord is a superior version of the pyrelord . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Mutated Terrorbird.title: Mutated Terrorbird
Mutated Terrorbird.intro: The Mutated Terrorbird is a superior variant of the warped terrorbird . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Mutated Tortoise.title: Mutated Tortoise
Mutated Tortoise.intro: The Mutated Tortoise is a superior variant of the Warped Tortoise . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Blood-starved venator.title: Blood-starved venator
Blood-starved venator.intro: The blood-starved venator is a superior variant of the venator . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Unlike other superior monsters, this is currently the only variant that is able to spawn without requiring a slayer task. While it shares the same basic attacks as regular venators, there are two key differences to note - they can walk to

Waterfiend.title: Waterfiend
Waterfiend.intro: Waterfiends are demonic creatures of water found in the Ancient Cavern underneath the Baxtorian Falls , as well as in Kraken Cove and Iorwerth Dungeon . They are moderately resistant to all forms of combat with the exception of crush and heavy ranged attacks, against which they are significantly more vulnerable. They use a magic attack whose projectile resembles Water Blast , along with a magical ranged attack resembling ice a

Gargoyle.title: Gargoyle
Gargoyle.intro: Gargoyles are Slayer monsters located in the Slayer Tower 's top floor and basement, requiring 75 Slayer in order to be harmed. Those found in the basement are only available to players who are assigned gargoyles as their Slayer task . If they attempt to kill them off-task, Raulyn will prevent them from attacking.

Mogre.title: Mogre
Mogre.intro: Mogres are Slayer monsters and a type of ogre that are found in Mudskipper Point , requiring level 32 Slayer to kill. Mogres appear when disturbed by the player, who must lure them using Fishing explosives on an Ominous Fishing Spot . Previously, they could only be killed by players who had completed the Skippy and the Mogres miniquest . Since the release of Sailing , Mogres swimming in the ocean can now be killed with cannons

Mogre (sea).title: Mogre (sea)
Mogre (sea).intro: Mogres are monsters that can be found in the Ardent Ocean . Like the ones found on land , they require level 32 Slayer to fight. This requirement cannot be bypassed by having a crewmate man a cannon .

Brine rat.title: Brine rat
Brine rat.intro: Brine rats are Slayer monsters that can be found in the Brine Rat Cavern near Rellekka . They are notable for being the only monsters to drop the brine sabre . A Slayer level of 47 is required to fight them.

Turoth.title: Turoth
Turoth.intro: Turoth are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 55 to kill. They are melee based, and as such Protect from Melee will negate all of their damage. They drop herbs and seeds commonly, though not as frequently as aberrant spectres , as well as frequent nature runes . In addition, they also drop the leaf-bladed sword and necklace of fangs .

Cave horror.title: Cave horror
Cave horror.intro: Cave horrors are Slayer monsters and a type of horror found in the Mos Le'Harmless Cave . Killing them requires the completion of Cabin Fever , level 58 Slayer , a witchwood icon or protect from melee, and a light source (unless a fire of eternal light is lit). They are most often killed for their black mask drops along with a decent rate of hard clue scrolls .

Spitting Wyvern.title: Spitting Wyvern
Spitting Wyvern.intro: Spitting wyverns are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 66 in order to be harmed. They reside in the Wyvern Cave on Fossil Island and are the weakest of the Fossil Island wyverns . Like with other Wyverns , an elemental , mind , dragonfire ward , dragonfire , or ancient wyvern shield (not including Anti-dragon Shield ) provides significant protection against their icy breath . These monsters require completion of t

Ancient Wyvern.title: Ancient Wyvern
Ancient Wyvern.intro: Ancient Wyverns are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 82 in order to be harmed. They reside in the Wyvern Cave on Fossil Island and are the strongest species of Wyvern in Old School RuneScape . Like with other Wyverns , an elemental shield , mind shield , dragonfire shield , dragonfire ward or ancient wyvern shield provides significant protection against their icy breath , and they are vulnerable to the effects of

Taloned Wyvern.title: Taloned Wyvern
Taloned Wyvern.intro: Taloned Wyverns are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 66 in order to be harmed. They reside in the Wyvern Cave on Fossil Island . Like with other Wyverns , an elemental , mind , dragonfire or ancient wyvern shield provides significant protection against their icy breath, and they are vulnerable to the effects of dragonbane weapons . These monsters require completion of the Bone Voyage quest to be assigned as a Sla

Long-tailed Wyvern.title: Long-tailed Wyvern
Long-tailed Wyvern.intro: Long-tailed Wyverns are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 66 in order to be harmed. They reside in the Wyvern Cave on Fossil Island . Like with other Wyverns , an elemental , mind , dragonfire or ancient wyvern shield provides significant protection against their icy breath , and they are vulnerable to the effects of dragonbane weapons .

Cave slime.title: Cave slime
Cave slime.intro: Cave slimes are Slayer monsters that require level 17 Slayer to kill. They inflict poison regardless of whether they do damage or not, so it is advised that the player brings a form of anti-poison when fighting them. As they are located in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves , a rope is needed if you have not entered the dungeon before. A light source is also required, but be aware that any exposed light sources (such as a candle ) may

Pyrefiend.title: Pyrefiend
Pyrefiend.intro: Pyrefiends are demons made of fire and molten rock that require level 30 Slayer to kill. As their attacks are magic based, it is recommended to wear armour with a high magic defence bonus, such as dragonhide . Pyrefiends and Harpie bug swarms are the only monsters to drop steel boots .

Harpie Bug Swarm.title: Harpie Bug Swarm
Harpie Bug Swarm.intro: Harpie bug swarms are mid-level slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 33 to kill. A lit bug lantern , which requires a Firemaking level of 33 to light, is required to damage these monsters (the lantern must be lit and equipped). If you do not have 33 Firemaking, you cannot be assigned harpie bug swarms as a Slayer task .

Pyrelord.title: Pyrelord
Pyrelord.intro: Pyrelords are stronger variants of pyrefiends that require level 30 Slayer to kill. They are found within the Sisterhood Sanctuary and on the north side of the Isle of Souls .

Bloodveld.title: Bloodveld
Bloodveld.intro: Bloodvelds are demons known for attacking victims with their long tongues, which have magical properties allowing them to pierce through physical defences. They are Slayer monsters requiring level 50 Slayer to kill.

Nechryael.title: Nechryael
Nechryael.intro: Nechryael are demons of decay which require a Slayer level of 80 in order to harm, plus completion of Priest in Peril to be assigned as a Slayer task . They are found in the Slayer Tower and Charred Dungeon , and their stronger variant, Greater nechryael , can be found in the Catacombs of Kourend , Iorwerth Dungeon , and the Wilderness Slayer Cave . Nechryael are known for their rune boots drop, which are one of the few boots

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Dark beast.title: Dark beast
Dark beast.intro: Dark beasts are monsters that require level 90 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Mourner Tunnels under West Ardougne and in Iorwerth Dungeon in Prifddinas . Along with their superior variant , they are the only monster in the game to drop the dark bow and the death talisman .

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Wall beast.title: Wall beast
Wall beast.intro: A wall beast is a Slayer monster that requires level 35 Slayer to kill. A spiny helmet or Slayer helmet is required to start fighting one; without these helmets, a player will be grabbed and hurt without a chance to retaliate. When their initial grab is repelled with either helmet, the message Your helmet repels the wall beast! will be displayed. Players will not be assigned these as a task until they reach level 5 Defence , a

Brimstone chest.title: Brimstone chest
Brimstone chest.intro: The Brimstone chest is located adjacent to Konar quo Maten on Mount Karuulm . This chest is locked and can only be opened by using a brimstone key , which players can acquire from slaying monsters assigned by Konar.

Rockslug.title: Rockslug
Rockslug.intro: Rockslugs are Slayer monsters that require level 20 Slayer to kill. A bag of salt must be used on it when it has 4 or less Hitpoints to finish it off. If used on a rockslug with 5 or more Hitpoints, the bag will be consumed but have no effect. If a rockslug's health is reduced to 1 but a bag of salt is not used on it, the rockslug will stop retaliating and wander off.

Desert Lizard.title: Desert Lizard
Desert Lizard.intro: Desert lizards are Slayer monsters found in the Kharidian Desert , requiring level 22 Slayer to kill. In order to kill a desert lizard, an ice cooler must be used when it has less than 5 Hitpoints . If an ice cooler is used on a desert lizard with 5 or more Hitpoints, the cooler will be consumed but have no effect. Players can buy the " Reptile freezer " perk from a Slayer Master for 10 Slayer points , which will automatically

Small Lizard.title: Small Lizard
Small Lizard.intro: Small lizards are Slayer monsters found north-north-east of Nardah east of fairy ring D L Q . An ice cooler must be used on a lizard when it has 1-4 Hitpoints left in order to kill it. They can be killed for lizard Slayer tasks .

Lizard.title: Lizard
Lizard.intro: Lizards ( Lacertilia giganteus ) are Slayer monsters found in the Kharidian Desert that require level 22 Slayer to kill. Ice coolers , which can be bought from any Slayer master , are required to kill them. The cooler will be consumed, so multiple coolers are necessary for slayer trips.

Sulphur Lizard.title: Sulphur Lizard
Sulphur Lizard.intro: Sulphur lizards are creatures found in the middle level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm , requiring level 44 Slayer to kill. As they are only found within the volcano, players must wear the boots of stone , boots of brimstone , or granite boots to protect themselves from the extreme heat of the dungeon floor, unless they've completed the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary .

Grimy Lizard.title: Grimy Lizard
Grimy Lizard.intro: Grimy Lizards are slayer monsters that require level 44 Slayer to kill, who are found in the Streambound Cavern within Neypotzli and the Tonali Cavern . They can be killed as part of a lizard Slayer task.

Infernal Mage.title: Infernal Mage
Infernal Mage.intro: Infernal Mages are Slayer monsters that require 45 Slayer to kill. They are mainly hunted for their unique drops: the fire ruby , and the rare dark mystic boots and hat drops, and are sometimes hunted for their frequent drops of death runes . Players who plan on fighting them should be wary of their accurate magic attack, although Protect from Magic negates this completely.

Aberrant spectre.title: Aberrant spectre
Aberrant spectre.intro: Aberrant spectres are Slayer monsters that require level 60 Slayer to kill, and completion of Priest in Peril to receive as a Slayer task . They frequently drop large numbers of grimy herbs and herb seeds . Because of this, bringing a herb sack and seed box when killing them is recommended.

Banshee.title: Banshee
Banshee.intro: Banshees are a Slayer monster that require level 15 Slayer to kill. They can be found at the Slayer Tower in Morytania on the ground floor 1 floor , on the eastern side. Players must wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet while fighting them in order to avoid the effects of their screams, which causes the player to take 6 damage and have their stats greatly reduced in Attack , Strength , Defence , Ranged , Magic , Prayer , and Agili

Fumus.title: Fumus
Fumus.intro: Fumus is one of the four mages guarding Nex in the Ancient Prison , within the God Wars Dungeon . Having mastered smoke magic , he enhances Nex's powers over smoke. As with all of Nex's mages, he is immobile.

Umbra.title: Umbra
Umbra.intro: Umbra is one of the four mages guarding Nex in the Ancient Prison , within in the God Wars Dungeon . Having mastered shadow magic , she enhances Nex's powers over shadow. As with all of Nex's mages, she is immobile.

Larran's big chest.title: Larran's big chest
Larran's big chest.intro: Larran's big chest can be found on the ship west of Pirates' Hideout . The chest is locked and can only be opened by using Larran's key , which is obtained from killing monsters that Krystilia assigns the player, or from the muddy chest .

Cruor.title: Cruor
Cruor.intro: Cruor is one of the four mages guarding Nex in the Ancient Prison , within in the God Wars Dungeon . Having mastered blood magic , he enhances Nex's powers over blood. As with all of Nex's mages, he is immobile.

Glacies.title: Glacies
Glacies.intro: Glacies is one of the four mages guarding Nex in the Ancient Prison , within in the God Wars Dungeon . Having mastered ice magic , she enhances Nex's powers over ice. As with all of Nex's mages, she is immobile.

Vyrewatch Sentinel.title: Vyrewatch Sentinel
Vyrewatch Sentinel.intro: Vyrewatch Sentinels are stronger variants of the Vyrewatch , and can be fought after completing the Sins of the Father quest. They can be found prowling the streets of the upper class areas of Darkmeyer , in search of unruly humans to snack on. The Vyrewatch Sentinels are one of the only monsters that drop the blood shard (the other being venators ), although they can also be obtained via pickpocketing the various Vyre citizen

Vyre.title: Vyre
Vyre.intro: Vyres are citizens of Darkmeyer that can be talked to as well as pickpocketed from with level 82 Thieving . A successful pickpocket yields coins or other items and 306.9 Thieving experience.

Venator.title: Venator
Venator.intro: Venators are Slayer monsters that require 74 Slayer and completion of the quest The Blood Moon Rises to fight. Compared to vyrewatch sentinels , they are a higher-intensity encounter with a better drop rate for blood shards , along with a relatively decent supply of dragon arrowtips and dragon dart tips via their fang and teeth drops. Like vyrewatch sentinels, they are considered tier 3 vampyres and can only be killed with spe

Warped Tortoise.title: Warped Tortoise
Warped Tortoise.intro: Warped Tortoises are creatures found in the Poison Waste Dungeon beneath the Galarpos Mountains , requiring partial completion of The Path of Glouphrie and level 56 Slayer to kill. Players must have the crystal chime in their inventory to fight them, otherwise they will be invulnerable.

Warped Terrorbird.title: Warped Terrorbird
Warped Terrorbird.intro: Warped Terrorbirds are creatures found in the Poison Waste Dungeon beneath the Galarpos Mountains , requiring partial completion of The Path of Glouphrie and level 56 Slayer to kill. It is recommended to wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet while fighting them in order to halve their max hit and reduce chip damage through protection prayer from their ranging attacks. Players must have the crystal chime in their inventory to fight

Sulphur Nagua.title: Sulphur Nagua
Sulphur Nagua.intro: Sulphur nagua are slayer monsters that require level 48 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Ancient Prison within Neypotzli , accessed from the south-west entrance of the antechamber. Partial completion of Perilous Moons is required for access.

Zombie Pirate's Locker.title: Zombie Pirate's Locker
Zombie Pirate's Locker.intro: Zombie Pirate's Lockers are scenery found on a zombie pirate ship that has run aground east of the Chaos Temple at level 14 wilderness. A zombie pirate key is required to be able to open a locker.

Earthen Nagua.title: Earthen Nagua
Earthen Nagua.intro: Earthen nagua are Slayer monsters that require level 48 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Tonali Cavern after completion of the The Final Dawn quest. As with sulphur and frost nagua , earthen nagua have -4 flat armour , so all successful hits will do an extra 4 damage to them. Because of this, it is useful to bring a multi-hit weapon such as the glacial temotli , since each hit separately benefits from the flat armour.

Juvenile custodian stalker.title: Juvenile custodian stalker
Juvenile custodian stalker.intro: Juvenile custodian stalkers are slayer monsters that require level 54 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Stalker Den near Auburnvale . They are similar to the stalker creature fought during the quest Shadows of Custodia . Unlike their older counterparts, they do not drop any uniques aside from broken antlers .

Strange creature (Shadows of Custodia).title: Strange creature (Shadows of Custodia)
Strange creature (Shadows of Custodia).intro: Strange creatures are a weak type of custodian stalker encountered within the Stalker Den during the Shadows of Custodia quest . Three of them ambush the player when they attempt to rescue Antos .

Killerwatt.title: Killerwatt
Killerwatt.intro: Killerwatts are Slayer monsters located in the Killerwatt plane , accessible through a portal at the top floor of Draynor Manor after completion of Ernest the Chicken . A Slayer level of 37 is required to kill them.

Sea Snake Hatchling.title: Sea Snake Hatchling
Sea Snake Hatchling.intro: Sea snake hatchlings are found in the Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon , which can be entered during and after the Royal Trouble quest. A Slayer level of 40 is required to receive a sea snakes Slayer task, but they can be killed at any level. The snakes are poisonous , with the poison starting at 5 damage. Players fighting them should bring poison protection of some sort, such as an antipoison , antipoison+ , or antipoison++

Sea Snake Young.title: Sea Snake Young
Sea Snake Young.intro: Sea snake young are found in the Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon , which can be entered during and after the Royal Trouble quest. A Slayer level of 40 is required to receive a sea snakes Slayer task, but they can be killed at any level. The snakes are poisonous , with the poison starting at 7 damage. Players fighting them should bring poison protection of some sort, such as an antipoison or superantipoison . They attack with

Giant Sea Snake.title: Giant Sea Snake
Giant Sea Snake.intro: The Giant Sea Snake is encountered at the end of the Royal Trouble quest. Level 40 Slayer is required to damage the snake. It drops the heavy box which is needed to finish the quest.

Tormented Demon.title: Tormented Demon
Tormented Demon.intro: Tormented Demons are extremely powerful demons bound into a state of perpetual agony, healing their bodies as they burn, summoned by the Mahjarrat Lucien after he teleports away the Stone of Jas during While Guthix Sleeps . They can be found throughout the Ancient Guthixian Temple after completion of the quest.

TzHaar-Xil.title: TzHaar-Xil
TzHaar-Xil.intro: The TzHaar-Xil are the agile hunters of the TzHaar , hunting the volcanic creatures for food. They are also responsible for creating the TzHaar Fight Cave and TzHaar Fight Pit , which they use for practice and sport respectively.

TzHaar-Ket.title: TzHaar-Ket
TzHaar-Ket.intro: The TzHaar-Ket are TzHaar who serve as the guards of Mor Ul Rek . They attack with melee .

TzHaar-Mej.title: TzHaar-Mej
TzHaar-Mej.intro: The TzHaar-Mej are TzHaar mystics who guide their fellow TzHaar. They fight with both melee and magic using their staves .

Lizardman shaman.title: Lizardman shaman
Lizardman shaman.intro: Lizardman shamans are giant reptilian humanoids that are stronger than their normal lizardmen and lizardmen brute counterparts. They are often sought after for their dragon warhammer drops. They never become tolerant to the player.

Fishing spot (cage, harpoon).title: Fishing spot (cage, harpoon)
Fishing spot (cage, harpoon).intro: Fishing spots can be found throughout Gielinor typically at coastal areas or docks. They can be fished at with lobster pots or harpoons for raw lobster , raw tuna , raw swordfish or Big Swordfish depending on the tool used.

Fishing spot (Piscatoris Fishing Colony).title: Fishing spot (Piscatoris Fishing Colony)
Fishing spot (Piscatoris Fishing Colony).intro: Fishing spots can be found at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony during and after the Swan Song quest. These spots are the only place you can fish raw monkfish , requiring a small net . Tuna and swordfish can also be caught from these fishing spots with a harpoon .

Fishing spot (big net, harpoon).title: Fishing spot (big net, harpoon)
Fishing spot (big net, harpoon).intro: Fishing spots can be found throughout Gielinor typically along coastal areas. They can be fished for raw mackerel , raw cod , raw bass , big bass , raw shark , and big shark . There are also non-fish items such as casket , leather boots , leather gloves , oyster , and seaweed .

Boat fishing spot (Piscatoris Fishing Co.title: Boat fishing spot (Piscatoris Fishing Colony)
Boat fishing spot (Piscatoris Fishing Co.intro: A fishing spot can be found just north of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony where raw monkfish can be caught at sea. The spot never moves or despawns. It can only be accessed by sailing to it, and fish can only be caught from a raft . To fish monkfish at this spot, you must have partial completion of the Swan Song quest. All raw and cooked fish that can be caught here may be stored in a cargo hold .

Boat fishing spot (big net, harpoon).title: Boat fishing spot (big net, harpoon)
Boat fishing spot (big net, harpoon).intro: A fishing spot with big net and harpoon options can be found just north of Musa Point . The spot never moves or despawns. It can only be accessed by sailing to it, and fish can only be caught from a raft . All raw and cooked fish that can be caught here may be stored in a cargo hold , though the miscellaneous junk from big net fishing can not.

Ogre.title: Ogre
Ogre.intro: Ogres are a monster found throughout Gielinor , most notably the ogre city of Gu'Tanoth .

Ice troll grunt.title: Ice troll grunt
Ice troll grunt.intro: Ice troll grunts are the foot soldiers of the Ice Troll King on the nothernmost isles of Jatizso and Neitiznot . They can occasionally hit hard through armour although Protect from Melee prevents all damage. The island immediately north of Neitiznot can be an effective training area if one uses the Honour guards that are always fighting the trolls to assist them.

Mountain troll.title: Mountain troll
Mountain troll.intro: Mountain trolls are aggressive creatures which can be found patrolling various mountainous areas. They are commonly killed as part of an assigned Slayer task of " trolls ".

Ice troll.title: Ice troll
Ice troll.intro: Ice trolls (also styled as Ice Trolls ) are level 120-124 monsters encountered during Desert Treasure I when the player is trying to get the Ice diamond . Five trolls have to be killed to gain access to the ice cave on the eastern side. They are also encountered during Troll Romance where the player has to navigate through the cave leading to Trollweiss Mountain .

Troll general.title: Troll general
Troll general.intro: Troll generals are huge and powerful trolls that live in the Troll Stronghold , on the top floor.

Suqah.title: Suqah
Suqah.intro: Suqah ( / s uː k w ɑː / SOO -kwah ) are a race of strange-looking but powerful creatures indigenous to Lunar Isle . Players must have at least started Lunar Diplomacy to have access to Lunar Isle. Despite their fearsome nature, they have a peaceful relationship with the Moon Clan , but are aggressive to outsiders, effectively serving as guards.

Giant Champion.title: Giant Champion
Giant Champion.intro: The Giant Champion is a giant who can only be fought after receiving the giant champion scroll as part of the Champion's Challenge minigame.

Zombie (Sepulchre of Death).title: Zombie (Sepulchre of Death)
Zombie (Sepulchre of Death).intro: The zombie is a monster that resides in the fourth level of the Stronghold of Security , the Sepulchre of Death . It is found next to the ladder leading to the current floor alongside several shades . Combat experience gained while fighting the zombie is drastically reduced; the player will gain 1 experience for 10 damage dealt.

Gorak.title: Gorak
Gorak.intro: Goraks are aggressive monsters found in the Gorak Plane (fairy ring D I R ) which attack with typeless melee that also drains stats. They are typically first encountered during the Fairytale II - Cure a Queen quest, where they are slain for their claws to make the magic essence potion . Several goraks can also be found in the God Wars Dungeon , aligned with Zamorak . Outside of the God Wars Dungeon, goraks are never tolerant t

"Full" Gorak drop table › Gem drop table

Gorad.title: Gorad
Gorad.intro: Gorad is an ogre who lives on an island north of Feldip Hills . He is killed during the Watchtower quest . He always drops the Ogre tooth required to get the second part of the Ogre relic . Upon killing Gorad, the Ogre tooth appears in your inventory and not on the ground, so you must have an empty inventory space to receive it.

City guard.title: City guard
City guard.intro: Ogre city guards can be found in the middle of Gu'Tanoth . Four bridges must be crossed to reach them. To cross these bridges, a rock cake from the market and 20 coins must be brought. During the Watchtower Quest , they provide players with a Skavid map .

Enclave guard.title: Enclave guard
Enclave guard.intro: Enclave guards are ogres that guard the Ogre Enclave dungeon in the heart of Gu'Tanoth . During the Watchtower quest, players must use a cave nightshade on them twice (on different occasions) in order to be able to enter the enclave. After the quest, a cave nightshade does not have to be used to enter the cave, but the following message will appear: You run past the guard while he's busy.

Ogre chieftain.title: Ogre chieftain
Ogre chieftain.intro: Ogre chieftains are ogres that can be found in the Feldip Hills and inside the Ogre Enclave . Players can kill ogre chieftains towards an ogre Slayer task .

Icelord.title: Icelord
Icelord.intro: The icelords are icy beings found inside the iceberg , and are encountered during the Cold War quest . They were found when Pescaling Pax moved much of the penguin population to the iceberg to prepare for the invasion of Gielinor . Some icelords enjoy hurling large icicles at their enemies, while others prefer to use their four arms to pummel them into submission.

Dad.title: Dad
Dad.intro: Dad is an abnormally large troll that players must fight during the Troll Stronghold quest to gain access to northern Troll Country . After the quest, he can be re-fought in the Nightmare Zone minigame .

Glod.title: Glod
Glod.intro: Glod is a huge, muscular cloud giant who can be found on the cloud at the top of the magic beanstalk in the Grim Tales quest. He has a Combat level of 138. Glod has the ability to bellow threats at players to either make them run in fear of the huge giant or charge at him in anger. He can also heal himself, similar to the gorillas on Ape Atoll, as well as boost his Attack and Strength, making him a bit harder to kill. When Glo

Giant Roc.title: Giant Roc
Giant Roc.intro: The Giant Roc is a large avian monster encountered during the quest My Arm's Big Adventure .

Sea troll.title: Sea troll
Sea troll.intro: Sea trolls are trolls encountered during the Swan Song quest . They first ambush the player and the Wise Old Man when first entering the colony. Players may also encounter sea trolls while fishing for fresh monkfish during the quest. After completing the quest, Sea trolls will no longer attack the player while fishing for monkfish.

Kraka.title: Kraka
Kraka.intro: Kraka is a level 91 troll found on Death Plateau . Like the rest of the "big, bad" trolls in the area, such as Stick , Pee Hat , and Rock , he drops a rune warhammer or granite shield , and as such is commonly hunted by ironmen looking to upgrade their armour .

Giant frog.title: Giant frog
Giant frog.intro: Giant frogs are monsters found in the Lumbridge Swamp , the Lumbridge Swamp Caves and Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon . The level 99 variants are the toughest monster in the dungeon. They are found to the south of the cave system, just outside the entrance to Juna 's Chasm of Tears .

Ice troll female.title: Ice troll female
Ice troll female.intro: Ice troll females are most commonly found near the smaller ice troll runts . They use powerful Ranged attacks that hit hard and fast. The damage dealt by these females can be reduced to 2 by equipping a Neitiznot shield made during The Fremennik Isles . However, the shield doesn't affect the accuracy of the attacks. Their accuracy seem to neglect all defence bonuses from stats and equipment; hence, they almost always are able

Ice troll runt.title: Ice troll runt
Ice troll runt.intro: Ice troll runts are the lowest levels of Ice trolls found on Jatizso and Neitiznot . Despite possessing only a slightly higher combat level than Mountain trolls , they can hit much harder (up to 17) and are much more aggressive, often attempting to engage the player from several squares away. They also have the ability to hit through armour, similar to Verac the Defiled . Yak-hide armour does not reduce the troll's maximum hit

Mammoth.title: Mammoth
Mammoth.intro: Mammoths are a species of elephant-like creatures that inhabit the area south-east of the Ferox Enclave . They are not very intelligent.

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Stick.title: Stick
Stick.intro: Stick is a troll found on Death Plateau . While not as strong as the nearby Rock , he can hit a max of 27, although this can be completely blocked with Protect from Melee . Like the rest of the "big", "bad" trolls in the area, such as Rock, Pee Hat , and Kraka , he can drop a rune warhammer or granite shield , making him a common target for ironman accounts.

Rock (Troll).title: Rock (Troll)
Rock (Troll).intro: Rock is the strongest troll on Death Plateau . He possesses a higher max hit and attacks 2 ticks faster than Stick , who spawns next to him.

Pee Hat.title: Pee Hat
Pee Hat.intro: Pee Hat is a level 91 troll found on Death Plateau . Like the rest of the "big, bad" trolls in the area, such as Stick , Kraka , and Rock , he drops a rune warhammer or granite shield , and as such is commonly hunted by ironmen looking to upgrade their armour .

Thrower Troll.title: Thrower Troll
Thrower Troll.intro: A Thrower Troll is a troll that attacks with ranged . They are relatively annoying monsters that throw rocks at passing adventurers, regardless of being engaged in combat or not. They are rarely ever on their own, preferring to be together in groups. Unlike most other monsters, the thrower troll's attacks are always successful hits . As they are found in multi-way areas, being attacked by three or more thrower trolls at once c

Ice troll male.title: Ice troll male
Ice troll male.intro: Ice troll males inhabit the islands north of Jatizso and Neitiznot . They use melee attacks that hit a maximum of 20 hitpoints.

Moss Guardian.title: Moss Guardian
Moss Guardian.intro: Moss Guardians are the guardian spirits of Glarial's Tomb , and are significantly larger and stronger than ordinary moss giants . They are encountered during the Waterfall Quest when the player enters the tomb to obtain Glarial's amulet , and must later be killed during the Roving Elves quest to obtain the consecration seed . They can only be fought unarmed, as it is impossible to take weapons, armour, ammunition or runes into

Nail beast.title: Nail beast
Nail beast.intro: Nail beasts are encountered on all three paths of the Temple Trekking minigame and are the only monster to drop nail beast nails . The combat levels of Nail beasts are based on the difficulty (length) of the event chosen: they are level 69 on easy (long), level 98 on medium (medium), and level 141 on hard (short). The number encountered also depends on the chosen escortee: with an easy escortee, players will see three Nail bea

Twig.title: Twig
Twig.intro: Twig is a troll that guards the prison in Troll Stronghold . He appears in the Troll Stronghold quest , and holds the cell key 1 , which opens Godric 's cell.

Khazard Ogre.title: Khazard Ogre
Khazard Ogre.intro: The Khazard Ogre is a monster fought during Fight Arena . After it is defeated, General Khazard will send out a Khazard Scorpion to fight next. This is General Khazard 's 4th best creature who is used to fight against the Slave fighters along with Bouncer and the Khazard Scorpion.

Berry.title: Berry
Berry.intro: Berry is a troll that guards the prison in the Troll Stronghold . During the Troll Stronghold quest , players must either fight or pickpocket him (requiring 30 Thieving ) to obtain the cell key 2 , which opens the cell where Eadgar is held.

Troll spectator.title: Troll spectator
Troll spectator.intro: Troll spectators are trolls found in the Troll arena , where fights with Dad and Arrg take place. They watch instead of fight, just as the name suggests. They may be battled though, and are exactly the same as mountain trolls . They are non-aggressive, but if the player kills Dad, they will immediately attempt to attack the player.

Muttadile.title: Muttadile
Muttadile.intro: The Muttadiles are bosses encountered in the Chambers of Xeric . Originally a stray dog , it was horribly mutated into a giant crocodilian beast by Xeric . The original muttadile was pregnant at the time when Xeric transformed it into its current form and as such its offspring was warped too. The two beasts now act as guardians of the chambers.

Skeletal Mystic.title: Skeletal Mystic
Skeletal Mystic.intro: Skeletal Mystics are skeleton mages found within the Chambers of Xeric .

Ogress Shaman.title: Ogress Shaman
Ogress Shaman.intro: These ogresses only utilise magical attacks. They share a similar drop table to Ogress Warriors .

Ogress Warrior.title: Ogress Warrior
Ogress Warrior.intro: Ogress Warriors are found in the Corsair Cove Dungeon . They are a good way for free-to-play ironmen to obtain rune battleaxes and rune full helms , as well as law and nature runes .

Lizardman shaman (Chambers of Xeric).title: Lizardman shaman (Chambers of Xeric)
Lizardman shaman (Chambers of Xeric).intro: Lizardman shamans are monsters found in the Chambers of Xeric , in the lizardmen shaman room. They do not count for Sherlock's master clue step that requires players to kill a lizardman shaman.

Sotetseg.title: Sotetseg
Sotetseg.intro: Sotetseg is the fourth encounter in the Theatre of Blood . It is a dark beast that has been corrupted through Haemalchemy . Despite this, Sotetseg does not count for a dark beast Slayer task.

Thrower troll (Trollheim).title: Thrower troll (Trollheim)
Thrower troll (Trollheim).intro: A thrower troll is a troll that attacks with ranged . They are aggressive monsters that throw rocks at passing adventurers, regardless of being engaged in combat or not. They are rarely ever on their own, preferring to be together in groups. Unlike most other monsters, the thrower troll's attacks are always successful hits . As they are found in multi-way areas, being attacked by three or more thrower trolls at once can be dea

Sourhog.title: Sourhog
Sourhog.intro: A sourhog is a boar-like monster introduced in A Porcine of Interest . It requires reinforced goggles to kill, or a Slayer helmet after the quest. If no protection is worn, the caustic saliva they spit will burn the player's eyes, draining the player's current Attack and Defence by 90% and cause 20-30 damage each hit accompanied by the player exclaiming Argh! My eyes! . Sourhogs are aggressive to players regardless of their co

tables.heading: Drops › Rare and Gem drop table

Headless Beast.title: Headless Beast
Headless Beast.intro: The Headless Beast is a headless undead bear encountered during the Getting Ahead quest . It was resurrected by the inexperienced necromancer Neilan Redmark . The Headless Beast attacks mainly with melee. It has a special attack where it slams the ground, causing a rock to fall from the ceiling onto the player's current location, dealing 12-16 damage. This can easily be avoided simply by moving one tile away in any direction.

Cyclops (God Wars Dungeon).title: Cyclops (God Wars Dungeon)
Cyclops (God Wars Dungeon).intro: Ancient horned cyclopes can be found in the God Wars Dungeon , as part of the Bandosian army. They are aggressive unless the player has a Bandosian item equipped, and killing them will contribute to the required kill count to enter General Graardor 's arena.

Frenzied ice troll runt.title: Frenzied ice troll runt
Frenzied ice troll runt.intro: Frenzied ice troll runts are a variant of ice troll runt found exclusively on the western side of the Ice Troll Caves , in the Fremennik Isles north of Jatizso and Neitiznot . They are primarily fought during The Fremennik Isles quest , in the joint assault by the islanders, and do not drop any loot.

Frenzied ice troll female.title: Frenzied ice troll female
Frenzied ice troll female.intro: Frenzied ice troll females are a variant of ice troll female found exclusively on the western side of the Ice Troll Caves (with one on the eastern side), in the Fremennik Isles north of Jatizso and Neitiznot . They are primarily fought during The Fremennik Isles quest , in the joint assault by the islanders, and do not drop any loot.

Frenzied ice troll grunt.title: Frenzied ice troll grunt
Frenzied ice troll grunt.intro: Frenzied ice troll grunts are a variant of ice troll grunt found exclusively on the western side of the Ice Troll Caves , in the Fremennik Isles north of Jatizso and Neitiznot . They are primarily fought during The Fremennik Isles quest , in the joint assault by the islanders, and do not drop any loot.

Frenzied ice troll male.title: Frenzied ice troll male
Frenzied ice troll male.intro: Frenzied ice troll males are a variant of ice troll male found exclusively on the western side of the Ice Troll Caves , in the Fremennik Isles north of Jatizso and Neitiznot . They are primarily fought during The Fremennik Isles quest , in the joint assault by the islanders, and do not drop any loot.

Moss Guardian (Nightmare Zone).title: Moss Guardian (Nightmare Zone)
Moss Guardian (Nightmare Zone).intro: A variant of the Moss Guardian can be encountered within the Nightmare Zone after completion of Roving Elves .

Arrg (Nightmare Zone).title: Arrg (Nightmare Zone)
Arrg (Nightmare Zone).intro: Arrg is a boss that can be encountered in the Nightmare Zone . He is a version of the regular Arrg encountered in the Troll Romance quest.

Black Knight Titan (Nightmare Zone).title: Black Knight Titan (Nightmare Zone)
Black Knight Titan (Nightmare Zone).intro: The Black Knight Titan is a boss that can be encountered in the Nightmare Zone . He is a version of the regular Black Knight Titan encountered in the Holy Grail quest. Like his normal counterpart, his attacks are slow and inaccurate, but he should be fought with Melee, as he has incredibly high Ranged and Magic defence.

Skeleton Hellhound (Nightmare Zone).title: Skeleton Hellhound (Nightmare Zone)
Skeleton Hellhound (Nightmare Zone).intro: The Skeleton Hellhound is a boss that can be encountered in the Nightmare Zone . It is a version of the regular Skeleton Hellhound encountered in the In Search of the Myreque quest.

Dad (Nightmare Zone).title: Dad (Nightmare Zone)
Dad (Nightmare Zone).intro: Dad is a boss that can be encountered in the Nightmare Zone . He is a version of the regular Dad encountered in the Troll Stronghold quest.

Giant Roc (Nightmare Zone).title: Giant Roc (Nightmare Zone)
Giant Roc (Nightmare Zone).intro: The Giant Roc is a boss that can be encountered in the Nightmare Zone . It is a version of the regular Giant Roc encountered in the My Arm's Big Adventure quest.

Glod (Nightmare Zone).title: Glod (Nightmare Zone)
Glod (Nightmare Zone).intro: Glod is a boss that can be encountered in the Nightmare Zone . He is a version of the regular Glod encountered in the Grim Tales quest.

Feral Vampyre.title: Feral Vampyre
Feral Vampyre.intro: Feral Vampyres are a type of vampyre that can be found in the Haunted Woods , near the Abandoned Mine , and in the God Wars Dungeon (Zamorak aligned). They are aggressive, and will attack anyone. They are stronger than other vampyres like juveniles and most juvinates , but can be harmed by all weapons . Feral vampyres always drop vampyre dust . Having garlic in your inventory does not weaken feral vampyres.

Werewolf.title: Werewolf
Werewolf.intro: Werewolves are found in Canifis . They appear as level 24 humans wandering the village until they are attacked, causing them to transform into level 88 werewolves unless the player attacks with Wolfbane , in which case they will remain in human form as long as it is equipped. They will always drop wolf bones , regardless of their form upon death. However, their human and werewolf forms have a separate loot table.

Aviansie.title: Aviansie
Aviansie.intro: Aviansie are avian monsters found in both the God Wars Dungeon and Wilderness God Wars Dungeon . Like other creatures within the dungeon, they can be found fighting for their god Armadyl , engaging in combat against the followers of Zamorak .

Knight of Saradomin.title: Knight of Saradomin
Knight of Saradomin.intro: Knights of Saradomin can only be found inside the God Wars Dungeon . They are found in the main area and in Saradomin's Encampment . These knights are hard to kill, so it is recommended that a player uses strong weapons and armour, as well as having high combat levels. However, their defence is low and numerous safespots are available to rangers and mages . They have very poor drops, but are generally killed by medium level pl

Ork.title: Ork
Ork.intro: Orks are stocky, green-skinned humanoids. They have small tusks protruding from their jaws, and prefer to wield large axes and/or maces. They can be found in the God Wars Dungeon , in the army of Bandos .

Grand Gold Chest.title: Grand Gold Chest
Grand Gold Chest.intro: The Grand Gold Chest can be found and looted in every room when playing the Pyramid Plunder minigame, providing Thieving experience, artefacts, and a chance to obtain the Pharaoh's sceptre . The chance of receiving a Pharaoh's sceptre scales depending on the room where it is situated, upon searching the Grand Gold Chest regardless of if the player fails or succeeds the search.

Sarcophagus (Pyramid Plunder).title: Sarcophagus (Pyramid Plunder)
Sarcophagus (Pyramid Plunder).intro: Several sarcophagi are found in the Jalsavrah Pyramid during the Pyramid Plunder minigame . Opening a closed sarcophagus gives strength experience and has a chance of awakening a mummy which will attack the player that searched the sarcophagus.

Dark Chest.title: Dark Chest
Dark Chest.intro: The Dark Chest is a chest in the basement of the Crumbling Tower on the Isle of Souls . It can be opened with a dark key for 1,500 Thieving experience, which uses up the key.

Shrine.title: Shrine
Shrine.intro: The shrine is an altar located within the Woodcutting Guild . Players can recharge their prayer points here.

Minotaur.title: Minotaur
Minotaur.intro: Minotaur are found on level one of the Stronghold of Security . They drop the right skull half , one of four parts of the skull sceptre . These monsters are great for training due to their low Defence , but have high attack damage making them dangerous for un-equipped players.

Catablepon.title: Catablepon
Catablepon.intro: Catablepon are magical creatures that appear to be green bulls with reptilian tails. They are found on the third level of the Stronghold of Security . They drop the top of sceptre , one of four parts of the Skull sceptre .

Flesh Crawler.title: Flesh Crawler
Flesh Crawler.intro: Flesh Crawlers are medium level monsters found in the second level of the Stronghold of Security . They drop the bottom of sceptre , one of four parts of the skull sceptre . Flesh crawlers drop herbs often, and are frequently killed for their uncommon grimy ranarr drops.

tables.heading: Members' worlds drops › Gem drop table
Free-to-play worlds drops › Gem drop table

Seed pack.title: Seed pack
Seed pack.intro: A seed pack is an item received from Guildmaster Jane as a reward for completing a farming contract , or purchased from Farmer Gricoller for 30 Tithe Farm points.

tables.heading: Average loot value › Tithe farm seed packs

Crab.title: Crab
Crab.intro: Crabs are found only in an undersea crab pen located in the Mogre Camp underneath Port Khazard . Crabs can be killed for crab meat , which is an ingredient of fishcake , used in the Freeing Pirate Pete subquest of Recipe for Disaster . They will occasionally drop a fresh crab claw or fresh crab shell , which can be crafted into a crab claw glove and crab helmet , respectively. They will also sometimes drop an oyster .

Lizardman.title: Lizardman
Lizardman.intro: Lizardmen are reptilian humanoids that inhabit the Kebos Lowlands and within the Lizardman Canyon . Secretly created from a native species of lizard during the 37th decade (1,040 years ago) under the rule of King Shayzien VII, he had intended the lizardmen to become his personal army to enforce his tyrannical rule of Great Kourend. After he returned from the dead as Xeric , the lizardmen continued to serve him loyally, seeing

Lizardman brute.title: Lizardman brute
Lizardman brute.intro: Lizardmen brute are reptilian humanoids that inhabit the Lizardman Canyon , the Lizardman Settlement and the Battlefront .

Stone chest.title: Stone chest
Stone chest.intro: Stone chests are thievable chests in the Lizardman Temple that require level 64 Thieving to steal from. Each stone chest yields 280 experience , and the chest's loot respawns instantly. Because of this, players can expect to gain over 85,000 experience per hour by thieving from stone chests. These chests are the only non-combat method of obtaining a Xeric's talisman .

Rabbit (Prifddinas).title: Rabbit (Prifddinas)
Rabbit (Prifddinas).intro: The rabbit is a monster that is found in a cave in the Gwenith Hunter area north of Prifddinas . Despite its low combat level, it is extremely dangerous, possessing as much health as the Corporeal Beast and dealing high damage coupled with a high attack speed. Unlike most monsters, the rabbit's Magic defence roll is calculated using its Defence level rather than its Magic level.

Elf (Thieving).title: Elf (Thieving)
Elf (Thieving).intro: Elves are citizens of Lletya and Prifddinas that can be talked to as well as pickpocketed from with level 85 Thieving . A player can only access the Lletya elves after starting Mourning's End Part I and the Prifddinas elves after completing Song of the Elves .

Guard (Prifddinas).title: Guard (Prifddinas)
Guard (Prifddinas).intro: Prifddinas guards can be found near each of the four main Prifddinas entrances, as well as in the Prifddinas Marketplace in the Meilyr district. They are notable for having the highest combat level of any guard of any city in Gielinor . They can be killed as an alternative for an elf Slayer task .

Iorwerth Warrior.title: Iorwerth Warrior
Iorwerth Warrior.intro: Iorwerth Warriors can be found in the Iorwerth Camp just south-west of Prifddinas . They are featured heavily during the Regicide quest . Players who have completed Regicide can receive them as a Slayer task .

Crystal impling jar.title: Crystal impling jar
Crystal impling jar.intro: The crystal impling jar is the result of successfully catching a crystal impling , while also having an empty impling jar . Level 80 Hunter is required to catch them.

Grubby Chest.title: Grubby Chest
Grubby Chest.intro: The Grubby Chest can be found on the south-west corner of the Forthos Dungeon , behind a locked gate that requires level 57 Thieving to open. The chest is locked and can only be opened by using a grubby key , which is obtained from killing monsters in the Forthos Dungeon. There is a warning message when attempting to open the chest with fewer than 11 free inventory spaces, which can be disabled.

Crystal impling.title: Crystal impling
Crystal impling.intro: The crystal impling is the third highest-level impling that can be caught in Gielinor . Players require at least 80 Hunter (or level 74 with a super hunter potion ) to capture this type of impling with a butterfly net , and optionally an impling jar . At level 90 Hunter, crystal implings can be caught barehanded. Capturing a crystal impling grants 280 Hunter experience .

Raw swordtip squid.title: Raw swordtip squid
Raw swordtip squid.intro: Raw swordtip squid is a fish caught by lantern harpooning , requiring level 52 Fishing alongside a lantern and harpoon . With lantern fishing spots exclusive to certain islands at sea, the minimum Sailing level to catch them is 47, the level required to dock at the Onyx Crest .

Golem (sunstone).title: Golem (sunstone)
Golem (sunstone).intro: Golems are a part of the golem crafting activity found on Wyrmscraig . In order to start building one, players need to place four sunstones onto an empty plinth, then shaping the golem from each side. Once fully shaped, a sunstone core must be placed into the front of it, alongside a hunter fur in the inventory or in a fur pouch .

Raw jumbo squid.title: Raw jumbo squid
Raw jumbo squid.intro: Raw jumbo squid is a fish caught by lantern harpooning , requiring level 69 Fishing alongside a lantern and harpoon . With lantern fishing spots exclusive to certain islands at sea, the minimum Sailing level to catch them is 47, the level required to dock at the Onyx Crest .

Wall safe.title: Wall safe
Wall safe.intro: Wall safes are found at the end of the maze within the Rogues' Den , where eight are installed on the central pillar in the very last room of the minigame. Players can attempt to crack one of these safes for a chance at obtaining a rogue kit or rogue's equipment crate , the latter of which containing pieces of the rogue equipment set. Cracking these safes will complete the necessary task for the Falador Hard Diary .

Pirate shipwreck.title: Pirate shipwreck
Pirate shipwreck.intro: Pirate shipwrecks are a type of salvageable shipwreck found at sea, requiring level 64 Sailing to salvage from with a salvaging hook . Pirate shipwrecks will yield plundered salvage , granting 76 Sailing experience; these can then be sorted at a salvaging station (or the boat facility ), granting loot and an additional 31.5 Sailing experience.

Hammerhead shark.title: Hammerhead shark
Hammerhead shark.intro: Hammerhead sharks are monsters found in the Western Ocean , Sunset Ocean , and Ardent Ocean . The player may be assigned to kill them as a bounty task starting at 40 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Port Khazard .

Barracuda shipwreck.title: Barracuda shipwreck
Barracuda shipwreck.intro: Barracuda shipwrecks are a type of salvageable shipwreck typically found near sites hosting Barracuda Trials , requiring level 35 Sailing to salvage from with a salvaging hook . Barracuda shipwrecks will yield barracuda salvage , granting 31 Sailing experience; these can then be sorted at a salvaging station (or the boat facility ), granting loot and an additional 15.5 Sailing experience.

Mercenary shipwreck.title: Mercenary shipwreck
Mercenary shipwreck.intro: Mercenary shipwrecks are a type of salvageable shipwreck found at sea, requiring level 73 Sailing to salvage from with a salvaging hook . Mercenary shipwrecks will yield martial salvage , granting 138 Sailing experience; these can then be sorted at a salvaging station (or the boat facility ), granting loot and an additional 63.5 Sailing experience.

Barronite rocks.title: Barronite rocks
Barronite rocks.intro: Barronite rocks are found in the Ruins of Camdozaal that contain barronite shards and have a small chance of giving a barronite deposit when mined. The Varrock platebody does not give a chance of receiving double deposits.

Quiz Master.title: Quiz Master
Quiz Master.intro: The Quiz Master is part of a random event in which the player is told " It's your lucky day! " and given the option to be teleported to an unknown area to play a game of Odd One Out.

Bottle of puzzlers poteen.title: Bottle of puzzlers poteen
Bottle of puzzlers poteen.intro: A bottle of puzzlers poteen is an alcoholic drink acquired by prying open a sealed crate to the north-west of the Isle of Serpents . Doing so requires a crowbar in the inventory, which in turn requires completion of Prying Times to obtain. It is one of few sailing drinks that can be sampled more than once, allowing players to retake the quiz, although each of the rewards may only be received once.

Merchant shipwreck.title: Merchant shipwreck
Merchant shipwreck.intro: Merchant shipwrecks are a type of salvageable shipwreck found at sea, requiring level 87 Sailing to salvage from with a salvaging hook . Merchant shipwrecks will yield opulent salvage , granting 200 Sailing experience; these can then be sorted at a salvaging station (or the boat facility ), granting loot and an additional 95 Sailing experience.

Small shipwreck.title: Small shipwreck
Small shipwreck.intro: Small shipwrecks are a type of salvageable shipwreck found at sea, requiring level 15 Sailing to salvage from with a salvaging hook . Small shipwrecks will yield small salvage , granting 10 Sailing experience; these can then be sorted at a salvaging station (or the boat facility ), granting loot and an additional 5.5 Sailing experience.

Fisherman's shipwreck.title: Fisherman's shipwreck
Fisherman's shipwreck.intro: Fisherman's shipwrecks are a type of salvageable shipwreck found at sea, requiring level 26 Sailing to salvage from with a salvaging hook . Fisherman's shipwrecks will yield fishy salvage , granting 17 Sailing experience; these can then be sorted at a salvaging station (or the boat facility ), granting loot and an additional 9 Sailing experience.

Bull shark.title: Bull shark
Bull shark.intro: Bull sharks are monsters that can be found in the Western Ocean and Ardent Ocean . The player may be assigned to kill them as a bounty task starting at 30 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Musa Point .

Tiger shark.title: Tiger shark
Tiger shark.intro: Tiger sharks are monsters found in the Western Ocean , Sunset Ocean , and Ardent Ocean . The player may be assigned to kill them as a bounty task starting at 55 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from the Red Rock and Port Piscarilius .

Large shipwreck.title: Large shipwreck
Large shipwreck.intro: Large shipwrecks are a type of salvageable shipwreck found at sea, requiring level 53 Sailing to salvage from with a salvaging hook . Large shipwrecks will yield large salvage , granting 48 Sailing experience; these can then be sorted at a salvaging station (or the boat facility ), granting loot and an additional 24 Sailing experience.

Fremennik shipwreck.title: Fremennik shipwreck
Fremennik shipwreck.intro: Fremennik shipwrecks are a type of salvageable shipwreck found at sea, requiring level 80 Sailing to salvage from with a salvaging hook . Fremennik shipwrecks will yield Fremennik salvage , granting 162 Sailing experience; these can then be sorted at a salvaging station (or the boat facility ), granting loot and an additional 75 Sailing experience.

Fish stall (Port Roberts).title: Fish stall (Port Roberts)
Fish stall (Port Roberts).intro: Fish stall is a stall in Port Roberts which may be stolen from starting at level 42 Thieving , granting 49.5 Thieving experience . This stall does not deplete when stolen from unlike other stalls throughout Gielinor. Three market guards patrol the area in a set pattern, allowing the player to steal several times before they can be caught.

Fishing spot (lantern).title: Fishing spot (lantern)
Fishing spot (lantern).intro: Fishing spots for lantern harpooning can be found at The Onyx Crest , Laguna Aurorae , Wintumber Island , and Buccaneers' Haven , requiring a Sailing level of 47, 58, 63, 76 respectively. They can be fished for raw swordtip squid and raw jumbo squid .
